lhordordo keke/ khardo ༷༷/ // — /
zhwa ga tho/ bsgo 'arje sa2 /sadzarnanyi —she ma ྾kho sar+yaspyorje/ ྾/ /das / — kephro sha li/ tsher+ṣa / ོ /྾ go

ra da/ /dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈mes po'i shul bzhag/〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo ba tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btang/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgom bzhengasate srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/ rang re'i mes pa'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyasadang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe sgrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ sgol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhesapa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu —1—

che bo'i shu ba las klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag// ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon phyon mes po mkhasadabang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'a ma dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsisarig sogasab phragarig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/'di 'dra'i dpe skrun mnyam las kyi go skabs legs po nged cag dpe sgrun khang la sgob pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag/〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tsugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams —2—

dpe sgrunagasal bshad/myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khad yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung ga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang /mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegasazhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyasadang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhababs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snyeng thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/ 'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'a ga mi nyung ba yod srid pas daphyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsal gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes10la/—3—

sngon 'atso zhu tshigade la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi snyo 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ spyod sgrub kyi shing rta ོ po lo brgyad rjes 'brang dang 4sa pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' sgol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su bre 'i ོ giri ོ ge sde' la ba thun mang ga gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngan brjad ba ོ /re zur sha ོ ོོ ge 2)sbyar/ skar sa dze+e rtsas/ sgra bza gas sags mad sngags ga gnas dang 4sa pa'i g.yi lugs zab cing rgya che ba tsha la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad kha lngar gsum dang / spyod sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar sgol btod/bar du gakha la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas bto ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du ba.as so cog gi glegs bam thamasacad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam snyo / chos ོ gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengasapar byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya bal sto sogs kyi yul gru kun khang dar khyab che/da lta'i oṃ bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag ung mo de/ dper na/—1—

me lo shugazhagalag klo༄ ོ rab 'byams kyigasung 'bum/oka si phor dhi dang / spyor wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi sgob grwa chen mo rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod pa ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde ོ dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/chos sgon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degasapa'i ka chen ba / /zhesadang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /shes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gasdong lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen ba dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bca brgyad rjes 'brang dang ba sa pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig /bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus sgog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phral yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/ de dag lasamang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis —2

sngon 'gra'i zhu tshigasems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/rig gnas gsar brje mjug sgril ba dang changs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phras te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrigadape sgrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so sa'i 'bas bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su sbyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyisabazhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyisaganang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gsa'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar gzhan gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngagasakyi gzhung bshad dang / chas 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams —3—

me tsho shu bsalag klong cha rab tsomasakyi gsung khrum/gsos/ 'khrugs pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa sogs rim pa bstar chags su par du sgrun dang bsgrun rtsis las/ da lan nga tshos 1nga chen rab 'byams pa'i snying zig ya bzhi dang / mdzod bdun/ngal gso skor gsum/ gsung thor bu bcasapod nyer drug 'tshol bsdu thub pa mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi nang du bsgrigs te/ rgya che'i 1ga pa po rnams kyi spyan zung yangs pa'i 'bab stegs su 'bul rgyu yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsal gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/zhor 'phros gsal 'debasazhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / semasakyi sgo grosabakra ba'i gzhan skyes rnamasal mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chas dang rig gnas slob gnyer byed/ 'khas bstun gyi sri zhus lasaka cung zad re sgrub nus na/ mes rgyal la zhabs tag 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyesal la/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chas mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhus/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khrusapo thub bstan nyi mas/ spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshesal gus phul/—4—

ra / /bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang / khyad par snga 'gyur ring lugs yongs su gsal bar mdzad pa'i/ kun mkhyen 1nga chen rab 'byams kyi gsung chos rnyed tshad phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par du skrun pa la/de yang mdzod bdun dang mun sel skor gsum sogs ni bla rung nang bstan slob :nga nas gsar skrun ji bzhin sor bzhag yin zhing / de yang mdzod bdun ni a 'dzoms dang / sde dge'i shing par ma/ dpal yul dgon du bzhugasapa'i thris ma dang / gzhan yang sngar 'bras spungs dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa chos dbyings mdzod jesam dang / theg mtshog mdzod gung thang par ma dang / rdzong sar n+d+ras rnying sogs phan tshun dpe bsdur zhus pa'i gsal bshad kyang chos tshan so sa'i bsdur mchan du bkod yod/ snying thig ya bzhi dang / ngal gso skor gsum sogs ni sde dge'i par ma ma phyi gtso bo la/ mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas mchis pa rnams/ a 'dzoms par mar dag bsdur zhus te mi 'dra ba dag(〈a〉mi 'dra ba'i yig 'byu)gug rtags 'di'i nang bas yod/ 'grel mchan yod rigs rnamasashing par ji bzhin sgog klad du 'khrid stabs ma bde bas dkyus tshig dang phreng gral gcig tu bkod de gzhung yig dang mchan gnyis rtsing zhi so sor phyesashing / dpe deb kyi dum mtshams dag ma phyi lasayar bsnan mar dbris cung zad dang bcasapod che chung snyoms thabasabyasayod/ dpe —5—

me bo'i shulabasalag klong ོ rab tsoms kyi gsung la ma/deb thams cad kyi mgor chos ོ so sor gzigs pa stabs bde yong ba'i ched dkar chag da lta'i dpe deb spyo 'gros ltar bkod pa las gaspyod don dngos la ma dpe ltar sor bzhag byas yod/ dus rkyen 'pho 'gyur ci rigs pas 'thor rgyar song nas ma phyi re re tsam las ma bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon rigs dang / do dam dpe mang gi mdzod du bskyil ba'i rnyed 'tshol dka' ba rnams kyang gang nus ci lcog gis/ 'gro song dang ngal ba la ma 'dzems par btsal 'tshol bgyis khul du/ rgya che'i chos lugs las rigs mi sna dang / gzhan skyes rig gnas lhur len pa tsho'i bsam bla'i dpal yon dang / zhi bde 'a ma mthun sogs mdor na da lta'i spyi tshogs 'dir phan du re ba dang / ma 'ongs mi rabs phyi mar yun du gnas pa'i rkyen grogs su 'gyur na snyam pa'i re 'dun gyis/ rtsis 'khrul gyi par gzhir bas ste 'gremasaspel zhusapa lags na/ rgya che'i gzigasapa po/ blo dkar gzhud drang gi gzur gnas dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi rogasa'adegs ci lcog gnang ba thugs rje che zhu/bod ljongasadapal brtsegasabod yig dpe rnying zhi 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/—6—

༈ rtsom pa lo rnam thar mdor bsdus/1nga ོ rab stims pa dri med 'od zer ni/ lho kha gra nang du yab sngags 'chang bstan pa srung dang / yum 'brom bza' bsod nams rgyan zur /kye zur ma sna/spro ma 1ste /spyo la snaganyas sras su rab byung lnga pa' sa pha la la 1308lar sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga tsam nas yi ge 'bri klog bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bdun nas bzung lo 'ga' shasakyi ring yab las phur pa sogs kyi man ngag khyag bzhes dang sman rtsis sogs thun mong gi rig gnas 'ga' byang chub par mdzad/ bcu gnyis par bsam yas su mkhan po bsam 'grub rin ོ las rab tu byung ste mo tshul khrims blo gros su gsol/ de nas slob dpon bkra rin/ btsan dgon pa/ bla brang pa chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ chos grags gnyis par grags pa gar+ṣa nu rin chen/ blo gros brtan pa/ r+ṣa rje rang byung rdo rje/ shug gseb rin po che/ saskya'i bla ma bdag kho ོ po/ bla ma khro phu pa sogs mo nyid dang ldan pa'i spyos gnyen r+sā phrag gnyis lhag tshul bzhin bsten te/ bod yul du grags pa'i gzhung lugs man ngag ba sa pa dang / thun mong shes bya'i rig gnas phal cher gsan cing sgo 'dogs legs par bcad/ lhag par du rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza'i drung nas gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi gdams pa mtha' dag nyams khrid du gsan nas bya bral kun spangs kho nas/ mchims phu la sogasadaben —7—

che bo'i shu bsal klong ོ rab tshomasakyi gsung 'bum/gnas dag tu zas gos sogs kyis mthun rkyen dman kyang dngul chu'i bcud len dang / snye mo zhig yod pa des gos gdan gnyis kyi go ba da de bzhugs pa sogs dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes snying por mdzad pas/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha du masabyin gyis brlabs shing / grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ gangs ri thod dkar sogs nas skal ldan slob ma mang por zab mas 'domasapa dang / mdzod bdun sogs ma 'ongasagadul bya'i khyad du rtsom pa/ zhwa'i lha khang gis mtshon pa'i rten gsum nyams pa rnams gso ba sogs 'bar lo gsum gyi bya bsargyal bstan yun ring du bskyangasapar mdzad/gzhan yang gdul bar dka' ba'i glo mon dge sdig mi shes pa dang /mon bum thang sogasadam pa'i chas kyi sgra mi grags pa rnams su'ang / brtse ba chen pos dge bas lam la bkod cing / mthar dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa chu mo yos 1363lo rgyal zla'i tshes ba brgyad nyin mchims phu ru ngo mtshang ba'i cho 'khrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ba sa zhi bar ga gas so/ /zhal slob kyang rgyal sras bzod pa/ bla ma o rgyan pa/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 1sa gong pa sogs dang / legs par bshad pa'i gzhung lugs kyang mdzod bdun dang / ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum sogs shin tu mang ngo // //zhes dpal brtsegasabod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nasa'agro 'dul rdo rjes/—8—

dkar chagagasang spyod rdo rje lam bstan/ nges don snying po/ 6byin rlabs thugs sgrub/ 22rin chen shog ser gyi skor rig 'dzin mchog sgrub/ 29mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho/ 37rdzogasarim/ 2rma drug rdo rje'i chings/ 6rma sbyor ye shes dra ba/ 47zab lam bde chen rgya mtsho/ 52'od gsal 'bar lor/ 58gzhi snang ngo sprod/ 66'od gsal sbugs 'jug 7 sgon ma bzhi skor/ 18'khrul snang gzhi grol/ 85rmi lam sbugs 'jug 89— —

dkar chagadabyings snang ngo sprod/ 95zab don gnad gyi lde mig 0 'od gsal pra khrid/ 2gsang lam rin po che'i ngo sprod/ 20zab don snying po/ 26kun 'dus rin po che'i ngo sprod/ 3 bar do sbubs 'jug 31bar do gnad kyi sgon me/ 42gnad gsum sgon me/ 49mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/ 55zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od/ 95zhal chems mthar thug gcig ma/ 205zhal che sa gnad kyi me long / 207bde ga gas rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs pad+ma stong ldan/ 2glurigs lnga'i bcad len bdud rtsi thigs pa/ 2 7bdud rtsi sprin phung / 232'chi ba brtag bslu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral/ 246btags grol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po/ 256 2—

dkar gasreg (1nga 31da kyi snye ma/ 265gathas phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/ 274phyag rgya bzhi mchod 'od kyi spyor lo'i gnad yig 328mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba/ 336rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes dri med/ 344mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba/ 347rdo rje g.yu sgon ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo/ 356gza' bsdogad gsang zlasab/ 363drang 11nga gi ba11da pa/ 367gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rma spyol ba/ 370shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub/ 380mkha' 'gro yang tig gi them byang dpag bsam ljon shing / 388

༄7/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan bzhugs so / /rin ོ shog skya'i skor/gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal la sna zhi /ste /re spyor /skye/ste ma pa /stel/ /rang ba byas pa da pa ngang nyad las/ / da lhun rdzags nga po'i gdangasashar ba/ /mtha' grol 1nga yangs rang bar+ṣa rdzogs pa che/ /rang shar rang sar grol la phyag 'a྾ lo/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig zab lo gnad bsdus nas/ /don zab 'gag 'dril nyamasasu blang bde ba/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun gyis ma rtogs pa/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhi bshad kyis nyon/ /bde chen gnas 'di stong gsal 'dus ma byas/ /snying dbus gar+ṣa nu bum pa'i skur gsal ba/ /ye shes nyid de nang gsal lhun gyis grub/ /'od lnga'i gdangs las sgod ba da snang srid chags/ /snang bas stong ste chu zla'i gzugs bar+sā 'dra/ /lhun grub goms pasanam zhig 'od lngar grol/ /de yang rang gnasaka dag rang grol nas/ /mtha' bzhi las 'dasasprin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /e ma'o bzhi dang me long gzugs bar+sā bzhin/ /bdag gzhan gnyis snang rang gis btagasapar zad/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod nas stong pa'i ngang / /dgra gnyen dgag sgrub gang yang ma mthong ngo / /mi mkhasabyisapa dag gis gnyis bzung ste/ /lha dang 'dre zhes goms pas de ltar snang / /'dod 'jigs mya ngan goms pas der snang bzhi/ /med snang 'khrul pas 'gro ba 'di bslusaso/ /gang la phyi rol cir —1—

me po'i shul bzhag la / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/(kasnang rang gi sems/ /snang la gnyis med 'od gsal gdod ma'i ngang / /phyi rol ma yin nang gi gzugs brnyan tsam/ /thams cad sku lnga ye shes dag pa'i gdangs/ /lha dang 'drer snang bde chen mkha' 'gra'i zhing / /rang snang nyid de dngos grub 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dgag sgrub phan gnod sems kyi rtsal sbyong yin/ /de la dga' bsamachod sbyin brtsam par rigs/ /kye ho bde sdug rkyen rnams rmi lam 'dra/ /rang snang gnyis 'dzin gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ /rang ngo ma shes da dung 'khar bar snang / /ye stong rtsa bral gdod ma'i ngang 'di la/ /snang stong gnyis med kun brtags cho 'khrul tsam/ /snod bas snang srid lha dang lha mo'i zhing / /gang snang ga gas rnams 'od gsal lha yi sku/ /sgra rnamasagrags stong sngagasakyi dkyil 'khar te/ /rtog pa'i 'phra 'du ye shes rol pa che/ /snang grags sgod ba da gnyis med chas sku'i ngang / /stong la dngosasnang rang bzhin gzugs kyi sku/ /gdod nas stong ngo rtsa bral gas ma'i ngang / /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rol pa ni/ /skye med lhun rdzogs rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /ye grol gdod nas dag pa'i chas nyid la/ /blang dang dor med dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /ye stong babs stong rang bzhan gdod nas stong / /'di zhes mi mtshon tshig gisashes mi nus/ /rten med gzhi grol yongs rdzogs ka dag dang / /gang snang gsal stong rang bzhin chu zla 'dra/ /sna tshogasami gnyis rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /kun bzang gzhi yi dgongs klong yangs pa ni/ /mi 'gyur lta ba'i khyung chen rtogs pa yin/ /mdor na snang grags snang srid chas rnams kun/ /ngo bo stong —2—

ga4 spyod rdo rje r+sā bstan/la rang bzhin gzugs bar+sā tsam/ /thugs rje ma 'gags cir yang shar ba la/ /'di spyo mi 'dzin mtha' grol 1nga yangs so/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar stong pa ste/ /chu dang chu zla gnyis su mi phyed bar+ṣa/ /gnyis med don spyo brda tsam balngas pa tsam/ /snang rung stong rung rtag rung mi rtag rung / /gang shar bshas pa de ltar shar ba tsam/ shar nub rnyog bral stong gsal phyam phyam mo/ /'di ltar rtogs nas gnyisa'adzin rang grol te/ /'dzin med phyam gdal ye grol sor gas go /ngang nyid ma skyes kun tu bzang h+pha snyo / /rtogs pa'i lta ba yangs na mngon du 'gyur/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song / /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /lta ba rdo rje'i le'u ste dang lo// //de nas sgom pa 'od gsal ོ po ni/ /lta ba'i don la goms par byed pa ste/ /r+ṣa dus 'od gsal nam mkha'i mthongs su blta/ /sems kyisami bsam sgom pa bsgom pa min/ /rang bawo gnyis med chu zla gzugs bar+sā 'dra/ /'di zhes mi marja ga nga 'dzin kun las 'das/ /gdod ma'i ka dag lhun grub mngon du ཿra/ /des ni ཿla snang longasaskur dzar ba yin/ /mo dus bde ba'i mal du bag phab ste/ /rang babasaltod chags gnyid du log pa'i tshe/ /nyin snang 'gags pas tshe 'di 'dor ba dang / /sgyur ོ zhisgyur ri zur kyi zhi tsaraganyad du 'gra bas 'byung ba tham zhes dang / /ma ga gnyan sa ga ya 'od gsal dang / /rmi lam sna tshogasabar do'i 'char rmya dang / /gnyid sad snang bas rang bzhin sprul sku'i snyo / /bgrod nas gang snang rang bzhi dag —3—

me po'i shul bas la / 1pa chen rab 'domasakyi gsung 'a pa/(kapa'i zhing / /semasacan lha dang lha mor dran par bya/ /tha mal dran bsam rang rgyud 'dzin pa dor/ /gnyad dang rmi lam gnyid sad snang ba gsum/ /chas sku longs sku sprul skur rtogs byas la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel rnam gsum gyis/ /bde gsal mi rtog blo 'dasachen por nyal/ /de yisaganyad dang rmi lam rgyun chad de/ /gdod ma'i ka dag 'od gsal ngang du gnas/ /'di ltar gnyid la nyal lugs rnam pa gsum/ /bde ba'i mal du 'dzin med phyam gdal ba/ /'od gsal chasasku'i ngang du nyal ba yis/ /rmi lam rgyun chad 'a la pa gzhi thog thim/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin spros dang bral ba yin/ /de bzhin nang 'od bum pa'i sbubs nyid du/ /ye shes 'od lnga 'dzin med nyal ba yis/ /rmi lam 'od gsal longasasku'i ngang du thim/ /sku dang thig le 'od lnga'i snang ba 'cha/ /dag pa'i zhing snang rigs lnga'i snang bar mthong / /snang ba'i rang bzhin spros dang bral ba yin/ /de bzhin rang lus sprul pa'i 'jig rten na/ /ston pa'i zhabasadrung yid kyis rab dmigs te/ /rigasalnga'i sa bon nyid la semasabasdus nyal/ /rmi lam bar snang sprul pa'i skur thim nas/ /mngan dga' la sogs zhing snang sna tshogasa'acha/ /phyi dusadag pa'i zhing der grol bar nges/ /sna tshogs gnyis med dag pa'i sprul sku yin/ /gnyid dang rmi lam sad dus rnam pa gsum/ /gdod nasasku gsum nyid du gnas pa'i tshul/ /ji bzhin gzugs brnyan gnyisapa'i rnam pa la/ /lam du goms pas 'brasabu sku gsum grol/ /de yang gomasapa'i gnad ni 'di bzhin sbyang / /gnyid sad dus na yul rnamasasprul sku'i zhing / /mngan dga' —4—

gsang spyod rdo rje lamabastan/la sogs gsal btang ldang bar bya/ /dus gsum dus rnams kun tu sku gsum zhing / /'od gsal sku gsum rdzogs pa'i nyams len bya/ /yul sems gnyis med rang snang shes par bya/ /bzhin dang me long lta bu'i lam khyer gyis/ /nyan mongs chags sdang rang snang rang grol zhing / /rang shar ye grol nam mkha'i mdud pa ltar/ /rang gi blo yisabyas shing ba ga pa ltar/ /gang snang rkyen rnams de ltar shes pas sbyang / /'di ltar spyod lam dusarnams thams cad du/ /rang snang 'og min rigasalnga'i sangasargyasazhing / /phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub pa'i lam khyer bya/ /de yis lhun grub kun tu bzang pa'i zhing / /brtson 'grusarab kyisatshe 'dir 'grub pa ste/ /'bring rnamasabar dor 'od gsal gnyisamed 'dres/ /tha masarang bzhin sprul skur grol ba ni/ /gomasapa'i gnad 'disamyur du 'grub pa yin/ /mdor na gnyad dusabar da'i gdams pa dran/ /ldang dus rang bzhin sprul sku'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /nyan dus 'od gsal phyi ru 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /snang semasaganyis med rang grol chen por sbyang / /mtshan dus 'od gsal nang du 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /sku gsum dbyer med gdod ma'i zad sar bskyal/ /ldang dus rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing snang la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'od gsal chen por sbyang / /chags sdang lasogasanyon mongs gang shar yang / /'dzin med rang grol gza' gtad bral bar sbyang / /rkyen rnams sems kyi rtsal sbyong me long ste/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar 'dzin med sbyang / /'di ltar phyi nang snang srid chas rnams la/ /sgom par ma gyur rdul tsam yod min pas/ /snang sems gang shar rang grol rtsal sbyang —5—

me po'i shulabazhag la / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum//dbya/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i sgom pa ste/ /bying rgod gnyid med zhi lhag zung du 'brel/ /snang stong thabs shes ye nas zung 'jug yin/ /blang dor re dogs dgag sgrub 'das pa'i don/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyisabastan nas song / /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /sgom pa rdo rje'i le'u ste gnyisapa'o// //de ltar lta sgom bogs 'byin spyod pa ste/ /deng dang ma 'phel 'gribasadang rkyen thog dbab/ /bde sdug sdug bsngal na tsha ci byung na'ang / /dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i gnas song ste/ /dam gtsang ngo tsha tshul 'chos rab spangs la/ /gnyisamed rang grol lta sgom ngang nyid dang / /blang dor 'dzin med spyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /'gro dang 'dug dang mchangasadang rgyug pa dang / /smra dang dgod dang ngu dang glu len dang / /dga' dang mi dga' chags sdang bde sdug dang / /rigasadrug spyod pa mthong thos dran tshad bya/ /rjes la gang shar rang grol rtsal spyong gis/ /lta sgom don de thog tu phebs sam blta/ /ji srid gnyis 'dzin dgag sgrub ma zhig par/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas brtson pas spyod par bya/ /mtshan dus rang babs bde bar nyal nas kyang / /dran bsam 'phra 'du'i rnam rtog kun bral te/ /skye med lhun rdzogs gas ma'i ngang du nyal/ /des ni bdag gzhan dgag sgrub re dogs med/ /dgra gnyen gnyis med gser dang bong ba mnyam/ /rkyen ngan lam bslangs snang ba grogs su 'char/ /lta sgom bogs 'khyan rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom pa rang gsal spyod pa bu chung 'dra/ /gza' gtad kun —6—

gsang spyod rdo rje lam ba na/bral ngang gis spyon pa 'dra/ /ye grol phyam gdal rang babs rgan po 'dra/ /gzeg dang snyems bral dur khrod mi ro 'dra/ /'dzin med rang grol yul med skye bo 'dra/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dra/ /nyon mongs rang grol chu dang rba sa sa 'dra/ /ci smras don med brag cha'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gang la'ang chags med 'dab chags mkha' lding 'dra/ /spang gnyen rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa 'dra/ /thams cad ye grol mkha' la sprin dengs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i skal bzang bde gshegasarig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos bco nasaphyag bya'i 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/khyad par nad gdon chos 'phrul ci byung yang / /nags dang dur khrod mtsho gling skyed mos tshal/ /phug dang khong stong shing gcig drung la sogs/ /'jigasashing nyams nga dben pa'i sa phyogs der/ /ba ga dang dkrugs long spyon pa'i spyod pa dang / /zhib dang ngesapa 'jam pos rnam pasanyal/ /snang sems ro gcig sems su thag ba da la/ /sems nyid ma bcas chas sku'i ngang du nyal/ /de yang sngon 'gro byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /snying dbusa'od gsal 'od zer rab 'phras pas/ /phyogs bas rgyal ba rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror ba sa/ /snang srid lha 'dre gnod byed spyan drangs la/ /dbus su bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang / /g.yas su yi dam g.yon du chos skyong dang / /rgyab tu gnod byed mdun du lan chags mgron/ /dus gsum pha ma rigs drug sems can bsam/ /yid kyis phyag 'tshal sna tshogs mchad pa —7—

me po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen pa 'thumasakyi gsung 'bum/(kadang / khyad par rang gi thod pa'i nang nyid du/ /lus 'di bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur pa las/ /ye las lung g.yos re lasame 'bar bas/ /thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon lngar gyur nas/ /rang nyid bye ba phrag stong mang sprul la/ /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro la bdud rtsi n+d+rams/ /dgyes shing tshims pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bsam/ /de bzhin phung po dum brgya dum stong dor/ /gnod byed lan chagasagang 'dod sbyin par bto / /rjes la mgron rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i dbyingasal bzhag /de ltar mtshod bya mchad byed rang gi sems/ /semasani ma skyes ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /thams cad gzhi rdzogasarang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /bsam rdzogs gdod ma'i chos nyid chen por shes/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongasapar phyin/ /gzhi grol ka dag ngang du la bzla 'o/ /de kun 'gro la gnyisamed phan gdags phyir/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas bsngo ba bya/ /'di ni sngon 'gro bsod namasaye shesatshogs/ /bar chad kun sel dngosagrub rgya chen 'byung / /dngosagazhi sems la 'di ltar brtag par bya/ /de ltar yid kyis sna tshogs cir sprul yang / /thamasacad rang gi semasasu gcig pa ltar/ /'khar 'dasadagag sgrub blang dor re dogasadang / /snang srid bdag gzhan gnyis snang sna tshogs dang / /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin ma lusarang gi sems/ /rmi lam bshin te mi snang 'khrul pa'i sems semasani rtsa bral ye stong chasakyi sku/ /gzhi rdzogs kun tu bzang pa'i rang bzhin te/ /phyogs dang ris med mtha' grol 1nga yangasaso/ /dba' rlabasagayo ba —8—

gsang spyod rdo rje lam bar+ṣa /ri 'dra rgya mtsho'i ngang / /sna tshogs dgag sgrub rang sems stong pa'i ngang / /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin gnyis med rtsa bral dang / /thams cad phyam cig rang babs chen pa'i ngang / /mi g.yo mi gnas spros dang bral ba ni/ /gdod ma'i ka dag ngang du gnas pa yin/ /de ltar shesapas snang srid chos skur grol/ /nad gdon 'drer snang cho 'phrul stong par zhi/ /nam mkha'i sprin rnamasagayo ba dengasapa bzhin/ khes rab chen pos gas ma'i gnas lugs shes/ /chos nyid sa la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /thabs kyi rim pasa'adi ltar shes par bya/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub semasabasgom la/ /zhabar ba'i lan chags byang bar mos pa bya/ /bskal par bzhugs zhes dga' bas bkur ste bya/ /de nas mched sbyin don la gzhag pa'i phyir/ /gdon la gzugs su grub pa yod dam med/ /yon na rdul phran bzhag kyang dngos por med/ /gzugs de ga gas med rang gdangs shar ba tsam/ /rang snang 'od gsal me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /rags pa'i gzugs med chu zla'i rnam pa 'dra/ /de yis su la phan gnod byar ci yod/ /rags par yod na dngosasu 'khyer ga 'a yang / /ga gas med 'dre la 'jigs sgrag sems kyis brtags/ /snang yang ma skyes stong pa'i rang bzhin no/ /'on te 'dra yi sems kyis gnod snyam na/ /semasani dngos med ye nas dag pa la/ /gnod bya gnod byed gnyis su grub pa med/ /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin rang yid 'dzin pa ste/ /nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhin du 'ching grol byed/ /rang snang snyems dang bral na gzhan med de/ /me long bsdus pasagazugs brnyan mi snang —9—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ klong 'a rab stimasakya gsung 'bum/()bzhin/ /mi snang 'khrul pas srid pa'i grong khyer na/ /bdag gzhan gnyis snang rmi lam ci 'dra'o/ /rang snang rang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis bzos pas/ /'khar ba nyid ces ma rigs 'khrul snang yang / /legs par brtags na gnyis med mas kyi sku/ /gdod nasagazhi rtsa bral ba'i chos nyid do/ /kye ho snang srid sgyu ma'i grong khyer na/ /don med bden par bzung bar byis pa 'khar/ /'dzin med rnal 'byar pa rnams rtogs pas grol/ /nam mkha'i ri mo smig rgyu'i mtshon pa sa /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan gsal bsa'akhrul ba ltar/ /mi snang 'gro ba don med a thang chad/ /ha ha gdod nas stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /1 bur 'khrul rtog rkyen gyis cir snang yang / /nam zhig rang bzhin shes pasagrol bar nges/ /gza' gtad med pa'i cho 'phrul chos sku'i ngang / /ye nasartsa ba bral bsablo re bde/ /re dogs gnyis 'dzin zhig pasabag re dro/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin ye nasasangs rgyasapas/ /glo bur bag chags sbyong ba yang mi dka'/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin gang gis gang la sgrib/ /thams cad ma skyesagadod nas stongs pas na/ /semasadang sgrib pa ye stong rtsa ba bral/ /gang zhig gang gisa'agro ba 'khrul bar 'dod/ /smig rgyu'i zhags pas mo ga ma bu ba ngas zhes/ /sdug bsngal mthong nas mya ngan byed par zad/ /ngas ni chas kun de 'drar rab mthong nas/ /'tshing grol gnyis med ye grol sangs rgyas zhes/ /bdag dang 'gro ba kun la gcig par rtogs/ /he he thams cad rang grol gza' gtad med/ /'di zhesasgrub tu yod na dga' ba la/ /re dogasa'abad rtsol zhig pas rab tu dal/ /de yin —/0—

gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan/ngasashes gang shar yin du chug /gnyis su ma 'dzin re dogs 'phrang las 'das/ /gnyis med ma yin chos nyid gzhan na med/ /thad ka'i shes pa rang gzo'i bsnyems bral te/ /don dam chas nyid ye shes gdod ma'i ngang / /rtogs sla blo bde ngo bo phyam phyam mo/ /ma bsgoms sgom med snying po'i don mthong yang / /kye ma bdag sgo rtsol ba'i gzeb tu 'ching / /ji tsam 'bad pa de tsam 'khrul pa'i yid/ /'khar ba'i chas te gang gis grol ba med/ /kye ho ma bcos rang sar dag pa'i ngang / /de rang nyid de rang babs gas ma'i don/ /gang shar rtsis med gza' gtad bral bar zhog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs 1nga mthar thug yin/ /de ltar gnod byed gzhi nas med pa ltar/ /gnod yul rang yang ye nas ma grub ste/ /gnod do snyam na lus sems gang la gnod/ /lus ni rdul phran tsam du'ang brtags na med/ /sems ni dngos med ngos gzung kun dang bral/ /de la gnod pa skyel ba'i yul 'dug gam/ /brtags pas med bzhin ma brtags dusana'ang med/ /gnyis 'dzin thag pas rang sems ba ngas par zad/ /'ching grol gnyis med nam mkha'i ri mo 'dra/ /de ltar rtogs na 'dre yang lha nyid de/ /rang sems dag pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du mthong / /lha med 'dre med rang sems stong pa'i ngang / /bsal gzhag 'gro 'ong gnyis med chasanyid la/ /bsnyems bral blo yis 'khrul gzhi zad pa yin/ /de ltar rtogs na re dogs rtsa ba stor/ /dgag sgrub blang dor chas nyid ngang du grol/ /gnyis med ye shes mnyam pa'i ngang du grol/ /'di ltar snang srid ye nas 'od gsal —/1—

me bo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'dom kyi gsung lam/()zhing / /'drer snang 'drer 'dzin lha dang lha ma'i ngang / /sna tshogs dran rig rang grol chosakyi sku/ /rten med gzhi grol rtsa bral gas ma'i ngang / /sgyu ma ye shes gnyis med chu zla'i ngang / /rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra bar shesabyas nas/ /bsnyems bral gza' gtad bral ba'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /de ltar gdon rnams chos sku grol ba ltar/ /nad kyang rig pa'i rtsal sbyang chos sku ste/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byangs nas/ /'gro ba'i nad rnams gnyag bsdus bdag la thim/ /bdag gi nad med bde ba 'gro la sbyin/ /bdag gi nad kyis 'gro kun bde bar shog /bskal par bzod bya bsran thub go bgosal/ /lusadang semasaganyisagang na legasapar rtogs/ /lus 'di sa rdo dur khrod ro dang 'dra/ /sems ni mkha' 'dra kha dog dbyibasamed pas/ /de la brtagasan na rgyu na mkhan med/ /na bar 'dzin pa rang gi rtog pa tsam/ /dran rtog dngosamed bar snang bser bu 'dra/ /gnyisamed don la na ba yod mi srid/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas nad ces btags par zad/ /btags kyang 'dogs mkhan rang bzhin gdod nasastong / /na ba'i lus kyang rdul phran gzhig pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' 'dra zhing stong gsal chos sku'i ngang / /na ba gnyis med rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /gnas lugs gsal 'debs me long chen po yin/ /spang blang mi bya lta sgom rtsal sbyong bya/ /de bzhin bde sdug rkyen rnams ci shar tshe/ /bdag dang yul gnyis legasapar dpyad byas la/ /kun rdzob rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mi bslu bas/ /sngon byas lasayin bdag gis bzod par bya/ /don dam yul sems gzhig cing dpyad pa —12—

gsang spyod rdo rje lasabar+ṣa/yis/ /dgra gnyen rang semasanam mkha'i ngang du grol/ /dgag sgrub gnyisa'adzin stong pa'i ngang du grol/ /'di zhes ched 'dzin mnyam nyid chen por grol/ /'gro 'dug snang sems 'dzin med pa/ du grol/ /nga bdag gzung 'dzin blo 'das chas skur grol/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras gdod ma'i ngang du grol/ /phyogs res re dogs gzhi rtsa med par grol/ /ye grol yongs grol shar grol 'dzin pa med/ /gang snang gang byung gang yin 'di yin med/ /de ltar rtogs te dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras/ /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i grong khyer zhig pa yin/ /de tshe byar med rdzogs chen nam mkha' la/ /bya bral gnyis med ngang gis gnas pa'i tshe/ /bya dang mi bya 'bad rtsol zhig pa'i mi/ /bya ba'i gzhi med byed mkhan stong par gnas/ /nga nyid yin na de tshe dga' ba la/ /ha ha rang gis kun tu brtagasapar zad/ /dga' dang mi dga'i gzhi las ye nas grol/ /smon pa'i yul med smon lam 'debs mkhan med/ /ngang yin ye yin rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song / /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ /spyod pa rdo rje'i glu ste le'u gsum pa'o// //de ltar lta sgom spyod par goms pa yis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu rnam pa gnyis/ /gnas skabs gnyis med 'od gsal goms pa yis/ /phyi ru dbyingasarig 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs zad sar phyin/ /rdos bcas gnyis zad 'od gsal zhing khams snang / /nang rtsa 'od song rlung sems nyan mongasastong / /phyi nang zang thal zas 13—

me bo'i shul bshagal / klong r+ṣa rapaspyomasakyi gsung la ma/(kagosadagosapa med/ /gsang bar 'khrul snang gnyis 'dzin rgyun chad nas/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shesathogs med cing / /'pho ba ོ pa'i gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni gnas skabasarig pa'i yon tan yin/ /mthar thug snang sems gdod ma'i gzhi la thim/ /nam mkha' bzhin te gzhan nu bum pa'i sku/ /nang gsal sku gsum ye shesathugs rje yis/ /dus gsum mi 'gyur chosaskur bde klong 'byel/ /de las phyir gsal longs sprul snang ba yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis sgrub la nor bu bzhin/ /gnyis ka mi rtog 'od gsal chen po ste/ /ji ltar snang yang de ltar ma grub pas/ gdod ma'i gzhi la 'pho 'gyur med par gnas/ /nang bzhugs dus na sku gsum gzhir bzhag ste/ /phyir gsal sku gsum gzhi bzhengs chen po yis/ /dbyings lasam g.yos 'gro don rgyun mi chad/ /'dir dag kun kyang rig pa'i yon tan te/ /rang gzhan don gnyisam lus phun tshogs shing / /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag pas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod brnyes lha yi lha/ /gdod ma'i mgon por lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de ltar dbyings rig ye shes 'bras bu'i don/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song / /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan las/ 'bras bu rdo rje'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //'dir ni snying po'i mthar thug zab mo'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig tshe gcig sangs rgyasalam/ /bas kyi snying po yang nasayang bsdus pa/ /rdo rje snying po'i theg mchog gsal bar byas/ /dge ba 'di yisam lus 'gro ba kun/ /theg mchag 'dir zhugs 'od gsal mthar phyin te/ /sku dang ye shes—14

gsang spyad rdo rje lam bstan/'du 'bral med pa yis/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /bdag bla' mkha' la rtogs pa'i nyi shar bas/ /skal ldan blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed slad/ /gsang spyod snying po rdo rje lam bstan 'di/ /gangs ri zod dkar mgul du legasapar bkod/ /gang gis mi snyogs thar pa'i grong khyer na/ /'di yis legs bgrod zab ma'i gnad bstan pas/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ra ba yongs spangs te/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi mkhas pa chen po/ rang byung pad+ma rgyal pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer blang khang bzangs su shar bas snang bar byas pa'i rnal 'thur pa dri med 'od zer kyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ o rgyan rdzong gi gnasamachag dam par/ rin chen shog skya'i ngos la legs par bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge zhing bkra shis/ /—15—

༄7/ /nges don snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rin r+ṣa shog ser skor:nges don snying po zhes bya ba: dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo:thugs rje'i rang bzhin phan bde'i sprin tshogs can: rang byung pad+ma rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: shin tu spros dang bral ba'i gang zag rnams: mngon sum snying da'as :de 0ri/) sa sa /stes 33 /ste sa da/res pa dan 'a ra gzhug bya' ra: spras kun dar spras da nga pa dan:ji ltar bdag la babs bzhin 'dir brjod bya: de la gzhi dbang : lam khrid: 'brasabu'i grol lugs gsum las: dang po ni tshogs kyi 'khar los brgyan par bla mas bskyed rdzogs bsgom zhing : slob ma la skyabs su 'gro ba dang : byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang : stong pa'i ngang las kun bzang yab yum mthing ga zhal sbyor rdo rje skyil krung mdzad par bsgom du bas nas: bla ma brgyud pa dang : sangs rgyas rigs lnga: mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang ba sa pa dbyingasanasasbyan drangasal: hūm̐ hūṃ ñtsa phe phe phe: hring hring hring : dzaX hūṃ baṃ hoḥpra bhe sha ya bra bhe sha ya: zhes bzlas shing bstem la: rol mo dkrol:tshil ོ gyi dud pa gar+ṣa ngo: de ni lus lhar gsal ba bum dbang ngo : de nas nam mkhar kun bzang yab yum bla ma brgyud pa dang ba sa pa'i spyor mtshalas nas byang sems babs pas: slob ma'i spyi bor thim nas lus gang bas: bde ba rgyas par bsam zhing : bdud rtsi lce la bzhag ste: lusakyi nang ye ges gang bar bsam zhing : ā+oṃ āḥhū dang : ā li kwa li brgya rtsa re bzlas /6—

nge don snying po/pa niḥ ngag sngags su gsal ba gsang ba'i dbang ngo : de nas bla ma yab yum du sgom du bcug nas snyoms par zhugs par bsam dus: rba rlabs mnan pas bde ba skyes pa la 'dzin pa med par ngo sprad pa ni shes rab ye shes te yid bde ba chen por gsal ba'o: de nas bu khyod shar gyi nam mkhar 'gro bar sgomasashig: e ma 'gro ba'i gnas 'dug gam: 'gro ba'i mkhan po 'dug gam: 'gro byed kyi shes pa 'dug gam: lto dang nub dang byang la'ang de bzhin du sbyar nas nam mkha'i dkyil na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khar 'od gsal ba'i steng du yod par bsgoms la: je mtho je mthor song bas sems dang nam mkha' 'dres te ldog pa'i gnas med par: mi rtog pa'i ngang la stong gsal 'dzin pa med par mnyam par 'jog tu bas nas: sems nyid nam mkha' lta bur ngo sprad pa ni: rang byung ye shes kyi gnas lugasaka dag lhun grub kyi rang bzhin: rdzogasapa chen pa'i tshig dbang rin po che': de yang dang po rnam rtog dang : sgo lnga'i shes pa rang grol du shes par bya ba'i phyir:grags stong la sogs par ngo sprad rjes nam mkha' lta bu'i don la ngo sprad pa ni gnad dam pa'o: dbang rnam par bye ba'i don gcig tu bsdus pa rdzogasab/: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ don gnyisapa khrid la gsum las: sngon 'gro ni lag pa spyi bo la ma reg par thal mo sbyar te brkyang : rkang pa'i mthil sprad de bskyed: sked pa bsrang la rdo rje mthing ga me 'bar ba'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa gcig tu bsgoms la zhag gcig 'bad nas: hū las hūṃ 'phros nam mkha' gang bas:17

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen raba'abyamasakyi gsung 'bum/()hūṃ sgra 'khrug stong ldir ba tsam bsgrags: hūṃ rnams nam mkha'i dkyil na phar 'gro tshur 'gro rang nyid rdo rjer gyur pa'i phyi nang zang thal du song : rdo rje yang je mthor 'gro zhing hūm̐ sgras nam mkha' gang bar bsams la: hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ zhesasnyan la gdangs ring ba zhag gsum rim pa bzhin 'bad do: de nas mtshan mo nyal dus rnams su dran bsam yid la mi byed pa'i ngang du rnal la dbab pa yang bya'o: de nas da ltar gyi semasadran rtog sna tshogs su 'cha ba ni: shar dusagang nasabyung : gang na 'dug: yal song dusagar song : kha dog ngosabazung ji ltar: shar ba dang 'cha mkhan gnyis gnyis su grub bam zhes zhag gsum du brtag tu gzhug par bya'o: de dag ni sngon 'gro dam pa'o: de nas dngos gzhi la: gzhi ka dag khregs chad kyi ngo sprod dang : lam lhun grub thod rgal gyi ngo sprod gnyis las: dang po ni tshogs gtang dang gsol ba btang pa'i rjes la: kye skal ldan phyi rol sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ste: sems la snang yang don la ma grub pas: ba sa ba sadang dgag sgrub ma byed: nang dran rig sna tshogasasu 'char ba ltar snang yang 'char ba dang 'a ra mkhan ma grub: ngo bo dang nges gzung ma grub: chu'i ri bo ltar wal po rjes med du grol bas/ gtang gzhag dang re dogasamabyed: phyi snang thog tu gzhag pas: nang rig thog tu grol nas sems spro bsdu med pa'i gnas lugasal gnas pa ni: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa yin pas: cir snang chasanyid du shes pas: rig rtsal rjes med du thong zhigasnye phyi 'byung ba lnga:nang 4nga po lnga: gsang ba dug lnga gang snang gi thog tu tsen gyis rnam rtog spro —/8

nge don snyeng po/bsdu med pa'i ngang la rang babs su ltod de glod dang : gang snang 'od gsal du grol nas bde chen phyogs yan du grol te: bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyamasarang byung du skye zhing : sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes nam mkha' mtha' dang dbus med pa'i dgongs pa nang nasanang gsal 'char ba yin: zhes zebs par gdab bo: gnyisapa thod rgal ni snga dro 'char mtshams sam: phyi dro nub mtshams su drang sgong gi 'dug stangs kyis bltar ba ga pas: ye shes kyi snang ba mngon sum du mthong ba'i tshe: phyi 'od kyi snang ba la ma yengs par bltas pa'i dus na: dgag sgrub kyi zhen rtog dbyingasasu nub ste: gang la'ang mi rtog pa'i ye shes spro bsdu med pa shar dus: 'di kho na sangasargyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa: shesarab rang byung gi sgron ma 'od snang mngon sum gyi gnad las rtsol med lhug par 'char ba ngo shesapar gyisashig: dus bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo bde chen 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa las mi g.yo ba ste:gdod ma chos zad kyi dgongs pa la thug pas zad pa ngo shes yin thog tu zhag la dusathamasacad du skyongasashig cesagadab bo: dngos gzhin: rjesasnang pabazhi'i 'char lugs la bzhi las: chosanyod mngon sum gyi snang ba ni:de ltar goms nasathig le gsum sbrel du snang ba tshun chad de: lus 'dug stangs las mi g.yo baḥ ngag smra brjod nyung ba: semasabade gsal mi rtog pa shasache zhing : rmi lam dge ba sdig pa zad pa rnamasarmi'o: nyamasagong 'phel ni: 'od snang ling tse dang : yul gru khyab pa'i nang nas thig le thig phran du gsal la mi g.yo zhing : pad+ma stong ldan dang : mchad rten dang : gzhal med /9—

me po'i shulabazhagal / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()khang lta bu nas lha yab rkyang pa'i bar du snang zhing : lus ngag semasagasum sngar bas dag cing : bar 'gar mngan shes khyang ldan pa'o: rig pa tshad phebs ni: lha'i sku gzugs sbrel nas dbyings snang nam mkha' khyab pa ste:rmi lam med cing rdzu'aphrul dang mngan shes 'grub pa'osnye mas nyid zad pa ni:snang ba'i 'phel dang : phyi nang gi 'dzin pa dang : rdos bcas su snang ba thams cad zad ba'o: 'di dag ni lam snang ba bzhi'i 'phel tshad zad pa'i rim pa ste: lam grol bar byed pa'i gdamasapa rnams rdzogasaso: sam ya:rgya rgya rgya: don gsum pa 'brasabu'i grol lugasani: gdod ma'i gzhi thog tu phyin pa ste: dper na shel 'od nang du thim dus 'od lnga sbubs su 'byul ba'i tshe nang gsal du yod la: phyi gsal du med kyang 'od kyi 'cha gzhi byed pa ltar: lam snang gi longasasku gdod ma'i da sa ka dag rang byung gi ye shes sprosapa dang bral ba'i chas skur thim dus: ngo bo la gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos su ma grub cing : chasasku'i sbubasan longs sku lnga ldan gyi 'od dang :sprul sku dkar po gnyis thim la ma rmugs pa 'char gzhi'i tshul du yod pa mtshon te: nang gsal lhun grub chen por bzhugs so: de'i dusathamasacad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mkhyen byed du yod kyang : spyod byed du ma shar ba zhesabya'o: 'di ni ka dag gi ngang nas lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shesanang gsal 'char gzhir bzhugasapa'i dus su: de nas gdul bya'i snang ba la 'jug pa na: shel las 'od gnyis po phyir 'cha ba bzhin du: ka dag chasasku'i ngang las: rang snang phyir gsal gyi longs sku'i snang cha lasasnye rang bzhin sprul pa —20

nges don snying po/sku'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sems dpa' sa la bzhusas pa la snang zhing :lha'i thub pa la sogs pa 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thub pa sprul pa'i sku dang :bems por snang bas don byed pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku rnams gang la gang mos su 'chang ba ni: lhun gyis grub pa'i thugs rje las g.yo ba dang : 'bad pa'i stsal pa gang yang med bzhin du ngang gis snang ba yin no: gdul bya med na de'i ngo kha la snang ba'i ston pa yang mi snang ba: chu sgod med pas zla ga gas mi snang ba lta bu ste: dbyings thog ma'i gzhi la g.yo ba med par dus thams cad du bzhugs so: gnam gang gi zla ba dbyingasan gnasakyang :phyir mig gsal ba ltar: ka dag gi gzhi la bzhugs par shes par bya'o:tha ma 'bras bu'i grol lugasabastan pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:'di ni nges don 'od gsal snying pa'i lam: mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i bcud bsdus nas: gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong gnas su:dri med 'od zer shar bas snang bar byas: phyi rabs skal ldan byang chub 'dod pa dag: yi ge 'di la rtag tu nan tan gyis: tshig nyung don 'dril nyams su blang bde ba: gang dang mi 'dra snying pa'i gnad bsdusate: phyi rabasadon du legs par bkod pa 'di: gsang zhing rgyas gdab snying la sa ma ya:mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid grol sa dang ba sa pa dril ba'i gnad:nges don snying po zhesabya bsnye pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ—2/—

ra da/ /byin rlabs thugs sgrub ces bya ba bzhugs soḥshog ser skor las —ka mā ma ga: byin rlabasabla ma'i thugs sgrub cesabya ba: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos grub kun 'byung pad+ma la: bas nas byin rlabs thugs sgrub 'di: kun 'dus spyo ru bsgrub pa dang : mtshan brgyad bye brag bsgrub pa 'o: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas: stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng : rang nyid tweḥlas mtsho rgyal sku: mthing nag gri gug thod pa dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs: gcer bu rusapasabargyan par bsgom: nyin par spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng : zhi ba kun 'dusalongs spyod rdzogs: dkar gsal za 'og ber chen gsol: pad zha rgod pa'i rtse rgyal btsugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gshag ka pā la: bdud rtsis bkang bsnamasaskyil krung mdzad: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang gcer bu la: gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs bzhugs: mu med 'od zer 'phra bar bsgom: mtshan dusarang gi snying ga sa pad nyi'i steng du pad+ma ni: yab yum he ru ka yi tshul: 'khril sbyor yab sngo rdo rje dril: yum dmar gri gug thod pas 'khyud: gnyisaka rin chen rus pas brgyan: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan rnamasardzogs: de yi phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: yab yum 'khril sbyor rgyan rnamasardzogs: dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs mdzad: phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul gtso bo 'dra: kun las 'od —22—

byin rlabasathugs sgrub/'phras bdag gzhan gyi: sgo gsum sgrib sbyang dngos grub thob: zag med bde bas gang bar bsam: de ltar nyin mtshan sgom pa'i tshe: bla ma mkha' 'gra'i 'od zer gyis: bdag gzhan sgrib sbyangs dngos grub thob: yang cig sprul pa'i 'od zer las: bla ma mkha' 'gro dpag med spros: 'jig rten khams kun gang bar bsgom: kun gyis sngags 'di brjod par bsam: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza dza: ting 'dzin gsal bas ma yengs bzlas: dngos grub gang 'dod thob par bsam: rjes la thams cad bla mar thim: de yang mi dmigs chas nyid ngang : ma skyes gdod nas dag par bzhag:dge ba sems can don bsngos la: spyod lam rmi lam sgyu mar sbyad: zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig na: dngosasam rmi lam gang rung du: slob dpon zhal mthong ci bsam 'khrub: mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur: mtshan brgyad bye brag bsgrub pa la:dang po zhi ba mchag sgrub pas: skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed stong pa'i ngang : pad zla'i steng du rang sems sno 'od 'phras don byas tshun 'dus pas: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsgol: skyil krung za 'og ber chen gsol: pad zhwa rgod pa'i rtse rgyal btsugs: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bas : snying gar pad zla'i dbus su hūṃ: phyogs bzhin ha ri na sa 'o: de lasa'od 'phras rang gzhan gyi: sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs dngos grub thob: snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gror bsgom: kun kyang hūṃ sgra di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang : bsgoms la hūṃ glu ring du blangs: thun zhababs 'di yang bzla bar bya: ā+oṃ ha ri ni sa āḥsno rjesal sngar bzhin shes par bya: las dang sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang : mchag dang thun mong dngos grub thob: nad rnams zhi —23—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum//shibar 'dod pa yis: skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed stong pa las: hūm̐ lasapad+ma sam bha wa: dkar ljang rgyan sogs gong dang 'dra: khyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: thugs kar pad zla'i dbus su sno phyogs bzhin ha ri ni sa las:'od 'phras bdag gzhan nad rnams bsregs: bdud rtsis lus khengs bde ba'i ngang : snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams: sngar bzhin hūṃ phaṭa sgogs pa las: na sar hūṃ gis zang thal phug: 'od 'phrasand rnams skar mda' bzhin: phyi rol nam mkha'i ngang du dengs: yang yang bsgoms la hūṃ glu len: de rjes 'di yang bzla bar bya: ā+oṃ ha ri ni sa.āḥhūm̐: rjesal sngar bzhin bsgomasapa yis: nad rnams ma lusazhi bar 'gyur: gdon rnams zhi bar 'dod pa yis: pad zla'i steng du rang sems hūm̐: de lasaseng ge sgra sgogs ni: dkar ser gtso 'khar sngar dang 'dra: phyag gnyis rdo rje ka pā la: thugasakar yig 'khru snga ma bzhin:'od 'phrasasnang srid mkha' 'gra'i zhing : bgegasarnams tshang bcad me phung bsgoms: hū glu blangasarjesasngar bzhin bzlas: bar chad gdon bgegs bla mar bsgom: spyi gtsug sbyan drangasagasol ba gdab: bar chad byang chub sems bsgom la: lan chags sbyang phyir rang gi lus: dum bur 'thor nasagang 'dod sbyin: lan chagasabu lon khyer bar bsam: rjesal mnyam gzhag stong pa las:dge ba sems can don du bsngo: bgegs rnams zhi bar the tshom med: gnyis pa rgyas pa'i las bstan pa: tshe dang bsod namasargyasa'adod na: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ lasarang nyid shākya seng : ser gsal gtso 'khar snga ma bzhin: phyag gnyis rin chen ka pā la: thugasakar pad nyi'i dbus su hūṃ: phyogasabazhin ha ri ni saser: 'od 'phras 'khar 'das thams cad kyi:—24—

byin rlabasathugasasgrub/tshe dang bsod nams nor rnams bsdus: bdag la dngos grub thob par bsam:snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams: bdag la byin rlabs dngos grub ster: hūṃ phaṭa gdangs skad brjod par bsam: hūm̐ glu blangs rjes sngagasa'adi bzlas: ā+oṃ ri ni sa ha āḥhūm̐: rjes la thams cad bla ma paḥ de yang nam mkha'i ngang bzhag bsngo: tshe dang bsod sgoms 'byar pa 'baraḥ ci bsam yid bzhin lhun gyisagrub: shes rab rgyas ṣer 'dod pa yis: skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ las blo ldan mchag sred ni: dmar ser gtso 'khar sngar bzhin la:phyag na glegs bam ka pā lasnye thugs kar pad nyi hūṃ gi mthar: ha ri ni sadamar ser ni: sgon me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: lus nang khengs pas gti mug gi:mun pa kun sangasashel sgong 'dra: 'od 'phras 'gro ba'i gti mug bsal: snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gror bsam: kun gyi 'pha rtsod rtsom pa dang : 'dzin bzang tshe dang gzi brjed sdud: snying ga'i yi ge lnga la thim: shesarab chen po thob par 'gyur: tshe dang shes rab bdud rtsi yis: rang gi lus khengasabade bar bsam:yang yang spro bsdu de bzhin bsgom: tshon bzung mnyam par gzhag par bya: de rjes spro bsdu sngar bzhin la: hūm̐ glu blang zhing ma yengs bsgom: rjes la rig sngags 'di yang bzlas: ā+oṃ ri ni sa ha āḥsno de rjes sngar bzhin sbyad pa yis:shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags rnams 'byung : nyi shu gcig gis skal ldan par:'khrub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: gsum pa dbang gisalas bstan pa: skyabasa'agro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ las nyi ma 'od zer dmar: gtso zhabar sngar bshin phyag gnyis na: pad ma dmar dang ka pā la: thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su sno phyogasabazhin ha ri ni sa dmar: 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam par —25—

me bo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen ranga'abyams kyi gsung 'bum/()'phros: khams gsum kun 'dusasnying gar thim: yang 'phros snang srid mkha' 'gra'i zhing : tshun 'dusasnying ga'i yi ger thim: yang 'phros gang mos bsgrub bya bkug: 'od gyur snying gar thim pa las: yang 'phrasadabang gi mkha' 'gro ma:dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i tshogs: ba skru'i bu ga kun nas thon: sngar bzhin bkug nas bsgoms byas la: hūm̐ glu blangasashing sngags 'di bzlas: ā+oṃ ni ha sa ri āḥ sno che ge ma'i rnam par shes pa khug dzaḥhring hring : rjes la snang srid hūm̐ la bsdu: de yang mnyam rdzogasachas sku'i ngang : bde chen gza' gtad med par gzhag: dge ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo: zla ba byed kyisaskal ldan par:'khrub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: bzhi pa drag pa'i 'phrin lasani: bgegs chen dam sri ma rungasapa: 'tshe zhing bdag la gnod pa na: skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed stong pa'i ngang : nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa rtsa rdo rje rwa ba bla bres gur: ye shesame ri 'bar ba'i nang : pad+ma nyi ma'i dbusasu ñtsa 'od 'phras me yi 'khor lo ni: rno ngar mo ma'i rang bzhi la: rtsibs stong ldan pa stobar bar bsam: da rjes hūṃ las rang nyid ni: pad+ma thod phreng mthing nag la: rin chen rusapa'i rgyan dang ldan: phyag g.yasame yi 'bar lo bsnams: g.yon pa sdig mdzub thugs kar mdzad: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabasadang : thod skam sbrul nag chun pos brgyan: g.yasabaskum g.yon brkyang dor stabasatshul: zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs: dbu sgra dmar ser ag tshom 'bar:thugs kar pad nyi'i dbusasu sno phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa mthing : nam mkha' khyab par bsgoms pa yis: rdo rje 'bar ba'i sbu gseb nas: ye shes me stag rnam par 'phra: sprul pa'i khro chung 'phra 'du yis: bgegs rnams gzir gnon —26—

byin rlabasazugasasgrub/bye mar rlog: phyogasabazhin 'phros pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: gtso bo 'dra ba rnam par bsgom: snang srid me 1nga gcig tu 'khyil: me yi 'khar lo 'khar ba yis:gnod byed rgyal bsen dam sri rnamasaḥ me lce'i kha la sbrang bu bzhin: lus gtungs mes bsrekhrus rdul phran bzhin: sku yi 'thor rlang bskyod pa yis: rlang gis sprin gtor dengasdo pa bzhin: gnod byed gnas 'bar yul gtor nas:rnam shes nam mkha'i debyings su 'dres: sus kyang gnod pa med par bsam:de ltar 'phra 'du'i ting 'dzin gyis: snang srid khro bo khro mo rnams: hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs pa yis: gnod byed gzir bar bsams byas la: hūm̐ glu ngar dang bcas pa blang : thun zhabasadrag sngags 'di yang brjod: ā+oṃ sa ha ri ni āḥṅgha gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bzlas rjes la chos nyid ngang :bgegs su 'dzin pa rang gi sems: sems ni kha dog dbyibasadang bral: srung dang bsrung bya med par bzhag: sems can don du bsngo ba bya: bgegasarnams med cing bsam pa 'khrub: de ltar bskyed rim legs bsgoms nas: 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang : dben zhing dngas la nyams dga' bar:skyabs su 'gro dang semasabaskyed dang : mi rtag 'chi ba dran byas la: spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'thur bsgom: snying nas gsol gdab byin rlabasabasam: de nasalta stangs gzigs stangs gas: ka dag lhun grub 'od gsal bsgom: bying rgod bral bas brtson byas te: rjes la semasacan don du bsngo: 'gro 'chag za nyal dus kun spya bar 'ga' mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom: bar da'i gdams pa dran par bya: bar 'ga' sgyu ma rmi lam bsgom: ka dag chas sku'i rtsal sbyang bya: bar 'ga' mnyam rdzogs chos su bsgom: 'od gsal dag pa'i lam khyer bya: bar —27

me bo'i shu bas la / 1nga r+ṣa rab gomasakyi gsung 'bum//shi'aga' gang shar chos sku la: dug lnga rang grol lam khyer bya: mdor na tha mal spangs byasal: nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' bar bya: tshe 'dir sangasargyas thob par nges: e ma ha mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i man ngag las: yang gsang zab ma'i byin rlabs thugs sgrub bkod: tshegs chung sgrub sla 'bras bu don che ba: 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med: de phyir skalaldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: byin rlabs thugs sgrub dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so: maṅgalo: ཿ—28—

ra༅/ /rin chen shog ser gyi skor rig 'dzin mchog sgrub bzhugs soḥrig 'dzin me//chog sgrub ces bya ba: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: rnamo smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun gyis grub: grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnamasala'ang phyag 'tshal lo: de nyid grub phyir sgrub pa'i rim pa ni:mchag dang thun mong rnam pa gnyisasu brjod: bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa: 'od gsal mchag gi sgrub pa dang gsum: dang po la gsum las: sngon 'gro ni: dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnasasu: rgyasapa'i dus: ston gsum me tag dang 'brasabu smin pa'i tshe: a ru ra: ba ru ra: skyu ru ra: gla rtsi: ghi wang : gur gum: ⑪shi: stogang : rgya tsha: rgyasatsha:kha ru tsha: pi pi lipa shing mngarasnye go snyod: a ba: dbang lag: rtag tu sto.a ka ru nag po: tsan+dan dkar dmar: sbrul sha: da byed rnamasabye mar btagasate: mu zi ser posadangul chu btso ma dang bsresal: ka ra: bu ram: sbrang rtsi gsum gyis dril te ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam byasal: rin po che'i sgod du blugasate: maṇ+ḍal pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du bzhag: mtha' skor du mchad pa yang bsham mo: gnyis pa dngosagazhi ni:zla ba yar gyi tshes gcig gi tshe: dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byar pa du yod kyis tshogs te: nyi ma rtse shar nasasgrub pa'i mgo bo brtsam mo: thog —29—

mesabo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kamar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas: rang nyid rig 'dzin gyi sgob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa ljang ser rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par mos la:stong pa'i ngang las gnas de nyid bde ba can du bsam pa'i nang du: ril bu rnams 'od du zhu ba las skad cig gis: pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du: tshe dpag med dmar po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thog pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung mnyam gzhag dang bcas pa'i phyogs bzhir:sman gyi lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi yang sman gyi bum pa bzung ste bzhengs nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam la: ye shes sems dpa' ba ga nas: dngos dang yid kyis mchad de: ā+oṃ ā yu ṣe a ma ra ni dzi wān ti ye swā 1 zhes ci 'grub brjod pas: phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa': nyi zla rtsi shing nags tshal: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tshe dang : gzi brjid dang : dbang phyug thams cad bsdus te de nyid du thim par gyur: sman gyi lha mo bzhi las 'od 'phrasapas:zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i dngos grub bsdus te: de nyid du thim par bsam zhing bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par zhag nyi shu rtsa cig tu bya'o: grub pa'i rtags su sman rnams 'phel ba dang : ngad kyisathams cad khyab pa dang : rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba dang : sman gyi ri la 'jegs pa dang : me tog 'thu ba la sogs pa'o: sgrub pa thon dus ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ril bur mos par bya'o: gsum pa rjes ni: ril bu de nyid tho rangs lnga lnga zos te: sngar gyi dmigs pa dang sngags kyi sgom bzlas byas —30—

rig 'dzin mchag sgrub/pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa dang : nad kyi rigs thams cad zhi zhing mi 'byung ba dang : sangs rgyas byang chub bsems dpa' la sogs pa 'phags pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang : mkha' 'gro thams cad sprin bzhin du 'du bas stongs grogs byed pa dang : zhi ba dang : rgyasapa dang : dbang dang :drag pa'i phrin las thogs pa med par 'khrub pa dang : gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang : longs spyod rab tu rgyasapa dang : shesarab 'phel ba dang : lha'i rigs 'du zhing mthong ba dang : ci bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'o: bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa rdzogs so:lja: rgya rgya rgya:gnyis pa 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa ni: dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su: stan bde ba la 'dug ste: skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas: skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las: pad+ma dmar po dang : nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phras snang srid sgod ba da thams cad 'od dmar po gcig tu gyur pa hrīḥl thim pa yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid slob dpon chen po nyi ma 'od zer dmar po tshe'i myu gu dang bum pa bsnams pa: rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa: yum gsang ba ye shes dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang zhal spyor ba: spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa: 'od zer dmar po 'phra ba'i phyogs bzhi: ha ri ni sa bzhi las tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dmar ser sems dpa'i skyil krung rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa: thams cad kyis phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa: gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'o: de nas ye shesapa ba ga la: 31—

me bo'i shul bzhagal / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()de thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na hrīḥre bsam pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs ba 'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'od dang ཿ gzi brjed tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus la: rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥl zim pas rang nyid tshe yi rig 'dzin thob: tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa thob par bsam zhing ཿ 'og rlung drag tu 'then: steng rlung cung zad mnan la: spyi bo nasadangs ma dkar dmar babs pas lus thams cad bde stong du mer khengs par bsam zhing :rlang bum pa can bskyil lo: bzlas pa'i rnal 'byar ni: tweḥlas hrīshā phreng ba yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du song bas: yum gyi mkha' nas yab kyi gsang bar zhugs te: snying ga'i hrī'i zhababs su thim pa 'gal me ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyisabla ma dang : sangasargyas dang : byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad dang : dpa' bo dang dpa' mo 'jig rten gyi lha klu rig 'dzin: nyi ma: zla ba: rtsi shing : nagasatshal la sagasapa'i tshe dang : shesarab dang :bsod nams dang : gzi brjed thams cad bsdusate: snying ga'i hrīḥl thim pas: rang nyid tshe'i dngos grub nyi zla dang mnyam pa thob par bsam zhing :hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥzhes grangs med pa bzlas so: thun 'jog khar snang srid sgod bas thams cad sngags phreng la thim: sngags phreng shrī la thim: 'khor bzhi yab yum dang ba sa pa gsal btang la: sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba byas te: sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas langs so: thun mtshamasasu gtor ma ji ltar 'thur pa bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la: mdun du lha de rnams —32—

rig 'a na mtshog sgrub/gsal gdab ste: ā+oṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa āḥhūṃ bha l+la ta kha kha khā hi lnga'am bdun gyis phul bas mnyes par bsam la: mgron rnamasarang la bsdus te bsngo ba bya': de lta bu'i sgrub pa lo re la zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig re ma chag par bya'oḥ zhag re bzhin tho rang dmigasapa thun re ma chags par bya'o: grub pa'i rtags su: nas la sogs pa 'khru'i phung po dang : nyi zla shar ba dang : me tog thu ba dang : nam langs pa dang : gos dkar po dri ma med pa rgyan pa dang : chu ba'i rgyun la 'thung zhing khrus byed pa dang : nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa rmi'o: lo drug bsgoms na 'chi med mo'i rig 'dzin grub bo: deng song tshe la long med skar mda' 'dra: zab ma'i dgongs gter nyams len mthar mi phyin: de phyir grub pa thob pa shin tu nyung : 'di ni 'a med tshe yi dngos grub mchog: rig 'dzin sa la snyegs phyir snying phyung nas: phyi rabasasnying tig spyod pa'i cha rkyen du: dri med 'od zer bdag gis legs par bkod: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa rdzogs so:lja: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa la gnyis las: nyin mo 'od gsal mkha' la dbyung ba ni: bzhugs stangs gsum gyisamatan sum gyi don la ma yengasapar bya'o:gnyis pa mtshan mo 'od gsal sbubaske su sba ba ni: lus ni lha yi dkyil 'khor la: sgra sen ye shes me ri 'ab8/: yan lag sgo bzhi rta babasab sa:mgo bo gtsang khang phyur bu la: mig sogos dbang po rnam pa lnga: rtsig pa lnga dang rgyan rnams rdzogs: de dus snying ga pad+ma dang : nyi ma zla ba'i dbus dag na: 'od kyi stobar lo mu khyud lnga: 'od zer nyi ma stong 'dra zhing : gsal —33—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ 1nga chen pa 'grums kyi gsung 'bum/()'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: de dbus rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas ni:rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung : snang mtha' don yod grub pa rnams:kun bzang mā ma gī dang niḥ sangs rgyasaspyan dang gosadakar mo: dam tshig sgol dang mnyam par sbyor: mthing ga dkar ser dmar ljang zhing: rdo rje skyil krung rgyan rnamasardzogs: 'bar lo rdo rje rin chen dang : pad+ma rgya gram 'dzin pa 'o: zur bzhir sems dpa' sems ma brgyad: sgo bzhir sgo ba yab yum bzhi: so sa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhin: yang na 'od kyi gong bu bsam:steng du khro ba'i dkyil 'khar ni: 'od lnga'i gdangasate 'khril sbyor nyid: yang na 'od kyi 'khar lo bsam: snying dbus 'od kyi 'khor lo na: rigasalnga yab yum 'od gsal sku: snang la rang bzhin med pa la: steng 'og phyogs mtshams lha rnams kun: 'od kyi gong bu 'od zer 'phra: gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan par bsgom: desani 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags: rmi lam zin dang med pa dang : rigs lnga'i zhing khams snang ba dang : rnam rtog ma lus dbyings su nub: nyin mtshan 'od kyi 'khor lor snang : lha la sogs pa'i gzugs mthong dang : sgra snyan dri mchog sngon med snang : tha mal snang ba nub pa dang : ci snang ga gas brnyan 'dra ba dang : phyi nang zang thal mthong ba 'o: de ltar gomasapas skal ldan de: brtson 'grus rab kyis tshe 'dir grol:'bring rnams bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas: tha ma'ang rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing : mngan du gyur nasardzogasasangs rgyas: de nyid rtagasasu skal ldan de:'dasadus sku gdung ring bsrel dang : 'ja' 'od sna tshogasa'abyung bar nges:—34—

rig 'dzin mchag sgrub/'di rnams rnal 'thur skal ba rab: sku gdung ring bsrel 'ja' 'od ni:nges par 'di yis 'grub pa yin: rjes 'jug spro ba mchog tu skyed: gdams pa'i snying po yang zab 'di: skal ldan gcig las mang ba na: mkha' 'gra'i chad pa 'byung bar nges: de phyir rang nyid nyams su longs: ma spel snying du rgya yis gdab: 'od gsal mchog gi sgrub pa 'di: rig 'dzin mchag gi sgrub pa yin: de phyir yang gsang snying la sba: 'od gsal mchag gi sgrub pa rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: 35:de yang 'di lta bu'i gsang sngags mthar thug pa'i chos dang 'phrad pa'i skal ldan de nyid rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin yin la: des zab ma'i don rdzogs par nyams su len pa'i phyir: 'chi med 'khrub pa ni tshe'i rig 'dzin yin: de'i rten la gdams pa'i don mngon du gyur pas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yin laḥ de nyid mthar phyin nas 'og min du sangs rgya ba'i tshe: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin yin no: 'dir mkha' 'gro snying tig gi skal ldan gcig la bzhi ka tshangs te: sngon nas las//(a rnam pa tshe 'dir smin nas 'di dang 'phrad pas rnam par smin pa'i rig/ 'dzin: ba na 'grus rab kyi 'od lus grub pas tshe la dbang thob: 'bring skong tha mas 'od gsal mchog gi tshe la dbang thob pas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin: mngon sum gyi snang ba mthong bas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin: de nyid cis kyang gdod ma'i sar grol bar nges pas lhun kyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin: des na 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med do: e ma r+ṣa mkha' 'gro snying tig bka' —35—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rala'abyams kyi gsung 'bum//shigasang rgya che las: shin tu zab ma'i gnad bsdus bcud phyung ba: don gyi snying po 'od gsal mchag gi lam: gang dang mi 'dra kun gyisam rtogs pa: tshig don mtha' dag rdzogasapar bdag la babs: bdag nyid snying la rgyas btang sba snyam pas: tho rangs bud med g.yu yi lan tshang can: shin tu mdzesapa'i gzugs can zhig na re: phyi rabasaskal ldan don du spel cig gsungs: de nasabadag gis zab ma'i gnad rnamasakun: shog ser ngos la lhag chad med par bkod: phyi rabs lasacan rnams dang 'phrad par shog: rig 'dzin mchag sgrub ces bya ba: dri med 'od zer gyis o rgyan rdzong du bkod pa rdzogs so: bkra shis: :

༄7/ /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho bzhugs so:rin ོ shog ser skor bskyed rimayid bzhi nor bu'oḥdangos grub phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi: rdo rje phag mo la barma de:sa da 1debyesko bye /skye 2) /sku shākhos mkha' 'gra ba rgya ma las: ba da ma da ba nar bu bshad:skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po sum brtsegs dbus su pad+ma 'dab bsnya steng du: zla ba dang : nyi ma dang : ro'i steng du: hrī dmar po las 'od 'phras snang srid thams cad la phog: 'od zer dmar po spyog tu gyur nas tshun 'dus: yi ge gnyis la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gcer bu spyan gsum dang : phag zhal nag mo ngur ba me long dril bu'i phreng ba 'khral ba: zhabs g.yon ra'i snying gar brkyang zhing : g.yas bskums pa'i rting pa bha ga la gtad pa: sgra 'phyangs shi/nga kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung du 0ga par bsam pa'i pang du dpa' bo rta mgrin (mar po sdi gtsug na rta rmego ljapre nag 'tshor ba: zha pre gnyisayud+me la 'khril pa: )na gsum skre mats+tsha ba gartsergesapa: de gasnyes kaskre phyag g.yas rgenyis na n+d+ra rgerge dang :g.yon gnyis na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams/pa : rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam mo:spyi ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi la pad nyi zla ba'i steng du: dbus su ha dang ra las skyes pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum dkar po dang : 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa bzhi las de dang 'dra ba'i rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro yab yum g.yas —37—

me po'i shulabazhagalas/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakya gsung 'bum/ /shigayon gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa: rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa: kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung na yod pa: spyan gsum pa'i thugs kar g.yung drung dkar pa'i lte bar ha dang ra: yan lag bzhi la a ri ni sa bzhi yod pa'o: mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bzhi la: dbus su ri dang tsa las rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser po: 'dab ma bzhi la ha a ni sa bzhi las rin chen dpa' bo de dang 'dra ba'i zhabar bzhi: rgyan dang phyag mtshan gong dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar: g.yung drung ser pa'i dbus su ri dang rtsa: yan lag bzhi la ha a ni sa'o: snying gar pad 'dab bzhi dang nyi zla'i dbus su ma dang hūm̐ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum mthing ka 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri na sa las de 'dra ba'i 'khor bzhi:snying gar g.yung drung 'khrul ba'i dbus su ma dang sa yan lag bzhi la ha ri ni sa'o: ste bar pad 'dab bzhi'i dbus su nyi zla la ni dang hrīḥdamar po las: pad+ma mkha' 'ab yab yum dmar po: 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri a sa bzhi las: de 'dra ba'i 'khor bzhi: thugs kar g.yung drung dmar pa'i dbus su ni dang hri hrī: yan lag bzhi la ha ri a sa'o: gsang bar pad 'dab bzhi'i lte bar nyi zla la sa dang ya las: las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu: 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni a las: de 'dra ba'i 'khor: thugs kar g.yung drung ljang gu'i dbus su sadang ya: yan lag bzhi la ha ri ni a'o: de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa rgyan cha lugs yongasasu rdzogs pa: 'og min dang phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten nas: ye shes pa bstem la rlung kha spyor du bzung bas lha de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis: 'jig rten thams cad g.yo 'degs —38—

mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho/'phar ba las: skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus: zas nor gyi char phab:nad gdon bar chad zhi bar bsam la:ā+oṃ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsici hri hri dzaḥdza: ā+oṃ sa ḍa kai ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri shā tsitā hri tri dzaḥdza: de bzhin( dwaX.ā+oṃ badz+ra ḍa gi ni ’ha' ri sa ra tsa hri ya tsitā hri hri dzaḥ(: ā+oṃ ra1 ḍa gi ni rte ri sne sa ra hūṃ trī pre rtserte hri lha dzaḥdza: /ā+oṃ pabye ḍa ki ni ha ri ni sa ( ( skre pre byetā hri skre dzaḥdza: ā+oṃ karma rte gi ni ha ri ni sa ra bye ṣ+ṭṛ skre rtset+ta lha lha dzaḥdza: zhes brjorde pas: 'bar lo /lngash+lau lhaskre hūṃgasarge'i g.yung drung rnams drag tu 'khar bas: lha de rnams rang gi snying ga na 'khrab cing gar byed pas: skye 'gro thams cad kyi dran pa myos par byas te dbang du bsdus nas bdag gi rkang pa'i drung du lhags par bsam zhing : rlung phyir song bas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu dang : zhags pa dang : lcags sgog dang :dril bu'i rnam pas: 'gro ba rnamasabakug: ba ngas/ bsdams: dbang du byas nang du rngubs pas de rnamasasnying ga dang gagang/ gnas su thim par bsam la: lus lha: ngag sngags: semabasacing 'dzin las ma yengabasapar rab tu chags pas bkug par bya'o: skabs su thig///le'i 'grems sdud kyis bde stong spar bzhin mkha' 'gro rnams mnyes par bya'o: de ltar zhag bdun ni bsnyen pa'o: de nas sgrub pa dang las spyor ni: gang la dmigs pa'i ba(1ba bya de'i snying ga'i nang na bdag nyid skyond par bsam 05: sngags bzlas dmigs pas gas la: kho rang dbang med par rang la 'dud cing dga' bar bsam ste: ā+oṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya t+t+waṃ mo a ga ya dṛ —39—

me po'i shul bas las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung la ma/(kakhug dzaḥdza: zhes pas rnam shes a'i rnam pa can rang gi gsang gnas dang :snying gar thim par bsam la: drag tu bzlas pas zhag gsum na rang dbang med par khug go: de bsnyo du nor sgrub pa'i tshe rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis phyogs bas nor lha bkug la: sgrub khang du nor gyi char 'bebs par bsam: ā+oṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sirnyi pha la be shra ma ne+e tsit+ta lha hri dzaḥdza:zhes so: nad gdon dang sdig pa zhi ba la ni: 'od zer dkar pos rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsgom la: ā+oṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa: nad gdon sdig sgrib shārnying ku ru ye swālha zhes so: lha la gang sgrub kyang de dang mthun pa'i sku mdog dang 'od zer du gsal ba'i thugasaka nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu dang : rigs de'i lha'i sngags thog mar 'dren pa ni gnad do: de ltar bzlas pa'i rnal 'thur pasa'akhor lo lnga gsal btab ste:bza' btung mkha' 'gra'i tshogs 'khor bya: gal te las rnamasam grub na:'khor lo lnga yi mkha' 'gro ma: gang yin 'khrab cing gzir ba dang : de yi sgog sngagasathog mar bgrang : des ni the tshom med pa 'o: sangs rgyasamakha' 'gro'i dam tshig spya skye med don la gnasapar bya: rdo rje mkha' 'gra'i dam tshig spya sems can kun la byamasapa sgoms: rin chen mkha' 'gra'i dam tshig 1 ma chags sbyin pa phyogs med gtang : pad+ma mkha' 'gra'i dmotshig lco gtum mo sgom zhing bde stong sparaḥ las kyi mkha' 'gra'i dam tshig lcospyon spyod gdug rtsub sna tshogs bya: me nang mkha' 'gro lnga bskyed la: zas sna 'khru sna sna tshogs bsreg: tshogs gtan bud med ston mo bya: des ni myur du —40—
gyu/ra:bskyed rim yid ba/de nor bu /debya ba:gangs ri thod da pa:/de:rgya rgya rgya:

༄7/ /rdzogs rim bzhugs:mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho las: rdzogs rim ye shes 'bar lo bshad: de yang ye shes sems gnyisalas: lnga ldan 'od kyi rim pa ni: bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas kyang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gra'i zhing khamasasu: rdo rje mkha' 'gra'i me long la: pad+ma mkha' 'gra'i sgo bye ste: sgo la las kyi mkha' 'gro phyon: rin chen mkha' 'gro mkha' la snang : mi 'gyul mi bsam mi yengs par: ye shes nyid las 'bral mi bya: tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgyas: sems kyi rdzogs rim rnam gsum las: bde ba nyid ni bsgom 'dod na: 'khor lo lnga yi dbus dag na: rtsagasum sbug ma stong pa la: yar sna tshang bug yi ge haṃ: mar sna gsang gnas yi ge a: lte bar ram̐ las me 'bar bas: haṃ las byang semasa'o rgyun bab: gsang gnasabar du khyab pa la: a dang 'dresapas bde stong skyes: slar bzlog hūṃ ring bzhi brjod nas: ni dṛ hing ni nyer gcig gis: sgal tshigs drangs la dgram par bya: de nyid 'thungs nas btsun mo dang : mnyam du sbyar bas bde stong sgom: mi rtog ka dag ngang la gzhag: gnyis pa gsal stong ye shes ni: gang shar rig pa ngos bzung la: mi dgag mi sgrub rang sar bzhag: khyad par rtsa gsum gsal btang la: bum pa can du bskyil ba dang : seṅge rnam grol 'cha ba dang : chu srin can du mnyam par gnas: dang por rlung ro phud nas kyang : lte 'og a —42—

rdzogasarim/la sems bzung la: 'og rlang gtso bor bskyil ba yinaḥ gnyis pa steng rlang 'ching ba ste: snying ka'i ha ri ni sa la: sems bzung gtso bor steng rlang mnan: gsum pa bar rlang sbyang ba ste: mnyam gnasagang la'ang mi rtog pas: 'gro 'ong rab tu dal ba yin: de dus gsal la mi rtog pa'i: ye shes don de ngos bzung la: yun du bsgom pa rab tu gces: lus gas 'khrul 'bar sna tshogs bya: g.yon dang mnyam rgyu'i rlung dang ni: dad dang ngesa'abyung skyes tshe gzung : chags sogs nyan mongs skyes tshe 'bud: nang du mi gzung drag tu 'don: des ni gsal stong chas sku skye: gsum pa mi rtog ye shes ni:lus bsrang e yi 'dug stangs kyis: steng 'og rlung sbyar mig mi 'gul:bar snang mda' gang tshad du gtad: gang yad mi sems mi rtog cing : ma ba sa ma bslad 'gyur ba med: ji ltar nam (mikha' dag pa bzhin: mi rtog mtha' dbus med par bzhag: 'phro na 'phra///mkhan rang gi sems: kha dog dbyibs bral ngos gzung med: gnas na gnas mkhan rang gi sems: ye grol gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid: blang dor re dogs rtsis gdab med:ye stong rtsa bral chen por gzhag: rjes la phyi nang snang srid kun: rang snang yin te rmi lam 'dra: snang la bden med chu zla 'dra: rten 'brel tsam ste sgyu ma 'dra: chags sdang re dogs med par blta: nyan mongs dug lnga gang skyes kyang : rlabs nyid rgya mtshor zim pa ltar: rang shar chas sku'i lam khyer bya:yod med snang stong btags pa tsam: 'bar 'das rang snang rmi lam tsam:blang dor re dogs blos btags tsam: don la gnyis med chos skur sbyar:—43—

me po'i shul ba las/ klong 'a 4 krumasakyi gsung khrum//shide ltar shesapa'i rnal 'thur la: thamasacad rnam dag bde ba'i zhing : o rgyan ye shesamakha' 'gra'i zhing : logasan med de rang la tshang : mkha' 'gro sprin bzhi ngang gis 'du: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob: bdag 'dra dri med 'od zer gyis: mkha' 'gra'i gnad yig gsang ba 'di: gangasari thod dkar mgul du bkod: khyu: rgya rgya rgyaḥ 44—

༄7/ /rlung drug rdo rje'i chings bzhuspyoḥshog ser skor (mkha' 'gro bde ོ rgya mtsho las: rlung////drug rdo rje'i chings nyid spyod: chos kun stong pa'i 4 nyid las: 'dab bzhi chasaḥng dmar gsal dbus: hū las rang nyid phag mo'i sku: mazing nag spri gug thod khrag 'dzin: kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan: ro steng g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhing : phag zhal spyan gsum khrosapar bsam: snying gar pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus:e dang ha ri ni sa las: gtso mo 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro lnga: thugs kar sabon yig 'khrusamo: stong gsum rang la thim par bsam: rlung ni mnyam gnas thub thang gzung : phyir rgyu ā+oṃ dkar nang 'jug ā: gnasapa hūm̐ yin snod bcud bsdu: thugs kar lha lnga gar byed pas: thams cad dbang bsdus zur saX zur /de la snaspyor /dezural pa la snarlung nyad bsgam: rtsa ba' rlung dang pa yan: yan lag rlung sbya ba sa rda rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar: snying gar ha dang phyogasabazhi sa a ri ni sa 'khar ba yis: 'jig rten bsdu zhing spyi gtsug lco dmigs pa gtad pas rlung gzung 'gyur: de bawo mgrin par pad zla'i steng : rin ོ mkha' 'gro ser gsal te: thugs kar ri dang phyogs bzhi sa ha a ni sa ser po bsgom: snying gar sngar bzhin dmigs pa ste: lte bar pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar:thugs kar ni la ha ri a: sa gzhi dag gisabaskor ba las: bud med rnams ni gtso bor dgug: chags pasabade stong bsgom par bya: gsang bar —45—

me bo'i shul bzhagams/ klong za rab gomasakyi gsung 'bum/()las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang: thugs kar sa la ha ri ni: a bzhis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: skyes pa rnams ni gtso bor dgug: de ltar 'khar lo lnga dbus su: mkha' 'gro lnga tshan lnga bsgomasal: rang dang mthun pa'i 'od zer ni: yi ge gsum gyi rnam pa yis: rdo rje rlang gi bzlas pa yis: shag drug bsgoms pa'i rnal 'thur ma: mkha' 'gros dngos su lung ston cing : mchag dang thun mong dngos grub thob: dam tshig chagasazhen chung ba dang : bud med mi spang bde stong bsgom: byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgom: lta ba nam mkha' yangs pa las: spyon spyod tho co skabasasu bcom: gtad med rang grol lam khyer bya: ji srid chen 'dzin zhig pa na: mkha' 'gra'i dngos grub mthar thug yin: rlang drug rdo rje'i chings zhes bya ba: mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho rdzogs so: lja: rgya rgya rgya: shu snye: :hūṃ 46—
