mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/rin po che dang rusapa'i dra bas brgyan par mthong nas/ khyed rnams kyis 'di cir mthong zer nas bshad do/ /de nas bla mas dris pa/ khyed 'dir ci la byen/ bla ma dam pa sku khamasabazang ngam/ rnal 'thur mas smrasapa/ do nub dus gnyan pas las can gyi sgob ma nyul du 'ong / bla ma sku khams bzang zer ro/ 'o na da lo bla ma sku chag che ba a'u tsi 'am dris pas sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'khrul la bar chad ga na yod/ gdul bya la dgongs pa yin mod/ bi ma la bod yul du byon pa mi shes sam gsungs/ 'o na ji tsam bzhugs/ da nas lug lo phyi ma'i bar bzhugs/ de nas gdul bya dang bstun pas nges pa med/'o na nga bla mas gzhan don la bskul de khyed kyis bskul ba lags sam dris pas/ 'o 'o de ka de ka zer dus/ ngasagacig pur bsdad nas/ 'od lus bsgrub bam/ gzhan don byas na sems can la phan thogs yong / /da ji tsam thub dris pas/ 'od lus 'grub kyang sems can la phan 'dogs dgos/gzhan don 'ur 'ur/ da lo nasabazung ste lo sum cu thub gsungs so/ /de dus rnal 'thur pa 'od zer go cha na re sku tshe ring bar 'dug zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mkha' 'gra'i 'di la gzab gtad med/ zla ba dang / zhag la lor brtsi ba'ang srid pas gang yin mi shes gsungs so/ /yang bla mas nga la bka' srung ji tsam yod dris pas/ mang mang bla ma'i thams cad khyed la yod/khyad par du rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin zer ro/ /'gro don sa phyogs ga na yod drisapas/ lto nub phyogs na yod/ de yang gra dang grwa phyi dang 'khrung po phyogs na yod/ 'o na ngas gzhan la phan nges sam dris pas/ da nasabazung nas 'ur —/63—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()'ur/ tshe phyi ma de bas kyang 'gro don rgya che gsungs/ phyi ma ga na yod drisapas/ lho brag phyogs dang / mon bod rgya gar gyi mtshams na rgya che rgya che gsungs/ mon bum thang yin nam dris pas/ 'o 'o de ka de ka ma nor ma nor gsungs so/ /'o na mkha' 'gro snying tig nas ji skad bshad pa'i dbang khrid da lta gdab tu rung ngam dris pas/ khyed rang gi yin pa la los los zer ro/ /mi rnamasakyis zog por 'dzin du mi yong bam drisapas/ mi'i kha la rgyu mtshan ci yod/ skal ldan rnams nged kyis sdud skal med smra mkhan med kyang mi 'du/ sangs rgyasala'ang skur pa 'debs pa zer ro/ /'o na snying tig gi chos bka' gang du 'byed rdo rje g.yu sgon gyis gnas su 'byed dam dris pas/'di na mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du bas 'dir 'byed dgos zer ro/ /bum thang gi gter kha de tshe 'di la thon nam dris pas/ dam tshig shin tu gtsang ba'i slob ma gsum bzhi tsam yod na thon zer ro/ /da lta yod dam drisapas/ med sngags pa dkar sangs sha ni bsrab la shin tu mjes pa zhig 'ong /de dusathon zer ro/ /gter yig dris pas/ de dusalung ston mkhan re yong dri mi dgosagasungs so/ /gter sa'i brag dris pas/ bum thang gi gzhung chu lho nub la babs pa'i lung pa zad du nye ba'i shar ngos kyi brag mtha' pi wang gyen du bslangs pa lta bu'i mgo phyir gyed la song ba'i mgul mtshams na tshur 'ongs pa'i gad mchu'i steng na shing lo stag ma ltar yod pa nas thag pa btags nas 'doms ba gnyis song ba na brag gru bzhi zo thabs su yod pa'i dkyil smad ser ka gru gsum yod pa na 'dug zer ro/ /nga dang sgob —164—

mthong snang si po che 'od kyi dra ba/dpon chen po nam mjal dris pas/ lung gsum gyi phu ri gsum gyi mda' brag chung nge ba kha lho nub tu lta ba brag gsum pa de'i g.yas zur gyi 'og tu mjal nas lung ston gsungs so/ /bi ma la dang nam mjal dris pas/mjal zin 'dug pa la zer ro/ /ngas rtogs pa 'di snying tig gi don mthar thug pa yin nam drisapas/ mthar thug go zer ro/ /gter kha gzhan dris pas 'di nas nub byang mtshalas na brag ri shin tu mtho ba mdung rtse gyen du gzengs pa 'dra ba'i ngos nas thon te der mi bzhung gsungs so/ /'o na shar phyogs khra mo brag gi gter kha de ngasathon nam mi thon dris pas/ thon zin 'dug pa zer ro/ /rnal 'byar pa 'od zer go chas spa sgang pa rin chen rdo rje de ga na yod dris pas/ spa sgang pa rin chen rdo rje zhes dar cig mi gsal ba las/ sgob dpon rin rdor dris pas/ lags lags so de khong yin 'di na bzhugs 'dug pa gsungs nas mdzub mo btsugs so/ /bla mas dris pa/khong skye ba de'i 'og tu bum thang du skye bar gsungs pa la dag na yin gsungs pas/ skye ba de'i 'og tu longs sku'i zhing dar cig nyul nas bum thang du skye ba las de ka ltar skye ba min/ da lta khyed rang longasasku'i zhing nyul ba yin zer ro/ /da lta longs sku'i zhing nyul ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin drisapas/ slob dpon rin rdor gyis gter thon dus lo 'gar gsang nas sgrub pa mdzad na rang don du 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing nyul gyis rtsal spyong dang snying tig gi gzhan la phan 'dogs 'ongs pa la/ ma gsung pas sku tshe tshad du ma phyin par da lta skyes dus 'od gsal 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba sgom zhing nyams su len pa —165—

mesabo'i shul bshag las/ klong chen rab 'byumasakyi gsung 'a ma/()la longs sku'i zhing dar cig nyul bar btags pa yin/ de gzhan gyis dgongs pa len ma shes pa yin/ lung bstan pa gsungs pa de da lta'i tshe 'di la dgongs pa lagasazer ro/ /ngas lhag med gar 'khrub dris pas/ gcig pur bsgoms na da lta 'grub/ /gzhan don mdzad pas bar dor grol nas sprul pasabum thang du skye ba blangasate/ rdzu'akhrul mang po bstan/ gzhan don byas nas sprul pa de yang mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor nas ma ga ta rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang o rgyan gyi yul du ga gas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston gsungs so/ /slob dpon rin rdor gang la grongs lo du song drisapas/ keg la grongs lo sum cu so gnyis song gsungs so/ /ngas snying tig gang gis phan thogs/bi ma la'i snying tig dang mkha' 'gro snying tig lo du gnas dris pas/ gnyisakas phan thogs bi ma la rgya che/ bi ma la lo brgya/ mkha' 'gro snying tig lo lnga brgyar gnas/ da lo nas mgo brtsams pa yin zer ro/ /de dusarnal 'byar pho mo rnams kyi tshe dang phan 'dogasakyang lung bstan nas/ dar cig na rnal 'thur pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyi snang ba la nam mkha'i dkyil nas/ bud med dkar mo za 'og gi na bza' dang dar thod can gser g.yus brgyan pa zhig byung nas bla ma la thim pa mthong dus/ bla ma bzhengs te ngas sngar mi shes pa'i rdo rje'i glu zhig bya'o gsungs mgur bzhengs pa/ lhun grub gdod nas stong pa ka dag dang / /bde gshegs kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems spyod spros dang bral ba chasanyid dang / /gti mug rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs —166—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/sangs rgyas rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye med bsam yul 'das pa'i gnas lugs nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlabs/ /rig rtsal 'char gzhi ma 'gags me long dang / /zhe sdang rang sar grol ba'i ngo bo nyid//mi bskyod nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs rdo rje'i rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyu ba stong gsal 'dzin med gnas lugs nyid//rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlabs/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med pa mnyam nyid dang / /nga rgyal rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rin 'byung nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs rin chen rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad phyam brdal gnas lugs mnyam pa nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlabs/ /bde stong dbyengs su nub pa kun rtog dang / /'dod chags rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /'od dpag nang na yod de phyi na med//bde gshegs pad+ma'i rigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde stong gzung 'dzin nub pa'i gnas lugasanyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlabs/ /rig pa thal byung rang grol bya grub dang / /phrag dog rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /don grub nang na yod de phyi na med/ /bde gshegs lasakyi rigasal gsol ba 'debs/ gang shar shugs 'byung 'gags med gnas lugs nyid/ /rang shar rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlabs/ /dus do nub mar gyi tshes bcu la/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan mdzad pa'i dus/ /rten 'brel nang du 'dzom pa'i rtags/ /dad ldan dam tshig g.yo ba'i rtags/ / 'gro don phyogs med 'byung ba'i rtags/ /'bar ba'i rgya mtshor brgal ba'i —/67—

me bo'i shulabs las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/(kartags//dga' 'o skyid do dag pa'i zhing / /'od gsal snod kyi 'jig rten 'di/ /'og min gnas su sgrebs pa bzhin/ /thams cad lha dang lha mo'i ngang / /rang rig mya ngan 'das pa snyam/ blang dor dgag sgrub zhig pa snyam/re dogs 'phrang las 'das pa snyam/ /srid gsum ye nas grol ba snyam//'phra 'du'i rnam rtog 'od lngar nub/ /'od lnga'i snang ba gdod mar nub/ /snang sems gzhi bral chos sku'i ngang / /tshe 'di yang bde ste phyi ma bde/ /bar dor rang ngo shes pas bde/ /da ni bde nas bde bar 'gro /glu mchad par 'a la lo dkon mchog gsum/ /thugs dgyes par mdzod cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /zhes bro brdungs nas dar cig na gnam sgo na yar bud med dmar mo rin po che'i brgyan pa zhig res gsum du snang ba 'gas mthong ba la bsu ba byas pa dang / bla ma la thim mo/ /dkar mo gcig kyang de bzhin du byen nas thim dus/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad mkha' 'gros gang bar mthong ngo / /de'i dus bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku phod ka sgrug nag dang rigasalnga'i dbu rgyan gsol nas rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa dkar gsal 'od lnga'i dbus na bzhugs pa la/ res dkar dmar mthing gsum mthong nas rnal 'thur mas cod paṇa btogs te bdud rtsi drangasadus/ thams cad la gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas lung bstan pa dang / mkha' 'gra'i snang ba byung tshul rnams su la'ang mi bshad pa'i mna' bsgags nas dar cig na/ bud med mthing nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa cig la de 'dra ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba nam mkha' na tshur byon nas bla ma'i sku la thim pa rnal 'thur ma —168—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/'gas mthong ngo / /de nas nam langs su nye ba na thams cad na re nam langs su nye mkha' 'gro yang gyes lasache zer ba la/ rnal 'thur ma sngo sangs zhig nyamasa'ur nas 'khrab pas/ mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'thibs pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i grub rtags yin/ /tshos skyong bla ma bran ltar khol ba 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i phrin las yin/ /'gro drug bu bzhin skyong pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /nyam chung mtho ris 'dren pa 'di/ /drin can bla ma'i byang sems yin/ /ci yod chas phyogs gtang ba 'di/ drin can bla ma'i rnam thar yin/ /zer ro/ /de nas nyi shu drug gi dro khar rnal 'thur ma bla yer nyal dus/ skyes pa lo bca brgyad lon pa phod ka can dang / bu mo lo bcu drug ma shin tu mdzes pa zhig dang / mkha' 'akro mang po bar snang la 'dza po mdzad pa mthong nas/ chos gsungs te de rnams nyan cing bla ma longs sku'i cha lugs su mthong ngo / /mtshan dus rnal 'byar ma 'ga' gzim chung yod dus/bud med sgra'i gos can ral pas gnam sa khebs pa rin po che'i brgyan pa zhig dang / /sngags pa dkar po zhig dang / bka' srung gi rigs mon pa dang /a tsa ra'i rnam pa mang po gtor ma len du byen dus/ rnal 'thur pa 'od zer mtha' yas bred de 'di na tshun byung ngo zer ro/ /de nas sang nyi shu bdun khrid 'chad dus/ sngar gyi slob ma dam tshig nyams pa zhig byung bas/ sprib kyisathams cad skad 'gags rig pa mig gsal te sang gnang bar chad 'od zer ba de yin par snang ngo / /do nub sgod la bla ma'i drung du bu mo lo bca drug lon pa dar zab can gnyis bdud rtsi gsol zhal bkang ba 'dren pa 'od —169—

mesapo'i shulabazhag la / 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung la ma//shizer mtha' yas kyis mthong ngo / /mkha' 'gro mang pos phyag dang bskor yang byed do/ /de dus rnal 'thur ma dkar sangs zhig gis gzim chung sa bud med gnyis song ba mthong ngo / /de'i tho rangs rnal 'byur pho mo thamasacad kyis skad ma thon par bla ma la zhus pas/ na rag gi skong bshags mdzad pas/ 'phral la nam mkha' dwangs shing grib sangs te/ bla ma'i nam mkha' la pad+ma'i sdong po la paṇ+ḍita lnga tsam res snang res mi snang zhing / 'dab ma labyis pa'i gzugs phra mos brgyan pa mthong nas dga' ston mdzad do/ /de nyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad la chos gsung dus lho nub nas slob dpon pad+ma dkar gsal za 'og gi ber dang sha ba'i mnyen zhu can mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon nas bla ma la thim pa rnal 'thur ma gsum tsam gyisamathong ngo / /de nub sgod la rnal 'byar pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis khong rang bla ma'i drung na gcer bu rus pa dang rin po che'i brgyan nas bla ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la bun bun 'gro bas mchod pa byed par mthong ngo / /de dus nam mkha'i dkyil na tshur bud med skrug nag gsum 'thab cing / /nga yong yong bde chen gyi gnas nasayong / /las can gyi slob ma sal du yong / /dam tshig gi gtsang sbra lta ru yong / /'gro don mdzod cig rigs kyi bu/ /zer ba bla ma dang rnal 'byor pho mo lnga drug tsam gyisamathong zhing / bla ma yang longs skur snang ngo / /yang nyi shu dgu'i snga dro rnal 'byar ma zhig na re mang bsing ran/mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus nas 'dug zer ro/ /de nub lung bstan pa'i dga' ston byed pas tshogs gtor shoms shig gsungs pas/ ji ltar bsham zhus —/70—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/pas/ bla mas dbus su dpal yon tan tham cad rgyas par byed pa'i dpal gtorachen po gcig shar du rdo rje phag mo srog sgrub gnyis la dpal gtor re/ rdorje g.yu sgon la sman leb gcig /dmar nag gi gza' bshas byed telacan gcig /lha rabs mched dgu'i zlum gtan gcig /bstan ma ba gnyis kyi sman leb gcig dang dpal gtor gnyis/ ldang lha'i btsan bshas gcig /byang gi mgor sngags srung gi dpal gtor gcig /mkha' 'gro spyi'i zlum gtor gcig /gza' bdud kyi bshas bu dgu bskor cig /dam can gyi bshas bu mkhar thabasacig pe dkar gyi gsang bsang phyi gcig /nub tu re ma ti mched lnga'i dpal gtor re/ gzhi bdag gi dkar gtan gcig /lhor legasaldan/ gdong bzhi pa/ mi thung / bya rog ma seng ge'i gdong can rnams kyi dpal gtor re'i mthar mgron glo bur pa'i zlum gtang gcig /pha tshad du bgegs gtor gcig rnams shoms shig gsungs so/ /de dus bsangs chu ma bran pa dang / sha brjed pa dang / bdud rtsi brjed pa rnamasal/nga'i der ma byung zer dus bltas pas mi 'dug nas gsos so/ /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'i skabs su mdun gyi nam mkha'i pad sdong las slob dpon pad+ma za 'og gi 'jol ber sha ba'i gnyen zhu can/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i g.yasasu bi ma la dkar po paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad g.yas po ti thugs kar 'dzin cing /g.yon mnyam gzhag can/ mkhur tshos gnyis rgya skegs kyis byugs pa 'dra ba dang / mdun na mkha' 'gro mang pos mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud cing /g.yon du rdo rje phag mo'i sku gcig gis nam mkha' gang ba mkha' 'ba'i cha —17/—

me bo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'dom kyi gsung 'bum/(kabyad can dang / rgyab na tshur sngags pa mang po 'chams shing / mkha' 'gro gser gyi go shubs can glu gar byed pa mang pos bskor nas bzhugs pa/rnal 'thur ma zhig gis mthong dus de dag gis bla ma la dbang bskur nas thim pa dang / bla mas bzhengs te ngasardo rje'i glu sngar mi shes pa zhig blang ngo gsungs nas bzhengs pa/ dga' 'o skyid do rnal 'byar kun/ /dus do nub 'og min dag pa'i zhing / /rang lus lha yi pho brang na/ /stong gsal zhi khra'i dkyil 'bar rgyas/ /sangs rgyas phyi na med de nang na yod/ /dus do nub bde chen gyi nyi zla shar/ /ma rig gi mun pa sangs snying 'dod/ /'bar ba'i rgya mtsho skam snying 'dod/ /bdag 'dzin gyi sprin tshogs dengs pa yin/ /tshos brgyad kyi mkhar spe zhig pa yin/ /re dogasakyi 'phrang lasa'adas pa yin/ /'di dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /bla ma phyi na med de nang na yod/ /ka dag lhun grub kyi bla ma de/ /gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhugs/ /'char sgor sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal 'a la/ /rtog med rang mdangs kyi yon chang 'bul/ /rang gsal 'dzin med kyi me tag 'a la/ /rang grol drug chad kyi bdug sbos 'a la/ /nyin mtshan kha sbyor snang gsal 'a la/ /'dzin med rang shar gyi dri cha 'a la/ /dga' bde lhun grub kyi zhal zasa'abul/ /grags stong skye med kyi sil snyan 'bul/ /phyi sna tshogs yul gyi mchod pa rnams/ shar grol 'dzin med kyi ngang nas 'a la/ /nang 'byung bzhi lusakyi gtor gzhang du/ /tsit+ta zur brgyad kyi gtar ma la/ /dpa' bo rnam lnga'i gtang rgyan btsugs/ /dwangs ma chen pa'i bdud rtsisabran/ /bde gsal 172—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/'dzin med kyi mchad pa 'a la/ /gsang ba kun gzhi'i bhan+dha phywa /rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi sman rag blugs/ /'gyu ba semasakyi dri bsung can/ /ngo bo stong gsal gyi bdud rtsi 'di/ shar grol dus mnyam gyi skyes bu yis/ /gzhi rdzogs gdod ma'i lha la 'a la/ /sems dag ye shes kyi nam mkha' la/mngon sum 'od gsal gyi nyi zla shar/ nyams snang gong 'phel gyi zer gdangs 'phra/ /rig pa tshad phebs kyi dkyil 'khar gang / /chas dbyings zad pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi zhing khams de/ /ka dag chasazad kyi ngang du thim/ /thim la ma rmugs bum pa'i sku/ /gsal ba 'dzin med rig pa'i gdangs/ /g.yo med chas sku'i ngang la bzhugs/ /gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don mdzad/ /'di bya rtsol med pa'i 'brasabu yin/ /dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje spun/ /tshe 'di yang bde ste phyi ma bde/ /bar do rang ngo shes pas bde/ /lus mi 'gyur ri ba'i dgon pa na/ /sems gcig pur gnas pa'i bsam gtan la/ /yid gcig la ma 'dzin gang bder thong / /sems 'phro yang stong la gnas kyang stong / /gang shar ye shes kyi rol pa yin/ /'di gnyisa'adzin zad na losakyang yin/ /skye med rnam dag gi sems nyid de/ /chos dbyings ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /gnas kyang mi lto gang bder zhag /bsam mno dgag sgrub kyi 'char gzhi de/ /me long ye shesakyi rigs gdangs yin/ /sems 'phra yang mi lto gang bder thong / /sems gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang gcig pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /sems gnas kyang mi lto gang bder zhag /semasayul la dga' ba'i —173—

mesapo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(ka'adod chags can/ /kun rtog ye shesakyi rig gdangs yin/ /semasachags kyang mi lto rang ngo ltos/ /sems dgag sgrub thol byung gi rig pa de/ /bya grus ye shes kyi rig gdangs yin/ /sems 'gyusakyang mi lto gang bder thong / / rigs lnga lhun rdzogasakyi rig pa 'di/ /ye bzhugs tshul shes pas grol bayin/ /dpe rmi lam rang ngo shes pa bzhin/ /de 1nga du gyur na losakyabagrol/ /'di lta ba khregs tshod kyi gdams pa yin/ /'od gsal lhun grub mi sgom pa ni/ /lus mi g.yo 'od kyi khang bu na/ /rtsa dri med shel kyi sbu gu can/ /de rgyang zhags chu yi sgon mar 'brel/ /gnas rin chen rgya mtshor 'brel ba'i gdangs/ /phyi sprin bral nam mkha'i dkyil du shar/ /nang ye shes 'od lnga kha dog lnga/ /za 'og ber khyem ris su snang / /de thig le stong palisgron mas brgyan/ /dbus rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /thig le thig phran 'brel ba ni/ /'dzam bu chu ba'i gser skud la/ rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa 'dra/sum bsgrigs 'od kyi snang ba 'di/ /chas nyid mngon sum gyi rang snang yin/ /de gong du 'phel ba'i snang ba la/ /ye shesamakhar thabs kyi snang ba dang / /lnga ldan 'od kyi pad+ma stong / /rtsibs rgyug rin chen dra ba dang / /'od lnga shel gyi mchod rten mthong / /thig le stong pa'i khang pa sa /thig pa'i sa bon yig 'khru dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyag mtshan dang / /yongasardzogasasku yi snang ba la/ /phyogs mtshams 'od lnga'i zer gdangs 'phra/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba la/ /de rnams lnga lnga zung 'brel mthong / /gang bltas 'od kyisa'ajig rten khyab/ /snying gar zer thag zug pa mthong / /de tshe rang lus gcig —/74—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/g.yo bas/ /phyogs bas zhing rnamasagayo ba dang / /rang lus tang 'dzin mnyam gzhag pas/ /thams cad mnyam par 'jog pa dang / /sku rnams tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /chas kyi rnga chen sgogs pa dang / /sadang lam gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /de bzhin rim gyis sa rnams kyi/ /yon tan gong du 'phel ba dang / /der 'dzin zad pa'i snang ba gnyis/ /mi 'gal gcig tu 'du ba ni/ /chos nyid zad pa'i sar byen te/ /rdos ba sa lus dang rtog tshogs zad/ /rnam smin las dang bag chags zad/ /ma rig 'khrul gzhi'i sa bon zad/ /snang ba rnams la 'dzin pa zad/ /rdosabacas dag pasa'aphel sgo zad/ /rang lus shel gyi khang pa sa /'od lnga yul kyi 'phra 'du ltos/ /'od dang rig pa gar 'jug kyang / lhun grub ka dag ngang du thim/ /ka dag gzhi la btsan sa zin/ /nang gsal sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /chas sku'i ngang la gzugs sku bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod du/ /chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /longs spyod rdzogasadang sprul pa'i skus/ /'gro ba'i don gnyisargyun mi 'chad/ /tshe 'dir grol ba'i gdams pa yin/ /bar da'i 'phrang la 'gro rtsa na/ /'byung ba rnams ni rim gyis thim/ /'od gsal ba la zhugs pa na/ /rang ngo shesapas gdod mar grol/ /de bzhin tshom bu ye shesadang / /lhun grub rang ngo shes pasagrol/ /rang grol me long mthong ba yin/ /sku gsum btsan sa zin pa yin/ /sprul pa'i zhing du 'di ltar 'gro/ / shar mngon dga' mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhing / /'di rang snang ston pa'i lha sa drung du/ /rang shar gyi dam chos nyan dang gcig /rang grol gyi 'dzin pa zhig dang —/75—

me bo'i shul bas la / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum//dganyis/ /lhun grub kyi rang ngo shes dang gsum/ /gzhi rtsa chad pa'i don rtog nas/ /lho dpal dang ldan par dbang bskur te/ /nub pad+ma brtsegs par ludz+wabastan nas/ /byang lasarab grub par dbugs phyung ste/ /gdod ma'i yang du rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bzhesadaga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i skrun/ /nang 'od lnga'i 'gro ldog shes pa yis/ /phyi 'od gsal gyi nyi zla rgyun du 'char/ /nang rtogs pa'i gzhi rtsa chad pa yis/ /phyi rkyen ngan bde chen gyi grogasasu 'cha/ /nang dngasama'i thig le'i rgyas pa yis/ /phyi mkha' 'gra'i sprin kung rgyun du 'du/ /nang 'od rtsa'i mdud pa grol ba yis/ /phyi gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pa rang sar grol/ /bde chen 'od gsal gyi sa la 'gro/ /'di dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i sgrun/ zhes gsungs pas mkha' 'gro rnams kyang dgyesaso/ /de'i sang gnamagang la mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa rnal 'thur pho mo phal gyis mthong ngo / /sgod la bud med sgra'i lan tshar can nam mkha' khengs pa cig na re nga la gtor ma slong zer ba rnal 'thur pa 'od zer mtha' yas kyis mthong ngo / /de nas dar cig na phyogs thams cad nas bso sgra 'ur sgra sil chom la sogs pa thams cad kyis thos so/ /dar cig na sngar nyi shu brgyad kyi nyan par gyisasnang ba'i mgron rnams byon dusatshogs gtor btang bas/ bud med mthing nag cig rnal 'thur ma zhig gi spyi bo la thim pa rnal 'byar pa rin chen 'od 'phrasamathong nas 'a ba bo/ rnal 'thur mas sgob dpon pad+ma/ bi ma la mtsho rgyal gsum byon pa mthong ngo / /de dus g.yu sgon ma dkar mo mched bdun ldem bag dang ldan pa byen nas/ bla ma la phyag 'phro/ res rnal 'thur ma la —176—

mthong snang ran po che 'od kyi dra ba/n+d+ramanas/ nga rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin nga'i gnas su ga gas par zhu zer ro/ /bla mas nga khyod kyi gnas su rgyun du sdod dgos gsungs pas/ rgyun du bzhugs na dang dga' ste dgun stod tsam las mi bzhugs pa 'dug zer ro/khyed nga la 'go ba ci yin dris pas/ gu rus dam la btags nas chosagater gyi phyi la 'brangs pa yin zer ro/ /chas ni pha gi na yod/ 'don mkhan ni shi/'dir ci byed dris pas/ chos pha gi na yod kyang don 'di na yod khyed tshe 'phos kyang skal ldan tshe ma 'phos pas 'ongs pa yin zer ro/ /bkang srung du yod dris pas/ mang po yod/ khyad par du dpal rdo rje phag mo/ sgog sgrub nag mo/ gnod sbyin dmar nag /rdo rje g.yu sgon ma nga rnams yod/ lha rabs mched dgu /bstan ma ba gnyis/ ldang lha rnams kyang yod zer ro/ khrid la mi du 'jug khrid thebasadu yod dris pas/ ba gcig yod dang po gsum gnyan pas mi gsum dang / bzhi dang lnga rnams rim pa bshin chug /lhag ma dgu la bdun bdun mdzod/ lar ni 'di shin du gnyan pasasku tshe la bar chad 'ong nyan yod/ khrid thebs sang na dga' zer ro/ /nga'i gter shog rnams e yod dris pas/ sib sib nged rnams kyis yid bsgul ba yin mod zer ro/ /de nas dar cig na ngas khyed la dbu ru dngos grub byin pa i dran zer ba la/ bla mas lcog lar sgrub pa byed dus tho rangs shig mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi go zhus can zhig byon nas dbu rgyan bskon pas nyams rtogs bzang po skyes pa de lags sam dris pas/ yin zer ro/ khyed g.yu sgon ma e yin dri pas/ min min rdo rje phag mo yin ngo mi shes sam zer ro/ /—177—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'a ma/()'di nas thig le gtso bor bshad nas dbang gsum pa rten can skur ba 'di ji ltar lags dris pas/ de chags can 'jug pa la dgongs7 yin/ chags bral la yid rig tsam gyis bskur ba yin zer ro/ /ngo sprod kyiskabs su rtog pa skye med du 'jog pa dang blo rtsis med du 'jog pa gang yin dris pas/ rtog pa la gnyen pos ci byed/ ye grol 1nga yangs chen mo'idagongs par ngo sprod cig zer ro/ 'o na snying chag 'di bshad pa mang po 'dug pa ngas bshad ci dgos/ lung byed pa karma pa dang / rin chen gling pa la sogs pa 'dug pa la brjod pas/ de rnams kyis bshad pa la nged mi dga' /lung dag rdza la yang yod de des gar chog /bdag po re yod pas de dgos/pa yin mod zer ro/ rin chen gling pa'i gter rnams ci 'dra yin dris pagayin pa yin dag po med zer ro/ /ngas ni khyed ma bsgom na grub pa ci yin dris pas/ nga la sgom pa'i lha 'dug gam/ bzlas pa'i sngags 'dug gam/mchod pa'i yul 'dug gam/ rnal 'thur dam tshig dang rtogs pa ldan pa kun la rgyun du yod pa mi shes sam/ khyed kyi'ang tshe rabs thams cad du nga dang 'du 'bral med pa yin zer ro/ /mchimasaphur sbasapa'i lha lcam gyi nor yod pa de ci 'dra zhig na 'dug dris pas/ brag lha bshas 'dra ba zhig la rtse mo med pa zhig na 'dug /da rung dus la ma bab zer ro/ /bi ma la'i gter de ji tsam na 'don dris pas/ da nasalo bca lnga na sngags pa dkar po zhig gis btan nas bsgyur te dar bar byed/ de na zab pa pod bzhi 'dug khyed rang gi lag tu yod pa 'dug zer ro/ /—178—

mthong snang rin po tshe'od kyi dra ba/de nas zla ba tshes pa'i tshes gcig la rnal 'byar pa 'od zer go cha dpe len du btang nas/ lam du 'ongs dus 'ja' tshon gyi sna dpe la zug cinga'abar ba dang / khyad par du 'byug po brag tu slebs pa'i mtshan mo de dang ri mo can gnyis 'ja' tshon kha dog lngas 'brel ba rnal 'thur pho mo kun gyis mthong ngo / /dge bzhes blo rin gyi dri lam du bud med cig na re/ khong mtha' la bzhung dgongs kyang nged mi gtang dgos par yod zer zhing 'dug pa bshad do/ /tshes dgu la dpe rnams gdan drangs te de nub skong bshagasamadzad nas tshogasal rol dus/ mkha' 'gro babasanas/ bla ma dang sgob ma gdams par 'dzom zer zhing gar mang po mdzad do/ /de nas tshes ba la sngar bas kyang mkha' 'gra'i 'du ba rgya che ba rnal 'thur pho mo mang pos mthong zhing / bcu gcig gi nyin par sngar gyi khrid thon nas khrid mi rnying pa'i rnal 'thur pho mo rnams gyes dus ye shes mtsho rgyal rnal 'byar ma zhig la babs nas/ mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra mang po sgogs shing sgod la me mchad chen po mdzad nas/ la la la dngos grub phra mor byin nas phyogs gcig tu cang smra bar ma byed cig zer nas bzhag /sgod thams cad kha bye dngos grub 'bebs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/ bla ma la dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams rim pas gtad nas 'gro don che zhing longs spyod phul sum tshogs pa 'ong bar 'dug gsungs so/ /dngos grub rnams bla ma'i gzim chung du bskyal nas nam langs so/ /de nas nyi ma shar dus rnal 'thur pho mo gnyis tsam phyir song dus mtshams dam par ba da de mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra sna tshogs sgogs —179—

me bo'i shul ba la / 1nga za rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum/()shaṃ nga gar ma dzad nas/ bcu gnyis kyi srod la chos sgo 'byed pa'i thugasadagongs mdzad dus/ ka pā la dang / me long dang / bum pas mkha' 'gra'i dbang gi brda rnams rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de dus yum mkha' ngo sprod kyisasnang srid 'od snang du 'char ba'i gdams pa bstan to/ /de nub bzhi pa'i ngo sprod sngar ma 'khrungs pa bla ma'i thugs la 'khrungs so/ /de dus nam mkha'i skar ma la sogs pa 'di ci yin drisadus/ lhar bsam pa'i bla ma la sogasa'adug ces brjod pas/ kha cig snyam na rdzun du 'dug gang byas kyang chog snyam pa byung zhing / sgo lnga ka la de bzhin du byas te/ sgra'i skabs su dbyug pa la dril bu brgyus te sa la brdung zhing cir thos ci skad zer la 'ur shod drisapas/ la lasasnga ma bzhin the tshom du smrasaso/ /de dus bla ma rang gis gang btags pa de ltar snang bas chos thams cad gtad med du ngo sprod par ga'/ /de dus rnal 'thur masasemasashes te/ dad pa la sogs pa'i semasal zhen dus/ dga' brod bdud la phaṭa/ snyems byed bdud la phaṭa/ gnyisa'adzin bdud la phaṭa/ ces zer zhing 'ar 'ur mang po byas pas thams cad sgrag cing rtab rtab tu gyur/ bla mas chos thamasacad skad cig gis gza' gtad dang bral ba'i rtsal sbyong du shes te rtogs pa'i me long du mkhyen no/ /mtshan mo ye shes dbang lta stangasal sogs pa ngo sprod do/ /de bzhin du nyin mo gar byed cing mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra sgrogs pas song nyin tho rangs bla ma gzims dus/ 'od gsal la thugs 'byams te yar ka dag gi snang ba/bar longs sku'i tshom bu/ mar 'gro drug gi 'char tshul/ sgra skad sna tshogs—180—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/thos pa la thugs kyis rig cing rags pa med pa'i snang ba dang / de'i skad cig snga ma na dran bsam rgyun chad nas/ snang ba dmar la mthing pa tsam gyi ngang la brgyal ba bzhin 'thums so/ /de nas lhun grub kyi snang ba la de bas rig pa rags par 'phros te yar ka dag /bar longasasku/ mar sprul sku'i ngang du 'byamasaso/ /de nas dar cig na rnal 'byar ma de 'ong ste snga ma'i de ni gdod ma'i ka dag tu nang gsal thim la ma rmugs par bzhugs pa'i ngo sprod yin no/ /brgyal ba zhesabya ste chas nyid kyi ngang du brgyal bas bslang dgos pa yin no/ /phyi ma ni phyir gsal du sprul sku 'gyed tshul dang / 'khrul pa rim gyis snang tshul rags par shar ba'i ngo sprod yin gsungs so/ /de nasanam mkha' thams cad la sngar med pa'i 'ja' tshon bka' srung so sa'i gzugs 'dra ba mang po byung ba ci yin dris pas de dag yin gsungs so/ /nyi ma shar dusabarda don du ma'i ngo sprad mdzad do/ /nyin gung bla ma khri la bzhugs pa la mtsho rgyal kyis gos sum brtsegs pa gsol te/ thams cad kyis yon phul phyag 'tshol de ring bu 'bogs dgosapar yod zer nas/ so so nasaphyag rten phul dus/ bkra shis dpag tu med pa brjod pas nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis khengs pa'i tshe bla ma dge ba'i bzhas gnyen gzhan don rgya cher 'grub pa gdan sar bsko ba la nam mkha' 'di 'dra zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs so/ /bla ma la dngos grub re byin nasaci yin gsungs dus/ dpal 'byar rgya mtsho yin/ gzhan don lhun grub yin zhes pa la sogs pa dang / grangs du 'dug gsungs pa la —181—

me po'i shulabs las/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()'bum phrag grangs med 'dug ces pa la sogs pas lan btang pas 'gro don 4na sum tshogs pa zhig 'byung bar 'dug gsungs so/ /phyi 'phred bla ma'i dbu la dbu rgyan gyi dong rngo sa gron tshom lnga bzung ste dar sngon dmar gyi cod paṇa dpyangs nas bkra shes kye tshigs su bcad pa mang pos mnga' gsol cing / sgod la gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel mdzad do/ /ngo sprod kyi rjes la mkha' 'gros 'ar 'ur mang po byung bas/ /'di 'dra chos gter gzhan 'byed pa la e yong na gsungs so/ /ngo sprod phyi ma'i nyi ma 'char khar bla mas nub ri mdun ma de'i steng gi nam mkha' la seṅge'i khri dar zab kyi 'bol gdan can rgyab yol dra ba ris phra mos brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ steng na rma bya'i gdugs yod pa zhig gzigasapa dang / rnal 'byar ma na re 'di slob dpon chen po rig 'dzin gyi khri yin/khyed rang 'di la gnas pa'i brda yin/ da rung ltos shig gsungs nas bltas pasaphyogs thams cad 'od lnga'i rang bzhin la/ thig les brgyan pa'i snang ba chen po gzigs pa dang / sku dang ye shes kyi zhing snang yin gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma nyin byed khri la bzhugs dus mkha' 'gro snying tig gi po ti/ zhi khra'i thang ka /rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams dang / tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i ka pā la phul nas gzhan rnamasakyang phyag rten re 'bul du bcug ste/ phyag 'tshal shis pa mang po brjod nas gzhan don mdzad par zhu zhes rjes gnang mdzad do/ /de'i phyi dro bla ma'i gsung gis ngasakhrid rim sdeb dgos gsungasanas dpe zhal bye ba dang / gu ru thugs sgrub kyi cha lugs su byon nas bla ma la —182

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/thim pa'i g.yas na mtsho rgyal dang / g.yon na g.yu sgon ma khrid tshig dpod pa rnal 'thur ma zhig gis mthong ngo / /de dus khrid rim gnyis kyi gzhung tshan so sor bye nas tho yig tu mdzad do/ /de ltar ches gcig nas bcu gsum gyi bar nyin zhag drug tu ye shes mtsho rgyal dngos su babs nas mkha' 'gro snying tig gi brda don dpe gsum gyi ngo sprod rdzogs par gtad rgya dang ba sa pa bla ma dam pa dri med 'od zer te pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gnang nas o rgyan du gshegs so/ khrid kyi skabs thams cad du bla ma khri la bzhugs dus o rgyan yab yum byen nas thim par mthong dus/ dmigs pa dang ngo sprod dang brjod tshul ngo mtshar can sngar med cing yi ge na mi gsal ba mang po 'phral la rang rdol du 'thun cing gzi brjid kyang sngon pas che bar snang ngo / /de nas tshes ba bzhi'i snga dro bla ma'i gsung gis de ring nas khrid 'jugs pas thams cad tshogs la mchod gtor shoms shig gsungs nas bshams te bla ma khri la byen dus nam mkha' thams cad 'jas gang dus/ rnal 'thur ma kha cig gi snang ba la/ bla ma la gu ru yab yum dang bi ma la phyon nas thim pas bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mthong / chos gsung dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad chas kyi gsung sgras khyab cing / mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam gyis chos nyan par mthong ngo / /de nas bzung ste khrid rgyab ma thon gyi bar du nyin mtshan tshogs kyi 'bar lo/ /mkha' 'gra'i 'du ba 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba dpag tu med pas khyab pa rnal 'byor pa kun gyis mthong ngo /tshes bcu bzhi'i sgod dbang gi sngon 'gro mdzad dus bla ma'i dbu thog na rma bya'i —183—

me bo'i shulabs las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakya gsung 'bum/()gdugs sum brtsegs pa gser gyi tog gis mtshan pa zhig skyes pa gos dang rgyan thams cad ser por yod pa zhig gis 'dzin cing / 'phan dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhan med pa mang po rang bzhin gyis 'dug pa rnal 'thur pa 'od zer mtha' yas la sogs pa 'ga'i dngos snang mthun par mthong ngo / /de dusamakha' 'gro dpag tu med pa yang 'dus nas masanyan no/ /bca lnga'i nyin mo thig mdzad dus thig sna gcig nas bud med dmar mo zhig gis bzung nasa'adebs par snang zhing / do nub kyang mkha' 'gra'i 'du ba dang gdugs dang 'phan lding 'khyar ba mthong ngo / /bcu drug gi nyin mo bla ma gcig pus dkyil 'khar bzhengs dus bud med dar zab kyi gos can gser g.yus brgyan pa zhig gis 'je grogs byas te phyogs bzhir dus mnyam du 'apri ba mthong ngo / /de dus sngon pas mgyogasashing legs par grub pasabla ma'i gsung gis/ sngon bas mkhasal mgyogasapar 'dug gsungasaso /de nub spros bcas bum dbang rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nasasang nub dbang gong ma mdzad par dgongs nas/ sngon 'gra'i skabasasu rnal 'byor pho mo bdun tshogs pas/ mkha' 'gra'i rtags glo bur ba byung ste bla ma la shangasakhrag byung nas bla ma'i gsung gis/ dbang 'di la gsum las mi spyod pa la bdun 'dug khyed bzhi phyir song gsung dus/ dbang khang la 'ja' tshon sna lnga zug par mthong ngo / /dbang bskur dus su mkha' 'gra'i ltasadang snang ba ya mtshan can byung ngo / /de'i sang nyin nas khrid rgyab ma thon gyi bar du —184—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/sngon chad yul de na med pa'i bya rog ya mtshan can gnyis nyin re bzhin chos kyi skabs su byung ngo / /spyod pa ba rnams la skyel bsu yang mdzad do/ /nyi shu dgu'i nam gung la nam gru re ma ti babs nas/ nga la gtor ma mi ster ba e yin ngas dka' las yun ring byas pa la zer dus thams cad skyi zing zing byed cing su yin dris pas/ nga tshos kun na yod/ gtsug tang tshun chad na yod pa la zer ro/ /yang drisapas/ nga nam gru re ma ti yin khyed kyi gter bsrungs pas sbyangs zer ro/ /ci yod dris pas/ na bza' dang sgob dpon gyi chas gos thod pa dang ba sapa yod do/ /gtad snyam nasayong pa yin/ /ngas sngar khyed la cho 'khrul tsam bstan yang nga ngo ma shes/ kha sang nas thams cad la gtor tshogs bzang po byin nas/ nga la med pas nga kha skyengs nasathams cad 'phrag tu bcug pa yin zer dus spyod chen po byung ngo / khyed du yod drisapas nged lnga yod zer/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dris pas/ nga nam gru ri ma ti nag mo dril rta rkang bzhi yin pa g.yas ral gri g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa dang / 'dod khams dbang phyug ma dmar mo drel rta rkang gsum chibs pa dang / rdo rje phra med ma ljang gu dred mo lag pa g.yob pa la zhan pa dang / rdo rje dbang phyug ma ser mo drel rta rkang gsum pa dang / /rdo rje las sgron ma dkar mo drel rta rkang gsum dang / de thams cad khyag mtshan bhan+ta dang phur pa thogs pa la/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma shang lang dang nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa yin zer ro/ /gter gyi cho 'khrul dang 'ar 'ur mang po zhag gsum du byas so/ /de nasakhregs chod kyi nub mo yang babs nas cho 'phrul —/85—

mesabo'i shul bzhag la / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//daston dusabla mas gsungs pa/ nga nang 'od gsal gyi gter sgo 'byed pa la/ / brag ser ka'i gter gyis dgosapa med/ /nga gter yod kyang cho ga la med kyang chag /skal ldan yin khyang chog la min kyang chag /nga chasazad blo zad kyi rnal 'byar la/ khyed gter bsrungs kyi yus che 'tshong mi dgos/ zhes gsungs pas de rnams kyis kyang lan re byas te/ phar lan tshun lan 'ga' mdzad nas/ dus la babs pa dang 'don pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad pasadaga'o/ /de nub o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon nasabyin gyis brlabs te snga ma la thim pa mthong ngo / /snga ma'i dbang gi skabs su yang de 'dra ba mthong ngo / /sang nyin thod rgal ngo sprod dusasnga dra'i dro bar kha na nam mkha'i shar nub la mthing shun gyi snam bu brkyang pa lta bu'i snang ba nam mkha' dwangs pa'i kha dog dang mi 'dra ba rgyang grags byed tsam gyi zhing yod pasathad ka'i nam mkha' chad dus bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'od mthing ga khyab pa chen pos 'od bya ba 'di 'dra zhig 'ongasapa yin gsungs dus/ byang shar du 'ja' tshon sngon dang mi 'dra ba'i kha dog lnga ldan shar bas/ 'o nang dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma 'di 'dra zhig 'ongs pa yin/ 'di na phar ltos dang / thig le stong pa'i sgon ma rang bzhin gyis 'char ba yin gsung dus/ nam mkha' yang sprin gcig tsam yang med par dwangs la byang du dud kha'i snang ba ya mtshan can dang / byang shar du lnga ldan dang / thad kar mthing ga'i snang ba ya mtshan can mthong dus thod rgal ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mkha' 186—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/'gra'i snang ba dang / ltas mang po yang sngon bsalhag par mthong ngo / de nub rgyab chos dang rin po che gsang ba'i ngo sprod pas ye shes mtsho rgyal bum pa bsnams nas dbang bskur ba rnal 'thur mas mthong nas/ thams cad la 'ur langs phyag 'tshol zer ro/ de nas sang gnang nyin bar do ngo sprod mdzad dus/ 'od gsal sbubs 'jug 'pho ba'i ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro du ma dgyes dus/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ nga'i chos 'di la mi bas mi ma yin gtsigs che bar 'dug /don gnyer dang 'dun pa che khyed rang tsho sems la zhogs gsungs so/ /sang nyin khrid kyi skabs su ye shes mtsho rgyal nyi ma'i phyogs nas ḍā dril dkrol zhing bla ma'i sku la thim pa rnal 'thur pa 'od zer mtha' yas la sogs pa 'gas mthun snang du mthong ngo / /tshes bcu drug gi nub mo 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo sprod mdzad pas/ mtha' skor dang bar snang thams cad mkha' 'gros 'khrigs te thal mo sbyar ba mthong ngo / /de nasatshes bcu bdun gyi nyi ma nub dus 1 bur du bla ma'i gsung gis/ tshogs gtor bzang du shoms/ do nub mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang byed gsung nas mdzad dus/sngags srung babs nas gar mdzad do/ /bla mas nged mkha' 'gro snying tig de bzhin ston pa yin/ khyed bka' srung dang mkha' 'gro rnams e dga' gsungs pas/ thugs la btags/ gu ru dang ye shes mtsho rgyal de bshin gsung gzhan ga na yod ngo mtshang che/ sbyir mkha' 'gro thamasacad dga'/ o rgyan rdzong na mkha' 'gro ma zhig lhag par gsol ba 'debs shing mnyes nas —187

me po'i shul bsalag klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()gda' zer ro/ /de nasadar cig na skyesabu chen po babs te/ do nub lasadag dam tshig gtsang bas yong / khyed kyi gdul bya nyi ma lto nub mtshams na yod zer ro/ /ga na yod drisapas/ 'di nasanyi ma gsum tsam phyin pa na snye'i phyogs kyi ri la gu ru'i bzhugs gnas o rgyan rdzong bya ba'i brag phug che ba mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing de na rgyun du mkha' 'gro mang po rang bzhin gyis gnas pa yod/ de khyed kyisabazhugs gnas yin/ chasadang 'gro don shin tu 'phel/ der gshegs par zhu zer ro/ /'o na nga la slob ma 'gro don byed pa du yod dris pas sum cu 'ongs/ de'i nang nas sems can du ma la phan pa ba gcig 'ongs/ khyad par can dgu 'ongs zer nas dar cig na khyed tsho bla ma 'di 'dra dang 'phrad pa 'tshengasapa yin zer dus/ thams cad kyis thos par mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra de ri ri ba dang / sil chas dang 'ur chom mang po byung ngo / /tshes brgyad kyi phyi dro masaskyong gi gto rgya byed dus/ sgog sgrub mas nga'i sgrub thabs mi 1ga pa zhu zer ba rnal 'thur ma zhig gis thos so/ /de nasadar cig na nyi ma nub dus bla ma'i gsung gis/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid thams cad yongs su rdzogasapas do nub gzob cig /gsung dus chang mi gda' zhus pas/ kha sing nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos grub byin pa yin/ do nub mkha' 'gro bos kyang e yong blta'o sbang rdzal chu rgyob la tshogs shig ngas byin gyis brlab bo gsung nas/ de bzhin btsagasapasardza ma gcig gang byung / desachag las che zhusapas/ do nub tsam dgos byed pa yin mi 'dang na tshogs shigs gsungs nas btsags—188—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/pas thams cad chang rgod btsags pa ltar byung nas rnal 'byar pho mo thams cad bzi ba byung dus/ nga dngos pos sprul bsgyur byed pa bya ba yin gsungs nas ku re yang mdzad do/ /de dus g.yu sgron mas nga'i gnas su gshegs par zhu zer nas byung ba la zhal bzhes mdzad pas dga' nas sngon la 'gro bar zhu zer nas song dus/ sngags srung babs nas bzhung dus thugs dkrugs pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug zer ro/ /de nas dar cig na nam gru ma babasate mi bzhung par zhu zer dus/ bla mas khyed mi ma yin rnams la ngas zab chas de 'dra bshad kyang go ba mi 'dug /dga' mi dga' rgya'i cho 'phrul yin mod/ nga yod sar shog zer nas ma gnang bar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhig mdzad pas ngo mtshar che thugs la btags zer ro/ khar sang nas gar phyin dris pas/ 'brog tu phud cig sdud du phyin zer ro/ /de dus phyugs nad mang po byung 'dug go /de nas rnal 'byar pho mo rnamasakyis rang rang gi gos dang /rgyan dang rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ sgrub pa'i dam bca' byas pas/ bla ma'i gsungs gis nga'i chos 'di la gtang phod che zhing sgrub pa la brtson pa mang po 'byung bar 'dug gsungs nas dgyes te 'od gsal sbubs 'jug gi gdams pa shin tu zab pa zhig gsungs so/ /de dus nga'i gdams pa 'di 'dra 'dzam bu glong na dkon pas 'od lus myur tu 'grub pa yod gsungs so/ /de nas tshes ba gsum la dbang gong ma mdzad dus/ sngar gyi slob ma khams pa zhig gis mi rigs pa'i spyod pas thugs dkrugs dus/chos 'di la sgob ma dam nyams re yong bar 'dug gsungs nas skong —189—

mesapo'i shul bzhagal / klong chen rab 'grumasakya gsung 'bum//shibashags cig mdzad de gshegs so/ /'gro khar thugs dkrugs pa zhiga'ongs zer ba de yin par gda'o/ /de nas 'ongs pa'i lam kha 'byug po brag tu tshogs mdzad dus 'ja' tshon mang po byung zhing mkha' 'gra'i ltas mang boyang byung ngo / /de nas gshegs pa'i lam du sprin med pa'i nyi ma tsha bas gdungs pa na/ gsol 'debs mdzad pas glo bur du sprin 'dus rlung rab tu mi che ba langs te g.yu sgon mas bsu ba'i snang ba yang byung ste/ mchil mor tshogs mdzad pas mkha' 'gra'i ltas du ma yang byung ngo / /de nas shug gse tu gdan drangs dus/ rnal 'thur ma zhig la mkha' 'gro babs nas zhag drug tu mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra sgogs shing bla ma o rgyan du gshegs par zhu zer ro// de dus su 'ja' tshon rgyun ma chad par nyin re bzhin byung ngo / /de nasagangs ri thod dkar du ri khrod btab nas o rgyan rdzong du btags te bzhugs shing / dbang khrid gdams pa dang ba sa pa mdzad dusasu'ang mkha' 'gro glo bur du babs shing ltas mang po dang nam mkha' 'jas khengs shing / gzim khang dang nam mkha' 'ja' tshon lnga ldan gyis 'brel ba skabasasu byung ba kun gyis mthong ngo / /de nas dbang khrid rnams grub rting rnal 'byar pa 'od zer go chas sngar kyi mkha' 'gro snying tig gi gdams pa rnamasal dbang khrid ngo sprod la sogs pa'i yig cha mdzad par zhus te/ tshogasagator gyi sbyin bdag byas te/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad nas sku mtshalasamadzad cing / bcu nas yig cha'i dbu btsugs pas/ nam mkha' 'jasakhengs shing mkha' 'gra'i rnam 'gyur dang / gzims lam du gsol ba —/90—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/'debs pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa'i tshogs mang pos phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed cing / thugs la btags thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zer ba byung zhin mtshan mo phyogs thams cad du mkha' 'gra'i rang sgra mang po dang / nye stobar gyi sgom chen pa rnams la'ang cho 'khrul rnam pa sna tshogs pa sngar med pa du ma byung ngo / /de ltar zla ba dang po dang / ston zla gnyis pa'i bar du r+ṣa mo du bla ma mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs shing yig cha mdzad dus/ gzhan la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel dang gzims lam dang / nyams snang dpag tu med pa dang / nyin re bzhin gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul gzim chung gi steng du 'ja' 'od 'jil ba dang / 'od kyi snang ba ya mtshan can mang po gang ngo / /de nasaston gyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i dga' ston mdzad nas/ rnal 'thur pa thams cad kyis bkra shis brjod dus nam mkha' 'jas khengs te bkra shis pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /de 'dra'i bla ma dpal ldan chosakyi rje/ /gu ru'i thugasasrasadri med 'od zer ni/ /gang dang gang du bzhugs pa de dang der/ /rang bzhin mkha' 'gra'i 'du ba rgyun mi chad/ /bkra shis dge mtshan du mas rab brgyan cing / /'gro ba'i don gnyis mdzad la nor bu bzhi/ /sngon rabasadusanasathugs rje'i rlabasache bas/ /mgon du mdzad pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma la gus gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /bdog pa kun gyis rtag tu mtshod mdzad cing / /gang la'ang ma chagasadangos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig /gza' gtad bral ba'i spyod la dgyes mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i lam ston de la gus phyag 'phro/ /—191—

me po'i shulabs las/ klong ོ rab 4masakyi gsung 'bum/(kartag tu zhi la yang dag rab gzhol bas/ /rnam g.yeng mi mang spros pa kun las 'das/ /gzhan yang de la sbyor bas legs bskul bas/ /ting 'dzin glang po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gong du 'od gsal chu zla stong pa'i ngang / /rang yang bzhugs nas 'gro ba 'god par mdzad/ /nyon mongs rtag zhi dben pa'i ri ngogs su/ /drang sgong spyod pa kun gyi legs gnas pa'i/ /'phagasapa'i brtul zhugs nor bdun gtsor mdzad pa/ /zhi ba'i mdzod brnyes de la gusaphyag 'tshal/ khes bya'i skar tshogs thugs la rab bkra bas/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam par dag /tshig don sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro 'dul ba/ /mkhas pa'i bla ma de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gzhan gzhusags rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /zab mo'i de nyid gzigs pa mtha' yas pas/ /nges don rgyud sde'i dgongasapa gtsor mdzad pa/ /gsang sngagasasdong po de la gusaphyag 'tshal/ /sku tshe snga ma'i snga mar legs sbyangs pas/ /phal cher thos pas don rnams thugs su thun/ /rang byung pad+ma'i dgongasagater rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'di yi gzhung lugasazab cing rgya che bas/ /thar par 'gro ba'i shing rta rin chen mchog /rdo rje snying pa'i theg pa gsal mdzad pa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du 'gro sgol ba'i/ /thugs rje mnga' ba de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ji snyed mkhyen kyang da dung legs bshad 'tshol/ /sgom las 'das kyang da dung dben par dgyes/ /nyon mongasabargal yang da dung bag med 'jom/ /rgya mtsho ltar zab de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lta ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /—192—

mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi dra ba/sgom pa'i nyi zla rang bzhi 'od gsal bas/ /spyod pa'i 'od stong 'byed la klong yangs pa/ /dri med 'od zer de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /snga rabasagoms pa'i byin rlabs pad rdzing las/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams dga' mdzad cing / /dam chas bdud rtsis 'gro kun tshims mdzad pa/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gus phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin dpag yas gting mtha' med/ /mtha' grol ye babs gzhi rdzogasachen pa'i ngang / /dus gsum dus bzhi dus rnams rgyun chad med/ /1nga chen rab 'byams de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'di yi ma chags gtong ba'i khyad par can/ /chasachen char gyis 'gro ba bsil mdzad gnyis/ /phan thun 'gran la rab tu zhugs pa'i tshe/ /'jig rten chas brgyad rtsad nas bton par 'gyur/ /gang la mi rtog ting 'dzin gru chen dang / /chas rnams rab 'byed shes rab kha lo sgyur/ /dusadang mthun pa'i ba dan rab g.yo bas/ /thar pa'i skams sar 'gro ba 'dren la brtson/ /dge legs thugs rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa las/ byin rlabasabadud rtsi'i char chen rab 'babs pas/ /dad brgya'i pad mtsho ngang gis gang gyur cing / /phun tshogasalo tag rgyasal mngan sum gyur/ /de 'dra'i masasamed chos rje nyi ma ni/ /dri med tshul khrimasapad+ma lta bu ste/ /'od zer blo gros bzang pa'i las 'brel rtsal/ /mtshan gsum don mthun gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gzhan kun gyi don gnyis phun tshogs shing / /bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /dam chos kun gyi ye shes bang mdzod ni/ /dus rnams kun tu skye dgu'i bla mar shog /dad brgya'i chu 'dzin phyogs —193—

me po'i shulabs las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung la ma/(kakyi mthar khyab pas/ /snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs sprin gyi rnga sgra can/ /dge legs glog phreng bro gar byed pa yis/ /phan bde'i char chen 'bebs te bsngags par shog /bsod namasaston ka'i ri bong 'dzin gzugasacan/ /phun tshogs rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus na mjes/ /dge tshogasa'od dkar du ma'i snang ba yis/ /zab gter kun+da phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /'di 'dra'i babs tshul ngo mtshar rmad byung gang / /skal bzang du ma'i dbang dang ba sa pa zhig /dngosasu byung yang deng sang dusasnyigasapas/ /bdud rigasaskye ba'i sgo skur gnas su 'gyur/ /de bas 'di nyid rab tu gsang bar bya/ snying dang 'dra ba gcig la gtod na yang / /ma spel dam tshigs bka' srung dpang tshugs shig /tshig brgyud bstan la yid chesabaskyed phyir gzhag /tshul 'di gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong / /'phagasapa'i ri ngogs mjes shing nyams dga' bar/ /phyi rabs skal ldan spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /legs sbyar me tog 'bras bu legs smin pas/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu dga' bar mdzod/ /mthong snang rin po che 'o/ ne zasabya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis snang bar byas pa'i rnal 'dor pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis zab gter mngon par 'byung ba'i lo rgyus cha tsam zhig mdor bsdus te rnam par bkod pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so// //'di rab tu gsang ba'i nan tan du bya'o/ /dge'o//—/94—

༄7/ /zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin r+ṣa shog ser skor/zhal chems dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad la khyag 'tshal lo/ /legs pa'i nyi ma shin tu rmad byung gsal gyur pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sna tshogs rol pa ston mdzad cing / /mdzad pa'i 'phra 'dus 'gro ba yongs la rjes gzigs nas/ /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings gzhol bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gisamadzad pa ma lus mthar phyin nas/ skye bo rtag par 'dzin rnams gdul bya'i phyir/ /grong khyer dam pa shin tu rmad byung ba/ /rtsa mchog grong gshegs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobar ba'i rang bzhi sngar nas shes zin te/ /'jig rten chos/ste /tsho (pe /re/bye /de/ye /re lag /byel nga pa da pa ra/ /da rtag sgyu ma lus 'dar bas/ /ga ga tu phan pa'i gdams ngag bshad kyis nyon// /tshe 'dir bden par bzung yang bsgru bslu 'dra/ /mi rtag snying po med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /yid brtan med ces nges par rtogs byas nas/ /de ring nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /rtag pa med pa'i mdza' bshes mgron po 'dra/ /re zhig 'dus kyang myur du 'bral bas na/ /sgyu ma'i grogs la chags sems rab spangs te/ /gtan du phan pa dam pa'i chas mdzod cig /bsags kyang 'jog pa'i nor rdzasasbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rang gis bsagasakyang gzhan gyis longs spyod pas/ /rang dbang —195—

'al chams dri ma med pa'i 'od/yod dus bsod nams sbyin pa'i tshogs/ /phyi ma'i lam rgyags da lta grabasamadzod cig /brtsigs kyang 'jig pa'i khang khyim g.yar po 'dra/ /sdod pa'i dbang med 'gro ba'i gnas skabs yod/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas la chags sred rab spangs te/ /da lta nyid nas dben pa'i gnas brten cing / /mdza' dang mi mdza' byes pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /don med chags sdang 'bar ba'i me dpung can/ /phan mun 'thab rtsod sa/na 'dzin rab spangs la/ /da lta nyid nas rang gisasems thul cig /snying po med pa'i bya ba sgyu ma 'dra/ /re zhig bcon yang mtha' ma 'bras bu med/ /tshe 'di'i bya bzhag 'jig rten chas spangasal/ /da lta nyid nasathar pa'i lam tshol cig /dal 'thur lusarnyed rin chen gru bo 'dra/ /sdug bsngal mtsho las sgol ba'i stobs yod pas/ /le lo snyomasalas sbyid lugs sems bor la/ /da lta nyid nas brtson pa'i stobs bskyed cig /dam pa'i bla ma 'jigs sa'i skyel ma 'dra/ /'khar ba'i dgra lasaskyob pa'i ded dpon la/ /sgo gsum zol med sri zhu chen po yis/ /da lta nyid nasamachod cing bsten par mdzod/ /zab ma'i gdams pa bdud rtsi'i sman dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso ba'i mchag yin pas/ khyud la brten cing legs par goms pa yis/ /da lta nyid nas klong du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /bslab gsum rnam dag yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /'di phyir bde zhing mthar thug legasapa'i lam/ /byang chub zhi ba dam pa thob pasan/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /sna tshogs thos pa rin chen sgon me 'dra/ /gti mug sel zhing thar lam snang bar byed/ /ye shes mig 'byed phan bde'i 'od —196—

me bo'i shul bas la / klong wo rab 'domasakyi gsung la ma/(da' bas/ /da lta nyid nasaphyogs ris med par mdzod/ /legasapar bsam pa gser mkhan mkhas pa 'dra/ /yin min the tshom sgo 'dogs kun gcod pas/ /thosapa'i rang bzhin bsam byung shes rab kyis/ /da lta nyid nasakhong du chud par mdzod/ /sgom pa'i rang bzhi bdud rtsi'i ro myong 'dra/ /thosabasam don sgom nyon mongasand kun zhi/ /spros pa'i mtsho brgal snying pa'i pha rol phyin/ /da lta nyid nas nags su bsgom par mdzod/ /lta ba'i rang bzhin dri med nam mkha' 'dra/ /mtho dman rgya chad phyogasalhung kun dang bral/ /yangs dog med cing smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /da lta nyid nasartogasapa'i thabs mdzod cig /sgom pa'i rang bzhin ri bo rgya mtsho 'dra/ /'pho 'gyur med cing dwangasal rnyog pa med/ /rnam g.yeng spros pa'i mtshan ma kun zhi ba / /da lta nyid nas ji bzhin bsgom par mdzod/ /spyod pa'i rang bzhin skye bo mkhasapa 'dra/ /dusasu babasadang gang phan gnasaskabs shes/ /chagasathogs blang dor dgag sgrub sgyu ma'i ngang / /da lta nyid nas ga nga 'dzin grol bar mdzod/ /'brasabu'i rang bzhin ded dpon nor lon 'dra/ /rang nyid 'byar pas gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /re dang dogs med ngang gis blo bde ba/ /da lta nyid nas thob phyir 'bad par mdzod/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chasadabyings nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin sems nyid gas ma'i don/ /don la gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po sa /da lta nyid nas nges par rtogasapar mdzod/ /sna tshogasachos rnams me long ga gas brnyan 'dra/ /snang bas stongs te logs na stong pa med/ /ga ga dang tha dad ma brtag nyams —197—

zhal chesasadri ma med pa'i 'od/dga' bar/ /da lta nyid nas nges par mkhyen par mdzod/ /gzung ba'i yulal 'dzin pa rmi lam 'dra/ /don la gnyalamed bag chags gnyisasnang ste/ de yang blos btagasarang gi ngo bos stong / /da lha nyid nas gnyis med mkhyen par mdzod/ /'khar 'das rang bzhin sgyu ma'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /bzang ngan snapayang ngo bo mnyam pa nyid/ /thamasacad ma skyesanam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /da lta nyid nas nges par mkhyen par mdzod/ /'khrul snang bde sdug sprul pa'irang bzhin 'dra/ /dge sdig rgyu 'bras so sor shar dus nas/ /rang bzhin maskyes ngo bor 'pho 'gyur med/ /da lta nyid nas ngesapar mkhyen par mdzod/ /blos btags chas rnams byis pa'i rtsod pa 'dra/ /don la mi gnas rtog pasarab phye nas/ /bzang ngan grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin so sor zhen/ /da lta nyad nas mnyam nyid mkhyen par mdzod/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa rin chen gter dpa'adra/ /mi zad gong du 'phel zhing 'thur pa'i rgyu/ /tha ma mchog 'athring bsod nams zhing rnamasal/ /da lta nyid nas ci 'os sbyin par mdzod/ /tshul khrimasadri med shing rta bzang po 'dra/ /mngon mtho nges legs grong khyer bgrod pa'i stegs/ /sdom dang chasasdud semasacan don byed rnams/ /da lta nyid nasargyud la brten par mdzod/ /bzod pa mtsho chen mi 'khrugs mchog dang 'dra//gnod pas mi 'phrag dka' thub nang nas mchog /sdug bsngal dang len snying rje'i tshos sems sogs/ /da lta nyid nas goms shing 'dris par mdzod/ /brtson 'grus me chen kung po 'bar ba 'dra/ /mi mthun phyogasabasregs dge la yang dag spro/ /sgyid lugs snyoms las le 'do med pa yis/ /—/98—

mesapo'i shulabs la / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//shid lta nyid nas thar lam sgrubs par mdzod/ /bsam gtan mi g.yo ri rgyal mchog dang 'dra/ /dmigs pas mi bskyod yul la yengasapa med/ /gang la mnyam gzhag gzhan gyis mi 'phrags pa/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la goms par mdzod/ khesarab rgya chen nyi ma'i dkyil zhabar 'dra/ /gti mug mun sel dam chos snang bar byed/ /thar gling mchog spel nyes pa'i chu gter skems/ /da lta nyid nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ /thabasamakhas ded dpon nor bu len pa 'dra/ /sdug bsngal mtsho brgal bde chen gling 'grod nas/ /sku gsum mchag thob don gnyasalhun gyisagrub/ /da lta nyid nasathabs kyis gzhan phan mdzod/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa'i dpa' bo 'dra/ /nyon mongs dpung 'joms byang chub lam la dgod/ /dge tshogs mthar phyin bar chad med pas na/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /smon lam yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'dra/ /'dod dgu lhun grub bde chen ngang gis 'phel/ /zhi la semasagazhol yid la re ba skong / /da lta nyid nas rlabs chen 'debasapar mdzod/ /ye shes mkha' la chu 'dzin 'khrigs par 'dra/ /ting 'dzin gzungs sprin phan bde'i char 'beb pas/ /'gro kun dge tshogs lo tag legs par bsgrun/ /da lta nyid nas thob phyir 'bad par mdzod/ /thabasadang shes rab bzhan pa bzang po 'dra/ /srid zhin mi lhung rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /lam lnga mthar phyin sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /da lta nyid nas 'bad pas bsgrub par mdzod/ /byang chub phyogasachos lam bzang chen po 'dra/ /dus gsum 'phags rnams snga phyi'i ga gas —199—

tshal chodasadri ma med pa'i 'od/shul te/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi sogs sum cu bdun/ /da lta nyid nasabasgom phyir brtson par mdzod/ /gzhan yang byams pa pha ma bzang po 'dra/ /'gro drug bu la thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /brtse bas don byed phan pa rtag tu sgrub/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la goms par mdzod/ /snying rje rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' 'dra/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gi sdug bsngal bzhin/ /bral bar 'dod pa brtson pa'i ya lad can/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud labarten par mdzod/ /dga' ba rigs kyi rje dpon bzang po 'dra/ /gzhan dag dge bsarang nyid blo bde bas/ /ched du bkod pa bzhin du rjes yi rang / /da lta nyid nas mchog du goms par mdzod/ /btang snyoms rang bzhin snyoms pa'i sa gzhi 'dra/ /nye ring chags sdang med cing zug ngu bral/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i ngang nasabade ba che/ /da lta nyid nasarang bzhin gomasapar mdzod/ /byang chub sems gnyis ded dpon dam pa 'dra/ /dge kun thar gling 'grod pa'i kha lo ba/ /srid pasami skyo gzhan don kun sum tshogs/ /da lta nyid nasayang yang bskyed par mdzod/ /mosapa rgya mtsho chu gter chen po 'dra/ /dge bas gang zhig snga phyi ro gcig 'dzin/ /dus kun mi nyams dad pa'i rlabasagayo ba/ /da lta nyid nasargyud la brten par mdzod/ /bsngo ba mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod dang 'dra/ /tshos dbyings bsngos pas mi nyams gong du 'phel/ /chas sku ro gcig gzugs sku lhun gyis grub/ /da lta nyid nasa'akhar gsum dag par mdzod/ /rjes su yi rang nam mkha'i khams dang 'dra/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dmigs med rlakha sems bral/ /mi g.yo rang tu dwangs—2la —

me po'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//dpa'i rnam pa can/ /da lta nyid nas yang yang brten par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dran pa lcags kyu bzang po 'dra/ /sems kyi glang po ma thul myos pa 'dzin//nyes las rab ldog rang bzhin dge la spyor/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ khesabazhin ma yengasamel tshe bzang po 'dra/ /mi dge'i rkun pos glags skabs mi rnyed cing / /dge ba'i nor mang srung la zhugasapas na/ /da lta nyid nas nges par brten par mdzod/ /bag yod lcagasari 'thas bzang (〈a〉'obasabazang )bskor ba 'dra/ /nyon mongs chas rkun tshogs kyis mi 'phrags shing / /lasakyi dgra lasargyal ba'i dpung tshogs can/ /da lta nyid nas sems bsrung 'bad par mdzod/ /gzhan yang dad pa zhing sa bzang po 'dra/ /'dod dgu 'byung zhing byang chub lo thog bskrun/ /'di phyir bde zhing rtag tu phan pa sgrub/ /da lta nyan nasagong du 'phel bar mdzod/ /gtong phod pad+ma'i rdzing bu bzang po 'dra/ /dam pa 'du zhing skye bo dga' ba bskyed/ /bdog pa 'brasabacasalongs spyod snying po yod/ /da lta nyid nas gzhan dag dga' bar mdzod/ /snyan par smra ba lha yi rnga sgra 'dra/ /'gro ba'i yid 'dzin mthong na mi mthun med/ /dul ba'i rjes 'gro dga' ba bskyed pasan/ /da lta nyid nas bstod pas mgu bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i spyod lam drang sgong dam pa 'dra/ /mi dge 'gog cing 'gro ba'i dad pa 'phel/ /bcosama'i tshul sbongasarang bzhin dul ba'i ngang / /da lta nyid nas spyod yul kun tshogs mdzod/ /dam pa'i chas nyid bde gshegs dbang po 'dra/ /kun dang mthun zhing kun las khyad par 'phags/ /kun dang cha mthun kun dang mi 'dra —201—

zhal chem dri ma med pa'i 'od/bar/ /da lta nyid nas rgyud la brten par mdzod/ /dal 'thur lusa'adi sgyu ma'i khang bzang 'dra/ /re zhag snang yang nam 'jig nges pa med/ /tshe la lopa med 'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chas/ /da lta nyid nas yang yang dran par mdzod/ /longs spyod g.yo ba ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'thur pa'i rang bzhinagang du rgud pa'i chas/ /snying nas snying po med pa'i rang bzhin du/ /da lta nyag nas nges par rtogasapar mdzod/ /'gro kun mi rtag snga phyi'i 'gron po 'dra/ /rgan rabs sngon song gzhan rabs phyi nas 'gro/ /da lta'i rnamasakyang lo brgyar gcig mi lus/ /da lta nyid nasanges par rtogasapa mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba de ring nyin gang 'dra/ /bar da' snang ba do nub rmi lam tshul/ /phyi ma'i snang ba sang bzhin myur du 'ongs/ /da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chosamadzod cig /de ltar chas kun 'dra ba'i dpes bstan nas/ /yang cig dad ldanarnams la bskul ba ni/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba'i chasayin pas/ kho bo mi sdod thar pa'i gling du 'gro /sa/ra ba'i chas la yid brton 'ga' med pas/ /skye med chas sku'i gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /'jig rten snang ba sgyu ma'i bslu prid mkhan/ /brdzun pa'i rang bzhin sgeg mo g.yon can 'dra/ /dge las sems 'gra nyen mod+ku sa tshogs 'phel bas/ /ring du spongs te dmapa'i tshos mdzod cig /cheg shes med na 'thur ya— dbul po ste/ /'jungs pa'i sems la khengs pa'i dus med do/ /drog shes/ — na na byer pa 'i yang rab yin/ /cung zad mchis la'— bde pas sem/sa gde nge / /chari dang bug med nyon mongs 'a nga khungs la/ /chags sred 'dun pa'i sems ni rapa —202

mesapo'i shulabazhag la / kleng char rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//daskongasate/ /drang sgong rnams kyi spyod la rab gzhol nas/ /dben pa'i gnas suzhi ba'i don sgoms shig /nyan mtshan mi dal gcig tu semasadage ba/ /nyes spangs phan pa mdzad des gsungs bzhin du/ /skad cig ma yengasadam pa'i chos mdzod cig /'chi khar mi 'grud ma 'ongs phan pa 'grub/ /yang cig yun ring las smon dag pa yis/ /chos dang dam tshig 'dres pa'i slob ma dag /'dus kyang 'bral ba'i chos te dpon slob gyes/ /tshong khang 'gron po 'dra bar mkhyen par mdzod/ /snying nas gcig tu phan pa'i gtam smras pa/ /yul dang longs spyod mdza' bzhas gnyen 'dun sogs/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.ye — 'du 'dzi kun spangs la/ /zhi ba'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par mdzod/ /cis kyang mi phan 'gro ba'i dus byung tshe/ /'chi khar mi 'jigs dam pa'i tshos dgos pas/ /bla ma'i man ngag zab don snying pa'i chas/ /da lta nyid nas goms shing brtson par mdzod/ /kun gyi nang nas 'od gsal snying pa' chos/ /kun gyi snying po snying zig gsang ba'i don/ /kun las mchog gyur tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ /kun bzang bde chen bsgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /gzhan yang zab don bdud rtsi'i snying po can/ /dam pa rnams lasabargyud pa'i chas btsal te/ /baphyon pa'i stobs kyis gcig pur nyams su longs/ /myur du rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /da lta nyan nasabade mchag kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma'i dus la'ang phan pa dam pa'i chas mthong dang ma mthong che ba'i yon tan can/ /snying pa'i don la deng nas brtson par mdzod/ /sprin bral zla ba gang ba'i tshogs gang ba/ /skar ma'i bdag po de —203

zhal chemasadri ma med pa'i 'od/yang 'char du nye/ /bla bre gdugasadang rgyal mtshan rol ma'i sgra/ /mkha' 'gra'i tshogs mang lhags pas mdzes gyur cing / /thugs rje mnga' ba'i mgon po pad+ma'i zhal/ /dbugs 'byen mdzad pa de yi deng bzung bas / 'gro ba'i dus babs mgron po lam zhugs bzhan/ /'chi bas dga' ba'i rted pa legs grub pa/ /rgya mtsho'i don yongs grub pa'i tshong pa dang / /g.yul lasarnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbang dang / /bsam gtan grub pa'i bde ba ches lhag go /da ni mi sdod pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ /'chi med bde chen bas sa 'dzin du 'gro /tshe zad las zad smon lam 'phan pa zad/ /'jig rten chasazad tshe 'di'i snang ba zad/ /bar da'i yul la zhing snang rgya che bas/ /ra snang ngo bo skad cig rang rig nas/ /gdod ma'i sa la gto srid zin du nye/ /rang nyid 'thur pas gzhan nyid blo bde ba/ /sbrul pa'i skye bsathar gling phag pa bsgrub/ /de dus slob ma'i dam pa khyed rnams dang / /phrad nas chasakyi dga' bas tshim par smon/ /da res tshe 'di'i 'brel ba de las med/ /phyogs med sprang po gang bder shi ba la/ /mya ngan ma byed rgyun du gsol ba thobs de skad phan par smra ba'i snying gi gtam/ /dad ldan bung ba dga' skyed pad+ma'i sprin/ /legasasmras dge bas 'gro ba khamasagasum po/ /gdod ma'i sal k+ṣiṃngan 'das par shog /zhal chesas dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ /dri med 'od zer gyis gdams pa rdzogs so// //bkra shis so/ / —204—

ra da/ /zhal chems mthar thug gcig ma bzhugs so/ /ā+oṃ uhūṃ/ rnal 'thur pa sna tshogasarang grol gyis/ skal ldan rnams la gdams pa/ e ma ho/ /mthar thug cig tu dril na 'di ltar yin/ /sus kyang ma byas gdod nasarang byung ba'i/ /sems nyid rgyal po rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /rin chen gter 'di rtag tu lta bar gyis/ /mi g.yo gsum ldan rlang rig mkha' la gtad/ /rang las byung ba'i 'od kyi khang bzang na/ /rang rig rgyal po rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /gsal stong 'dzin med nam mkha'i dkyil du 'char/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la zhog /dag snang dngos 'di rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu yi zla ba 'dra/ /sna tshogs sems 'di 'byung ba rlung dang maXs/ /gang shar dran 'dzin ma byed gang dgar thongs/ /sgom du med de rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /gang shar rgyal po lhun rdzogs ngang la rol/ /rang rig rang grol grol ba gzhan nas min/ /bcos bslad ma byed rang bzhin lhug par zhog /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i ngang la gnas pa yin/ /'di ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byar pa/ /gang la zhen na de yang nges par thongs/ /dmigs gtad zhen pa byung na rnal 'byar min/ /gang shar zhen pa med na ci dgar rol/ /nang gi rang gdangs phyi ru shar ba'i tshe/ tags nyams snang nyams 'phel 'gribasaci byung yang / /dgag sgrub ma byed rig pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /gtad med rgyal po 'dzin med ngang du 205—

mesatsho shul bas la / 1nga za rab khrumasakyi gsung tsom/(kagyur/ /bzang ngan blang dor thams cad spros pa'i ngang / /gnyis snang mar+yā cha thams cad 'a la pa'i gzugs/ /rtsol sgrub zhen pa thams cad sgrib phyed nyid/ /re dogs 'ching pa thams cad go pa'i rgyu/ /gdod ma'i ngang 'di brjod 'das gzhi rtsa bras/ /spang blang rtsol sgrub re dogs phyogs ris med/ /gnas der gnasan kun kyang chas kyi sku/ /cog bzhag rang growa 'bad med gang gis yul/ /gnas lugs mthong na gzhi rtsa gang yang med/ /chig chod mthong la sgom pa rdul tsam med/ /snyems dang bral la spyod pa yod ma yin/ khregs rja mthong la dran 'dzin gar+sā po med/ /sgod rgal mthongu la sems 'dzin sgom pa med/ /rnam rtog byung na gang shar rang grol yin/rtsol skyab ma byed rang babs lhug par zhag /so ma gas ma ma bcas zang thal dang / /cir snang thams cad chas sku'i zhing du 'a4/ /'di nyid bla ma'i gdams ngag kun dril nas/ /phyi rabs rnal 'thur rnams kyi don du bkod/ /'di ltar nyamasasu longs shig rigs kyi bu/ /sangs rgyas sa wa tshegs med bde blag 'gro /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dang / / gas don lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /gru ོ ngogs la mgron po zur zuradape sa sna /sgo /rezur sa sna sa sna zur /ste —chas pa bzhag/ /dra da 'ad ra thar pa glang du 'gra /sdad pa' yun da brtson pas sgrubs shig bu/ /dge zhing bkra shis pa gyur cig /dge'o/ / —206—

༄7/ /zhal chems gnad kyi me long bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog ser skor/zhal chesas gnad kyi me long du gdams pa/ e ma ho/ /gnas lugs rig pa kun bzang chas kyi sku/ /lhun grub rig pa 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /'char tshul ma 'gags thugs rje sprul ba'i sku/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su mthar phyin rtogs pas 'dud/ /yang zab rtse mo rdo rje snying pa'i don/ /mtha' grol 1nga yangs dgongs don gsang ba 'di/ /mtha' dril lus chub thig le nyag gcig po/ /phyi rabasarnams la gdams pa e ma ho/ /ā+oṃ/rang rig dbang chen dbyings su rdzogs pa'i don/ bla mas mngon bstan rtsal dbang dam tshig ldan/ /'khar 'das sems dang ye shes shan bye la/ /lnga ldan dbyings su lta dgongs la zlos shig /āḥ rig stong ngo bo ka dag chas zad dang / /'khar 'das ming med gsal dag chos sku la/ /gzung 'dzin ye grol cog bzhag chos nyid du/ /nang dbyings khregs chad gdod mar e ma ho/ak+ṣ-iḥ lhun grub gzhi snang lta stangs gzigs stangs gtsun/ /phyi gnad gshun pas nang dbyings chos zad dang / /snang bzhi tshad phebs gdod ma'i dbyings su grol/ /lhun grub nang dbyings 'gyur med e ma ho/ aḥ thams cad dbyings gcig rang byung rig pa'i 1nga / /gzhi dang gzhir snang mthar zad gdod ma'i dbyings/ /rang don chas sku 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /gzhan don gzugs sku gzhi snang rol pa yis/ /thams cad don mdzad phrin las rgyud mi —207—

me h+pha shulabs snyo/ 1nga 'a rab stimasakyi gsung khrum/()'go/ shin tu rnam dag 'bras bu e ma ho/ /gzhi lam gosabu thamasacad dbyer med ngang / /rang byung ye shes che ba lnga dang ldan/ /lhun grub rang rdzogasache sa 'is di 'i bye ci da :/the sa da dzisde sa na pa dan 'a nyad/ / ga ga gral ba ga mchag ma ha/ 'kha gdams gnad kyi me long gab pa mngon du phyung ba/ sbas pa gsal bar ston pa/ dgongasapa maphyo du lta ba/ ཿla kyi me long / sna tshogasarang grol gyi rnal ⑲ra pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyis/ mthar thug don gyi snying po lnga phyung ste/ phyi rabasal gdamasapa/ sam ya/ rgya rgya rgya/dpal sngags kyi srung ma bshan pa srog sgrub nag mos srungs shig /dge'o/// /—208—

༄7/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs pad+ma stong ldan bzhugs so/ /rin r+ṣa shog 'dra'i skor/bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs pad+ma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi wīr ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo rnam dag chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /rang bzhi 'od gsal rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs khyag 'tshal lo/ /snang srid sgod bas ye nasarigasalnga'i snyo / /'od lnga lhun rdzogs stong gsal ji bawo nyid/ /rang gag 'gro ba kun gyis sgrub pa yi/ /pad+ma stong ldan rgyasapa'i tshul 'di bshad/ /de la gsum las/ dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ skad cig gis rang gi spyi bor āḥ dkar po las 'od los/ rang dang sgod r+sād thams cad 'od du zhu zhing / ā+oṃ mahā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa wā ko ྅ haṃ gis stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ oṃ badz+ra r+ṣa d+mā rtu ād+ma ko3 haṃ gis kun la khyab pa'i snying rje bsgoms nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ gis rang gi sems hūṃ du gyur pa las/ 'od zer e'i rnam pa grangs med pa 'phrasapas/ snang srid thamasacad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang las/ yang hūṃ de nyid kyi 'od zer ye baṃ le /khye tshor don /de /) la sna /bye(ste h+phu/ste khya rnam par 'phas pas/ rlung sa da la 'khar nga du/ rgya ma nga du gser gyi sa gzhi chus gang ba'i dbus ri rab kyi steng du pad+ma nyi ma dang zla —209

me bo'i shul bas la / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung la ma/()ba'i dbus su rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po sgo rta babs dkyil zhabar gyi bkod pa rdzogs pa las/ hūṃ bhi shudhe dz+nyā na tsakra bye gyis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten dang mnyam pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che/ ltor rta mchog /nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang rnams kyi steng du pad+ma nyi zla'i dbusasu/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ gyi a lasa'od 'phrasa'aphags pa mchad/ sems can gyi don byas tshun 'dus pas sa bon rnams rim pa bzhin 'bar lo dang / rdo rje dang /rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / ral grir gyur/ mtshams kyi pad zla bzhi'i steng na e baṃ le re ye las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phras snod bas lha dang lha mor gyur/ 'od zer tshun 'dus phyag mtshan las/ dbus su rnam snang yab yum gnyis su med pa/ mthing ga yab kyi phyag g.yas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang / shar du mi bskyod pa dkar po rdo rje g.yas/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ byang du don yod grupapa ljang gu ral spisamatshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ mer mā ma gī dkar mo/ srin por sangs rgyas spyan ser mo/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang ldan du dam tshig sgol ma ljang guyab rnams kyis g.yon na dril bu dang / yum rnamasagayas g.yon gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil mo krung / rin po che'i dbu rgyan mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ longasaspyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pa'o/ /yum bzhi'i thugs ka nas dza ༷hūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhi 'phros pas sgo bzhi'i pad zla nyi ma'i steng du —210—

bde ga gsarigasalnga'i sgrub thabasapad+ma stong ldan/yongs su gyur pa las sgo ma bzhi ste/ dzaḥlas shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hūṃ las lto sgor zhags pa ma ser mo zhag pa 'dzin pa/baṃ las nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgog 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas byang sgor dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil mo krung dang cha lugs su bzhugs pa'o//de thams cad kyi spyo bor ā+oṃ dkar po/ masprin par āḥdamar po/thugs kar hūṃ mthing ga'o/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa hūṃ gis spyi bor sna tshogasardo rje rgya gram las rdo rje'i dra bas lus thams cad gtams par gyur/ de thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus su rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phras pas/ rang rang gi phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' byonaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ r+ṣa gnyis su med par thim nas/ sku lasa'od zer 'phrasapas snod 'khrud thams cad lha dang lha ma'i dkyil 'khar du bas sa la/ snying ga'i sabon la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phra 'dus sems can gyi don byed par bsams la/ ā+oṃ dzi na dzi ka le te shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ badz+radṛ ka sum̐ da tu shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ swā rahṝ dṛka me mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ/ e a ro lig bye rā ga ra ti s+t+waṃ/ ha pra dz+nyā dṛ ka haṃ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ sngosirnyi hūṃ/ zhesaci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ snang srid thams cad lha la bsdu/ lha rnams sa bon/ sabon mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /des ni lus ngag yid gsum kyi sgrib pa dang / nus pa thon/ sku gsum du gnasagyur/ dug lnga ye shes lngar grol nas/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring bar do/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing —21/—

me po'i shul bzhagal / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'khrum/ (kadu 'tshang rgya'o/ /rigs lnga phyi ltar sgrub pa rdzogs so/ /gnyis pa nang ltas sgrub pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ skad cig gis rang nyid kun bzang yab yum mthing ga 'a la sbyor phyag mtshan yab rdo rje dril bu/ yum spri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ skyil mo krung rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dkar po/ mgrin par rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ser po/ snying gar rnam par snang mdzad yab yu7 mthing ga /lte bar snang ba mtha' yasayab yum dmar po/ gsang bar done+e yod grub pa yab yum ljang gu /phyag mtshan gtso bo yab yum dang 'dra ba'o//yan lag bzhi la sgo ma bzhi sngar ba'ab te/ lag pa g.yas pa la lcagabasar ma/ g.yon pa la zhagasapa ma/ rkang pa g.yasapa la lcagasasgog ma/ g.yon pa la dril bu ma bskyed la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī aḥsi ti pha la hūṃ dzaḥ zhes bzlas zhing / 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pas grags ltar du bzlasapa'i mthar/ thams cad snang stong dbyer med 'od gsal gyi dang nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /des ni nyan mongs pa lnga ye shes su gyur te phrin las bzhis semasacan gyi don byed cing tshe 'dir grol bar 'gyur ro/ /nang sgrub rdzogs so// //gsum pa gsang sgrub ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin dpa' bo yum rdo rje phagomo dmar mo sa la—spyor spri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar mo rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i thugs kar ha 2/2—

bde ga gsarigasalnga'i sgrub thabasapad+ma stong ldan/la ari ni sas bskor ba/ mgrin pa rtsa 'dab ba drug la rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i spri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar ri la ha a ni sas bskor ba/ snying gar rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum sngon mo 'khar los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar a la ha ri ni sas bskor ba'o/ /lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dmar mo pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar ni la ha ri a sas bskor ba'o/ /gsang bar rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad la las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar sa la a ri ni as bskor ba'o/ /gzhan yang lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu kha bye ba tsam gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang / gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin par bsams la/ ā+oṃ uhūṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta thing sring dzaḥdzaX/ ā+oṃ bud+dha badz+ra raṇ+ḍapad+ma karma ḍā ki ni ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bzlas la/ snang srid dbang du bsdus par bsam mo/ /rjes snang stong skye med kyi ngang nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ dngosagrub char bzhin 'bab/ sgo gsum nus pa 'bar/ sems nyid ka dag gi don myur du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnyis las/ lta ba khregs chad ni/ rang rig mi 'gyur kun tu bzang / /rig rtsal ma 'gags rigs lnga ste/ /ye shesarang grol sgo ma bzhi/ /gang shar chos nyid rol pa la/ /spang blang dgag sgrub re dogs—2/3—

me po'i shul bzhag la / klong za rab 'byamasakyi gsupa 'bum/()med/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ /rang las shar zhing rang du grol/ /skye med bsam yul kun las 'das/ /'di yin gza' gtad phyogs ris med/ /thams cad rang grol gas ma'i ngang / /'gyur med gdod mali chos sku yin/ /'di ltar snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /sgyu ma rmi la 'dra bar shes bya ste/ /ngo bo rten med rang bzhin so sor gsal/ /thugasadze+e 'gags med phyogs ris 'dzin pa med/ /ji ltar rmi lam grong na sgyu ma'i bu/ /sna tshogs bde sdug yul la spyod pa ltar/ /thamasacad snang stong gasgo med rtsa ba bral/ /ye grol rang grol shar grol ngo bor grol/ /gtad megargyal po 'dzin med blo bde ba/ /gang snang grogs su 'char ba'i rang bzhin la/ /spang blang 'khrul ba'i byung khungs zad pa yin/ /'di ltar rtogasan snapasrid chas sku'i zhing / /bde chen mi 'gyur 'og min mkha' spyod yin/ /chosarnams ma skyes bsgom du med pa la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon su zhig sgom par byed/ /gang ltar btags pa de ltar gzung 'dzin te/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gzeb kyis 'ching ci dgos/ /thams cad rang grol lta ba'i rgyal po mchag /gakha med gang shar sgom pa'i rgyal po mchag/ blang dor 'dzin megaspyod pa'i rgyal po mchag /re dogs bral na 'brasabu'i rgyal po mchag /dziltar snang ste snang rung mi snang rung / /'di zhes ma 'dzin me long gzugasabarnyan bzhin/ /rkyen las skyes pa rang sar ngang gis grol/ /chas nyid rtsabral stong rung mi stong rung / /ched kar ma bsgom gnyis med don ma tshol/ / ye grol sor gzhag gdod ma'i ngang du grol/ /snang dang mi snang stong dang mi—214—

bde ga gsarigasalnga'i sgrubathabs pad+ma stong ldan/stong kun/ /byis pa'i blo yis mtshan mar bzung ba ste/ /yang dag don la 'di zhes ngos gzung med/ /nam mkha' tsam du'ang dper bya'i yul las 'das/ /bsam brjod spros pa'i yul las ye nas 'das/ /de la sgom na dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i blo/ /rtag chad gzeb tu rang nyid 'ching bar zad/ /rtog dang sgom dang dpyod pa'i tshol 'phra zhog /rang bzhag phyam gcig gnyis med chos sku'i pa/ / /da lta'i 'di nyid gdod ma'i ga sa kyi don/ /skad cig gang snang de yin blo bde 'o/ /'di ltar rtogs nas ci byas chas nyid ngang / /rtsa ba bral bas 'bras bu 'byin pa med/ /'khar 'das 'dzin pa kun las grol ba yin/ /pad+ma lasa'abrel rtsal gyisabastan nasasong / /zhesapa'o/ /sgom pa lhun grub ni de bzhin ga gsapa'i gsang sgo bye ste/ sems dang / yid dang /dbang po'i lta sgom kun las 'das pa'i ngang las dran bsam gyi rtsol sgrub zhig pas/ babs lugasachen mo gdod ma nasaganas pa'o/ /sna tshogasadran bsam kun las 'das pa'i ngang / /dag pa'i mkha' la dbyings rig gzer chen btang/ /snang min stong min mu bzhi 'das pa'i don/ /lnga ldan 'od gsal don dam snying po ni/ /snang bas stong ste me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /stong pas snang ste chu zla'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral me+ed pa'i gdangs/ /gsang sngagasakun gyi yang gsang rdzogs pa che/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i snying po yin/ khyab gdal chen pa'i rin chen pho brang du/ /'dzin med mig gi ye shes lcags kyu yis/ /rgya che gzung dka'i dbyings rig gzer btang nas/ /mtha' grol 1nga yangs chen pa'i dgongs —215

mesabo'i shul bzhag la / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakya gsung 'a ma//dpar bskyal/ /zab ma'i gnad bsdus ba da kyi snying po 'di/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis bstan nas song / /rigs lnga gsang bar sgrub pa rdzogasaso/ /de ltar rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /ye nas bdag dang dbye ba med pa la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa'i dgon par 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal sra 'thibs mun pa'i nags khrod la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun yun ring nyon re mongs/ /de ring bla ma mgon pa'i gsung thosanas/ /thams cad rang byung sangs rgyas zhing du snang / /e ma ya mtshan ngo mtshar blo re bde/ /des na srid pa'i 'khrul pa gzhal sla bas/ /grogs dag tshur nyon skad cig rig pa'i mchog /de phyir snying pa'i don 'di blang bar mdzod/ /'bar ba'i rgya mtsho tshe 'dis grol ba yin/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun rang grol te/ /gdod ma'i gnas su lhun gyis grub par shog /tshul 'di rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar 'phags pa'i ri ngogs su/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /skal ldan skye ba'i tshogs kun dga' bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs par rigs lnga'i gsang sgrub pad+ma stong ldan zhesabya ba/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi rnal 'byar pa/ dri med 'od zer gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /—2/6—
