༄7/ /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa bzhugs so/ /rin r+ṣa shog 'dra'i skor/rigs lnga'i ba da len bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ye shes rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin thugs rje'i 1ga phreng can/ /phan bde'i char gyis 'gro ba tshim mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro snying tag gsang ba'i snying po las/ /zab don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'dir bsdus te/ /phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis snang bar bya/ /phyi nang 'byung ba thams cad ye shes gdangs/ /ye shes dngos las ye nasagrub pas na/ /phyi yi 'byung ba'i bcud lnga la brten nas/ /nang gi 'byung pa rnam lnga'i gsos sman bshad/ dang po sayi bas len ni/ /satshil rdo tshil khrol bu gsum/ /rnal 'thur pa yi bza' ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad pa bya/ /de las tshil ni/ sngon bskal pa bzang pa'i dus na/ sa'i tshil zhag chags pa gad rdzong dang ri ngogasadang thang yangs bzang po la snang ba ste/ rigs lnga'i mdog dang mthun pa la sbrang rtsi'i ro ltar mngar zhing so mi seg pa ste/ rnal 'byar pas blangasal/ dang po bye dang sum cha sum gnyis/ de nas bye byed/ rim gyis sanyid la slob cing /—217—

mesapo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'grums kyigasung 'bum//shibadag nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i 1 gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gisakhengs pa bsnams pa'i lus kyi 'khor lolnga'i nang na/ ha ri ni sa a rnams dkar ser dmar ljang mazing gar gnasapa la/ mtha' skor du yi ge bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i mgrin pa'i ri ser po la ha a ni sa ser pos bskor ba las bdud rtsi babs pas/ lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing / rlung kha sbyar la bsgom zhing / ā+oṃ ri ha a ni sa sirnyi pha la āḥhūṃ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te phyogs ba 'i bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro snang srid snod bas thamasacad kyi gzi brjid dang / tshe dang / 'od zer dang nus mthu rnams rang gi mgrin pa'i yi ge nyed la thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar bsgoms nas mthar bsngo ba bya'o/ /de'ang mar dum re bcug pasagegs med cing 'byangs rtags shin tu nye'o/ /rtags su lus 'jam zhing gnyer ma med pa dang / sems gsal zhing ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang /ngag nus che zhing byin rlabs dang ldan pa dang / mkha' 'gro 'du zhing kun gyisamathong na yid du 'ong ba'o/ khyad par du bdud rtsi phor re tsam brten no/ /sngo dang rjen spang / nyi ma dang me spang / thig le ma nyamasapar bya'o/ /rdo tshil ni rigs lnga'i kha dog gang yang rung ste/ sa med par bye nas bkrus te khal ga ga la nas bre gsum/ gro bre gsum/ bra 'o bre do/ sran ma bre gang rnams dang bsres pa zhib mor rtsi bzhin btags la/ dang por btsos zan du bya ste/ phru ba thod pa'i ngo bor bsam pa'i nang du chu ran par phye dang mnyam du batsho'i/ /de nyid ā+oṃ uhūṃ bdun gyis bdud rtsir bsams la/ dang por zhag —218—

rigasalnga'i bas len bdud rtsi zigasapa/lngarabye dang byed bsres/ de nas ba ra sum cha sum gnyis/ de nasanyi shu rtsa gcig song dus/ bye drug cha re bsres la/ zan dron byas pa mar 'gron bu tsamare bcug nas bdud rtsir bsams la/ rang nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro snga ma bzhin bsgoms te/ zos rteng mgrin pa nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/lus sems bde bas rgyas par bsam la sngags de nyid bzlas te/ phyogs 'ag bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gra'i byin rlabs thams cad rang la babs pas lus khengs par bsam la/ rlang kha sbyor yun ring du bzung nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /dam tshig tu sngo dang rjen dang / nyi ma dang me spang / bdud rtsi phor re 'thungs shing / rtag tu bla ma la gsol ba gdab bo/ /'thungs pa'i rtagasasu lus la bde ba/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la rtogasapa 'bar zhing / mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du/ skyes pa bud med 'du/ zas nor gter rdol ba bzhin 'a la du 'ongs/ log 'tsho dang ser sna'i sgrib pa byang nas/ mu ge'i bskal pa las thar/ rtag tu lha'i longs spyod kun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gegs med do/ /phyis ni ji ltar dga' bas khrol bu dang skyo tsha dang spags pa'am/ thug pa'ang bya'o/ /de nasardo khrol bur za ba la brtag pa/ bza' ba/ phan yon dang bsrungasamatshams gsum las/ dang po ni sha chen tshil chen/ rusachen dang / mkhris chen dang / shi sha dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni mdog gang yang rung ba la so mi rtse zhing snyi ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni dkar la snyi ba'o/ /gsum pa ni dkar gong dang me rdo lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni g.ya' ma ljang gu lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni rdo phal pa thams cad do/ /de'ang sha tshim —2/9—

stesabo'i shul bas la / klong chen rab 'grums kyi gsung 'bum/(kaganyis las gzhan gsum mi brten no/ /rdo de dag ni spa gro stag tshang seng sgokug dang / kong po dang / rag sham brag dang / yar khyer dang / te sgo bragadakar dang / lha snyan dbu ri nas phar cung zad phyin pa dang / phag mo gru dpa/byar smad kyi lha ri rgyab dang / lto brag mkhar chu dang / 'dab smad bya dkar mo dang / bzad kyi bye ma lung dang / 'khrung po sle'u chung gi 'chil mo dang / dpalagyi chu bo ri rnams na yod do/ gnyis pa la drug las/ rdo btu ba ni skyabasa'agro sems bskyed bya ste/ rta mgrin tu bsgoms pa'i sor mo lnga mkha' 'gro lnga/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang / rdo bdud rtsir bsgoms la/ ā+oṃ trig yer swā hās btso la/ de nas bza' thabasadangos ni/ khrol bu de ka bzhin bza'/ zan dron yang de ka dang 'dra/ 'gams bye la skyo tsha dang sngags/ skyo tsha'am sngo dang bsres nas tshod ma byed pa'ang nyan no/ /sdor ni gang yang rung /tshwa gdab/ de'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsams la/ ā+oṃ mu le mu le mahā mu le swāhā/ ā+oṃ gor chun gor chun swāhā/ zhes bzlas la/ rang spyod rta mgrin du gsal bas bza'o/ /gegs sel ni tshe 'di blos btang / snying rje dang ldan pas/ dang po za ba'i tshe mar mthe bong tsam re rdo za ba'i snga phyir btang / chu bskol la mar btang la bas / des gegs mi 'byung ngesaso/ /phan yon dang bsrungs mtshalas ni/ mar nag mi za/ phud gzhan la mi sbyin/ dkon mchag mchod/ gsog 'jog mi bya/ sngagasa'adren dus ngag gsad/ thig tsem nyams par bsrung ngo / /de'ang rim gyis rdo grangs byas la mar byung dusatshang bam blta'o/ /phyisami dgos/ yog tshad zos pas chag zas kyi sred pa —220—

rigasalnga'i ba len bdud rtsi zigasapa/'chad/ sha skye zhing dkar la snum pa'o/ khes pa dngas/ dbang po gsal/ ro mchag thon/ lus la sgog chags mi 'byung / drod skyes/ mkha' 'gro 'du/mngon shes skye'o/ /de ltar sa yi ba da len byas pa yin/ log 'tsho med cing sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ dngos grub nye zhing bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /mkha' 'gro 'du zhing ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub/ mdor na phan yon dpag tu med pa yin/ sa'i bas len bdud rtsi yang zhus ces bya ba rdzogs so/ khru/rgya sbyo/ sbyod/de nas chu'i ba da len ni/ /bdud rtsi dngul chu'i sbyor ba ste/ /rnal 'byar pa yis bza' ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes/ /sngon 'gro rdzas bsag rab gnas ni/ /dngul chu mu zis bas ba ni/ /srang lnga sgog skya de dang mnyam/ /dbang lag nye shing ra mnye ba/ /a ba sbrul sha rtag tu ngu / /srang re tshogasan shin tu rab/ /gla rtsi shu dag gu gul nag /li shi tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis/ /star bu shing kun brag zhus dang / cu gang dzā ti ghi hang dang / /rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha/ yīng tsha bca' lda pi pi ling / /se 'khru sug stel a ru ra/ /a ka ru ni nag po dang //mgron bu bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams/ /ci 'thur bye mar rtsi bzhin bya//cong zhi bre byed dang bsres nas/ /klad par bsdus te yun ring bsna //dngul mdangs rtsig rtsig byung ba dang / /ril bu lug gi ril ma tsam/ /byasate rin chen sgod du blugs/ /tshesabaca nyi shu lnga la sogs/ /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshod du/ /tshogs gtor bshams la ril bu rnams/ /mkha' 'gro sde —221—

mesabo'i shul bzhagal / grong chen rab 'grumasakyigasung 'bum/(kasngar gsal btang la/ /ye shes bcug cing mchad bstod bya/ /'od kyi phyogs ba 'i sangasargyasadang / /byang semasabla ma mkha' 'gro yi/ /dngos grub byin rlabs kun bsdus la/ /ril bu'i mkha' 'gror thim par bsam/ā+oṃ a ha ri ni sa sirnyi pha la hūṃ/ 'di dang rten 'brel snying po yis/ /me tagador nasabakra shis brjod/ /tshogs kyi dga' ston rgya cher bya/ /de ni rab lco gnas pa 'o/ /nasani dkar la bzang ba la/ /gro bye bre gsum skyo tsha byas//gnyis pa dngos gzhi bza' thabs ni/ /tho rangs langs te skyil krung bya/ /byung ro lan gsum phyir phul la/ /las dang sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ /de nas ril bu mid nas ni/ /skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed ldan pa yis/ /rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dkar gsal zhal ga ga spyan gsum mjes/ /g.yasagayon brkyang bskum mi ro gnon/ /gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang / /phyag gnyis rdo rje gri gug dang / /thod khrag bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /me lopadril bu'i phreng bas brgyan/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga dang / /lte ba gsang gnasarnam pa lngar/ /dkar ser mthing ga dmar ljang gi /rtsa 'dab 'bar lo rnam lnga'i dbus/ /ro rkyang dbu ma ka ba bzhin/ /'bar lo lnga na yig 'khru lnga/ /ha ri a ni saganas pa'i/ /phyogasabazhir rang gnas 'khar lo bzhi'o//dbu ma sbubs stong yar sne na/ /bde chen zhabar lor haṃ gnas te/ /lte bar ni dmar me stag 'dra/ /gsang ba'i ye las rlang byung bas/ /ni las me 'bar haṃ la phog /thig le dmar pa'i me 'od kyis/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib sha khrag rnams/ /bsregasasbyangasalan ni bdun —222—

rigasalnga'i bas r+ṣa skud rtsi thigasapa/pa'irjes/ /haṃ las bdud rtsi dkar h+pha rgyun/ /rkang mthil spyi gtsug gang bar babs/ /phyogs bas bla ma mkha' 'gro dang / /sangs rgyas byang a sems dpa' dang / /snang srid sgod bas bdun rtsir gyur/ /bdag gi lus zur /yi /shā /sgo /je ma sna /bye la pal tham pa sa/ / dpal ga ba da 'ad dang ldan/ / na rlabasadangs grub thob par bsam/ /bde stong dbyer med ngang la gas /rjes ni bsngo bas rgyas gdab bya/ /zhag ni gsum gsum ril bu re/ /nyi nyu rtsaspyog gong du bza'/ /de nas ⑩ra ra zos pasaspyo /oṃ snyo phor re gas bar bya/ /gsum pa rjes la rnam gsum ste/ /rtags dang gegs sel phan yon no/ /rtags ni phyi nang gsang ba ste/ /phyi rtags gnyid chung shes pa gsal/ /lus yang bde drod skye ba 'o/ /nang rtags rmi lam mkha' la 'gro /྾ 'go skye bosabastod pa dang / /bsnyen bkur spyos gho byed pa rmis/ /gsang rtags phyi ru snang ba ni/ /lusani r+sā drug lon pa 'dra/ /rgasanas so 'u skye ba dang / /maphro par shesapa 'a4 ba dang / /mkha' 'gro mtsho la ngang pa bar+ṣa/ /'du zhing dngos grub sna tshogasaster/ khrub pa brgyad kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gegasasel ga' mo bsgomasapa dang / /bla ma la gusagasol ba gdab/ /nad ni tsha grang gang langs kyang / /de dang mthun pa'i sman gyisagaso/ /gdon la snyeng rje byang sems bsgom/ /des ni gegs med yon to 'grub/ /spyir na 'di la gegs med de/ /mkha' 'gros gegasasel dngos grub ster/ /gal srid byung yang 'jigs mi dgos/ /zhag grangs them 223—

mesabo'i shul bzhagalas/ 1nga chen rab 'byams kyi gsu— 'tsho/(kadus gegs las grol/ /dam tshig sngo ngad spang ba dang / /me dang nyi ma tshwa rnams spang / /zig le bsrung zhing bde stong bsgom/ /phan yon lusasemasabade stong bskyed/ /nad gdon mdze rigs dug rnams zhi/ /mkha' 'gro 'du zhing ci bsam 'grub/ /'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob/ /'di 'dra'i gdams pa yid bzhin 'dra/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig cha rkyen du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ skal ldan rnamasadang 'phrad par shog /chu'i bas len bde chen rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ lho/ rgya rgya rgya/de nas me yi bas len ni/ /gas mo bde drod ye shes gos/ rnal 'byar pa yis bgo ba'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo pad+ma'i rigs dmar mo/ gcer bu pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dpa' ma'i rgyan rdzogs par bskyed la/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag dang / rnam snang gi chasabadun dang ldan pas/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu/ masprin par ba drug /snying gar sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bsam pa'i dbus su dbu ma sbubs stong pa'i yar sna tshangs bug /mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa'i g.yas g.yonaganyisanas ro rkyang gnyis 'khar lo lnga la 'khyud nas klad pa'i steng na tshun byung ste/ smin mtshams nasasna bug gnyisasu spyod par bsam de gnyis kyi mar sna ste 'og sor bzhi na dbu ma'i nang du spyod par bsam rtsagasum po de mda' smyug tsam pa dmar por bsam/ de nas rlung ro drag po —224—

rigasalnga'i bas len bdud rtsi thig pa/gsum phyir phul la/ sna bug gnyis na tshur 'jam la ring bar nangadudrangasal rtsa gnyis nas mar phus btang pa bzhin song bas gsang gnas su dbu ma'i nang du spyod par bsams/ gsang bar sa dmar po zhig kyang bsgom/ de rlung gis bus pas dmar lam gyis byung bas lte ba'i rtsa mdud na pad+ma ḍā ki yab yum sbyor ba'i gsang gnas las/ bdud rtsi babs pas gsang ba'i rtsa bdud gang bar bsgom zhing / rlung thub thang du bzung zhing / cung zad re brngubs la mnan/ yang byed tsam re dal bus phyir btang la lhag ma ga nga /gtong dus sna bug gnyis na phar dal bur song ba'i tshe/ kun dhar ma'i nang nas tshangasapa'i bu gar sngo sangs kyis song bar bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas gsang gnas su drod phebs te dwangs ma 'a ra bar 'dug na/ lte ba nas gtum mo sbar la snying gar snga ma bzhin bsgom/ de nas masprin par bsgoms pas snying gar drod skyes dus spyi bor sbar la bsgom mo/ /des ni rtsa bye nas dwangs ma rgyas te/ bde drod 'bar bsalus la gos mi dgos snum la dro zhing dwangs/ sems la bde stong lhan cig skyesapa'i ye shes 'char zhing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub chen po thob/ tshe gcig gis rig 'dzin gyi sa non par 'gyur ro/ /bde chen ye shes gas ma'i me 'od kyis/ /bde gshegs khams rnams ma lus rab rgyas nas/ /bde chen mi 'gyur 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /bde gshegasarnamasadang skal pa mnyam par shog /ga' mo me'i bcad len bde drod 'bar ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ lho/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas rlung gis ba da len ni/ /mngon shes rdzu'aphrul skye ba ste/ /rnal 'byor —225—

me bo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kapa yisabasgrub pa'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /de la gyenasnethur sel/ mnyam gnas gsum ni/ pho mo ma ning gi dbye bsate/ drag dang / 'jam pa dang / mnyam par gnas te/ las kyi rlang bco nasaye shes kyi rlung sbyang ba'i phyir/ dus bzhir rlung gi rim pa bsgom pa ni/ dgun grang nga chu yi dusasu me'i rma dmar zhing dro ba gzung ngo / /dpyid bad kan sa'i du na rlung gi rlung 'byed cing 'thor ba ljang khu mnyam par gzung ngo / /dbyar tshab me'i dus su chu'i rma dkar zhing bsil ba gzung ngo / /ston smin byed rlungagi dus su sa'i rlung dal 'jam ser po gzung ngo / /de yang stan bde ba la'adug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ rang nyid las kyi mkha' 'asgoljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyis yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang / g.yon pa bdugartsis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i/ 'khar lo lnga snga ma bzhin gas blta la rlung ro gsum phyung nas/ rlung rab tu dal ba gsum tshur srung ba rorkyang gnyis nas dbu mar zhugs/ 'khor lo lnga rgyu ma 4sa btang pa bzhin song / gsang ba'i sa ljang gu ha ri ni as bskor ba la gsal stong gnyisamed kyi ye shes skye bar bsam zhing thub thang re bzung la phyir dal bus phyed tsam re gtang ngo / /de yang bum pa can du bskyil ba'o/ /de bzhi du rma rabatu dal bas phyi nang du mnyam zhing gzung ba ni/ 'jam pa ste khong seng can du sba ba'o/ /de bzhin du rlung gi 'gro 'ong shin tu dal bas mi tshor bar byas te/sems gsal stong gi ngang la 'jog pa ni nam mkha' can du sba ba ste/ ma ning zhes bshad do/ /de gsum gang byed kyang dus bzhi'i rlung gi rjes 'brang bas —226—

rigasalnga'i bas len bdud rtsi thigasab/rlungaskyon med cing ye shes myur du skye'o/ /langs dus bsngo ba byas la/ lus thams cad dkrugs shing ba sa te bskor la mnyam par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas lus yang zhing mgyogs pas rkang mgyogs 'khrub/ sems gsal la dwangs pas mngon shes 'grub/ rnam rtog 'gro 'ong chad pas ye shesa'agrub/ rtag tu lus sems bde zhing snying pa'i don la reg/ rtsa lasasu rung bas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung / rlung las su rung bas mngon shes dang rdzu'aphrul la dbang bsgyur/ mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyisa'adu/ dngosagrub sna tshogs 'byung / myur du gdod ma'i ka dag gsal stong chen por mya ngan las 'da' 'o/ /de yang 'od gsal dang bsres nas bsgom pa ni mchog tu gces so/ /rlung gi ba da len dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ lja/ rgya rgya rgya/ de nas nam mkha'i bas len ni/ /zag med ye shes bskyed pa ste//rnal 'thur pa yis bsgom pa'i phyir/ /'di nyid du yang bshad par bya/ /dwangs shing mtho ba'i sar song ste/ nam mkha' dwangs pa'i tshe skad cig gis rang nyid sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mthing ga 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i spri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i 'bar lo lnga dang rtsa gsum gsal btab ste/ rlung phyir 'gro dus las dang sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sang sang phar song bar bsam zhing / nang du brngubs dus nam mkha' sngo skya thams cad na ra ra byung ste ro rkyang nas dbu ma dnga'akhar lo lnga gang bas ka dag spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam ste thub thang nang du mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin du phyi'i nam mkha' nang gi nam mkha' la thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad sprin —227—

mesabo'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/(kamed pa'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bur bsams pa'i ngang la shes pa gsal stong 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes la gzhag go /de nasaphyi'i sa rdo ri brag la sogs snang srid thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur te nang gi nam mkha' rnams par dag pa'i nam mkha'i ngang du thim par bsamazhing mnyam par gzhag go /skabs su lus dang phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur te/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' gnyisa'adres pa ni/ bumapa chag pas bum nang gi nam mkha' dang nam mkha' chen por dbye ba med pa bzhin gsal lta nga mtha' bral gyi ngang la phyam gyis mnyam par bzhag pas/chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i don mngon sum du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo nam mkha' ltar chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral bar zhi zhing thim nas/gdod ma ye stong ka dag chen po/ skye med bsam yul las 'das pa'i don mngon 'gyur te/ tshe 'dir rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i ngang der 'bad rtsol dang bral ba grol ba yang yod do/ /phal cher bar do'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi skad cig dang por don de nyid goms pa dang / 'dresanas ka dag gi sa la rang grol lo/ /de'ang rnam shesanam mkha' la thim pa'i tshe phyi'i nam mkha' sprin med pa ltar stong gsal gdod nas dag pa'i snang ba 'char la/ nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim pa'i tshe/ phyi'i nam mkha' nang gi nam mkha' dang 'dres pa ltar bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngon bas 'phags par 'char ba de nyid/ gzhi'i 'od gsal du rang ngo shes pas da lta sbyangs pa'i 'od —228—

rigasalnga'i bas leg bdud rtsi thagasapa/gsal bu'i ye shes dang 'dres te gnyis med gcig tu grol lo/ /de'i tshe phyi nang gi nam mkha' dbye ba med pa ltar lus rdos bcas bor sems chas nyid gdod ma'i ye shes su nub/ ye shes 'od gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang / nang gsal ka dag gi ye shes gcig tu gnas pas chos sku bsal bzhag dang bral ba/ phyi nang gi nam mkha' la dbye ba med pa ltar/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang du gnas te/ phra ba'i ye shes gsal dwangs gzhi la mi g.yo bar gnas pa tsam las/ phyi nang gi 'dzin pa gang yang med pa'i rang bzhin shel sgong dri ma dang bral ba ltar/ ka dag chas zad kyi gnas lugs gdod ma'i grol gzhi chen po nyid du 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe gsal ba'i cha tsam lasame long g.ya' dag pa ltar/ sku dang ye shes kyi 'char gzhi phyir gsal du 'byung ba mi 'gags pas/ ga gas sku 4na gsum tshogs pa'i snang ba ston la/ nang gsal phra ba thugs rje'i cha tsam las 'gro ba'i gnas dang dbang po dang skye ba la sogs pa mkhyen nas gang la gang 'dul ston pa'i sprul pa 'khrul bas sems can gyi don lhun grub tu byed kyang gdod ma'i ngang nam mkha' lta bu chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang las g.yos pa med do/ de ltar gdod ma'i gnas lugs gsal por bshad pa ste/legs par bkral na nam mkha' lta bu las gzhan med do/ /zab mo'i chos tshul rgya mtsho thams cad nas/ chas sku nam mkha' lta bur gsungs pa'i don de yin no/ /de ltar gsungs kyang gzhan du brjod pa dag mi gsal zhing go bar dka' la/ 'dir go sla zhing gsal por brjod pa'o/ /dbu ma rab tu mi —229—

me po'i shul bzhagalas/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'a ma/ /da gnas pas de'i tshe ye shes rgyun chad par 'dod pa ni sems sems byung sgospros pa dbyings su zhi ba tsam la dgongs so/ /'dir rang bzhin rdzogs sa chen pos sems sems byung gi spros pa ma lus pa dbyengs su zhi bas gdog ma'i ye shes nang gsal phra ba'i rig pa thugs rje'i snying po can du gnas pa las sems can gyi don byed par 'dod do/ /snga mas smon lam gyis don byed pa las thugs rjes don byed par khas mi len no/ /dngos por smra ba ni sangs rgyas dngos por sku dang ye shes grub pa ltar da ltar gyi sems can rang rgyud pa ltar 'dod de/ de dag ni rtag pa'i mthar lhung la/ ye shesargyun chad nas smon lam gyis don byed pa ni chad pa'i mthar lhung pas/ de gnyisakabasal te phra ba'i ye shes gsal ba'i cha las stong pa rig pa'i snying po can du lhun gyis grub pa'i don la 'jug pa yin rgo/ /de'i tshe ngo bo stong pas rtagapa'i mthar ma lhung / rang bzhin gsal bas chad pa'i mthar ma lhung / thugasarjes khyab pas sems can gyi don 'bad med lhun grub chen por bzhugs pa yin no/ /'di ni rab tu gsang ba'i snying po mthar thug pa'o/ /nam mkhalibacud len ye shes gsang skor zhesabya ba rdzogs so/ /sgo rgya rgya rgya/ de ltar ma dag 'byung ba'i thabasanyid las/ /dag pa'i ye shes bskyed pa gsang ba'i lam/ /rdo rje snying po'i theg pa mthar thug ste/ /ma lus 'gro kun gnad 'dis grol bar shog /sa yi ba da len 'byung ba'i lus bzung ste/ /chu dang me yis bde chen mchag bskyed nas/ /rlang gis gsal stong nam mkhas mi rtog nyid/ /sku gsum sa la rang bzhin lhun gyis—230

rigasalnga'i bam len bdud rtsi thigasapa/grub/ /'di ni mthar thug nges pa'i snying po ste/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig sbas pa'isgo bye nas/ /gangs ri thod dkar 'phags pa'i ri ngogs su/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /gzhi rdzogs 'od gsal snying po'i zhing khams su/ /ma lus phyam gcig thams cad byang chub nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par shog /rigs lnga'i bcad len bdud rtsi thigs pa zhesabya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi sgob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rjesasu bzung ba'i rnal 'thur pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum me tag dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe bkod ba rdzogs so// //'di nyid gsang zhing phangasapar bya/ /kun la mi bstan nyams su blangs/ /las 'brel rtsal kyi khyad chasayin/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig man ngag yin/ /dge'o/ /—231—

༄7/ /bdud rtsi sprin 2nga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog 'dra'i skor/bdud rtsi sprin phung zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs te/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis phyogs bas 'gro kun gyi/ /nyon mongs nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /bde gshegs rang byung pad+ma rgyal po yis/ /'dab stong bdag rgya'i yid kyi tshal lhung bas/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu tshim par bya/ /de yang rdo rje'i lus 'di la/ /bde chen longasaspyod chas dang sprul/ /bde skyong zhabar lo lnga yod de/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga rigs lnga'i gnas/ /ye nas 'od gsal dri ma med/ /rtsa khams yi ge'i tshul du gnas/ /de ni 'byung ba'i byer zug gis/ /'khrugasashing nad rnams 'byung ba na/ /rlang dmigasayi ge'i spyor ba yis/ /nad rnams 'don par bya ba ni/ /rnal 'thur pa yis 'dir shesabya/ /dang po bde chen 'khar lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu ste/ /dbus na ha gnasashar du a/ /lho ri nub ni byang du sa/ /de dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar/ /yab yum rdo rje thod khrag bsnams/ /sbyor mtshams dwangs ma babs pa yis/ /mgo dang snying ga'i mtshams su babs/ /tsha grang nad rnams zhi bar bsam/ /rlung ni phyir 'phangs nang du gzung / /tsha ba'i nad ni dwangs la bsil/ /grang ba bad kan 'dus pa la/ /rab tu tsha bas gang —232—

bdud rtsi sprin phung /bar bsgom/ /rlung yang bad rlung grang ba la/ /thog mar phyir sbur nang du gzung / /tshad nad la ni ga nga mi bya/ /desani bde chen 'khar lo yi/ /nang gi nad rnams zhi bar byed/ /phyi yi nad ni 'di ltar 'don/ /dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba la/ /yi ge bzlas shing 'phangs pa ni/ /ting nge 'dzin kyisagatan bsreg bya/ /gang du na ba khol bur 'don/ /yi ge'i gnas ni 'di lta ste/ /'phar ba'i ni rtsa nyi shu gnyis/ /'di dag la sogs phyir ru 'phra/ /spyi ba'i gtsug ni drang po na/ /yi ge a ni gnas pa ste/ /sman skad snyan gyi re thag yin/ /'di gtang rims dang snying nad sel/ /'di nas g.yas ni tshon gang na/ /yi ge ga ni gnas pa ste/ /'di ming sto dhe g.yasapa zhes/ /'di gtang gzhog g.yas na la phan/ /de g.yon tshon gang gi yin te/ /de ming sto dhe g.yon pa zhes/ /'di gtar bzhags yon na la phan/ /de nas sor bzhi mtshogs ma'i steng / /gi yig gnasate 'di ming ni/ /ral dmigs chen po zhes bya ste/ /'di dag mgo 'khar 'a bas la phan/ /de g.yasatshon gang btsal ba na/ /ku gnas dung rtsa 'khar ma ste/ /'di gtang ldan g.yas nad la phan/ /de g.yon tshon gang k+ṣu yin te/ /dung rtsa 'bring bu zhesabya ba/ /'di gtar ldan g.yon nad la phan/ /de nas tshon gang mdun ngos la/ /khyeganas ral dmigs chung ngu zhes/ /'di gtan mig gi nad la phan/ /de nas g.yasakyi tshon gang na/ /gnas mkhris rtsa ser po yin/ /'di gtang dang ka 'gribs na phan/ /de yi g.yon nas tshon gang nas/ /ke gnas mkhris pa'i dung bu zhes/ /'di gter kha kha'i nad la phan/ /de nas dpral ba'i dbus na ke/—233—

mesama'i shul bzhagalas/ klong ོ rab gomasakyi gsung las/()'di mingamakhris rtsa ser dung yin/ /'di gtar chang gi nad la phan/ /de g.yas mig gi phug na gyen/ /kor gnas mig rtsa 'greng bu zhes/ 'di gtang ling thog la sogs phan/ /g.yon pa phug na ko yin te/ /'di ming mig rtsa 'phar ma zhes/ /'di gtar tshad pa'i nad la phan/ /de nas gyen du tshon gang g.yas/ /ka gnas mig rtsa 'phred nyal zhes/ /g.yon gyis 'phrad na shaṃ gnas te/ /'di gnyis mi gtang tsan dan byugs/ /mig gi nad rnams kun la phan/ /de nas phar ba la rtse gtad g.yas/ /tha gnas klad pa 'khyams la phan/ /rtse gtad g.yon na de bzhin thā/ /'di gtar mig ni lug la phan/ /mig phug g.yas na yi ge shrī/ /mig rtsa lhum bu zhes bya ste/ /'di gtar mig rtsa'i nad la phan/ /g.yon gyi phug na shrī gnasate/ /mig rtsagang po zhes bya 'o/ /'di gtang mig ni rno bar byed/ /lce steng g.yas phyogasayas rkan gyi/ /dkar ba'i rtsa gnyis dag la ni/ /thu dang thu gnyis 'khrel ma'i tshul/ /'di ming lce rtsa nag po zhes/ /'di gtang lce phug brosal phan/ /rna ba g.yas nas bye gnasate/ /g.yon na rtsa gnas mdzum mos mnan/ /'od ni mngon du snang bar gyur/ /mkhur tshosagayasagayon ba dang bā/ /'gram zhabs g.yasagayon bi dang bī/ /rna ba'i tshun 'gram g.yasagayon na/ /de bzhin bu dang ru gnyis gnas/ /de bzhin phar 'gram g.yasagayon na/ /bhe bye gnyis ni gnas pa yin/ /rna ba g.yas pa'i steng 'og na/ /ba bī g.yon pa'i steng 'og na/ /bo sto 'gram zur g.yas g.yon na/ /me māṃ lko gzur g.yas g.yon na/ /ma mā lto mgo g.yas g.yon na/ /mi sī lto stong dag na —234—

bdud rtsi sprin kung /ni/ /mu mū gnyis po de bzhin no/ kha yi mtha' ni g.yasagayon na/ /meh+ya maih+ya gnyis gnyis gnas pa'o/ /lce yi steng 'og mi lī'o/ /sna bug g.yasagayon me swe gnyis/ /ya rkan ma rkan dkyil gnyis na/ / māṃ lta zur g.yas g.yon na/ /tsa tsā ltag khung steng 'og na/ /tsi ṭī mjing zur g.yasagayon na/ /tsu tsū gnyis po de bzhin no/ /mgo ba'i 'a ra ni g.yas g.yon na/ /tseh+ya tsih+ya dpral dbyingasagayas g.yon na/ /tse rtswa smin ma g.yasagayon na/ /tso rtswa ltag pa'i bdud sgo na/ /yi ge tse ni gnas pa yin/ /rtse'u chung g.yasakyi mgo gnyis kyi/ /phar 'gram tshur 'gram gnyis po na/ /nya nywa de bzhin g.yon gnyis na/ /nyi twe gnyis ni gnas pa'o/ /'gram zur rus mgo g.yas g.yon na/ khu nyu gnyas po de bzhin no/ /mig gi lkog ni g.yas g.yon na/ /nyeh+ya nyeh+ya gnyis po yod pa'o/ /mtshogs ma'i khur ni g.yas g.yon na/ /na nā ya mchu'i dkyil gnyis na/ /ni twe ma mchu'i gnyis po na/ nu nā mkhur tshos g.yon g.yon mgo'i/ /rus pa 'khyar ba gnyisan ni/ /peh+ya bekhya lce zur g.yasagayon na/ /ne+e twe sna bug g.yasagayon na/ /no two lce rtse sna rtse na/ /rna dz+wa lkog tse lto stong mgor/ /bh+yo bye sna yi rtse gnyis na/ /bhe snye gnyisapo gnasapa yin/ /rlang sbyor dmigs pa gsal ba yis/ /yi ge bzlas shing phyir la 'don/ /bu ga gzer 'don mda' 'phangs 'dra/ /ting nge la na gyi gtar sreg yin/ /gzhan la dngos su gtar bsaphan/ /bde chen 'khar lo'i gnad yig go /gnyis pa longs spyod 'khar lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab ba drug bdag nyid de/ /dbus na ri dang shar na ha/ /lhor a nub ni byang du sa/ /—235—

me po'i shul bas las/ klong chen rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum/()rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum lnga/ /rin chen gri gug thod khrag ser/ /sbyor mtshams dwangs ma babs pa yis/ /mgrin dbus nas bzung lus kun gang / /tsha grang nad ku na zhi bar bsam/ /rlang 'phangs tsha grang shes par bya/ /nang gi nad kun zhi bar byed/ /3 rol yi ge sbyor bas 'don/ /mgrin g.yas gyen rgyug e gnas te/ /'di ming rtse'u chung g.yasapa zhes/ /'di gtar mjing pa rtengs la phan/ /g.yon na o gnas rtse'u chung g.yon/ /'di gtar stod ni bsdams pa phan/ /mgo chag khong nad kun la phan/ /dpung pa g.yas na e gnas te/ glo rtsa yon po zhes bya 'o/ /'di gtang glo ni tsha la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na a gnasate/ /spyi rtsa then po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar nad rnams kun la phan/ /dpung pa'i nyid kyi g.yas na a/ dug rtsa yon po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtang dug nad kun la phan/ /g.yon a sbal rtsa nag po zhes/ /'di ltar spyo 'bog brgyal la phan/ /dpung zur g.yasagayon i i te/ sbal rtsa nag po ches bya ba/ /'di gtar ske nad kun la phan/ /g.yon rig ser rtsa thung po ste/ /'di gtar rtsa yi nad rnam sel/ /o ā+o sog pa'i me long dkyil/ /'di ming glo rtsa chen po ste/ /'di bsregs mgo bo 'khyams la phan/ /dpung pa lung mjug dkyil na o/ /gshen thag g.yas pa zhesabya'o/ /'di bsregs dpung pa byung ba sel/ /g.yon par i gnas 'di bsregs pas/ /pho ba khengs pa'i nad la phan/ /masprin 'og khung na ri gnas te/ /ltag pa'i dkyil nas e gnas te/ /li ni rtse mchan g.yas g.yon lī/ /de bzhin mdun gyi e yin no/ /'di kun gtems shing dmigs pa min/ /yi —236

bdud rtsi sprin kung /ge 'di dag gnas pa yi/ /phyogs nas dbugs ba sa bzlas pas 'khrub/ /dmigs pa'i me yis bsreg pa ste/ /gzhan la me btsas phan pa yin/ /longs spyod 'bar la'i gnad yin no/ /gsum pa chos kyi stobar lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis dbus/ /a gnasashar ha lho phyogs ri/ /nub ni byang du sa gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum mthing / /'bar lo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /lus khengs nad gdon zhi bar bsam/ /rlung gnad la sogs gong bzhin no/ /nang gi nad kun sel bar byed/ /phyi rol yi ge'i sbyor ba ste/ /snying las gyesapa'i rtsa chen ni/ /phyi rol rnam pa 'di ltar snang / /lag pa'i gre mang g.yas pa'i ga nga / /yi ge ka yi mjug mo gnas/ /sman skad 'bab bsam gru mgo yin/ /'di gtar rigs kyi nad kun sel/ /g.yon pa'i ga nga na kha yod de/ /'di ming bha la ti ti zhes/ /'di gtar mkhrisapa'i nad la phan/ /bad kan nad kun sel bar byed/ /de yi phyi rol g.yasan ga /'di gtar mchin pa'i nad la phan/ /de ming ru thung g.yas pa 'o/ /g.yon na gha gnas ru thung g.yon/ /'di gtar pho ba'i nad la phan/ /lag ngar nang rol dbus na na/ /'di ming mkhris pa'i rgyal mo yin/ /'di gtar mkhris pa'i nad la phan/ /de yi g.yas zur rtsa gnas te/ /mchin rtsa za ma zhes bya ste/ /'di gtar mchin pa'i nad kun sel/ /de yi ro thung nang rol tsha/ /rtsa bran kha kha zhes bya ba/ /'di gtang bad kan nad la phan/ /lag ngar mkhrig ma dpral mtshalasazur/ /dzā gnas gong rtsa g.yas pa zhes/ /'di —237—

mesapo'i shul bas la / klong ོ rab spyoms kyi gsung 'bum/()gtar glo ba'i nad la phan/ /g.yon na dza gnasagong rtsa g.yon/ /'di gtar lud pa sel la phan/ /mkhrig ma'i rgyab dkyil drang por nya/ /'di ming rgyab rtsa grub mgo zhes/ /'di ltar ro stod nad la phan/ /lag pa'i maspeb mdzub gnyis kyi bar/ /tshon gang bcal ba'i shong bu na/ /ṭa gnas snying rtsa dkar mo zhes/ /'di gtang mkhal mkhris snying nad sel/ /rgyab kyi drang por tha gnasate/ /rgyab rtsa chen mo zhesabya ba/ /'di gtar ro rgyab nad la phan/ /mtheb chung ngos kyi phyi zur ṭa/ /mchin rtsa khron bu zhesabya ba/ /'di gtar lag pa'i nad la phan/ /mthe bong rgyab kyi drang por dha/ /mkhris rtsa ghan+dhe zhesabya ba/ /'di gtar mgo ba'i nad la phan/ /mdzub ma'i rgyab na yi ge ṇa/ /pho ba'i yal ga zhes bya ste/ /'di gtan dug gi nad la phan/ /gung ma'i rgyab na ta gnas te/ /mtsher pa'i yal ga zhes bya'o/ /'di gtar srin gyi nad la phan/ /srin lag rgyab na de bzhin tsa/ /mkhal rtsa yon po zhes bya ba/ /'di gtar mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ /mthe'u chung rgyab na da gnas so/ /pho rtsa yon po zhesabya ba/ /'di gtang pho ba'i nad la phan/ /lag mthil dkyil na dha dha gnas/ /mchin pa'i rtsa nag ces bya 'o/ /'di gtar pho mchin 'bar la phan/ /mdzub mo'i ngos na 'khor ba ni/ /na gnas snying rtsa 'khar ma ste/ /'di gtang snying mi dga' ba dang / /snying rlung ldang dub nyid la phan/ /rnal 'thur pa yis bzlas shing 'don/ zhu ma'i steng na pa gnas te/ /de yi g.yon na ba gnasaso/ mchan khung g.yasan ba gnasate/ /de bzhin g.yon na bha gnasate/ ma ni brang gi lhan sna la/ /pho ba'i steng na la gnasaso/ /ya ni rgyab kyi 238—

bdud rtsi sprin phung /tshigs pa la/ /'di kun phyogs ni gang nar bsreg /rnal 'byar pa yisagatams pas 'khrub/ /gtems dang dkrugs dang skyil ba ni/ /phyi rtsa rnamasal rab tu gces/ /chas kyi 'khar la'i gnad yin no/ /bzhi pa sprul pa'i 'bar lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzha'i dbus/ /ni dang shar ha lho phyogs ri/ zhub a byang du saganasate/ /pad+ma yab yum dmar mjesa'adzum/ /pad+ma gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ /spyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i lusakhengs te/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus dag /rlang gnad la sogs gong dang 'dra/ /phyi rol yi ge'i spyor ba ni/ /pa pā mkhal khung g.yas dang g.yon/ sha sha sbu nag mtshamasan gnas/ /ra ra mkhal ma g.yasagayon na/ /g.yasasu gas cing g.yon du bor/ /nga pa ste ba'i mdun rgyab na/ /mtheb mdzub gtemasapas rlung ni 'gags/ /re ha lte khung 'og dang steng/ /ṭu ṭu rgyu 'og g.yas dang g.yon/ /dza dzā gnyis kyang de bzhin no/ /ṭa ṭā mkhal khung g.yas dang g.yon/ /'di kun gtems pa ma yin te/ /rab tu bzlas shing sbur ba yis/ /'byung ba rnams ni cha snyomasabyed/ /sked pa man chad gang na yang / /yi ge bzlas shing spros pa yis/ /'byung ba'i nad rnams rang sar 'dzad/ /g.yas g.yon yi ge rang gi gnad/ /tsha grang kha dog dkar dmar ro/ /yi ge kun la nges shes bya/ /lte ba sprul pa'i gnad yin no/ /lnga pa bde skyong 'khar lo ni/ /rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad dbus/ /sadang shar ha lho phyogasari/ zhub ni byang du a gnas te/ /lasakyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang / /rgya gram gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /sbyor mtshams byang sems babs pa yis/ /lus—239—

stesapo'i shul bzhagal / klong ོ rab stemasakya gsung 'bum/()khengs nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /rlung gnad la sogasagong bzhin no/ /phyi rol yi ge'i sbyor ba ni/ /hū ni sbu gu thung la gnas/ /bsregs pas rengs ba'i nad la phan/ /rnal 'byar pa yis dbugs ba sa te/ /phyi nas nang du drang bar bya/ /u i bshang gci gnyisapo sgo/ /k+ṣa ni rkub kyi lung na 'o/ /mdzub mos mnan te rnal 'tshur pas/ /dbugs ni gyen la dal gyes drangs/ /nang du yi ge mang por stel/ /lte ba yi ges khengasapa na/ /gtems shing yi ge yid kyis bzlas/ /de ltar goms pas lo gnyis nas/ /zas gos gnyis kyi 'du shes 'gags/ /ra hū brla nang g.yas g.yon na/ /'phar rtsa 'di gnyis mdzub mos btsir/ /sems ni 'brasapar 'gyur ba min/ /ṭa la rdo rje'i steng 'og na/ /'di gnyis gtems pas thig le 'gags/ sha ni rdo rje'i rtse mo na/ /mnyes pasa'adod chags spyong bar byed/ /lus ni ga nga gis zin pa na/ /'di kun bzlas shing gtems pa yis/ /'dus pa'i nad de drungs nas 'byin/ /ti ṭi dbyi mgo g.yasadang g.yon/ /la wā brla khung g.yas dang g.yon/ /mi yi pus mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /'di bsregs sprid dang sa mas pa 'tsho/ /nya i pus steng g.yasagayon na/ /'di bsregasamakhal ma'i nad la phan/ /de yang pusama'i mar mtshan na/ /sor bzhin ngar gdong g.yas pa na/ /yi ge su yi mgo yod de/ /sman skar mcher rtsanag po zhes/ /'di gtar 'byung ba snyoms pa'i grogs/ /skad 'gags rtsib mar zug la phan/ /de g.yon so so'i mgo gnas te/ /mcher pa'i gsang chung zhes bya'o/ /'di gtar sgal tshigs 'khrid la phan/ /de nas sor bzhi'i gdong —240

bdud rtsi sprin kung /g.yas na/ /yi ge ṣa yi mgo gnas te/ /sman skad mkhal ma'i rtsa nag ces/ /'di gtan lus ni ga mas padang / /rkang pa g.yas pa bshal la phan/ /'byung ba rab tu mnyam par byed/ /g.yon na she yi mjug yod do/ /chu ser rtsa nag ces bya 'o/ /'di gtang chu ser rgyas pa dang / /mje yi nad la rab tu phan/ /byin pa'i dkyil tshad g.yasapa na/ /yi ge'i k+ṣa yi mjug yod de/ /sman skad byin mjug ring po zhes/ /'di gtang mkhal ma 'grams la phan/ /g.yon na sha gnas byin mjug thung / /'di gtang sgur ba'i nad la phan/ /bol gong g.yasan ṣa yi mjug /'di gtang glang thabasand la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na k+ṣa gnasate/ /glang bu rgya gyu zhesabya 'o/ /'di gtang long nad byung na phan/ /long ma'i phyi mtshan g.yas pa na/ /yi ge kha yi mjug yod de/ /sman skad byin mjug yon po yin/ /'di gtar mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ /de bzhin g.yon na khaṃ gnasate/ /mkhal rtsa'akhrud ma zhes/bya ba/ /'di gtang sked pa 'khyag la phan/ /zha grum nad rnams kun la phan/ /'di kun lnga lnga dbugasadang ba sa/ /na sar btan pas phan pa yin/ /yi ge bzlas shing rlung gnad bstun/ /dmigs pa'i nad rnamasasreg spyong gtan/ /mkha' la rgyangs kyis song bar bsgom/ /des ni nad rnams kun la phan/ /bde skyong 'bar la'i gnad yig go /de ltar phyi nang rtsa nang gi /yi ge 'di kun bzlas pa ni/ /sbrel dang rkyang pa mgo zhabasacan/ /'di kun rnal 'thur pasashes bya/ /'bar lo re la dbang ba yi/ /rtsa yi rnam pa na ba'i tshe/ /thams cad sbrel te bzlas par bya/ /de yi g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus/ / 241—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(katshad ni ji ltar yod pa kun/ /ji skad spros bzhin shes par bya/ /de bzhin sa/ra la' 'og nasani/ /steng du mched pa'i nad byung na/ /gong gi yi ges brgyan par bya/ /de bzhin 'og tu mched pa na/ /'og gi yi ges gong mar brgyan/ /'khar lo lnga char 'khrugs pa na/ /thog ma gang nas nad langs pa'i/ /yi ge'i tshig gisasbyar nas ni/ /rlang dmigs gtems gas bzlasapar bya/ /de bzhin thad ka'i nad byung nas/ /bzlas pa dbugs dang bstun nas ni/ /grangasani nyi shu rtsa re la/ /gang na'i yi ge bzlas pa'i tshe/ /yi gesa'akhar lo khengs pa na/ /gcig la gcig thim lus gnad gzir/ /nad ni phyir sangs song bar bsam/ /de ltar yi ge bzlas pa'i tshe/ /ngag ni lcong lcong grul bum skad/ /'don zhing yan lag bskor bar bya/ /de rjes dbugs ni phyir phyung la/ /grang ba la ni dmar po yis/ /nang du bstem zhing snying la bsdu/ /tsha na dkar bas phyi la 'don/ /'di ltar lan grangasanyi shu gcig /bar du lus gnad gzir byas shing / /rlung dmigs 'jom pas nad kun grol/ /gdon rnams kun gyis glags mi rnyed/ /phyi nang yi ge rtsarlung gnad/ /thamasacad 'dir rdzogs khyad par 'phags/ /phyi nang nad rnamasagang la yang / /'thar lo lnga yi yi ge rnams/ /rtsa yi grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro yab yum mang po dang / /ba sbu'i grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo grangs med kyis/ /lusakyi phyi nang bar gsum khyab/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems des/ /lusagang nad rnamasasangs par bsam/ khyad par na sar bdud rtsi babs/ /nad de bde ba chen —242—

bdud rtsi sprin kung /por gyur/ /sems nyid don dang gnyis med bsre/ /de yang tshad pa'i nad byung na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gra'i spyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsi dkar bsil rgyun babasapas/ /lus khengasatshad nad zhi bar bsgom/ /rlang ni nang du mi gzung bar/ /phyir 'phangs phyir gzung rab tu bsngags/ /grang ba'i nad la lte ba nas/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gra'i sbyor mtshamasanas/ /bdud rtsi dmar gsal me 'bar bas/ /pho ba'i nang nas lus kun khengs/ /tshig cing rdos ba sadag par bsam/ /rlang ni nang bzung kha sbyar la/ /yi ge yid kyis bzla bar bya/ /bad kan la ni masprin pa nas/ /rin chen mkha' 'gra'i sbyor mtshamasanas/ /bdud rtsi babs pas bad kan byang / /rlung ni phyir 'don gtum mo bsgom/ /rin chen mkha' 'gra'i yi ge bzlas/ /'khrul 'khar bya zhing yan lag spyod/ /'dus pa'i nad la snying ga yi/ /rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyisakyi/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gra'i spyor mtshalas nas/ /dwangs ma babs pas lus khengs pas/ /steng 'og rlung ni kha spyor bsgom/ /de dag kun gyi grogs nyad du/ /gsang ba bde skyong 'bar lo nas/ /las gyi mkha' 'gra' rlung byung bas/ /nad gdon gtang bsregs sbyangs par bsgom/ khyad par rlung gi nad byung na/ /gsang bar mkha' 'gro nyi shu brgyad/ /spyor mtshams rlung gi dwangs ma yis/ /lus khengs bde skyong bde ba rgyas/ /mi rtog stong pa'i ngang la gzhag /'jam rlang gsang bar gzung bar bya/ /de ltar lus gnad 'byung 'khrugs na/ /rlung dmigs yi ges 'don par bya/ /sems gnad snying rlang rnam rtog 'phra/ /dgag sgrub nyon mongs skyes pa'i tshe/ /gang shar ngo bo ngos —243spyo

me po'i shul bldan la / klong snyo 4 'doms kyi gsung 'bum/()bzung la/ rang sor bzhag pas rang gis grol/ /gdod nas ma skyesagazhi rtsabral/ /ye stong ka dag chos kyi sku/ /rgya mtsho las ni rlabs bzhan du/ /sems nyid don dam rgya mtsho las/ /ye shes rba rlabs rang shar bas/ shar tsam nyid nas gzhi la thim/ /gtad med stong pa'i lam khyer bya/ /gang ltar na yang rang gi sems/ /sems ni stong pa ngos gzung med/ /na sa na mkhan gnyisasu med/ /na rgyu chasadabyings stong par grol/ /nam mkhan sems nyad ngang du thim/ /na sardul phran tsam du med/ /de ltar bltas te lam khyer bya/ /spyir na ma rig nyon mongs las/ /'byung bzhi 'khrugasate nad du gyur/ /don la gnyis med chu zla tsam/ /ngo bo ngos gzung gnyis su med/ /thams cad ro mnyam chas sku'i ngang / /snang ba sna tshogs gzigasamor che/ /de ltar mthong ba'i rnal 'thur la/ /sdug bsngal chosanyid stong par grol/ /rkyen rnamasabade chen grogs su 'char/ /me la bud shing bsnan pa bzhin/ /gang 'dug 'og min mkha' spyod yin/ /gang shar chos sku'i rol pa yin/ /gang snang rang grol gas ma yin/ /rang gzhan dge ba'i phun tshogs chu gter las/ /stong pa'i 'dab stong snying rje'i snying po can/ /gzhan phan dri bsung phyogasab ra ldang ba yis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub byed yin/ /chas tshul 'di ni zeg mchog rin chen mdzod/ /thar par 'gro ba dag gi them skasate/ /gnyisamed ye shes gdod ma'i khang bzangs su/ /kun dga'i dusaston rgya cher 'phel byed yin/ /bdag bla'i mkha' la rtogs pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /don zab 'khrug sgra snying rje'i sgog phreng can/ /phan bde'i char rgyun rab tu 'bab pa —2rmā—

bdud rtsi m+bin phung /yis/ /dad ldan skye ba'i pad mtsho gang bar shog /bdag gisalegs smon sngon sbyangs ge sar las/ /gzhan phan snying rje'i 'dab ma dkyus ring bas/ /yid mkha'i chu gter rab tu brgyan pa de/ dad ldan skye ba'i bya tshogs brten par shog /chas tshul rgya mtsho'i rgya mtsho ji srid bar/ /bde chen mchag nas mchog tu 'gro ba kun/ /thar pa gang nas gang du rab 'gro bas/ /yon tan phun tshogs phun tshogs gnyis 'grub ste/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi mkhas pa chen po mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byur pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar du ston rnams kyi tshe/ rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la bkod pa rdzogs so/ /—245

༄7/ /'chi ba brtag bslu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/'chi ba brtag baglu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral zhes bya ba/ dpal dus ngesapa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangasargyas rnamasakyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /sems can ma lus 'bar ba las sgrol phyir/ khyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phra ba/ /bde ga gas 'chi med nyi zla'i dbang po rgyal/ /'byung bzhi'i sbubs nang ye shes rig pa'i lha/ /'od lnga'i sgong na bzhugs la skye 'chi med/ /de gdangs rlung sems so sor 'bral ba'i dus/ /sha khrag sgyu ma'i phung po 'jig pa ni/ /bdag gzhan don du brtags te baglu bar bya/ /sgyu ma'i nang na mi lusasgyu ma'i mchag /gang la brten nasadon gnyis 'khrub 'gyur bas/ /legs bzung brtan pas bdag gzhan dga' bar bya/ /de la dang po 'chi ba brtag pa ni gnyis las/ /thun mong pa ni/ sen ma'i bkrag shor na zla ba dgu na nad kyis btab nas 'ching/ /mig gi mtha'i sprin dkar po yal na zla ba lnga na'o/ /ltag pa'i bdud sgo nas sgra tshom gcig gyen la langs na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na'o/ /rkang pa'i long bu phyir log tu gyur na zla gcig na'o/ /skyes bu nad kyis btab pa'i so rnams kyi rtsa bar dreg pa chags na zhag dgu na'o/ /sna zhan na zhag lnga na'o/ /rtag tu yan lag brkyang na zhag bdun na'o/ /mig 'byed 'dzum me+ed par 'khru tshugs su blta na zhag gsum na'o/ /mig gi tshigs 'khrul zhing yud tsam gyen du log log byed na zhag bco lnga na'o/ /'gram sha shong 'bur shor na zhag 'byu dgu —246—

'chi ba brtag baglu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral/na'o/ /dbugs rtsegs mar rgod na zla ba drug na'o/ /mig nas mchi ma mi thub par 'dzag na zhag lnga nado/ / /'gram pa g.yon pa shong gis song na zhag gcig na'o/ /so 'thams na zhag gsum gyi nyi ma phyed na'o/ /lce'i thog tu thig le nag po sngar med pa byung na zhag gnyisana'o/ /rna ba leb mor 'byar na nam phyed na'o/ /rtsa gnyid log med na zla ba phyed na 'chi bar nges so/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rnal 'byor pasarang gi don du brtag par bya'o/ /de yang tshe'i gzugs la brtag pa ni/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rab tu dwangs pa'i tshe/ lnga dro'am phyi dro rang gi grib ma'i snying gar mtshan ma btsugs te ma yengs bar bltas pas/ mig sbrid dus nam mkhar cher gyis bltasapa'i tshe/ rang gi gzugs ma tshang bar med par dkar lam kyis mthong na bar chad med pa'o/ /dang po chad rtags las dus brtag pa ni/ lag pa'i phyag mtshan phreng ba'am bum pa med na lo bdun na'o/ /lag pa g.yas med na lo lnga na'o/ / g.yon pa pred na gsum na'o/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i pus mo man chad med na lo gnyisana'o/ /thams cad med na zla ba brgyad na'o/ /g.yon pa med na lo gcig na'o/ /mga'i phyed g.yas sped na zla ba dgu na'o/ /g.yon med na bdun na'o/ /rke yan chad med na zla ba lnga na'o/ /rke dang ba sa pa med na gsum na'o/ phung pa'i stod me+ed na zla ba gnyisana'o/ smad med na gcig na'o/ /lus phyed g.yasamed na zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu na'o/ /g.yon sted na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na'o/ /gnyis pa dbyibs las bsgrus pas bzlog mi bzlog brtag pa ni/ tshe gzugs gru bzhir 'dug na bslus pas bzlog go /zlum po dang / nar po dang / zla gam yang bzlog pa'o/ /ro gsas pa 'dra ba dang / gru gsum ni mi bzlog pasayo —247—

mesapo'i shulab las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsud+ku 'bum/ ()byad spangasadag bya/ mi chagasapa mchag yin no/ /gsum pa kha dog las/ gdon brtag pa ni/ dkar por snang ba dbusanasayal na klu dang rgyal posaganod pa'o/ /nag por snang ba g.yasanasayal na bdud dang ma ma'/ /dmar por snang ba g.yon nasayal na btsan dang rang gi lha dang chasaskyong ngo / /ser por snang ba 'og nasayal na klu btsan dang rgyal 'gong ngo / /sngon po las rkang pa nas thung ngur yal na klu'am mtsho sman no/ /yang na ban bun du 'dug na khyad par du ma mo dang ga na rje'o/ /ser brang thring ni sabadag go khra khyug khyug ni 'che 'dre sna tshogs pa'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags so/ /yang gnam saganyis kyi 'brel thag la brtag pa ni/ nyin phyed na kha sgor bltasal gru mo pus ma'i steng du bzhag ste/ lag ngar gyen du bsgrengs pa'i khu tshur smin phrag tu ba ngasate/ mig gi zur gyisabaltasapasashin tu phra bar 'ong ste/ de nyid chad na zhag bcu dgu na'o/ / yang ri rab kyi logasal seng ge zhan pa'i mi babasasam ma babs brtag pa ni/ shar phyogs su chu'i rdzing bam/ /lteng ka yod pa'i nub ngos la rgyang ngam rtsig ngos la chu mdangs yod sar bltas pas/ grib ma zang thal gnyis brtsegs su 'ongasate/ de'i spyi ba'i steng ma med na zhag bltadrug gi nyi ma phyed na'o/ /yang mtsho'i steng du chu sprisayal lam ma yal brtag pa ni/ mtshan mo ngal dub dang /chang 'thungasapa dang / bud med dang 'grogs pa skrangasal/ nangasapar nyi ma ri rtse la shar dus snod mi dkar mi nag pa'i nang du rang gi chu btang ba la/ shar du phyogs pasabaltas pa'i tshe/ nyi zer la slangs pa sngon dmar du byung na zla ba phyed na'o/ /nag po thol thos ni zhag ba gcig na'o/ / dmar po thig le can ni zhag dgu na'o/ /gzhan ni skyon sped pa'o/ kha dog las gdon brtag pa snga ma bzhin no/ /yang sa'i grong khyer —248

'chi ba brtag brlu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral/na dge sbyong gi du ba brtag pa ni/ nyi ma rtse shar la rang gi rnam snang dor ba la bltasapas rlangs pa med na zhag dgu na'o/ /ri rab kyi rtse na mi 'gyur ba'i nyi ma nub ma nub brtag pa ni/ mig btsir bas 'od sted na zhag gsum na'o/ /ri rab kyi khong seng na mkha' 'gro'i rang sgra brtag pa ni/ seng ge ltar nyal ba'i rna ba sa la sbyar bas sgra med na zhag lnga'am bdun nam ba gcig na'o/ /dpag bsam gyi shing la bdud langasasam ma lang brtag pa ni/ ltag pa'i sgo na skra nyag bdun gyen la langs na zhag bdun na 'chi bar nges so/ /gnyis pa 'chi ba ba1 ba la gnyis las bsdoms te spyir bslu ba ni/ bla ma dkon mchag mchad cing tshogs bsag /che'i sgrub pa bya/ 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bya'o/ /de'ang rlung gi 'khar lo rtsibasabazhi mu khyud dang bcasapa'i lte ba dang / rtsibasal yam̐ lnga/ de bzhin du me la ram̐/ chu la khaṃ/ nam mkha' la e bkod pa'i mu khyud la ā li kwa yi bkod la/ so sa'i kha dog bya/ 'byung ba de dag gi lha re bskyed nasayi ge rang gi lo grangs shig lha la bstim la/ zhabar lo lnga po de paphor so ma kha sbyar du bcug la tshon skud kyis dkris pa dang / dud 'gro dang mi la sogs pa sems can rigs mi mthun pa du ma la sbrel pa'i ngar zan la mi ga gsakhru gang byas la/ mig tu ram̐/ rna bar yam̐/ sna la lo/ lte la khaṃ/ snying gar e bris la gzhug /zan nam sal rang gi glud lo grangasatsam byasal/ sa dkar sadamar la sogasapas kha bsgyur te/ nag po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang / ljang gu dang / khra bo byasal phya ba la sogs pa'i steng du bsgrigasal/ rang gi dri ma la sogs dang / gosarasadang /skra sen dang / kha sna'i chu rnamasadang / rin po che'i brdar phye/ bal tshon dang dar snas—249—

spesabo'i shul bzhagalas/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi yisung 'bum/ ()brgyan te/ ltas ga gyi bya sgro mang po btsugasal/ mdun na phar gtor ma so sa'i mdog can lo grangs dang / chang bu lo grangs tsam byas la/ ā+oṃ uhūṃ gisaso sa'i 'dod dgu 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs te/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tat+t+waṃ ut+pa te shā ra ṇa hi me ga ga na kham gis nam mkha' dang mnyam par spel nas/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i sngags kyi 'chi bdag ga na rjesagatso byas pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren rnams la bsngos te/ khyer cig khyer cig stobasaldan rnams/ /sred dang lan chags zhen pa dang / /dran dang bzung dang bsam dang rig /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /cesabarjod la/ stobar lo lnga dang bcas pa chu bo chen pa'i gzhung la bskyal bsalo gsum gyi 'chi bdag thams cad bzlog go /'di nyid lo gsum gsum na lan re bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bzlog pa ni/ bla ma'am rdo rje'i skrun bzhugs na rab/med na'ang skyes bu mchog lasabyung ba gcig gis/ 'byung ba lnga'i sa bon gyi yi gesamig la sogs pa'i dbang pa'i sgo sngar dbang bskur la/ dam tshig gi nyams chag bskang ba'i cho ga bya'o/ / de'ang sen ma'i bkrag me+ed pa la dge sgong bdun la ston mo bya/ yon dbul/ sdom pa blang ngo / /mig gi sprisam yalan tsha tsha lo grangasatsam dkar po la rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas pa byas te/ bskor ba bdun byasal chu bo chen por bskyal nas/ gom pa lo grangs byer ma log gi bar phyi mig mi blta'o/ /ltag pa'i bdud sgra langasab la/ 'byu nag pa'i zan langar glud khrug gang ba byasal/ de'i snying gar rang gi ming dang / lung thang gi rdog po lo grangasatsam bag nas/ rang gi sgras de'i sgra dang khrag byugs gos dum gyis gril la nag por byas te/ rang gi gnas—250—

'cha ba brtag bslu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral/nas goms pa brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sar dong nag po gru gsum brus par khyer te/ ri lo grangs tsam bzlas te/ bdud nag po khyod 'di khyer cig gal che'/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ dong du bsgyur te steng du rang gi brun btang nas phyi mig mi blta bar 'bros so/ /long bu log pasanyi ma nub khar kha nub tu bltas te/ gcer bur phyung la/ 'phongs su khyi gzhug btsugs te/ mdun du dri chen btang ba nasakhams re zos te/ khyi skad lan gsum du 'don no/ /yang so dreg chags pasashar du bltas la (〈a〉ra'i pagasapa gyon la ) ra'i skod lan gsum 'don no/ /sna zham pas chu sna dgu'i khrus bya zhing / sna'i rtser a dkar po bsam la/ a nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla'o/ /yan lag brkyang bskum la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus chus bkrus la/ yan lag bzhi snying dang lngar 'byung ba lnga'i sa bon gyi 'khar lo snga ma bzhin rgya skyegs kyis n+d+ras la btagasan bzlog go /mig 'khru tshugs su blta ba la/ dge 'dun dang / byis pa lo grangs tsam la ston mo bya zhing / gos dmar po rgyan no/ /'gram pa'i shong bu la sa'i las su tsha tsha lo grangs/ chu'i las su chu gtan lo grangs/ me'i las su sbyin sreg lo grangs/ rlang gi las su ba dan ljang gu lo grangasaphyar/ nam mkha'i las su e lo grangs tsam bzla'o/ /dbugasargod pas bu ram gyi lde gu la yam̐ bzlas te za'o/ /sna yo bas sna rtse hūṃ dkar po bsam zhing bzla'o/ /mchi ma 'dzag pas mig tu je bsams te bzla'o/ /'gram pa g.yon pa shong bas k+ṣe bsams shing bzla'o/ /so 'thams pasasnye bsams te bzla'o/ /lce'i thig le nag po la hūṃ bsams te bzla'o/ /rna ba 'thur pa la sum̐ bas sate bzla'o/ /rtsa gnyid log me+ed pas hūṃ bsams te bzla'o/ /brang gi snyen sna zham pas yam̐myu bsams te yi ge de dag lo grangs tsam bzlasashing / /mtshal dang dri —25/

ste po'i shulabalhagal / 1nga ོ raba'abyamasakyi gsung 'bum/ ()bzangs kyisaganas der bri'o/ /tshe gzugasakyi phyag mtshan sled pas bla ma la tshogs brgya rtsa gtong ngo / /lag pa g.yas pa med pas ngar glud khru gang ba seng ge'i mgo can kha gdangs pa gcig la/ khyim bya'i skru lo grangs tsam glan nas byang ngos kyi lam srang khar bskyal lo/ /g.yon pa med pasasre mo yi drid bur/ stag nag khra'i mche ba/ phag nag khra/ khyi nag pa'i mche ba gsum bas pa'i khar rang gi dri chus sbrus pa'i ngar zan brdzangs te chu ོ por dor ro/ /rkang pa g.yasapa'i pusamo man go med na/ nyi ma nub tu nam sros dus seng ldeng ngam rgya shug gi me rang gi lo grangs tsam gtang ngo / /g.yon pa med pas sa dkar pa'i glud khru gang byas te snyeng khar stag pa nag po sor bzhi par lo grangasakyi nyag ga byas te/ btsag byugasapa btsug nas lha khang stong par tho rangs bskyal lo/ /mga'i g.yas med pasaphung shul gyi sasna dgu dang / shing nag po'i 'bras bu sbyar te/ ga'u kha sbyar byas par rang gi skra dang / gos kyi dum bu dang / dri ma dang / khrag rnamasabs /glang ma'i byang bu bltaganyisal lo'i ming brisate/ lo re bzhin lo'i rgyal po 'di khyer cig /ces pa n+d+rasapa bas la de'i kha bcad pa'i steng du/ tsher ma rigs mi mthun pa mang po blugasal/ nam phyed na gosanag po rgyan te dur khrod du bskyal lo/ /mga'i g.yon med pas 'byu sna nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ngar zan gyi snyeng gar/ mi rta khyi gsum gyi rusapa bcug ste/ rang gi gosarnyingasapasadril te tshes ba gcig gi nam sgosadus gzhan la bskur te/ /ltor gom pa brgyad cu 'das par dong nang du bas nas/ rang gi ming nasabatan la/ lan gsum ngu ba'i tshul bstan te sba'o/ /rke yan chad med na shar ltor tsher ma can gyi hom lo grangasabyasate/ rim pasabasreg cing ram̐ lo grangs re bzlas so/ rke dang ba sapa med pas lus ro sol gyis—252—

'a ba brtag bsnyu'i man ngag nyi zla ga 'a bral/byugs la skra spyi bor ba ngas/ shog gu sor bzhi la rang gi lo dang gnam lo'i ming brisapa'i phyogs bzhir 'byung bzhi'i sa bon n+d+rasate rang gi sna la btags la tshes dgu'i nam gung la phyogs bzhir rgyug cing / kha la khyod khyer sarasmu/ tsi zhes 'brel med mang du brjod cing / shog gu de dur khrod du sba'o/ /stod med pas me bto bar lo bcu gnyisakyi ming byang bsreg go /smad med pas dur khrod du rusapa sna tshogs pa'i dud pa btang ngo / /lusakyi g.yas med na tsha tsha lo grangasabatab cing / gtsug tan lo grangs 'don no/ /g.yon me+ed pasagos dmar po gon zhing / ga ngasagra lnga lo grangasa'adon rgo/ /gnam sa'i 'brel thag chad pasagasung rab mang po 1ga cing dge rtsa grub tshad bya'o/ /seng ge mi babs pasadakyil 'khar gyi cho ga lo grangs tsam bya'o/ /dpag bsam gyi sbyon shing chag pas 'brasabu gsum dang / ra mnye ba dang / dbang lag sbyar ba'i sman mar za'o/ /rlangs pa sngon dmar gyisakhamasal lo bcu gnyis kyi gzugs byas te 'byung ba'i kha dog gisabasgyur ba re re la/ tsha tsha re re/ ngar glud re re/ stag pa'i ham re byasate nyi ma nub dus byang shar gyi dur khrod du bskyal lo/ /nag po thol thol la 'byu sna tshogasadang / lcagasazangs kyi phye ma phyogs bzhin gtan ro/ /thig le sang 'khru tsam dmar po la rang gi dri ma sbresapa'i ngar glud lo grangs tsam la gzugs mo byi thur dar dmar po tshon re btags la btsugs te rus pa sna tshogs dang lhan cig shar gyi lam po cher bskyal lo/ /dri chen gyi rlang pa me+ed pas nyi ma mdung gang dus nub tu bltas te/ rta'i skad nusatshad 'don zhing / rta'i thod pa la 'byung ba'i sa bon n+d+rasal phyar ro/ /rna ba'i 'khrug med pasasnying du yam̐ bsams te mig gyen la ldog cing /gzhan gyis gzungs chu'i khrusaspyi bo nasabya'o/ /rna ba'i rlung sgra shar shar zer bas —253—

mesabo'i shul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/ /shizas sna tshogs tshad kyi gtor ma lo grangs ba gnyis ming dang ba sa pa shing sdong chen po'i rtsar bskyal lo/ /dpag bsam gyi shing lo langs pas tshogs lo grangs tsam gtang / tshe sgrub la 'bad bas grol nges so/ de'ang sngar bas dge spyor sum log tu bya zhing sgom bzlas dang / bdud rtsi'i bas len sna tshogs dang / thig le'i rim gro la brtson pas bzlog par bya'o/ /de ltar byas nas yang snga ma bzhin blta zhing 'chi ltas baglus sam blta'o/ /de ltar lan gsum gsum thabs de rnams la 'bad pas/ zhag gi dus btang pa zla bar nur zhing / zla ba lor 'phel te lo yun ring por phyir 'khyangs pas 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa las tshe'i bgol 'debasapar byed do/ / thabasamachag tu gsang ba 'di dag ni/ slob dpon chen po shrī sing ltas skal ldan gyi don du legasapar gsungs pa nyid/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen du rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la snang bar byas pa'o/ /de ltar 'chi ba brtag baglu'i man ngag mchag /nyi zla gza' bral gsang ba'i yi ge 'di/ /o rgyan thugasasrasadri me+ed 'od zer gyis/ / gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /phyi rabs skal ldan rnamasadang 'di 'phrad de/ /'chi ba lasani slar yang bgol btab nas/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig mngon sum don bsgom zhing / /che gcig 'od lus mkha' spyod 'grub par shog / bdag kyang deng nasadagongasagater zab ma'i don/ /ji snyed ji bzhin mthong ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /blo gsal blo yi pad+mo kha phye ste/ /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog / snying nas snyeng po don mthong legs pa'i lam/ /'od gsal 'od lnga'i snang ba rgya che bas/ /skal bzang skal ldan rnams kyi don byed cing / /tshe 'dir tshe gcig sangasargyas 'grub par shog /'chi ba —254

/de ba brtag bsnyu'i man ngag nyi zla gza' bral/brtag baglu'i man ngag rin po che gsang ba'i gter mdzod nyi zla gza' bral zhes bya ba/pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis/ ston ka'i dus me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ o rgyan rdzong gi dben gnasasu bkod pa rdzogs so// // —255—

༄7/ /btags grol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin ོ shog 'dra'i skor/bakhas grol man ngag rin ོ snying po zhes bya ba/ gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chas kun ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad kun bzang rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /rig 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo /skal ldan rnams ni 'bad med grol bya'i phyir/ /bakhas grol rgyud drug chas sku'i ston pas gsungs/ /de nyid bri dang rab gnasadabang bskur dzang ///bye /re(re /spe ma pa/bye /de /sgo ma snaklag nga bzhu ba ma pa gas par bstan/ /dang pa ba ma nga shag zur nas zur du sor brgyad pa la/ gser gyi gzab mar dbu gnyisar+ya la yod pas/ bakhasagrol rnams dang 'das rjes gsum po brisate/ dar ོ gyis dril lo/ rab tu gnasapa ni/ zla ba rgyasapa'i tshe dpen zhing / sngosadaga' bar maṇ+ḍal mda' gang mthing kha dkar ser dmar ljang lnga'i mu khyud bskor la/ de'i nang du rigs lnga'i 'od kyi tshom bu lnga bris pa la so so'i kha dog gis gang bar khyams mthing gas gang / tshom bu'i mu khyud mthing dmar dkar po'i ra ba gsum gsum gyis bskor ba'i dbus su masdi'i steng du rin po che'i sgod 'khrus bkang ba spyog gi steng du bakhas grol rnams na bza' dang bcas pa gzhug /dkyil 'khar gyi mthar phyi nang gi mchod pa dang / 256

btagasagrol rgyud kyi man ngag than chen snying po/tshogs gtor bzang du bsham mo/ /de nas bgegs gtor byin la gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgras bgegs rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bsgrad la srung ba'i 'khar los mtshams ba da de/ thams cad kyi skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed byas la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum mthing ga rin po che'i rgyan can du bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug mchad bstod can zad byas la/ rigasalnga'i rtsa sngags rten 'brel snying po dang bcas pa nas bzlas pa yang sta gon du bya'o/ /de nas stong pa'i pa/ las bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'thur pa rnams 'og min gyi zhing dang pa'i ston pa dang 'khar du bsams te/ mdun gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khar 'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba rnams dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can mthing ga 'khar lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ byang chub mchag gi khyag rgyas bzung ba'i/ shar du mi bskyod par dkar po bdud 'dul gyis rdo rje dang / ltor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mtshog sbyin gyis ut+pa la dang / nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyis pad+ma dang / byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyis rgya gram 'dzin pa/ so so'i yum dang ba sa pa bskyed la/'od zer gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar bar btags grol de nyid bsam mo de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs dang ba sa te/ hūṃ ma lus semasacan kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /ba ma ldan rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas ga gas/ zhes pas 'og min nas rigs—257—

mesabo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()lnga'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byen pa la/ me tog bdug sbos snang gsal dri/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ bde gshegs ma lus 'bar bcas mchad/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ༷dza dh+ra pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi t+ya shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ ye nas 'od gsal chos sku dag pa ༄las/ /sna tshogs gzugasasku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od can/ /bla ma yi dam rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra pra we sha hos/ btagasagrol lha'i skur gsal ba la/ gnyis su med par thim yang phyogs ba 'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbang bskur/ yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rgyas btang la/ sngar gyi bzlas pa'i me tag gisagator zhing / rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags rten 'brel snying po dang ba sa pa brgya rtsa brgyad brjod nas/ 'khru dang / sman dang rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul te/ sagazhi spos kyis byugs shing me tag bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyasazhing du dmigs te 4la ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ zhesapa dang / me tag la sogasapa phyi nang gi mchod pas mchad la/ bla ma dang rigs lnga'i bstod pa rgyas par byas te/ me tog gis snyims pa bkang la masprin gcig tu/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i sangs rgyasasras dang ba sa pa dang / bla ma dang 258—

ba7sagrol rgyud kyi lo ngag rin za snying po/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ ces pa gsum dang /rgyud dang 'das rjes rnams tshar gcig brjod pa'am/ rgyud kyi snying po tshar bdun brjod la/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas bkra shis brjod par bsam la/ me tag 'thor/ rol mo sgogs shing mgrin gcig tu/ bde ba gas mi 'gyur sku lnga lhun gyis sdodab/ /ye shes lnga ldan phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /gdod ma'i mgon po rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir phun tshogs shog /'og min ye shes bde chen rgya mtsho'i zhing //rgyal ba rgya mtsho dpag med tshogs mnga' bas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang bde legs shadag /bde chen rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'gro ba'i yab/ /rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun kyis grub/ /so sa'i sku dang ye shes phun tshogs pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa desakyang bde legs shog /dga' rab rdo rje shrī sidha dang / /o rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor bcas/ /dngos grub sna tshogs 'bar ba'i sprin 'phra ba'i/ /bkra shisadam pa des kyang bde legs shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma py-isnasdu kaupa ṭ+wāṃ/kra/ shāsdu ༷ t+t+waṃ daso ṭ+wāṃrdo rjo sa/ t+t+waṃs rngo rgyadh+ri rjo shā shā rīrdo 'irte rdo/ —259—

me po'i shulabazhagalas/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//dathams cad grol te/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la gnasapar bsam zhing / ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā lhas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rab 'byams rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur te/ skal ldan de'i gnas lngar/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīlaḥlnga bsam pa lasa'od 'phras/ bdag dang snang srid yi ge dag tu bsamasashing / ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ zhes pa la sogs brgya rtsa re brjod nas snang srid longs sku'i zhing du bsams la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /'khar 'das snang srid rang gi sems/ /gdod nas ma skyesartsa ba bral/ /stong gsal rig stong chasakyi sku/ /gang shar rang grol sgrul mdud bzhin/ /spangs blang gnyisamed shesapar gyis/ /zhes ngo sprad la/ yang / e ma skal ldan snying gi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i khams su ltos/ /snang ba sna tshogs 'od gsal zhing / /thig le dbyings dang lu gu rgyud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang chen dbang / /don gyi snying po 'di nyid do/ /zhes pas mngan sum ngo sprad do/ khyud kyi glegs bam la/ maṇ+ḍal tshan pa gsum phul nas/ sgob ma'i spyo bor ā+oṃ bsams la rgyud der bzhag pas/ rgyud las 'od zer byung ba'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsamasal/ sangs rgyas thamasacad kyi sras gcig pos ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /smin par mdzad du gsol lo/ grol bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /gang bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /sku rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du —260—

btagasagrol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snyeng po/gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha kā ya a bhi khiñtsa ā+oṃ/ zhes brjod nas mgrin par tshig de rnams brjod cing khyad par du gsung rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha kā ya wāk+ka a bhe ḍiñtsa āḥ zhes pa dang snying gar tshig snga ma bzhin brjod cing / khyad par du thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ gha dzha dharma kwa ya tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ zhesabarjod nas spyi bo'am/ snying ga'am/ mchan khung gang drang du gdags so/ /rjes ni tshogasakyi dga' ba rgya chen po bya'o/ /de nasaklog pa ni/ dusam yin pa'i sgra dang / sad dang / ser ba dang / 'khrug dang / sa g.yo ba dang / 'ja' 'od dang / nyi zla gzasazin pa dang / mu ge dang / nad la sogs pa'i mtshan ma byung dus/ steng dang / 'og dang / phyogasabazhi gang du byung ba brtagasal/ steng 'og tu byung na/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsgoms pa'i lce 'khar lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad par bsam/ nyi zla gzas zin pa de nyid la sogs pa'i rtags mtshan yang kun bzang yab yum du bsams te/ rgyud drug 'das rjes dang ba sa pa tshang gsum mam lnga'am bdun nam/ brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ gnod pa'i mtshan ma thamasacad zhi zhing / 'jig rten thams cad bde legs phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /rjes la snang srid rigs lnga'i zhing du bsam ste bsngo ba bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar dang shar ltor byung na/ bdag dang mtshan rtagasade nyid/ mi bskyod pa yab yum du bsam pa'i rang gi lce rdo rjer bas sa la/ zhing khams mngon dgar mos pa bya'o/ /lto dang lho nub la —261—

mesabo'i shulabazhag las/ kloju chan rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(karang dang mtshan rtags rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bsams pa'i lce rin po cher bsams la/ zhing khams dpal dang ldan par mos pa bya'o/ /nub dang nub byang la 'od dpag med yab yum gyi lce pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhing khams bde ba can no/ /byang dang byang shar la don yod grub yab yum gyi lce ral sprir bsams la/ yul de las rab grub pa'i 'jig rten du bsams la brjod do/ /de'ang mtshan ma gang byung gi phyogs der kha bltas la 1ga par bya'o/ de'ang mtshan ma de dag 'gro ba gang gis mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / reg pa thams cad sprul pa'i skur sangasargya'o/ /de nasaskal ldan de'am/ gzhan yang rung sde 'das pa'i tshe snying gar btags nasabasregs pas bar dor sangs rgya'o/ /de yang sku thob pa'i rtags su spur khang gi dbus su 'ja' 'khyil ba'am/ dud pa sngon po gyen la 'greng ba'am/g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / me'i 'od dkar gsal 'khar lo la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnams pa 'byung ngo / /gdung sha rī ram ser po dang / chu rī ram dkar po dang / ba rī ram dmar po dang / nya rī ram ljang gu dang / pañtsa ma mazing ga la kha dog lnga ldan te rigs lnga'i gdung dang / sku 'byung ngo / /gsung gi rtags su 'od khyim gyen 'greng dang / sgra 'ur ba dang / thug pa dang sa g.yo ba'o/ /thugs kyi rtags su nam mkha' sprin med cing dwangs la gsal ba dang /'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga'i snang ba dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang yi ge dang / sku dang / ring bsrel du ma 'byung ngo / /phan yon ni btags grol snying pa'i rgyud las/ e ma 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /dbang po rnam lnga 'on —262—

btanasagrol rgyud kyi man ngag rin chen snying po/gyur cing / /rgan gzhan pho mo dge sdig med/ /bag chags bzang ngan med pa sa /'di nyid ba ngas pas 'tshang rgya'o/ /tha ma dbugs la slebasakyang grol/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'dzin sras gcig yin/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dus gnad nges pa las/ 'di nyid ba ngas pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur pa las/ /the tshom bya bar ci zhig dgos/ /gal te phyol song mgul du 'di/ /btags pa tsam gyis de grol nas/ /'gro ba mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /e ma rang byung yi ge 'dis/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed na/ /tshe 'das de yi spyi bo'am/ /mgul du 'di btags bsreg na ni/ /'di nyid grol bar smos ci 'tshal/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pa yang / /nyan thos rnams dang skal ba mnyam/ /lung du ma bstan skye bo rnams/ /byang chub bsams dpa'i sa dang mnyam/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' yang / /rdo rje 'cha dang mnyam par nges/ /'di nyid bcangs pa'i skyes bu de/ /gang na 'dug pa'i yul phyogasatsam/ /ngan song dag nas grol bar 'gyur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob/ /rig pa dngos kyi rtags yod pa'i/ /skal ldan de la bsreg mi dgos/ /'chi khar 'phrad pasa'agyur ba yin/ /zhes pa la sogasadapag tu med pa gsungs so/ /e ma ho/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs las/ /bcangs pa tsam gyis grol ba'i man ngag 'di/ /skal ldan rnams dang rab tu 'phrad nas kyang / /lhun grub sa la kun tu bzang por shog /o rgyan thugs sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /o rgyan zab chas mkha' 'gro snying tig las/ /o rgyan dgongs don ji bzhin —263—

me bo'i shul bas lag klong ོ 4 gomasakyi gsung tshom/()bshad pa 'di/ /o rgyan rdzong du phyi rabs don du bkod/ /bakhas grol man ngag rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal kyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / —2yo—

ra༅/ /sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma bzhugs so/ /shog skya'i skor/sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ dpal snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugasarje'i me 'od ye shes 'od 'phra bas/ /'gro kun sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud sde rdzogs pa rang byung las/ /tshe 'das 4nga po bsreg ste sgrib sbyong don/ /ma nor ji bzhin gsal ba'i rim pa yis/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis legs par bstan/ /de bzhin ga gsapa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khar du/ /ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba la/ sngon 'gro sta gon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi ji ltar sbyang ba/rjesarus bu bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po la thab rtsig pa/ ro chasa'ajug pa/mchad rdzasabasham pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sa'i stegs 'dom do la sogs pa ji ltar 'osapa byas la/ be+eg chen bzhi btab pa'i dbus su/ me spyor sa tsho1detshor /kye sa sna /bye /te shā) sa snakhang gru bzha pa/ ra nyad khru skar sa rmang ba nga pa nang du zlum skar gsum bris pa'i nang ma la rigs lnga yab yum gyi mtshan ma pad 'dab bzhi'i dbus su spyor lo/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram rnams bris/ gnyis pa la sems dpa' sems ma yab yum brgyad kyi/thig le gnyis brtsegs pa kha dog dang mthun pa brgyad bya/ gsum pa la sgo ba yab yum gyi mtshan ma dgod/ zur bzhin zla byed rdo rje re bri/ nang ma'i mu —265—

me po'i shul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'doms kyi gsu— 'bum/ (kakhyud bzhi mthing ga /bar pa dmar/ phyi ma dkar pos bkang / ye shes kyi mu khyud lnga ldan phyi ma la bskor/ de nyid ras la sogs pas bkab nas/ sngar gyi 'phro gyen la rtse khru gang dang mdzub gang rtsigs la/ shing shug pa brla bas mi phra ba/ rtse khrur re thab kyi nang du bslang la drang por gshabs de khengs par dgang / phyogs bzhi'i gseng phug sa thang mtshams la gyen du mkhyid re yod pa'i phyogs su/ shing gi khong seng / dpal 'bar 'dzugs yod pa re bya/mdun gyi bug pa de shing bcug pas shong bar byas la so phag la sogs pas phyi nas gcad/ rtse khru gang gi gong na mdzub gang yod sa bug pa cig byas/yam shing phra mos zang zing du dgang / de'i steng nas ro khang khru gang pa zlum po'am gru bzhi par brtsig go /gnyis pa ni rang drung du mchod pa bshams la/bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum du bskyed la/ mchod bstod byas nas bum par bzlas pa bya/ ro la bsang chu gtor nas/ me tag phog pa'i lhar bskyed te/ rnam shes bkug la bgegs bsgrad sdig pa sbyang / gzungs sngags kyi bum chusabakru zhang / phar phyin drug dang chu bo bzhi la sogs pa'i tshig ba da brjod nas/ ā+oṃ sarba be+ed badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ gis/ rdo rje khu tshur dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags tshan pa gsum bris pa'i gcig spyi bo/ gcig mgrin pa gcig snying khar btags la mchod bstod bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dbang bskur nas lam bstan lam sbyong byas na'ang shin tu legs shing / ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas ro khang du ba ga ste/ rol mo'i sgras bgegs bsgrad la/ shing sgom mam dur khang rgya —266

sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma/byubs ma byed na steng nas bkab/ med na bre'i gzugs gru bzhi pa/ cung zad yangs pa gshig gam/ dang ma'i zhabs mtho gang phug pa bkab/ phyi nasadu ba mi 'chor bar dres mas bcings la zhal ba bya'o/ /gsum pa ni mchad pa mdun/ sreg rdzas g.yas/ gtang ma g.yon du bsham mo/ /de'ang mchad pa ni/ mchod yon la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams so/ /sreg rdzas ni yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa mang po dang / mar dang / til dang / yungs kar dang / zho zan dang 'brasal sogs pa 'khru sna tshogs dang / ra'i 'o ma'o/ /de rnams kyi yam shing dang mar ma gtags pa sgod gcig tu bsres pa'am/ so sor bya'o/ gtor ma ni 'jig rten lasa'adas pa'i gcag /mkha' 'gra'i gcig /chos skyong gi gcig /me lha/ bzhi bdag /rigasadrug /bgegs gtor dang bdun no/ /gnyisapa dngosagazhi la/ bdag bskyed pa/ mdun bskyed pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ srungasa'abar sngon du 'gro bas kun bzang du bskyed la/ ye shes pa bcug /dbang bskur mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag mchog la dz+wa la'i sngags tsam gyisame sbar/ phal pa la/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigasalnga'i me sbar ro/ /'byung ba /zhe zur /shi sa sna /de/sku(3 da sna /tsho zur bzhib ya bud nga la/ /lha ma ba sbar ra/ /dbang pa drug ga bud nga la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro/ /yul rnams drug gi bud shing la/ /lha mo drug gi me sbar ro/ /d+ku mongasalnga yi bud shing la/ /ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba sku gsum me 267—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'brumasakyi gsung 'a ma//shisbar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis 'grub par shog /ā+oṃ badz+wa dz+wa la ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas mdun ngos kyi gseng nas me sbar la/ bsang chu gtor nas thab dang mchod gtor sreg rdzas dang bcasapa bsangs nas/ su bha was stong par sbyangs la/ so sa'i sngags kyis byin gyisabarlabs te/ ā+oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/rin po che'i thabs yangs shing rgya che ba/ sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbus su ra skyes kyi steng na ram̐ las me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang po pad+ma/ gnyis pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ g.yon dang po dbyeg pa/ gnyisapa ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /de nasadabyug gu'i phyag rgyasardo rje dril bu dang dbyangasakyis/ ā+oṃ tshur byen tshur phyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang sgong bram ze mchog /sreg blugasazhal zasabazhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjed chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thamasacad sgrub pa po/ /thugasarjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugasasu gsol/ /ā+oṃ asne ye ma hā te dza e h+ya hi sa ma ye dzaX dzaḥ/ zhes pas shar lho nas me lha 'khar dang ba sa pa spyan drangs la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs thab kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la bstims nas/ ā+oṃ asne ye pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul nas ku sha thobasate/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyesapa'i snying po mchag /tshangs pa'i lha yang dag pa ste/ /dkon mchag gsum gyis dag byed yin/ /de yisabadag cag 'khar ba sa la/ /bgegasarnams med cing zhi bar mdzod/ /cesapas rtse ma nyamasapar dgram mo/ /de nas/ ā+oṃ —268—

sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma/asne ye swāhās mar blugs gzar bdun bdun gyis bkang pa'i dgang blugs kha sbyar ba gsum dbul zhing / ā+oṃ asne ye di bya di bya bi shukhye mahā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya che ge mo'i sdog pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swāhās byon zan phul nas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /drang sgong stobar dang ṣ+ṭhas la la la/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ asne ye ma hā te dza ar+ghaṃ pra twets+tsha byu tsa me gha sa mu tra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa nas rol mo'i bar phul la/ sreg rdzas rnams kyi mar dang yam shing so sor 'bul/ gzhan ma rnams bsres la/ ā+oṃ asne ye che ge ma'i sdig pa/ sarba pā paṃ sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pas nyi shu rtsa gcig re grangs byas la dbul/ de'ang rgyas par byed na sreg rdzas rnams so sor dbul te/ ā+oṃ sto dhi n+d+rak+ṣa ye swāhās yam shing dang / asne yesamar/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hās til/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sid dha ye swā hās nyung dkar/ ā+oṃ sarba saṃ bha de swā hās zho zan dang / 'bras la sogs pa so sor 'a la lo/ /'og ma rnams la'ang tshul 'dis shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pas mchad la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangasadabang mchag gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā gis dbang bskur bas/ khes rab mchog gis nyan mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon pa'i sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang sgong mchag /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags sgrub pa'i drang sgong tshul/ /nyan mongs bsreg pa'i shesarab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi —269—

mes po'i shul bas la / klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/()brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'khrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas khyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyesakyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mtshod cing bstod nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod cing bstod pa ni/ lha rnams spyan drangs la gang zag mchog la ro dang lha rnams dbyer med la mchod bstod bya zhing / phal pa la lha bskyed pa la sreg rdzas dang / ro'i sha khrag rus pa rnams bdud rtsir bsams la 'a la lo/ /de'ang rgyas pa la dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim la/ bsdus pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ me lha'i lto bar bzhugs par bsams la mchod pa'o/ /de yang thog mar me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bar khro bo rta masprin yab yum du bskyed la/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang ga na rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnod dgra 'dul ba'i/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchad kyisagashegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu sa ma ya dzaḥs sbyan drangs pa bstem la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu/ ar+ghaṃ/ pa h+ye/ pulga dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ ghasmre/ nai wi te/ shabha ā hūṃ —270—
