sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma/gis mchod nas/ dbang chen bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /'jigs byed chen po ral pa gyen du brdzes/ khro la' rgyan rnams ma lusarab rdzogs pa'i/ khro rgyal rta mchag dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i rjes la sngags de nyid la/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/btags la/ sreg rdzas rim pas brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul ba'i rjes la/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcasami bzad 'dzoms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pas/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum po gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ā+oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ bhu rtswa dharmā saṃ gha sa ma ya dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa khro bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgol zhang / /gcig tu don dam mchag gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhesapas bstod nas/ na mo rat+na tra yu ya brnya dharmā saṃ gha bh+yo/ che ge ma'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ khro ba'i lto bar zhi kha'i dkyil 'khar bskyed la/ spyan drangs te bstim nas/ mchad bstod rgyas par byas la/ rnam snang gi rtsa sngags ming —271—

me bo'i shulasazhag las/ klong 7 rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()spel dang ba sa pa stong ngam 'bum/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi sngags rnamasakyis brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa yang rgyas par byas te/ slar yang khro bo rta mgrin la/ sngar gyi tshul de nyid kyisabargya stong grangs med pa phul la/ mchod bstod byas te bgegs zhi bar gsol ba btang nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la gtang rag gi mchad cing bstod nas/ /bzod par gsol te/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs spyan drangs pa rim pa bzhin gshegs nas/ dam tshig pa bsdu la yang me lha'i lto bar mkha' 'gro chos skyong yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa rim par spyan drangasate/ rang rang gi sngags sam/ ā+oṃ a kwa ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde a du nud pan na twa ta ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces sreg rdzas phul la gtan ma yang phul te/ phrin lasab la nasagashegs su gsol la/ slar yang me lha gsal btang nas/ sreg rdzasalhag ma ci 'byar ba bdun la sogs pa phul te/ mchod pa dang gtor ma phul nas phrin lasabacal te/ bstod pa byas nas/ bdag gi (〈a〉don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyis bzhung cig byin za khyod/ /rang gnas dge bar ga gas nas kyang / /slar yang dus bzhin ci nas phyon/ /bdag gi zhes me lha'i phyag rgya bkrol la/ 'byung dgosapa thamasacad mdzod/ /ā+oṃ asne ye gaṭ+wā) /po thamasacad pa'i gtang ma byin nas bsngo ba byas te/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gisabadag nyid bsrungs nas/ gson po don du bkra shis brjod la yon phul dga' ston bya'o/ /gsum pa ni me rnamasazhi ba'i tshe/ bdag bskyed mdor bsdus pas lag pa gnyis dpung par bsgol te se gol gtogs shing /—272—

sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma/ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rus bu bsdus la/ bum chus bkru zhing sdig sgrib dag par bsam la/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags spel drig dang ba sapa brjod nas/ mchod de gshegs su gsol lo/ de ltar tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs/ /ji ltar rgyud las gsungs bzhin sbyar ba yis/ /dge ba dri med ston ka'i zla 'dra des/ /'gro kun rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /tshul 'di rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas mchag tu/ /rin chen shog skya'i ngosal legs par bkod/ /sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //bha wan+tu/—273—

ra༅/ /ga.a phan 'od kyi 'khar lo bzhugs so/ /rin ོ shog dkar gyi skor/gzhan phan 'od kyi 'bar lo zhes bya ba/ ston pa 4na sum tshogs pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen rab sprin tshogs mdzad pa'i 1ga gi phreng ba can/ /thugs rje'i 'khrug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab phan bde'i char rgyun legasa'abebs pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum de skye dgu'i mkha' la mjesapa yi/ /bdag gzhan gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod yun ring bkra shis byed par shog /gang 'dir bdag bla'i yid kyi pad+ma la/ /byin rlabs nyin byed zer gyis phog pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis sgrub la 'dab stong rgyas/ /de slad gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khar lor spyod/ /de'ang 'dir snying po'i rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung gi rjes su lngongs nas tshe 'das rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga brjod par bya'o/ /'di la nub dang po bya ba'i rim pa dang / lhag ma rnams su bya ba'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la sa'i cho ga dang / sngon 'gro legasapar bsham pa dang / me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khar dngos ji ltar mchad pa gsum las/dang po ni sa'i cho ga bsang sbyangs dgos pa'i phyogs su/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru shādri shā) /zhi13 95/rnyi/skye :drozurashāje (pegang pa ba byung dang / bsabyug pa dbus sdo / ā tha sa 'a ga dang / me r+sā gi tshom bu bkod la/ de'i drung du chu gnyisasngon du 'gro ba'i mchad pa lnga dang gtor ma gsum bshams la/ rang nyid skyabs su 'gro ba —274—

gagan phan 'od kyi 'khar lo/dang sems bskyed nas/ skad cig gis kun bzang yab yum du bsgomasate/a n+d+ra tas bsang zhing / swābhā wasasbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang lasatshom bu nyid/pa da zla'i steng du paṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin par bskyed nas/lha mo chen mo sa bdag 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen rdzogs dbang mchog gi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra sgogs semasadapasamachad/ /mchod yon 'di bzhes 'di ru byin rlab mdzod/ /ā+oṃ dṛ thi de wī sa ma ya dza ༷dza ༷zhes pas sa bon las 'od 'phras/ sa'i 'og nas lha ma sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis bslabs nas/ dri med yid 'ong bdud rtsi yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchad yon 'di/ /lha mo la ni bdag 'bul gyis/ /sa 'di bdag la gnang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ pri gi dhe lbi ar+ghaṃ pra ti tsa ye swāhā/ tshag des mchad pa lhag ma rnams kyang mchad nas/ skyob pa sangs rgyasathams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ yākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde ba ma pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khar pri/ /bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mo zhes bya bas/ che ge ma'i don du sa phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khar chen po bzheng gis/ lha mo khyod kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzod cig /ces brjod pas des kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar byosashig /ces gsungasabar bsams la/ gtang ma dang po de lha mo 'khar ba sa la 'bul/ gnyis pa de dkar pa'i phyogs la byin nas/—275—

mesabo'i shulabazhagalas/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/(ka/degang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis slong bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khar don du stsal du gsol/ /dkyil stobar chen po'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ gsum pa de nag pa'i phyogs la byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir ni sgob dpon bdag /dkyil zhabar rgyal po sgyu 'khrul ni/ /bzheng gis sa 'dir gnas pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /ā+oṃ sum bha ni dang gu gul gyis bdug la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs lha mo 'khar bcas ga gas par bsams te/ /gyo mo dang rus pa la sogs dor nas/ /samanyen bzang po la stegs bu gru bzhi pa me long gi ngos ltar 'jam zhing snyoms pa/ shar dang byang cung zad gzhol pa'i/ steng dang khor yul tu lag mthil g.yas bskor zhing / /ā+oṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyisa'od zer byung bas ma dag pa sbyangs/ ā+oṃ bhu khang gis sa phyogasathams cad nam mkhar gyur/ ā+oṃ me de ni badz+ra bha bhan+ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyisardo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa phaṭa kyis bsrung zhing brtan par bya'o/ /sa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa ni srad bu dkyil 'khor nyisa'agyur du byas pa'i sna sgob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas shar du bltas la/ slob ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis nub tu bltas te/ dza zhesabarjod cing gtad nas tshangs thig la sogs pa gdab cing / cha chen bcu drug rdzogs pa na/ /dang po byed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /gnyis pa cha bzhir bgo byas te/ /gsum pa bzhi pa mi gdab bzhag /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyisagadab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /bdun pa cha bzhir bgo byas te/ /—276—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ de'ang dbang chog ltar ye shesakyi zig gdab pa'ang byas na legs so/ /de nas lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar mchod gtor bsham mo/ /gsum pa ni bdag nyid bskyed cing mchod bstod byas te/ dkyil 'bar sgrub cing mchod bstod byasapa'i rjes/ ho dgongs su gsol/ rgyal ba rigasalnga yab yum khor dang ba sa/ /sems dpa' sems ma ma lusabadag la dgongs/ /rgyal ba sras ba sa mchod pa dang / /tshe 'das khyod kyi rjes gzhug phyir/ /bdag ni che ge zhes bgyi bas/ /nangasapar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khar bri/ khyed kyi thugs rjesadagongs mdzod la/ /byin gyisabarlab par mdzad du gsol/ /cesamakhyen par gsol bas/ gtso ba'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyisasems can gyi don du dkyil 'bar chen po'i las rtsoms shig /gsungs par bsam nas/gtor ma bsngos/ bzod par gsol/ bsngo ba byas/ bdag nyid bsrungs nas/ sang me tog tshom bu'i lha rnams la/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/badz+ra mus ye shes pa dkyil 'khar gyi nam mkhar bteg nas dam tshig pa bsdus te/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing tshom bu dang mchod pa rnams re zhig dben par bsdu'o/ /gnyisapa nub lhag mar bya ba'i rim pa la/ dkyil 'bar bri zhing sku legs par bsham pa dang / cho ga dngos ji ltar bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshon rnamasadabus dang phyogs bzhin rigasalnga'i kha dog bzhin bkod la/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.aḥrnamasan+d+ras te/ rigasalngar bskyed nas ye shes pa bcug /mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i —277—

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum//da tshon ye shes lngar bsams la/ slob dpon gyis shar nas tshon thogs te/sangs rgyas rigs lnga yi shes gtso/ /kun gyi don rig bya ba'i phyir/ /ye shes lnga yi tshon dgye 'o/ /zhes pasare khā bri'o/ /de'i tshon gyis bri ba ni/ /dbus su 'dab brgyad mu khyud gsum/ /dbus mthing shar dkar lho ser zhing / /nub dmar byang ljang shar lto dmar/ /lto nub ljang gu nub byang dkar/ /byang shar ser pos dgang bar bya/ /mu khyud mthing dmar dkar pos bskor/ /gru dang lha snam phyogs mdog la/ /phyogs mtshams thig le gnyis gnyis dgod/ /sgo bzhir thig le re re bya/ /rtsig pa lnga ni nang rim bzhin/ /mthing ga ljang dmar ser dang dkar/ /'dod yon dmar la pha gu ser/ /dra byed sngo la mda' yab dmar/ /pu shu mdze+es tshon zhing khams ljang / /rta babs mjes tshon chu srin dmar/ /rdo rje'i rwa ni phyogs kyi mdog /nyi zla dmar dkar dur khrod brgyad/ /phyogs mtshams pad+ma sna tshogs mdog /rdo rje mthing la me ri dmar/ /yang na ye shes rnam lnga'i mdog /srab mthug med cing snyomasapar bri/ /de dag gi khor yug kun tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang /bdud rtsi sman rag la sogs pa nang mchod rnams legs par bshams/bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings ldan pa gnyis kyang sman dang 'khru dang chus bkang la bzhag /sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis dang / gzhan lnga yang bshams/bye ma sol phor/ ting lo mangs bu la sogs pa 'dir dgos pa rnams tshogasapar byas la/ yol ba bla bre n+d+ras sku la sogs pa'ang dgram mo/ /gnyis pa ni/thams cad kyi spyod lam bstun la thog mar mchod pa bsang sbyangasani/ ku —278—

gas phan 'od kyi lasar lo/shas bsang chu gtang nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ/pāñtsiḥ puṅge dhu pe/ ā le ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai li te/ shak+ta ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ yongs su gyur pa las phyi nang gi mchod pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pas sa dang bar snang kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin 4nga lta bus gang bar gyur/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'/ /chas la skyabs su mchi'/ /dge 'dun la skyabasasu mchi'o/ /ba ma ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'thums kyi lha tshogs zhabar dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'/ /chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje/ de dag thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcam ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'thums kyi dkyil 'bar chen po bsgom/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /dga' ba chen po dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /ā+oṃ swā bhā wa bi shukhye sarba dharmā su bhā wa bi shud+dha ྅ha/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po/ stong pa'i ngang lasapaṃ las pad+ma/ a lasazla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil zhabar gyi steng du/ gyilas 'od 'phras/ semasacan gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug tho dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i pang na/—279—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'grums kyi gsung la ma//shirdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang rus pa dang thod pa'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan pa/spyan gsum pa khro bo'i lta stangs chen pos bskal ba'i me ri me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ rtsa ba mgrin par zug cing lo 'dab lkog mar rgyas pa'i mdun gyi 'dab ma'i lce'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil zhabar gyi dbus su/ hūṃ lasardo rje dkar po nyal thabs su gnasapa 'od du zhu zla ba la thim/ de 'od du zhu lce la thim pas rdo rje'i lcer gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dzi hā lag pa'i mazil gnyisasu a a lasazla ba'i dkyil gabar re re'i dbus su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du 'greng ba re re 'od du zhu ba las zla ba la thim/ zla ba zhu ba lag pa la thim pas rdo rje'i lag par gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri me kung 'bar ba'i dal chen por gyur/ hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro ma'i sku/ /badz+ra sing ha seng ge'i gdong / /badz+ra bya kri stag gdong ma/ /mthing nag mdza cha me 'od 'phro/ /gti mug dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /steng 'og dgra bgegasamatshamasachad cig /hūṃ rab 'jigasaphra men khro ma'i sku/ /kang ka mu kha bya rog gdong / /dkar gsal mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /zhe sdang dbang bsgyur lasamakhan ma/ shar sga'i dgra bgegasamatshamasachad cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro ma'i sku/ khu lu mu kha 'ug gdong ma/ /ljang nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phra/ /phrag dog dbang bsgyur las mkhan la/ /byang sga'i dgra —280—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/bgegs mtshams chod cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku/ yā na mu kha khyi gdong ma/ /dmar nag marja cha me 'od 'phra/ /'dod chags dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /nub sga'i dgra bgegs mtshams chad cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khra'i mo'i sku/ /su ra ka seng phag gdong ma/ /ser nag mo cha me 'od 'phra/ /nga rgyal dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /lto ba'i dgra bsho sa tsho /bye sa dres /de /sri sa /bye /bye sa ba gas mnasas 'ad ga /ā bha bha hūṃ/ /cas t+ta t+na hūṃ/ cas ṣ+ṭṛṇ+ḍa pa ya ṣ+ṭṛt+na pa ya hūṃ/ ā+oṃ a na ya ho/ bha ga wan bibya ra tsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje me ri'i rwa ba gnyis pas 'bar bar gyur/ hūṃ ye shes bskal ba me ltar bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsregs/ /zhe sdang ga na rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo r+ṣa po dpa' mo stag lngags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du sbyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchad kyis gshegs su gsol/ /steng gi nam mkhar khro bo dbang chen dpag tu med pa byon/ /ā+oṃ ma hā ko ta sa pā ri wā ra/ /ar+ghaṃ pa h+ye ༷dza ju paṃ ā lo ke ghadhe ni wi t+ya shabha āḥhūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos bdag la gnyis su med par thim /hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing/ /thamasal mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'khru ga —28/—

mesabo'i shulabaldan las/ klong chen rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum/(kastong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma rungs dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nasa'ajoms mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 1nga dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyisasdang mig gis/ /bgegasadapung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ gas chen dusamatha'i me ltar gzi brjed 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam ba'i nga ro 'khrug sgra stong sgogs shing / /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ dbang chen bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjed 'bar/ /dbu sgra kham ser sbyan gsum sdang mig bgrad/ /mche ba gtsigs shing brkyang bskum 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dpal chen yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ nyon cig bgegasadang log 'dren tshogs/ /lusangag yid gsum gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar chad 'byung po thamasacad kun/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /nga ni dpal chen rta masprin rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /nga yi bka' lasa'adasagyur na/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur/ ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra ha ya gh+ri wa ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa rak+ṣa u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i mthar byer nas/ ye shes kyi me phung gcig tu 'bar bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ras twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sarba sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi rdo me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ u nu rak+to —282—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yaṭ+wā sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shri yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me mulca badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sam ya sa twa ā/ ā+oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swā bhā wa bi shud+dha ྅haṃ/ phyi nang gi chasathams cad stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ ram̐lasanyi ma'i dkyil 'khar gyi steng du/ hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phras/ semasacan gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rang bzhin gzhi'i kun tu bzang po/ mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsgol ba/ e las chos nyid kun tu bzang mo sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa gnyis ka'ang rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/ rdo rje sngon pa'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i rwa lnga la/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.aḥs mtshan pa'i phyi rol du ā li bcu drug dang / kā li rnams mar me'i phreng ba ltar 'od gsal ba'o/ /lag pa'i mthil gnyis su a hūṃ/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khar re re'i steng du hūṃ/ hūṃ gis mtha' skor gnyisan phar/ a ā/ i yī/u lū/ ṛ dṛ/ '-i lī/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ mchag tu dkar zhing 'od gsal ba rnams kyis gang bar gyur/ sor mo rnams la a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal g.yas pa'i sor mo la zla ba'i dkyil 'bar gyi steng / rigs lnga yab kyi sa bon rim ba bzhin du/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī ༷a las rnam par snang mdzad/ mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rdo rje dbyingasakyi dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje —283—

me po'i shul bas la / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'a ma/()rkun mo rnams/ phan tshun lha dang lha ma'i rang bzhin/ sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa 'dra'o/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī āḥ e ram̐ lam̐ haṃ ye/ lha rnams phan tshun dgyesashing snyoms par zhugs par gyur/ hūṃ kun tu bzang po bde gshegs rigasalnga'i gtso/ /ye shes mchog gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas thugs rje'i rnam 'khrul gyis/ /yab yum 'khar dang ba sapa gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes pa steng gi nam mkhar byon pa la/ ā+oṃ phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yis/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'thums rgya mtsho rnams/ /ma lus blo yisablangs te gus 'a la gyis/ /thugs rjesatshe 'dasadon du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta skru tsa me gha sa mu dra sla ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ ngang nyid chas kyi dbyings lasam g.yosakyang / /thugasarje'i rnam 'khrul sna stogs ston mdzad cing / /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ has bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ ā+oṃ uhūṃ gis sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyisabs / ā+oṃ 25 a bhi ṣañtsa ā+oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi khiñtsa t+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ/ ā+oṃ karma a dzhai ṣiñtsa aḥ/ sbyi bo'i gnas lngar rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs kar pad zla'i steng gi rdo rje dang / sngagasarnams las 'od zer byung bas/ sgod bar thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer gyi 'phra 'dus sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho ston par dmigs te bzlasapa bgyi 'tshal/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī aḥ a ā i sī/ u lū/ ṛ dṛ/ t+pa lī/—284—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/e i/ o au/ e aḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ slar yang bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bgyi 'tshal/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phyi nang gi mchad sprin sa dang bar snang gang bar gyur/hūṃ phyogs r+sā dus bsnya 'jig rten na/ /marja yon ji snyid yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'a la/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra twets+tsha byu tsa me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /me tag ji snyed yod pa dang /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'a la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ༷dza āXhūṃ/ hūṃ phyogs ba dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /bdus spos ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshamasapa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'a la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ phyogasabacu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasal 'a la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ phyogasab dusabazhi'i 'jig rten na/ /dri cha ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghasnye āḥhūṃ/ /hūm̐ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal brgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'a la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ /hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi' 'jig rten na/ /sil snyan ji snyed yod pa —285—

me po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'domasakyi gsung la ma/(kadang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasala'abul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shabha āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ sgod bcud snang srid 'jig rten kun/ /rdo rje gzugs sgra dri dang ro/ /reg bya'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā byu tsa āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ gsang ba'i lha mo yid 'ong ma/ /so sa'i gzugs mdzes rig ma yis/ /sku gsum bde chen rgyas mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasal mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dhe ba ta āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ rang bzhin gdod ma'i mgon po ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi yab/ /sangs rgyasakun lasasngar sangs rgyas/ /lhun gyisagrub la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma skyesachos dbyings byang chub sems/ /thog mtha' med pa'i mkha' 1nga nas/ /dus sum rgyal ba skyed mdzad ma/ /kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang bzhin chos sku dag pa'i ngang / /sna tshogasathabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /rigs lnga ye shes lngar ston pa/ /lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bum pa bsgrub pa la 'jug par ba gyi/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ sabhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma su bhā wa shud+dha ྅nya/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ ā ཿlas zla ba/ re las nyi ma'i steng du/ 1 snye las rnam par rgyal ba dang / lasathams cad pa'i bum pa rin po che sna ོgaṭ+wāṃ kyi rang bzhin/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba zhabs zhus pa/ ma 'khyangs ba/ masprin pa phra ba dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/lha'i gos pañtsa li kas masprin pa dkris la/ phyi bum pa'i dbyibs can la/nang lha'i gzhal med khang du gnas pa'i/ nam par rgyal ba'i bum par dbus su seṅge'i khri/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang gi —286—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/steng rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigasalnga so sa'i sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan yum dang ba sa pa rdzogs par gyur/ lasathams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su dpa' bo rta masprin yab yum khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs chen po gsal bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sam ya dzaḥ ye shes pa byon/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par thim/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab/ ā+oṃ bzhi a ste ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ/ badz+ra/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ karma a bhi nyis ā/ de bzhin gshegasapa rigasalngas dbu brgyan/ bdag gi sasnying ga nas 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas rnam par rgyal ba'i lha rnams la phog bde ba'i sgras bskul/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshamasanas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsams la bzla bar bgyi/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.ā/a ā/ i sī/ u ྅/ ṛ dṛ/ oṃlī/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ kakha gagha nga /tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa snye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+taḥ slar yang las thams cad pa'i bum pa snga ma bzhin dmigs te bzlasapa re bgyi/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī sno mchad yon me tag bdug skros dang / snang gsal dri ma zhal zas dang / rol mo la sogs mchad pa'i sprin/ ji snyed kun gyis rgyal ba mchad/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha pa h+ye puṣ+ṭha dhu be+e ā lo ke ghaste nai wi te shak+ta ā hūṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdod nas rang byung sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /phung po gnas gyur ye shesalnga yi dngos/ /bde ga gas yab yum dbang chen yab yum la/ /gnyis med 'du 'bral med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 287—

mesapo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥye shesapa gshegs/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil zhabar chen po bsgrub par bgyi/ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa shud+dha ྅haṃ/ phyi dang nang gi mas thams cad stong pa chen po/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba sto swa bhā wa shud+dha ྅ha/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ ye hūṃ las rlung gi dkyil zhabar ljang gu gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mchog ma ba dan la ye gis mtshan pa hūṃ re hūṃ las me'i dkyil 'bar dmar po gru gsum pa re gyis mtshan pa hūṃ baṃ hūṃ las chu'i dkyil zhabar zlum po 2 gyis mtshan pa/ hūṃ le hūṃ las sa'i dkyil zhabar gru bzhi ser po le gyis mtshan pa/ hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ las ri'i rgyal po'i ri rab kyi steng du/ hūṃ baṃ hūṃ lasasna tshogs pad+ma yangasashing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ a hūṃ lasazla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ hūṃ re hūṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khar gyi steng du/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ lasasna tshogasardo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mchag tu mthing ga'i dbus su/ hūṃ tram̐ hūṃ las 'od 'phras/ phyi sgod kyi 'jig rten la phog /ma dag pa thamasacad sbyangs/ 'og min gyi zhing khams shin tu nyams dga' bar gyur/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa sgo bzhi gru ba rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyang nang nas rim pa bzhin/ mthing ga/ ljang gu dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams kyi steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ nor bu'i dra ba/ dril bu g.yer kha/ rnga ma'i chun po/ dar gyi lda ldi la sogs pa 'phyangs pa/ de'i steng na rdo karma shi la las grub pa'i mda' yab rin po che'i rnam par spel ba'i —288—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'bar lo/steng na/ rin po che'i drwa mig /gseng ma'i byu shusayongasasu bskor ba/ rtsig pa rnams kyi phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ lha mo ba drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas gzhal yas khang pa'i lha rnams la mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer chen po 'gyed pa/ sgo rnams kyi steng ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babasabang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa rnams la/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chasakyi zhabar lo/ khen tu mdzesapa'i ri dwags/ lha'i gos/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa'i/ nang ka ba chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng / rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su yug pa'i dbus/phyur bu rab tu mtho ba'i rtse mo dang phyogs bzhi'i rta babs phyur bu rnams kyi rtse mo thod pa dang / rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tag gis mdzes pa'i kha khyer bzhi bzhi la/ ba dan nyi shu rtsa bzhi thod pa la 'khyangs pa'i gser gyi dril bu g.yer khas bres pa/ phyi mchod rten rtse lnga pa la nang lha'i gzhal yabasakhang pa phyi nas/bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas/bltas na phyi gsal ba/ ye shebasarin pa'i che'i ngo bo las grub pa/ 'od zer chen po rab tu 'bar bas/'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phyi rol na/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ me brgyad dang chu brgyad/ shing brgyad dang sprin brgyad/ grub thob kyi sgob dpon brgyad/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro brgyad la sogasapas mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / me ri me phung gis bskor ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i dbus su/ ā+oṃ oṃ.ā+oṃ las seṅge'i khri/ hūṃ ga hūṃ las —289—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'khum//shishar du glang po che'i khri/ t+t+waṃ tha t+t+waṃ las lhor rta mchog gi khri/ hrī hrī las nub tu rma bya'i khri/ a shaṃ a las byang du shang shang gi khri rnams kyi steng du/ paṃ lasapad+ma/ a lasazla ba/ re las nyi ma'i steng du/ dbusanasaphyogasabazhin rim pa bzhin/ ā+oṃ hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a/ e shā lo ram̐ ye lasa'od zer gyi dra ba chen po rab tu 'phros pas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu snang bar byas so/ /snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi las dang sgrib pa sbyangs te/ lha dang lha ma'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar 'dus ā+oṃ e yongs su gyur pas dbusasu bcam lda na 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyisamajes shing / yab kyi phyag g.yas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/yum gyi khyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su ā+oṃ gyi mthar/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ tweḥ.as bskor ba las 'od zer rab tu 'phra ba'o/ /hūṃ 2 yongs su gyur pa las shar du mi bskyod pa dang mā ma twe dkar mo/ yab kyi g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byasapa'i rdo rje dang / thugasakar pad zla nyi ma'i dbusasu hūṃ gi mthar/ ā+oṃ t+t+waṃ gri a bskor ba/ tru lo las lto rin chen 'byung ldan dang sangs rgyas sbyan ma ser mo yab kyi g.yas rin po ches yu ba byasapa'i rdo rje dang / thugs kar t+t+waṃ gi mthar hūṃ ā+oṃ hrīḥ.asabaskor ba/ hrīḥre lasanub tu snang ba mtha' yasadang gos dkar mo dmar mo yab kyi g.yas pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang / thugs kar lha'i —290—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/mthar hūṃ t+t+waṃ ā+oṃ as bskor ba/ a yam̐ las byang du don yon grub pa dang daskatshig sgol ma ljang gu /yab kyi g.yas rgya gram gyis yu ba byasapa'i rdo rje ral gri dang / thugs kar a'i mthar hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥswo gyis bskor ba/ sa bon de dag thams cad kyi mtha' ā li dkar po dang / kwa li dmar pos bskor ba/ yab thams cad kyi phyag g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum thams cad kyi phyag na gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'o/ de dag gi zur gyi grwa nang ma bzhir pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a gnyis gnyis las/ 'od zer phyogs ba ra 'phras pas shar lho /hūṃ hūṃ las nam mkha'i snying po dkar po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo me long 'dzin pa dang spyor ba t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ las lho nub tu sa'i snying po ser po rin po che'i myu gu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ hrī hrī las nub byang du spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ glu ma dmar mo pi wang 'dzin pa dang spyor ba/ a a las byang shar du kun tu bzang po ljang gu /rin po che'i snye ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gar ma ljang gu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang spyor ba'o/yang phyi rol gyis grwa bzhin/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a gnyisaganyis las/ mer hūṃ hūṃ las byams pa dkar po klu shing dang dril bu 'dzin pa/bdug sbos ma dkar mo 'dug sbos kyi khang pa 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ las srin por sgrib pa rnams sel ser po po ti dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ me tag ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa dang spyor ba/ hrī hrī las rlung du 'jam 291—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen raba'abyamasakyi gsung 'a ma/(kadapal dmar po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snang gsal ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ a a las dbang ldan du phyag na rdo rje ljang gu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dri ma ma ljang gu dri'i dung mas 'dzin pa dang spyor ba/ de thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de dag gi sku'i rtsal las shar gyi snam bu la thag bzang ris mthing ga go cha 'dzin pa/ lhor shākya thub pa ser po 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ nub tu seṅge rab brten mthing ga po ti 'dzin pa/ byang du kha 'bar dhe ba dmar po rin po che'i sgom bu 'dzin pa/ steng du brgya byin dkar po bi wang 'dzin pa/ 'og tu a ba glang mgo nag po me chu bsnams pa rnamasapad zla'i steng na bzhengs pa'i tshul gyisasprul pa'i sku'i rgyan dang ldan pa'o/ /sgo bzhin pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyal gnyis lasashar du dza dza las khro bo rnam par rgyal ba dang sgo ma lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ hūṃ hūṃ las lho sgor khro bo gagan rje'i gshed po dang / sgo ma zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa dang spyor ba/ me baṃ las nub sgor khro bo rta masprin rgyal ba dang / sgo ma lcags sgog ma dmar mo lcags sgog 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ ho ho las byang sgor khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang sgo ma dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa dang spyor ba/ de dag thamasacad kyang khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ khro ba'i stangs stabasakyis me ri me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na —292—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi sku'i gdangasalas/ steng na khrag 'thung lnga ba rtsabargyad kyi dkyil zhabar me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na shin tu 'jigs su rung ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis snang la rang bzhin med par bsam mo/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas se gol dpung par bsgol te gtagasanas/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'jomasamadzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /ba ma ldan 'khar bcasaganas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ hūṃ dusagasum bla ma kun bzang chas kyi rje/ /nyan mongs lnga dag phung po gnas gyur pa'i/ /sku gsum lnga ldan rigs lnga yab yum gtso/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchad kyis gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ gu ru badz+ra hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.a/ sa ma ya dza dza/ bla ma dkyil 'khar gyi lha tshogasathamasacad byon par bsam//hūṃ sgyu ma chu zla ye shes gzhal yas khang / /skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma snyur+ya tsan+d+ra ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ chu dang thang skyesame tog yid 'ongs rnams/ /dngosa'ador kho 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khar lha la 'a la/ /thugs rjesatshe 'dasadon du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dpo byu tsa me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ a gar sih+la tsan+dan la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byar ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchad sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khar lha la 'a la/ /thugasarjesatshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ’ pe byu tsa me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rin chen snang gsal nyi zla'i 'od 'pha ba/ /dngos 'dor 293—

presapo'i shulabazhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//shiting nge 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'bar lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū tsa me gha sa ma dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /dngos 'dor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khar lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe byu tsa me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sam ye hūṃ/ kha dog dri ldan ro brgya ldan pa'i zas/ /dngos 'byar ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchad sprin byas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khar lha la 'bul/ /thugasarjesatshe 'dasadon du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni wi te skru tsa me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sil snyan dril chen rnams dkrol tshangs pa'i dbyangs//dngosa'abyar ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin byas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil zhabar lha la 'a la/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shabha pū tsa me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchad sprin ni/ dngosa'abyar ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchad sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khar lha la 'a la/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pū tsa me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sam ye hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs nyid ye nasakun tu bzang / /sku lnga ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /thabasamakhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga'i tshogs la bstod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ ye shes pa rnamasadam tshig pa'i dal du byen/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ so so'i spyi bor byon/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ gnyis su —294—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/med par zim/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hoḥ dgyes shing brtan par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ masprin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ ā+oṃ brnya a dhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi dzin t+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ti hrīX ā+oṃ karma a bhi nyis a/ de bzhin ga gas pa rigs lngasabadud rtsi'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyisani/ /lha rnamasakyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bshin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ gis dbang bskur bas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchad pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa dang nam mkha' kun tu khyab par gyur/ hūṃ phyogs ba ra rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /me tag sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnams sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchad/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pas āḥhūṃ/ phyogs ba rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /bdug sbosasprin yung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasal gus pasamachad/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ phyogs ba rab 'thums rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /snang gsal sprin kung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyisarnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasal gus pasamachad/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ phyogasabacu rab 'thums rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /dri chang sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/—295—

mesabo'i shul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'dza//dargyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchad/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+de āḥhūṃ/ phyogasab rab 'thums rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /zhal zas sprin kung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyisarnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gusapasamachod / ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogasabacu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ rol mo'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klasapa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasal gus pasamachad/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegasapa thamasacad la/ /'bar lo rin chen 'di 4la bas/ /srid pa'i 'khar lo rgyun chad nas/ /chas kyi stobar lo bskor bar shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na phu tsi te (〈a〉pū dzi te)āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkres shing phongs pa rgyun chad de/ /'thur pa phun su stogs par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi rat+na byu tsi te(〈a〉byu dzi te)āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegasapa thams cad la/ /btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ khes rab dbyings kyi don rtogasanas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wa ti rat+na pū tsi te (〈a〉pū dzi te)āḥhūm̐/ bde bar ga gas pa thams cad la/ /blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum zeg gsum ldan/ /bas yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ta rat+na byu tsi te (〈a〉byu dzi te)āḥhūṃ/ bde bar ga gas pa thams cad la/ /glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams—296—

gzhan phan 'od spyo 'khor lo/nirab bsal te/ /bla med theg par rab zhan nas/ /thamasacas bgrod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sko rat+na byu tsi te (〈a〉gadzi te)pāḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /rta mchag rin ོ 'dikul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu'akhrul mchag gi shugasathob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tu re ga a shwa thā rat+na pū tsi te (〈a〉byu dzi te) ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bde bar ga gsapa thams cad la/ /dmag dpon rin chen 'di 4la bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar ba da de/ /snyems bral mchag ni thob par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rat+na pā tsi te (〈a〉byu dzi te)āḥhūṃ/ /hūṃ sgod bcud snang srid sna tshogasayid 'ong gzugs/ /rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ྅ pa pra ti dza hūṃ/ /sgod bas snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra /rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogasasu kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjesatshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shak+ta hūṃ/ /sgod ba da snang srid sna tshogs dri zhim 1sa/ /rdo rje dri ma'i tshogasasu kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol//ā+oṃ badz+ra ghasmre hūm̐/ sgod bas snang srid sna tshogs ro ldan zas/ /rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho tshogasal mchad par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhesasu gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te hūṃ/ sgod —297—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'doms kyi gsung 'bum//dbacad snang srid sna tshogs bde ba'i ro/ /rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das dorda du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra parle hūṃ/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /rdo rje'i rin chan bla na med/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas/ /rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra lwa phye hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mā le t+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra shārti 1 ā+oṃ badz+ra ༷rti ā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dh+ra pe hūm̐/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pa/ t+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ tshwa badz+ra ghan+dhe ā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa two su saṃ kra ha/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nu ta ri ram̐/ ā+oṃ badz+rapad+ma ka ya ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra karma a rong bha we/ hūṃ gsang mchag sku yi bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams/ khaṃn tu yid 'ong — bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasakun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra a dhar she āḥhūṃ/ gsang mtshog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgogs ma/ phren tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra mu rañdzi āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni/ /skumadog mthing mdzes pi wang sgra sgogs ma/ phren tu yid 'ong bde ga gsadagyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra wini āḥhūṃ/ /gsang mtshog yon tan bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog ser mdzes gling bu'i sgra sgrogs ma/ phren tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyesagyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra waṃ se āḥhūṃ/gsang mchog phrin las bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog ljang mjes rdza rnga'i sgra—298—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/sgogs ma/ khen tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra me dhe (〈a〉dṛ haṃ)ke āḥhūṃ/rtsabargyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dug lnga gnas sgyur ye shes bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchad par bgyi/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa ā n+d+ra ta khā hi/ bde ga gas rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni/ /yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las/ /'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchad/ /bde ba'i ro mnyam mchad par bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sto dhi cit+ta gu khya byu tsa (〈a〉byu dza)me gha sa mu dra spra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sna tshogs chos rnams ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang / /snang srid 'khar 'dasasgyu ma'i mchod sprin ni/ /chas sku stong pa mtshan med smon pa med/ /gdod nasarnam dag zhi ba'i dbyings su 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba dharma kwa ya āḥhūṃ/ chas nyid ye shes mnyam pa'i ngang / /rang bzhin yon tan lhun gyis grubab/ /thugs rje yid bzhi nor bu 'dra/ /phyag 'tshal gdod ma'i mgon po la/ /chosadabyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyan mongasagati mug rnam sbyong zhing / /nam mkha'i khamasani rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rnam snang yab yum la/ /me long ye shesango bo nyid/ /nyon mongasazhe sdang rnam sbyong zhing / /chu yi khamasani rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod yab yum la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyan mongs nga rgyal rnam sbyong zhing / /sa yi khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rin 'byung yab yum la/ /kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags rnam sbyong zhing / /me yi khamasani rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal snang —299—

mesapo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/()mtha' yab yum la/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs phrag dog rnam byeng zhang / /rlung gi khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal don grub yab yum la/ /bcu drug ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /gzung 'dzin sgrib pa rnam sbyong zhing / /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal sems dpa' yab yum la/ /tshad med ye shes ngo bo nyid/ khamasabazhi'i dri ma rnam sbyong zhing / /'byung bzhi'i sgo ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal sgo ba yab yum la/ /pha rol phyin drug ngo bo nyid/ /'gro drug bag chags rnam sbyong zhing / /tshogs drug rnam shesarnam par dag /phyag 'tshal thub pa drug la'o/ /zhi las ye shes rnam 'phrasapa/ /'jigs ga gas khro ba'i dkyil 'khar ni/ /lnga bca rtsa brgyad 'bar ba'i sku/ /phyag 'tshal dbyings kyi dkyil 'khar la/ /sadang ye shesazhing khams na/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das tshul/ /dur khrod chen pa'i gnasabargyad na/ /bzhugs pa'i 'gro ba kun la bstod/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gtor ma'i sgod yangs shing rgya che bar ba da ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pas gang bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ i rda ste na bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchad sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ bla ma bde gshegs rigs lnga zhi khro rab 'thums kyi lha tshogs 'khar dang ba sapa rnams la 'bul lo/ /tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a ha ri ni sabha li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la 'akul lo/ /tshe las 'das pa'i sa dang lam gyi bar du gsad pa —300—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma rna a phywa nud pat+pa na twad ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yul lha gzhi bdag gi tshogs thams cad la 'a la lo/ /tshe lasa'adas pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a shā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma rna a sde nud pan na twad ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swālha 'gro ba rigs drug gnod byed lan chags bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang bcas pa la 'a la lo/ /tshe las 'das pa la lan chags pa thams cad khyer nas gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /ā+oṃ a kwa ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ni a phywa nus na tad ā+oṃ āḥhūṃphaṭa swā ༈ dus las 'das pa'i gtsor byas bar do na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la 'a la lo/ /bar do'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /na mo bdag gis bsam pa'i stobasadang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chas kyi dbyingasakyi stobasarnamasakyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogasapa med par 'byung 'gyur shog /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par sbyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /chasarnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ khyu dang lasalas kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo gnyis med gnasamed pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob ba'i sras su skye/ /de ltar chas dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshogs —30/—

mesabo'i shul bldan las/ 1nga chen rab 'byam kyi gsung 'bum/()gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib pa gnyis byang ste/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /ces brjod nas skabs 'dir/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khar du dbang blang ngo / /tshe 'das la dbang bskur te/ sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thog mar rten bskyed pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sā bha wa bi shud+dha3 sarba dha swā bhā wa bi shu sgo3nya/ stong pa'i ngang lasapad+ma dang / zla ba'i steng du/ dṛ yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe 'das de nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gson gyi dus na ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du yong bar gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par ba sa pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabasakyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bden pa dang / gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyis bden pa dang / chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rten cing 'brel par 'gyung ba zab mo'i bden pa dang /bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'thums kyi lha tshogs 'khar dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nasapha rol du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i rnam par shesapa las kyi dbang gis khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnasarnam pa bzhi/ srid pa bar ma do/ 'khar ba dang mya ngan las 'dasapa'i char gtogs pa/ gang na gnas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig la rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig /ā+oṃ ḍāk+ki dza hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ rnam shes 'od kyi —302—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/rnam pa nam mkhar bsams la/ ā+oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūṃ/sdig pa sbyangs te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ha/sa rten la bstim/ /ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ bhi shā dha ni hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ sarba bid tra thā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi po ta ya sarba a pa ya bhan+ta ni/ pra mo k+ṣa ya sarba a pa ya ghan+dhe bh+ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra thā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra bhan+ta tra thā/ ā+oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa sbyangasadu rung bar gyur/ /thog mar gtor ma bskor zhing zhi bsasbyong ba ni/ /ā+oṃ sarba sarba bi sne na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad khaṃ/ ut+pa te spa ra ṇa hi ga ga na khaṃ/ tshe lasa'adas pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams gtor ma 'dis brdan par gyis la song zhig /ces pa gsum dang / ting lo dang chang bus bskor zhing / sum̐ bha ni/ ting lo 'dis snang ba gyis changs bu 'dis lam rgyags gyisal song zhig khes pas zhi drag byed ma dang / gu gul gyis bdug cing rdo rje dril bu gsil la/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me la sogs pas khro bo mang po byon par bsam la/ hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegasarnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ā+oṃ sum̐ bha nis bgegs rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bsgrad/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na/ ma thā da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa kyis me ris mtshams ba da par gyur/ rten gyi g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu/ mdun du til bzhag nas/ snying ga'i sdig sgrib shaṃ nag po'i rnam pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can du gyur pa/ mtheb srin gyis til la zim pa g.yas g.yon gyi ye shes kyi me dang —303—

mes po'i shul bzhag lag 1nga chen pa 'grumasakyi gsung ba ma//shichur bor bas dag par bsam zhing / ā+oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru ye swāhā/ che ge'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ sngags bzlasapa'i bye masabrab pasasdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam zhing / ā+oṃ dzi na dzi ka le te sha ra te s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra bye ka sum̐ snye shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ/ swā rat+na dṛ ka mo mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ/ e a ro lika/ bye ra ga ra ti s+t+waṃ/ hā pra dz+nyā dṛ ka haṃ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ gyi.āḥ dzaḥhūṃ shā ho/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sarba pa paṃ zi dha ni badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bhasmi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ snre ste na sha ya/ a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ t+t+waṃ bi sha dadha ya a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta ka ta ka ha na ha na a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sum̐ sar sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra a war ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/sarba a wa ra ṇa ni bi pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ bye ta ṣ+ṭṛ ta sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ tra tha tra tha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ tshin+ta tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba raya ga he he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ tshe lasa'adas pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ lha'i ngos su me long la khrusagasol zhing / /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyisani/ /de bshin ga gas kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin sa sa ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal bar mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta —304

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shrī hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po sbos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par gang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrusagasol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shrī hūṃ/ de dag sku la mtshungasapa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'a la/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī a/ ka ya bhi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes gsol ba'i chu las bum du blugs par rnam rgyal gyi rka'ang bsres nas/ ming byang la bkru zhing / /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtang ba dri yisalegasabagosachu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ khrimasa'achal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /tshul khrims dri yis legasabagos chu/ khrus legasamadzad kyi khrus ba3 'o/ /'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhi chu/ khong kha'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bzod pa dri yisalegasabagos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni brtson la/sarang bzhi chu/ /le la'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /brtson 'grusadri yis legasabagosachu/ khrus legasamadzad kyi khrusabagyi'o/ /'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ khes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / khes rab dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrusalegasamadzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /chu bo drug gis khrusabyas pas/ /bag chagasarnam drug sbyong mdzad cing / /gang la —305—

me po'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kanyes pa mi mnga' ba/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing / /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ khrus legasamadzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchad don du/ /dad pasabadag gis khrusabagyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrī.a/ che ge ma'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs drug zhi nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'dasadug gsum ste/ /ba ma ldan sangasargyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangasargyas bden pas dug ba ma mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /skyob pa'i dam chos dug mi mnga'/ /dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chagasazhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'dasadug gsum ste/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun bden pas dug ba ma mo/ /che ge ma'i nyan mongs pa dug lnga dug gsum thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas sharnying ku ru ye swāhā/ yang 'byung ba bzhigabakru zhing / /sani dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum sayi nang du song / /chu ni dug gi pha yin te/ /chu ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum chu yi nang du song / /me ni dug gi pha yin te/ /me ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum me yi nang du song / /rlung ni dug gi —306—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khar lo/pha yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum rlung gi nang du song / /ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ gyi.a/ che ge ma'i 'byung ba'i dug thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i nang du shārnying ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bkrus nas shis pa brjod pa ni/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legasamadzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang phyir bde la mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugasakyisa'agro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangasades/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khar bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun kyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyan gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogasadon 'thur gyur cig /don grub tshogasakyang grub pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pasasarnams ni/ /nags tshal ba sa par rab g.yos te/ /sems can rab dga' mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legasamadzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por ga gsapa na/ /sadag rnam —307—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()—drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legasamadzad par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khar lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung zhing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrag gang zhag mu stegs byed/ /thamasacad chas kyis pham mdzad cing / tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pas des/ khyed la bde legasamadzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod namasamathu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa'i/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed chag bde legs shog khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legasashog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs shog khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /che las 'dasapa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal zhing shin tu bkra shisapar gyur cig /ces brjod nas byang bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pas gtso byasapa'i sems can thams cad/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag —308—

gas phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tag phog pa yi/ /dkyil stobar lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par ṣ+ṭhas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yid dam dkyil 'khar gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba kun bzang rigs lnga'i gtso/ /sems dpa' sems ma sgo skyong thub pa drug /zhi khro rab 'thums dkyil 'khar lha tshogs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /gzhan yang phyogs ba 'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / /byang a ltam dral lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje pho nya mkha' 'gro shug 'gror bcas/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /rgyal sras nyan thosarang sangs rgyas pa'i tshogs/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong byer mi 'ongs pa dang / /slob dang mi slob bsod nams zhing rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tsha skyabasasu nye bar mchi/ /thog med dus nas stobar ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /ma rig dbang gis 'khrul zhing 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa che la sogs/ /so sa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho'i 'dul khrims las/ /'gal zhing nongs pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa/ /ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ khes dang spyad dang dang du blangs la sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga rtsa ba yan lag ba sa/ /bsrungs mtshams dus lasayal ba mchis so 'tshal/ /ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ /mdor na nyes lhung sdig pa'i tshogs kun bshags/ /dge la yi rang 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /—309—

mesapo'i shulabs las/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyasa'agrub par shog /cesapas phyag 'tshal nas/ de nasatshe 'das kyis dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal kul la/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ zhes pa dang / e ma dus gsum rgyal ba kun tu bzang / /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol/ /tshe 'das khyed kyi rjes su 'jug /dkon mchag gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /so thar byang sems dam tshig rnams/ /thar pa'i grong du 'jug bya'i phyir/ mgon posabadag la gnang du gsol/ /ces brjod par bsam nas me tog dor ba'i lan du/ e ma sgod dang ldan pa'i bu/ /gsang sngagasacho ga khyed la bstan/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyis/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyang / /gsang sngagasacho ga 'di mkhyen pas/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas thob pa yin/ /kun bzang rgyal ba rigasalnga yis/ /bdud kyi dpung yang 'di yisab ma/ /de ltar khyod kyis thob bya'i phyir/ /'di yi rjesasu kun zhugasamadzod/ /cesabarjod nas sdom pa byin/ /phyogs bas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gra'i tshogs rnams dgongs/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo phyogs bas sangs rgyas dang / /zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chas rnamasadang / /tshogs mchag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi /kun bzang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la/ /'di bzung bla med byang chub bar/ /—310—

gas phan 'od kyi masar lo/gusapa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo chosaskyong bcas/ /byang chub semasadapa' slob dpon la/ /bdag ni gusapas skyabasasu mchi/ /bla ma kun bzang sbyan snga sa /lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la/ /gnod pa las ldog dge ba bsgrub/ /dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /bdag ni rgyun du gnas shing bsrung / /zhesapa gsum dang / /ho bla ma kun bzang dgongs su gsol/ /'di bzung byang rtsa ma thob bar/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis/ /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol dgrol dang dbugs dbyung phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang / /sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar/ 'di ba nga 'khar ba ma stongs par/ /bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems/ /tshe 'das bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /pha rol phyin drug slob cing bsgrub/ /brtson 'grus bdag gis thams cad bsgral/ /kun don tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung / /bdag gis sems bskyed sdomasag nga nas/ /ma grol dgrol dang ma brgal bsgral/ /dbugasadabyung mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /cesapa gsum dang / sras ba sasangasargyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'thur ma rnams kun/ /tshe 'dasal ni dgongs su gsol/ /deng nasabyang chub snying pa'i bar/ /dkon mchag gsum ni mi gtang ngo / /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /rin chen rigasakyi dam tshig tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /speg pa gsum —31/—

me bo'i shulabazhag las/ 1nga 'a rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum/(kadang chos rnamasabashad/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya/ /yar mchad gus shing mar la brtse/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung / /rtsa ba bzhi lasa'ada' mi bya/ /zhesapa gsum gyisarjes la/gdong g.yogs yid kyis bcings la gsol ba btang pa/ kye khro bo mi bzad 'jigasapa'i sku/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /bdag cag 'khar ba las bsgral phyir/ khyed kyis gnang ste gtang du gsol/ /ces pa dang /khyed su yin ci byed dris la/ bdag ni skal ldan rigs kyi bu gcig po lags/ dpal rigs kyi bdag po la dbang zhu/ zhes lan smras par bsamasal/ bgegasabasgrad/ yang / kye rigs lnga bde bar gshegasapa dang / /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /sgo ba ོ po khyed rnams kyis/ /sgo bye thar pa'i grong bstan 'tshal/ /zhesapa gsum dang / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /dkyil 'khar lha stogs spangs na ni/ /skyob ba gzhan nas mi mnga' bas/ khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la stsal/ /zhes pa gsum dang / e ma khyod ni sgod mtshog dam pa ste/ khyod 'dod pa ni bdag gisasbyin/ /zhesadang /bdag ni 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /smin cing grol bar 'dod pas na/ /thugs rjes bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /gsum gyi rjesal/ e ma e ma rigs kyi bu/ khyod ni lasazad 'khrul ba zhig /rigs kyi bu mchag khyod yin pas/ /ngas khyod kun bzang rigs lnga yi/ /dkyil 'bar 'jug cing ye shes dbab/ /dngos grub thamasacad khyod kyisathob/ /dngosagrub dkyil stobar 'di dag ni/ /ma mthong ba la 312—

gagan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/smras pa na/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar lhung / /rigasalnga ye shes rnam pa lnga/ khyod kyi snying la zhugs pa ste/ /'di smrasaye shesalha dang bral/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sregasapar byed/ /bsrung na dngosagrub thams cad thob/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung / /ā+oṃ a n+d+ra ta dam las ma 'da' swā hā/ khyod kyis ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas nga yin pas/ngas bka' bsgo ba las ma 'da' zhig /'dasan rdo rje'i dmyal bar skyes nasathon pa'i dusamed do/ /zhes pas bdud rtsi 'thor nas/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khar gyi lha tshogs/ tshe 'dasakyi snying nang du thim par bsamasal/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya pra be sha ya hūṃ hūṃ/ zhesapasarol mo dkrol lo/ /tshe 'das gsol ba 'debs par bsamasanas/ kye shar sgo srung ba'i sgo ba lcags kyu ma/ shar gyi sgo 'di byes la ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /kye lto sgo srung ba'i sgo ba zhags pa ma/ /lho yi sgo 'di byesal ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /nub sgo srung pa'i sgo ba lcags sgog ma/ /nub kyi sgo 'di phyes la ni/ /tshe 'dasayi dam lha dang sprod/ /byang sgo srung ba'i sgo ba dril bu ma/ /byang gi sgo 'di byesal ni/ /tshe 'dasayi dam lha dang sprod/ khesabarjod nas me tog dor te/ kye bde ga gas rigs lnga'i pho brang du/ /'brel ba'i me tag 'di dor bas/ /'brel ba gang yod lha dang bdag 'phrad shog /ā+oṃ ༷dza si ti (〈a〉sidhi) s+t+waṃ/ zhes dor nas/ ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis/ khyod kyi ma rig 'khar ba'i mig /ye shesaspyan du dbye ba ltar/ /de bzhin khyod kyisa'agro ba rnams/ /ye shes spyan du 'byed par shog /ā+oṃ tsak+ṣu 313

me bo'i shul ba las/ klong chen rab 'doms kyi gsung 'bum/(kaswāhā/ zhes yid kyis gdongs g.yogs byes la/ e ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/khyod ni sdig pa kun las grol/ /dkyil zhabar chen po 'di la ltos/ /lusangag yid kyisadad pa bskyed/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyisabarlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob/ /dam tshig sngagasal brtson par gyis/ /kye rigs kyi bu rdul tshon gyi dal 'di ni rten lha'i gzhal yas khang ste/4nga po khams dang skye mched mtshon/ de na bzhugs pa'i lha ni/ rang gi sems rigs lnga'i sangasargyas su bzhugs par dran par gyis shig /ces brjod nas/ yang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ /kun bzang yab yum ye shes dbang / /bdag la bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ khesagasum brjod dus/ me tag gang la phog pa 'di/ /sngon nas khyod kyi yi dam lha/ /rtag tu bsgom dang bsgrub par gyis/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra put+pa si ti (〈a〉sirnyi)s+t+waṃ/ zhes pasame tog ba ngas la/tshe 'das rdo rje semasadapar bsamasal/ bum pa spyi bor 'dzin pas/ hūṃ ga gas kyi phung po rnam dag cing / /nyon mongasazhe sdang spyong byed pa'i/ /me long lta bu'i ye shesakyis/ /dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa hūṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la chu 'di gtad cing bkrus pa tsam gyis/lusakyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dbang thob pa yin no/ khyod kyi gzugs kyi phung po rdo rje semasadapa' nyid du sangasargyas te/ chu'i khams mā ma gī'i rang bzhin du gnasa'agyur nas/ zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rigasakyi sku 'gyur ba med pa thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa —314—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/dang / snang ba mtha' yas su bsams te rdo rje ba nga nas/ hūṃ 'du shes 4nga po rnam dag cing / /nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i/ /so sor rtogasapa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi shiñtsa gyi 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyi lag tu rdo rje 'di gtad pa tsam gyis/ 'dir ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du shes kyi phung po snang ba mtha' yas nyid du sangs rgyas te me'i khamasakyang gos dkar ma'i rang bzhin du dag nas/ 'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes nyid du grol te/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rigs kyi gsung 'gags med pa'i chas kyi sgra dbyangasathob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / rnam snang du bsams nas ming 'dogasapar mosashing / hūṃ rnam shes phung po rnam dag cing / /nyan mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa'i/ /chas kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ bzhi abhi nyis ā+oṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la ming che ge mo zhes bya ba btags pa tsam gyis/ 'dir yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /rnam par shes pa yang rnam par snang mdzad du sangs rgyas te/ nam mkha'i khams kyang chas kyi dbyings phyug mar dag nas/ gti mug chas kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegasapa'i thugs 'khrul pa med pa chos kyi sku thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / rin 'byung du bsams nas dbu rgyan thogasanas/hūṃ tshor pa'i 4nga po rnam dag cing / nyon mongs nga rgyal spyong byed pa'i/ /mnyam —315—

mesabo'i shulabazhagalag 1nga chen rab 'domasakyi gsung 'tsho//dpa nyid kyi ye shesakyis/ /dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣañtsa t+t+waṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbu rgyan 'di bskon pa tsam gyis/ 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan nyid du sangs rgyas te/ sa'i khams kyang sangs rgyas sbyan du dag nas/ nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rin chen rigs kyi yon tan thamasacad mkhyen pa thob nas/ 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ zhes pa dang / /don grub tu bsamos nas dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūṃ 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing / /nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa'i/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shesakyis//dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ karma a bhi ṇiñtsa a/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dril bu 'di gtad pa tsam gyis 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa ma lus pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du byed kyi phung po yang don yod grub par sangs rgyas te/ rlang gi khamasakyang dam tshig sgol mar dag nas/ phrag dog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangasargyas don yod grub pa'i phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhesapa dang /kun tu bzang por bsamasate/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ thabasadang shes rab dbyer med cing / /snang stong dbyer med 'di zung la/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yis/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis/ /'gro kun rjes su 'dzin par mdzod/ /'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rdo rje dang dril bu 'di gtad pa —316—

gas phan 'od kyi sa ra lo/tsam gyis/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa'i sabon thebasanas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob pa yin no/ /rang gi sems skye ba med pa chas kyi skur sangs rgyasate/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas/ sku gsum 'bral ba med pas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / rnam rgyal gyi bum pa 'dzin pas/ hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' ba ma ldan 'das/ /mā ma twe yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyisamed byang chub semasakyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /snang ba mtha' yasabacam ldan 'das/ /gos dkar mo yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub semasakyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcam ldan 'das/ /kun tu bzang ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub semasakyi chus/ /rigasakyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bcam ldan 'das/ /sangasargyasaspyan ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub semasakyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /don yod grub pa bcam ldan 'das/ /dam tshig sgrol ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub semasakyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā kyini si ti (〈a〉sidhi) pha la hūṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.aḥha ri ni sa a bhi ṇiñtsa mai/sidhi pha la hūṃ ā/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa bum pa'i dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis/ sgod bas lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin phung po khams dang skye mched lha dang lha mor gnas gyur pa yin —317spyo

mesapo'i shulabaldan las/ klong za rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()pas/ phyi nang snod bas thams cad la brnyas pa byas na lhung bar 'gyur bas dag snang dang mos pa gyis la mchod pa dang bstod pa la dga' ba dang ngo shes par gyis shig /cesapa dang / rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bstan la/ 'o rigasakyi bu khyod la rigs lnga'i sku 'di bstan pa tsam gyis/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /de yang nyon mongs pa rang bzhin gyis dag cing ye shes lnga rgyas pas/ rang bzhin gyi don gnyisalhun gyisagrub pa'i brda yin no/ /zhesapa dang / de ltar brda yi ngo sprod kyang / /logs na yod pa ma yin te/ /rang gi lus sems 'di la tshang / /'khar 'das rig pa'i ye shes te/ /sku lnga ye shesalhun gyisagrub/ /sangasargyasagazhan du ma 'tshol cig /ces pa dang / e ma tshe 'das bu nyan cig /thun mong skyabasa'agro nasabacomasapa'i/ /so thar byang sems bslab bya dang / /rig 'dzin sngagasakyi dam tshig kun/ /byang chub ma thob bar du ni/ /sgog gi phyir yang ma gtang zhig /dam tshig nyamasan bskal pa sa /ngan song gsum nasathar mi srid/ /de phyir srungs shig rigs kyi bu/ 'o khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi dbang thams cad rdzogs par thob pa yin pas dad pa dang dam tshig thams cad legs par bsrungs ba la brtson par mdzod cig /ces brjod nas/ shin tu dben zhing skal ba mchag rab dang ldan pa la dbang lhag ma'ang bskur zhing / thun mong pa thamasacad de nas maṇ+ḍal phul lo/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /deng nas byang chub snying pa'i bar/ /lus dang longasaspyod kun gyisamachad/ khyed kyi rjesasu ga nga mdzod la/ /srid pa'i rgyal mtsho lasabargal mdzod/ /ces —318—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/gtang rag phul ba dang / slar yang mchad cing bstod pa/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa//mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa skru tsi te āḥhūṃ/phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchag sgra snyan yid 'ongasaldan//mos blos rten gyi lha la mchad par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shabha ka ma gu ṇa skru tsi te āḥhūṃ/phyogs dusakun na tsan dan sgrul snying dang / /a gar nag sogs dbang po tshimasabyed dri/ /mos blos rten gyi lha la mchad par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghasmre ka ma gu ṇa byu tsi ti āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dusakun na bas dang ror ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtasabyed ro mchag ci mchis kun/ /mos blosarten gyi lha la mchad par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rā sa ka ma gu ṇa phyu tsi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'a la chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshims byed rnams/ /mosasgosarten gyi lha la mchad par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pasne ka ma gu ṇa pā rtsete (〈a〉phu dzi te)āX hūṃ/ ye nas rnam dag chos sku dag pa las/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi gzugs skur rnam sprul zhing / /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ nub tha ma la 'dir byang bu'i rnam shes —319—

me po'ishulabazhag la / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung la ma//danam mkhar hūṃ du bsam la 'og tu me sbar te/ /gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigasalnga'i me sbar ro//'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro/ /rnam shesabargyad kyi bud shing la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro/ /skye mched drug gi bud shing la/ /thub pa drug gi me sbar ro/ khamasadang phung pa'i bud shing la/ khro bo ye shes me sbar ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum me spar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa/ /'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /cesabasregs nas/ dkon mchag rin chen dpal zhing du/ /dkon mchag rin chen lasabyung ba/ /dkon mchag rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ / byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nasasdig pa kun sbyangasanas/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /ā+oṃ rad ne+e rad ne+e/ /rad na sam bhā we/ rad na mā la/ rad na ki bi shuste/ sho dha ya/ sarba pā paṃ swāhā/ pad+mo 'dam kyisam gosaltar/ srid gsum dri mas ma gosapa'i/ /srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /ā+oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we/ su khaṃ bha ra bha ya/ gha tsha ru swāhā/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khar bzang zhing dga' ba der/ pazlo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang tshe 'das der thob shor/ ces me tag 'thor bas/ nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa 320—

gagan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skyes te/ ston pa 'od dpag med 'khar bcas mchod cing lung bstan nas/ /slar yang steng gi nam mkha' drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gi 'char 'bebs shing / ched du brjod pa/ e ma sangs rgyas ye sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chas dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med do/ /sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /e ma sangasargyas rnamasakyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ zhesabarjod nas slar bde ba can du song ste sangs rgyas par gyur/ de nas skabasa'adir tshogs kyi dga' ba byas la/ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchad pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /me long ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ༷dza āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyesadang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug sbos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shesabarnyesal 'a la/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra — pe āḥhūṃ/mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing / /phyogs kun snang ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun rtog ye shesabarnyes la 'a la/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /bya grub ye shes brnyesal 'a la/ /tshe 'das don du bzhesasu gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /zhal zas mchog gi bshas gtsang 'di/ /chas dbyingasaye shes brnyes la 'a la/ /tshe 321—
