mesabo'i shulabazhag las/ grong chen rab 'grumasakya gsung 'bum/(ka'adas don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ni wi te āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras bcasal/ /snang srid 'dod yon marja pa'i sprin/ /bdud rtsi bde rja bla na med/ /ye shesamachag gi mchad par bgyi/ /ā+oṃ ma mṛ ta byu tsa sarba āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ zhi ba lhun gyisagrub pa yi/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dkyil 'khar du/ /phung po nyan mongasaganas gyur pa'i/ /bde gshegasabazhi ba gnyisal 'dud/ /che mchag gdod nasardzogs sangs rgyas/ /gar dgu'i rol par rab dgyes shing / /sna tshogasarnams par 'khrul pa'i bdag khrag 'thung lnga ba brgyad la 'dud/ /zhing dang dur khrod nye ba'i zhing / /gnasarnams la ni rab rgyu zhing / /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /kun la rang bzhin gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pasabastod la/ sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchag dam pa lha mis mchad 'osapa/ /sangasargyasaphyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legasashog /semasacan gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thamasacad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'osapa/ /chas la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir ba de legasashog /semasacan gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thamasacad 'dir ni bde gyur cig tshogasakyi mtshog rab lha misamachad 'osapa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces pasame tag 'azor la/ gang yang bdag sgo gti mug pas/ /legasabyas 'di la nyes gyur gang / /de kun lus can skyabasagyur pa/ /bla ma mgon posabazod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag rtsod pa'i dus/ /snyigs ma'i dusakyi sems —322—

gagan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/can du gyur pa lags pas/ /gasdong bzhin du yo byad ma tshogasapa dang / /ma 'byar pa ci mchis pa thams cad bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sems can du gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob ste/ bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / nyan mongs pa'i dbang gis cho ga nyams shing lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon dngos po ci mchis pa de dag bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yā/ ma nu pā la ya/ sarba sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su twa ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yaṭ+wā sarba mne su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shi yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me mulca badz+rī bha wa/ mahā sam ya satwa āḥ zhes brjod nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ phyogasabacon bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang zhi khro rab 'thums kyi dal thams cad tshe las 'das pa la dgongs su gsol/tshe las 'das pas dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dang gang yang bdag cag gi tshe las 'das pa'i don du/ dkon mchag mchad cing dbang bskur/ 'byung po la gtor ma byin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mos thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dang /thun mong gcig tu byas te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan te/ lha —323—

me po'i shulabs las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'a ma/()dang mi'i mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa gtang nus par gyur cig /srid par skye ba la 'dun pa thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul khrims bsrung nus par gyur cig /semasacan thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa bsgom nus par gyur cig /dge ba'i chos ma lus pa myur du sdud pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam nus par gyur cig /gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam pa 'jog nus par gyur cig /thabs snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs shing khong du yod par gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas kyang sems can gyi don du rnam par thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang / bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du phyin par gyur cig /de yang mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan pa skyon gang yang med pa nyid thob par gyur cig khyad par du bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bzhas gnyen mthun pa'i zhabs drung du skye bar gyur cig /de dag las theg pa chen pa'i chos zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thob par gyur cig /de'i don nyams su blangs nas sa dang lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /cesapa gsum brjod nas/ gson pa'i don du bsngo ba/ yang /phyogs ba na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khar gyi lha tshogs 324—

gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ gang yang bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas/ rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag pos gtso byasanam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du tshe 'di nyid la yang / nad dang gdon dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing / mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'khrub par gyur cig /dge ba rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba'i nang du sangasargyasarang byung shog /sngon gyis rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgol bar shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin sa sa dang / /chas nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byen sa sadang / /dge 'dun mi byed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /cesabarjod nas/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sku gsung thugasabasrungasanas nub tha ma la/ ā+oṃ khyed kyisasems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngosagrub stsol/ /sangasargyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byan par mdzad du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mus ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ has bdag la thim par gyur/ de nas a kwa ros byang shar nas rdo rje srin 'grosasu byasate/ rdul tshon bsdus la/ las kyi rjes mi mngan par byasanas/ tshom bu lnga bkod nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyasadang / bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas shis pa brjod par bsams la me tog 'thor/rol ma'i sgra sgrogs shing mgrin gcig tu/ ā+oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba —325

me bo'ishul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakya gsung 'bum//dgaser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangasapa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyasapa 'dab 'dra'i sbyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shisadang po des kyang ding 'dir bde legs shog /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchad pa/ /chasakyi dam pa skyed dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /bkra shis gnyis pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchad pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /bkra shis gsum pa desakyang der 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang / /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang / /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa yi//gsum po des khyang deng 'dir bde legasashog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs las grol ba dang / /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legasashog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i/ /lnga po desakyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtang zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang / /bzod pa sgom bzhin brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs gyur pa'i/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang / /don yod grub ba sa rigasalnga'i —326—

gzhan phan 'od kyi lasar lo/bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bde chen rnam dag chos dbyings gang chen mtsho/ /mkha' 'gro rigs lnga ye shes sprin 'phro ba//snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i zhing / /bkra shis des khyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas/ me tog gtor la bkra shis su bya'o/ /snying pa'i rtsa rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung las/ ji ltar gsungs bzhin de yi don bsdus nas/ phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod//bdag blo dri med nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /mang du thosapa'i 'od zer stong 'phra bas/ /blo gsal pad+ma rab tu kha bye nas/ /dad ldan rnamasal las 'brel rtsal du snang / /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus bde 'gyung bde gshegs dbang pa'i gnas/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i gling du phyin gyur te//rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur shog /gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khar lo zhes bya ba/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'pha gnas kyi thugs kyi 'od zer bla'i pad+mor phog pas kha bye ba'i rnal 'thur pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis/ ston gags me tag dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ gangasari thod dkar kyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi dben gnas dam par bkod pa rdzogs so/ /bha wan tu/ bkra shis// //—327—

sa sa ge sa sa sa/'i༄7/ /phyag rgya bzha mchad 'ad kya 'bar la gnad yig bzhugs so/ /shog skya'i skor/phyag rgya bzhi marja ces bya ba/ rdo rje gar mkhan la phyag 'tshal lo /)sdo 3) skyos sa :sgo10 sdog () sa bye/ sa da la ma sa nga da 'ang lta bas sa nga / / nang mchad na 'ad ra rab 'phra bas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogasakun mnyesamadzad ma/ /marja pa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /phyag rgya'i gar gyis rgyal ba mchod pa'i phyir/ khyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud bsdus nas/ /phyi rabs don du bdag gis gsal bar bshad/ /de la dang po bye'i mchad pa lag pa byin gyis brlabasapa ni/ dzī ha dang mnyam du lag pa gnyis pusama'i steng du mthe bong nang du bkugs la bkan pa'o/ /ha ya sgyi bas mtshams gcad pa ni sdigs mdzub rgyab sprad pa'i mdzub mo gnyis sbreng /mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel nas steng 'og phyogs ma྾sa su ston pa'o/ /sum bha nis mtshams ga da pa'ang sngags tshar gcig dum bu bzhir byas pa phyogs mtshams dang / gcig phyed kyis steng / byed kyisa'og tu phyag rgya snga masam྾sa gcad do/ /yi ge brgya pa ni rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu ma go par dkrol ba'o/ /sor mo byin gyis ba7sa pa ni/ skyil krung gi steng du kho nge 'dzin ltar bkan la/ rim pas reg cing / ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ gyi.atshogapa'o/ gnas—328—

phyagargya bzhi mchod 'od kyi la ra lo' gnad yigalngar dbang bskur ba ni/ bhud+dha a bhi khiñtsa la sogs pa rim par brjod pas go rim bzhin/ thal mo sbyar ba spyi gtsug /de nyid las gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar ga bas/ mthe bong maze'u chung brkyang ba dpral bar/ de nyid lasamadzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar bkug ste/ rna ba g.yas kyi steng du/ mthe bong mthe'u chung ga bas la brkyang / gzhan rnams so sor pad 'dab rgyas pa ltar rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba rgya re ltar bsnol te/ rna ba g.yon pa'i thog tu bzhags pa'o/ /phyogs ba dus bzhi'i mchod pa yang / ar+ghaṃ la thal sbyar gyi mdzub mo gnyis dang maze bong gnyis zlum por bkug /gung mo sor bzhag /srin lag mthe'u chung nang du blta ba'o/ /pu khu tshur bkan la me tag 'thor ba bzhin no/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo dang mthe bong sbyar bas skrosarengasa'adzin pa ltar ro/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis mthe bong gnyisamar me'i sdong bu ltar sgreng ngo / /thal sbyar gyi mdzub mo gnyis dang / mthe bong gnyis zlum por bkug gzhan rnams sor bzhag nas dri'i dung chas lta bu'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha sbub la brkyang pa/ slar log ste bshas 'bul ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje se gol bsnol nas sosor gtag go /rdo rje thal mo lnga la/ 'dod yon lnga 'am me long gi phyag rgya'o/ /rig mal pad skor byas nas bsgol te nu ma g.yasagayon gyi steng du 'jog pa'o/ /dkyil 'bar sgrub mchod kyi pad+ma karma la ni me tag 'a la ba bzhin no/ /e ku sha ni rdo rje khu tshur bsdams pa las/mdzub mo g.yon brkyangs pa'i steng du/ g.yas lcags kyu ltar rtse bkug pa'o/ /pā sha hūṃ ni de nyid las zhags pa ltar mdzub mo'i rtse bkug pa'o/ /pho —329—

mesapo'i shulabazhagalas/ klong chen rab 'thumasakyi gsung 'bum//shiṭa bam̐ ni de nyid las mapreb mdzub kyi nang du gcig bcug pa lcags sgog ltar sbrel lo/ /pra be sha ho ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe bong gnyis nang du ba ga la bsdams pa'o/ /me long bstan la khrusagasol lo/ /'khar lo ni lag pa gnyis mkhrig ma bsnol te rgyab sbyar sor mo rnams bsgol te 'khrud/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du dgug go /nor bu ni thal sbyar gyi mthe bong dang /mdzub mo rin po che'i mig ltar zlum por bkug la gzhan rnams kha sbyar ba'o/ /btsun mo ni rdo rje bsdamasapa'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de sgreng ba'i logs la mdzub mo gnyis sbyar ba gcer ba'o/ /blon po ni rdo rje bsdamasapa'i gung mo mthe bong mthe'u chung rnams ga bas te sgreng / srin mdzub bsnol te rdo rje rtse gsum pa ltar bya ba'am/ khu tshur gyi mdzub mos gter ston pa lta bu'o/ /glang po ni g.yas glang pa'i sna ltar brkyangs pa'i gru mo nas g.yon pa'i lag mthil gyis bteg pa'am de gnyis go bzlog pa'o/ /rta mchog ni rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung srin gnyis brkyang mthe'u chung gnyis bsgol te maze bong gnyis rna ba ltar brkyang / mdzub mo gnyis bsgol ba'o/ /dmag dpon ni g.yon pa'i khu tshur sbubs can gyi nang nasagayas pas gong mdzub ral gri ltar bsgrengs pa'i maze bos srin mtheb mnan la ral gri shubs nas 'dun pa lta bu'o/ /gzugs ma ni g.yas pa'i thal mo phyir snying ga nas me long ltar bstan pa'am me tog 'thor ba ltar ro/ /sgra ma ni yi wang sgreng ba'am ting shag dkrol ba ltar ro/ /dri ma ni g.yon pa'i snyims pa nas g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis dri'i bye ma 'byed pa'i tshul lo/ /ro ma ni bshas 'degs pa ltar —330

phyag rgya bzhi mchod 'od kyi la ra lo'i gnad yigaro/ /reg ma ni mtheb mdzub gung srin rtse sprad mthe'u chung bsgreng la/ gosa'abul ba'i tshul lo/ /sgeg mo brgyad mchod las/ wā phya ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur brten nas g.yon du cung zad 'khyang ba'o/ /mā le ni rdo rje thal mo gnyis nang nas thur ldog g.yo bas breng ba 'dogasapa ltar ro/ /ghirti ni pi wang sgreng ba'i tshul du'o/ /narti ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi spyi bor gar byed pa'i tshul lo/ /dhu pe ni/ thal sbyar tshigs ba ga pa bdug spos kyi khang pa ltar ro/ /pa ni me tag 'thor ba'i tshul lo/ /ā lo ke ni rdo rje khu tshur gyis mthe bong gnyis mar me ltar sgreng ba'o/ /ghasmre ni sngar bstan pa'i dung chas kyi tshul lo/ /de'ang / ā+oṃ ring po ring po glur blang zhing / rgyasapa la brgyad po re re'i snga phyir tshigs ba da dang / sa twa su saṅka ha la sogasapa'i sngagasabarjod la/ 'bring la phyi sgeg bzhi la de lta bu gas/ga /nang sgeg bzhi la de lta bu gcig dang gnyis so/ /bsdusapa la chun gcig gis byed pa'o/ /sku'i rig ma ni/ thal mo snying ga nas phyir me long ltar ro/ /gsung ni rnga zlum brdung pa ltar/ g.yon pa cang zad gyen la phyogs/ g.yas pa'i sor mo g.yob pa'o/ /thugs ni pi wang sgreng ba ltar/ g.yon gyen du bsgrengs pa'i mthe bos/ gung srin mnan mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung brkyang / g.yasapa'ang de bzhin byas pas sgreng ba'o/ /yon tan ni gling bu 'a da pa ltar/ phyag rgya de nyid kha'i drung nas byed pa'o/ /phrin las ni phyag rgya de nyid snying ga nas phyir bstan la re mos kyi rnga brdung ba ltar bya'o/ /bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar g.yin brkyang pa kha bkan te/ dung chas ka pā la lta bu nas g.yas pa'i mtheb —331—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ klong chen rab 'thumasakyi ga nga 'a ma/(kasrin gyis blangs te gyen du 'thor ba'i tshul lo/ /'khril sbyor ni/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yo bas snying gar bsnol ba'o/ /bla na med pa phyag rgya chen po'i mchad pa ni/mtshan ma med pa'i nam mkha' mtshon pas pad skor cher bskyod pa'o/ /'dir bstod pa'i skabs su rdo rje dril bu'i 'jog mtshams tshig rkang pa gnyis gnyis su/ rigs lnga spyi dang thun mong gi phyag rgyasabya'o/ /de'ang pad skor g.yo bas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol nas g.yas pa'i rdo rje thal mo nang nas phyir ldog cing / phyi nas nang du ldog pas 'phred la cung zad g.yo zhing gyen du gsor ro/ /dbyangs ni khugs pa re dang stun nas/ rigs lnga so sor phyag rgya dang spel lo/ /byang chub mchag ni g.yon pa'i khu tshun du/ g.yasapa'i mdzub mo'am maze bas sgreng ba'o/ /bdud 'dul ni g.yas pa'i pus mo la rdo rje thal mo kha sbub pa'o/ /mchog sbyin ni de nyid bkan pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ni mnyam bzhag bkan pa'o/ /skyabs sbyin ni g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas snying ga nas thal mo phyir bstan pa'o/ /sgeg mo ni khu tshun dkur brten pa'o/ /phreng ba ma ni phreng ba 'dogasapa'i tshul lo/ /glu ma ni pi wang sgreng ba'o/ gar ma ni rdo rje khu tshur sbyi bor gar byed pa'o/ /gzhan bzhi ni sngar gyi bdug 1sa la sogs bzhi dang 'dra'o/ /sgo ma bzhi yang sngar gyi dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan dag ni phyag rgya med pas rigs lnga spyi dang thun mong gi dril thabs spel ba'o/ /rnam shes dgug pa ni rdo rje khu tshur las g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dang / g.yasapa'i mthe'u chung sbrel te mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug pa'o/ tan dha ni sdig pa sbyong ba ni rdo rje khu tshur pad skor du byed pa'o/ /bstem pa ni sgo ma bzhing/ /—332—

phyag rgya bzhi mchod 'od kyi la/ra lo'i gnad yigasarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ni la rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis mnyam pas mtha' bzhi rtse sprad pas mnyes pa'o/ /badz+ra ban+ta tra thā la/ rdo rje bsdams pa phral ba'o/ /ā+oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi la sogs la rdo rje khu tshur gyis spyi bo la sogs par gtugs par bsam pa'o/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la la sogs pa la sor mo rgyab sprad de me 'bar ba ltar ro/ /gtor ma ni mtheb sgyu gsum lan gsum bshams la rten la bskor ba'o/ /sreg pa ni mtheb srin gyis til lam nyung kar blangs pa rten gyi sna bug nas 'byin pa ltar byas la/ bsgol te g.yas g.yon gyi me dang chur 'dor ba'o/ /bye ma ni g.yas pas cung zad re brab pa'o/khrus ni nub dang po rnams su me long gi ngos la bkru zhing / tha mar ming byang dngos la snum bskus te bkru'o/ dze+es pa brjod pa ni ku sha'i rtses las bum nas rten la tshigs ba da kyi mtshams su chu blangs la gtor ba'o/ /sa ni sas ming byang la gtor ro/ /chu ni chus so/ /me ni mes yul ba re bya'o/ /rlung ni rlung g.yab kyis bya'o/ /phyag ni byang bu la sogs pa de nyid bu la sogs pas bzung la 'tshal ba'o/ /maṇ+ḍal ni dbus dang phyogs bzhir re re ste tshom bu lnga bkod la dbul lo/ /'jug pa dang dbang gi skabs su tshe 'das nyid yod par dmigs te/ rten de la yang dbang bskur zhing bum chus 'thor ba dang bkru'o/ /gtang rag gi skabs su snga ma'i phyag rgyas bya'o/ /de yang lus lhar gsal bas phyag rgya bya/ ngag sngags su gsal bas sngags rnams bzlas/ sems ting nge 'dzin gsal bas so so'i skabs dang bstun la bya'o/khyad par du mchod pa gang la babs pa'i lha mor bsam pa'i/ snying ga dang —333—

mesapo'i shul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()lag pa las 'od zer gyi rtse las/ mchad pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phras nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khar gyi lha la mchod par bsam mo/ /de nas bzod par gsol dus snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'o/ /bsngo ba ni thal mo snying khar sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis ni me tog 'thor zhing rol mo sgogs pas tshigasabacad re'i mtshams su brjod pa'o/ /mchod par byin dbab pa ni rol mo 'bud dkrol cher byed pa'o/ /ming byang bri ba ni/ stod du ā+o hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.ā/ na mo phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par ba sa pa'i bla ma rnams dang / zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang ba sa pa thams cad la zhes bris pa'i sor gcig gis ma reg pa'i mjug tu/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du tshe las 'das pa ming dang rus che ge zhes bya ba khyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'/ /sdig pa sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/bar da'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangasargya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /zhes jes pa'i rgyab tu ga gsabrisapa'i snying gar dṛ bris la/ skyes pa la mda' bud med la 'phang la btags pa dri gos dkyil 'khar gyi zur gcig tu gzug go /byang bu sreg dusagang rasaglo la dril te tshwa dza'i nang du gzhug cing / thal ba rdul tshon dang lhan cig 'jim pa'i gseb tu btang la tshwa tshwa btang bo/ /nub tha ma la zas mang po ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabasal/ gos lhum dang lhan cig phyogs dus kun la sogasapa'am/ rdo rje gzugs ma la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyisabastod pa tsam bya'o/ /dri gos ni bshig go /'dir de tsam lasagazhan —334—

phyag rgya bzhi mchod 'od kyi sa/ra lo'i gnad yigapa'i zas gtad med pas mi bya'o/ /dpon sgob kun kyang sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / tang nge 'dzin gcig pas/ cho ga lding shar la masprin gcig tu bya'o/ /des ni ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing chad lhag med pasakun gyi yid du 'ongs pa yin no/ /de ltar phyag rgya bzhi mchad gnad yig 'di/ /gangs ri rin chen ra ba'i skyed tshal du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gisalegs par bkod/ /dge ba de yis 'gro kun grol bar shog /bsod nams sprin gyisagazhol ba'i bla bre las/ /ye shes char chen rab tu 'bab pa yis/ /phyag rgya gar gyi glog phreng 'gran pa bzhin/ /lhan cig skye dgu'i 'dab bskyod dga' bar shog /'di 'dra'i tshul la bdag 'dra'i blo mig rgyas/ /mang po'i dbus na bzang pa'i grags dkar can/ /mkhas mchog chas rje'i mchog gi bdud rtsi las/ / legasa'ongasadon de ma 'ongasadon du bkod/ /rang bzhin sngon nas sbyangasapa'i dkyil 'khar las/ /tshe 'dir lan re thos pas 'od stong rgyas/ /gzhan phan chu skyes rab tu 'dzum pa yis/ /skal bzang rkang drug ldan rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /phyag rgya bzhi mchad ces bya ba gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khar lo'i gnad yig pad+ma las 'grel rtsal gyis/ ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //—335—

ra / /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog skya'i skor/mchad rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rin chen drwa ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi thugs rje shin tu rmad byung ba/ /dgung zla'i 'od las ches dkar rab 'phra bas/ /ma rig mun sel 'gro kun mtshan ma'i mig /thar gling snang bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugasabade legs phun tshogs kyis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lus bsgrub bya'i byer/ /mchad rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ /dri med 'od zer bzang pos snang bar byas/ /'dir rang 7 gzhan gyi don du tshwa tshwa bzheng par 'dod na/ gtang ma byin nasas blangs te/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūṃ gis rin po che'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra mu ka ra a ko tra yu hūṃ gis brkos nas 'jim par g.yos la/ de'ang tshe 'das pa'i ched yin na/rus pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khar bsams la/ de'i dbus su a dkar po las bdud rtsi babs pas sdig pa dag par mos shing rigs lnga'i sngags zlos shing / dri bzang pa'i chus bkrus pa'i mthar ā+oṃ pra mar dha na ye swā kha sgrib pa dag par bsamasal zhi par brdungs te/ 'jim pa dang bsres la/zur /ste :nge /re sa /de /ri ༷ spyor sa (bye95 sa pad zla' nga du 'a ma pa phung pa nyad bhu las ran pa 'a kung par bsams la/ skad cig gis bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsams —336—

mchod rten rab gnasarin chen drwa ba/pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer 'og min gyi rnam par snang mdzad la phog pas/de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas 'jim pa la phog pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung maze bong gis mnan nasagan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byasal kha sbub la/ ā+oṃ na mo bha ga wa te be+e ro tsa na pra bha ra dza yuḥ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar ha te saṃ myag oṃbhud+dhā ya/ tabya thā/ ā+oṃ suk+ṣa me suk+ṣa me/ samaye sam te/ shan te dharnye/ a na ya a lo bhe/ ta ram̐ bhe/ ya sho ba ti/ mahā te dza nir ku la ni ra bha ni/ sarba ta thā ga ta hrid da ya/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha na/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ zhesabadun brjod nas/ na maḥs man+ta/ bhud+dhā nan/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā yu she swā hās 'jim pa snyoms par ba da pa'i nang du/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ la sogasapa'i ga ngasagazhug ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dharma 1stu ghar+bhe ye swā hā sa gzhug go /oṃ badz+ra dzod bha wa swā hāsa'abi 'bi byas la/ā+oṃ badz+ra ā ra dze wa ra je swā hās snum bskus la/ ā+oṃ dharma —— gar+bhe ye swā hāsakol phor du bcug la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra mud ka ra a ko tra ye swā lhas kol phor brdung nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dharma ra te swā lhasaphyung la/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma kā ya ma hā su kha/ badz+ra su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis chas skur bsamasapa'i ngang las/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ bho kwa ya s+t+waṃ gyis longasaskur byon te/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma kwa ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis sprul skus sems can gyi don byed par bsams la bre mthun par bsgrigs te gdab bo/ /de dag gi mdun du mchad pa lnga dang /gtang ma gsum bshamasal/ 'khru'i sgod gnyis kyang sta gon du bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'og ma gnyis bgegs dang gzhi bdag la bsngos te bka' —337—

me bo'i shul bldan las/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/()bsgo byas la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du dmigasal mchod bstod byasal/ sgod kyi nasagacig la rigs lnga'i sngags dang / rten 'brel snying pho bzlasaso/ /de nas/ ā+o sa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swā bhā wa shud+dha ྅ha/ stong pa'i ngag lasapaṃ lasapad+ma/ a lasazla ba/ ram̐ lasanyi ma'i steng du/ d+dhi lasarin po che'i mchod rten/ gdan khri ri rab bum pa bre 'khor lo ba gsugagadugs char khebs tog dang bcas pa'i bum pa ma gtogs pa shar dkar/lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang bum pa mthing ga'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/shar du glang chen/ lhor rta mchag /nub du rma bya/ byang du shang shang gi khrilisteng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/ ā+oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hrīḥ.aḥlnga las/ rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed la/ ye shesapa gzhug dbang bskur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gisasku gsupathugs kyis byin brlabasal/ langasate me tag 'tshar zhing / phyogs ba na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongasasu gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i semasacan thams cad kyi khamasarnams mi gnasapa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa lam gzhag gi bar du/ brtan par bzhugasasu gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gsudz+wa thugasakyi rten 'di dag la yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pam byung gi bar du bzhugs nas/ gang gisamathong ba dang / thos pa dang / reg pa thamasacad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phrin lasamadzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ sa pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hwa/ ā+oṃ 1 tram̐ hriḥ.āḥ ā+oṃ ye tshi he ta pra byu wa he dme+e skusathā gto h+ya ba data/ rte rte yo t+t+waṃ 1 bye e waṃ bā dz+wa ma hā r+sha ma rte ye swā ༄je/'asnyoskre—338—

ma/de na ba gnas/de /de drwa ba/tog 'thor nas/oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rad na ke tu rā dza yā/ta thā ga ta ya/ar ha te oṃmyag sam /de ya//de thā/ā+oṃ rad ne rad ne ma hā rad ni/rad na bi dza ye swā /de bskor ba bya /de /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ba/de nas/mchod pa'i sprin phung r+ṣa por bsams te/'jig rten 'di 'am gag dag na//me /de ji snyid yod pa dang //bdag gisagusapar /demasapa 'di//mgon po srasadang ṣ+ṭhasal 'bul/ā+oṃ badz+ra stso āḥhūṃ/de bzhi du marja pa lhag ma'ang 'gres mthun par /del/'gro ba'i bla ma gcig po lum par bltams//ser skya'i grong khyer gcig tu gnasamadzad cing //yon /de rin /de bye bas brgyan pa yi//bde /degasam/de rten rnams la phyag /de lo//ma ga ta yi byang a shing gi drung //chu bo nai rañdzu ra /debya ba'i//'gram ba/desam/de rten yon /de rgya che bas//byang chub rten du gyur la phyag /de lo//ka shi ka yi wā rā na sī sa/dekyi /der lo rnam grol /de byung bas//nyon mongs sgrib kun rnam par sbyangs mdzad pa'i//ye shesamo rten bzhi la phyag /de lo//mnyan du yod par ga stobs tshar r+ṣad nas//dze snya r+ṣa du cho wīl ོ po yis//sagasum dgongs pa mchog tu bsgrubasamadzad pa//mu stegs pham mdzad mchod rten phyag /de lo//grong khyer dam pa ma/de ni gsal ldan du//lha rnams/degasate bla na med pa yi///des la /des dbang cod pan gyisam/de pa//sum /de lhasamo mo rten phyag /de lo//dge khrun dbyen bsdum snga gyur te/ston pa'i sh+ka thosarab /dem pa//rgyal /de khab kyi 'od ma'i /de//byamasapa'i 9

me po'i shul bzhagalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kamachad rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tsho'i 'du byed btang ba las/ /slar yang sku tshe byin brlabs shing / /rnam grol yangasapa can kyi tshal/ /byin rlabs mchad rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku sha'i grong du 'gro ba rnams/ /dge ba la ni sbyor mdzad cing / /'gran med gyad rnams bzung ba'i tshal/ /mchad rten myang 'das phyag 'tshal lo/ yāka thub mchad rten brgyad po dang / /phyogs bca gzhan dang gzhan rnams na/ /bzhugs pa'i mchad rten kun la 'dud/ /gzhi lartag tu spyisaphyag 'tshal/ /zhesabarjod nasame tag bkram ste/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs ba na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ /mchad rdzas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang ba sa pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gas lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la/ /thugasamakhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ /skyob pa'i nusamathu la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bzhas gnyan pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang / /thugasadam dang / /rtogs pa dang / phrin las la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing gong nas gong du 'phel bas/ 'gro ba'i don rgya ོ po 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /bdag cag chos sgrub pa po rnams kyi/ chos spyod bas sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /sbyin —340—

mchad rten rab gnasarin chen drwa ba/pa'i bdag po 'bar dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bar du gcod pa zhi nas/ ci bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad chas ldan du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang lo phyug rtag tu legasashing / phyi 'khrugs dang / nang 'khrugs dang / mtha' dmag dang / sad ser dang / mu ge dang / gnod 'tshe thamasacad med cing bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /ci bsam pa'i dngosapo thams cad chos ldan du 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes pa gsum gyis me tog 'thor ro/ /tshe 'das kyi yin na che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di'i sa dang lam gyi bar du gsad pa thams cad zhi nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gtang ma de nyid/dpa' mgon dam pa chas skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la/ a kwa ros bsngos la/rten 'di la phyi nang gi gnod pa dang 'tshe ba la sogs pa thams cad med par mdzad du gsol lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas rdo rje'i glus shes pa brjod par bsams la/ me tag 'thor zhing mgrin gcig tu/ phun sum tshogasapa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyasapad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchag rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchad pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la rtag tu zhi byed pa/ /bkra shis/dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shadag /—341—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ klong chen rab 'domasakyi gsung las/()dge 'dun dam pa chas ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha mayin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchag rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyigazhi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal ba srasab sa bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyis legs par gsungs pa dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang / /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang / /snyan pasanam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legasashog /bgegasarigasaltar phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogasalasagrol ba dang / /mthun pa 'khrub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde legasaphun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchag la nges par 'byung 'gyur pa'i/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legasashog /sbyin pa gtang zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang / /bzod pa sgom zhing rtson 'grusartsom pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lug rtogasagyur pa'i/ khrug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang / /don yod grub ba sa rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khad kyang rung / /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byamasabyed cing / /nyin dang 342—

mchad rten rab gnasarin chen drwa ba/mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā lhas brtan par byas te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs sbyad 'di la nyes byas gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rgas na 'a 'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces brjod la stan la sa/da la dga' ston bya'o/ /gangs ri'i ngos la bdud rtsi'i chu babs pas/ /yid 'ong bya tshogs mang po dga' ba ltar/ /bdag bla'i legasabashad pad+ma'i gangs can mtsho'i/ /rigs ldan skye ba'i bang pa dga' bar mdzod/ /'di ni rgyun don snying papo'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /dri med 'od zer deng sang shar ba yis/ /mkha' 'gra'i snying tag zab ma'i cha can du/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /'od gsal snying po'i de nyan legs gzigs nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /gdod ma'i gnasasu lhun gyisagrub par shog /mchod rten rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rin chen dra ba zhes bya ba pad+ma las 'brel rtsa la gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge legs so// //maṅga le/ 343—

༄7/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes dri med ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin ོ shog skya'i skor/dpal ldan ye shes 'khar lo can/ /kun bzang rigasalnga'i sangasargyasadang / /rig 'dzin rnamasal phyag 'tshal te/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bshad/ /de'ang sku ga gas zin nasarab tu gnas pa ni/ lugasam yin na stod du sangs rgyas/ bar du ྾dang dge 2na/ smad du ྾skyong dang gnod sbyin gyis gzungs ba ga /zhabs ra bsdams/ ras bris la sogasapa'i rgyab tu bris la/ bgegs bsgrad/ de bzhugasapa'i mdun du mchad pa spyoms la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsgom ste mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ 'khru la rigasalnga'i rtsa sngags dang rten 'brel snying po bzlasate/sta gon du byasanas/ skyabasasu 'gro ba dang semasabaskyed la/ su bhā wasastong shā) /rto /de zur 1dezur /ce shā / /repa ras/ na lha gang yan pa nyad dam gas lnga sangs rgyas bskyed la ye shesapa spyan drangs te/ mchad cing bstod nas bstem ste/ rigasalngas dbang bskur/ yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabasate/rab gnas kyis brtan par bzhugs pa'i tshig brjod nas/ rigasalnga'i sngags dang / rten 'brel snying pos me tag 4la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'a la ba'i tshig gisadabyangs dang bcasapa dang / mchad pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ me tog la sogs pa phyi nang gi marja pa dang / bstod —3rmā

rab tu gnasapa'i cho ga ye shes dri med/pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa dang / shis pasamanga' dbul ba ni/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po brjod do/ /de thams cad kyang rgyas par dbyangs dang / rol ma'i sgrasamanga' dbul cher byed rnam pa yin no/ /gtor ma btang nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po bya'o/ /de yang glegs bam rab tu gnasan/yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/g.yasadang po pu ti dang / g.yon dang po pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la phyogs btso sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor bar bskyed nas 'og min nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa bcug ste/dbang bskur la sogs snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /khrus chu dang / bkod ma'i chu mig rab tu gnas na/ de nyid lha'i khrus kyi rdzing bu bzang pos brgyan par bsams la/ rten 'brel snying pos me tag 'thor zhing bkra shisabarjod de/khang pa dang skyed mos tshal la'ang de bzhin ga gas pa'i gzhal med khang dang / lha'i nagasatshal bstim la/ rab tu gnas te bkra shisabarjod par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i sku ni/ de nyid kyi sngags dang bskyed chag byas nas/ sbyin sreg dang nang mchad dang / bdud rtsis mchad pas mnyes par byas la/ rab tu gnas pa ni man ngag yin no/ /'dir mdor bsdus te gsal bar bye bas legs par bstan to/ /de ltar snying tig bka' gsang rgya che las/ rdzogs pa rang byung rgyud don rab bsdus te/ phyi rabs skal ldan —345—

me po'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'doms kyi gsung 'bum/(karnams kyi don ched du/ /ye shes dri med bzang pos 'di bkod pas/ /'gro kun rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams su/ /sgrib bral rdzogs pa'i sangasargyasathob par shog /de ltar don gsal yid 'ong cho ga 'di/ /o rgyan thugs srasadri med 'od zer gyis/ /ston gsum me tag 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /gangasari thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /tshig don pad+ma'i nags tshal dga' ba 'dis/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu tshim par shog /rab tu gnasapa'i cho ga ye shes dri med ces bya ba mkha' 'gro snying tig gi rnal 'thur pa pad+ma lasa'abrel rtsal gyis/ ston ka'i dus me tog dang 'brasabu smin pa'i tshe sbyar ba rdzogs so// //—346—

da pa 1re /ce /se /bye la snar da/ /mthang snang na na ga ra dra ba bzhugs sa/ /rin ོ shog skya'i skor/mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba zhes bya ba/ dpal snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin bde gshegs kun gyi dngos/ /pad+ma rgyal zhes mngon spyod ma 'khrul pa'i/ /'gro ba'i bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrub pa'i rim pasamathong ba'i snang tshul brjod/ /de la bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi mthong snang ba dang / 'od gsal maspyo gi mthong snang gnyis las/ dang po la grub pa'i mthong snang ni/ rnal 'thur pa rab la mngan sum/ 'bring la nyamasasnang / tha ma la rmi lam du snang ste/ de yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa gang yin yang / dam can 'du bas mkha' 'gra'i rtags 'byung nges te/ mkha' 'gra'i gzugs dang sgra skad sna tshogs pas lung bstan cing / dngos grub ster ba dang / bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shesaskye ba dang / gsal snang mngon shesalta bu 'byung ba dang / gnyid 'od gsal bde ba r+ṣa por 'char ba dang / gag snang 'gyur bar nusapa dang / rang snang dga' bder 'bar ba dang / r+ṣa mongs pa chosawo du grol bar snang ba ni mngon sum dang nyams su myong ba'i snang ba'o/ /rmi lam du mchog gi rtags su shel gyi mchod rten la 'dzegs shing bskor ba byed pa dang / dkyil stobar 'dri zhing mthong ba dang / rang nyid sangs rgyas par mthong ba dang / rang gis rang gi ro khur nasaskyel ba dang / snyo khams bzang por 347—

me bo'i shul bzhagalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung las/()phyin nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phrad pa dang / sngon ma thos pa'i chos zab mo thos pa dang / bya dang ri dwags ya mtshan can mthong ba dang / nyi zla'i steng du skyil krung bca' ba dang / rtag tu nam langs shing nyi ma shar ba rmi ba dang / rdzing dang zam pa 'dzugs pa dang / bdag nyid gru'i kha lo byasate chu'i pha rol tu phyin pa rmis na/ 'khar ba las thar pa'i lam sna zin te/ ngesapar grol ba'i ltasaso/ /thun mongasal nad zhi ba'i ltas su lusalasarnag khrag thon pa dang / gdon 'thon pa'i ltas su gzhan lasargyal ba dang / sdig sgrib dag pa'i ltas su nyi zla shar ba dang / gos dkar po gon pa dang / khrusabyed pa dang / ri rtsel phyin pa dang / nam langasapa'o tshe 'phel zhing rgyasapa'i rtags su 'khru'i yung po dang / lo thog legs po dang / nyi zla shar ba'o/ khes rab rgyas pa'i rtagasasu me tag 'thu ba dang / yi ge 'apri klog dang / dkar gsum 'thung ba dang / me 'bar ba dang / nyi zla shar ba dang / ral spri rnyed pa'o/ /gragasapa rgyasapa'i rtagasasu dung 'a da pa dang /rnga brdung ba dang / dar po che phyar ba dang / kun gyisabastod pa ma'/ /nor rgyas pa'i rtags su/ rin po che'i char 'bab pa dang / gter 'khru ba dang / lo thog legs pa dang / khang bzangs longs spyod ldan pa mi'/ /stobar 'dab rgyas pa'i rtags su skye bo mang pa'i dbus na 'dug pa dang / ba glang la sogs pa mang po skyong ba rmi'o/ /'gro ba dbang du 'du pa'i rtags su bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal zhing nor la la ba dang / zhal slob dang skye bo mang pos bstod pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'dus pa'i rtags su/ bud med mang pos phyag —348—

mthong snang rin r+ṣa gser gyi dra ba/'tshal rgyan 'dogs bstod pa'o/ /dpa' bo 'dus pa'i rtags su skye bo'i tshogs dang / dmag gi tshogs 'dus te khyag 'tshal zhing nor 'bul ba rmi'o/ /bgegs drag po tshar ga da pa'i rtagasasu/ gzhan bsad cing brdung ba dang / me dpung 'bar ba dang / rgya mtsho skam pa dang / chu chen po 'phral la 'bab 'phro chad pa dang / semasacan phra mo mang po bsregs pa dang / rgyal ba'i sgra sgrogs pa rmi'o/ /ma grub pa'i rtags la bud med mtshan ma ston pa dris na/ mo rgyud ma grub pas spog pa'i las bya/ skyesapa gcer bur byung na pho rgyud 'khu bas gzir ba'i las bya/ 'a ba rtsod byed na mkha' 'gro 'khrugasapas skong bshags bya/ sprang po byung na ma bskang bas me tshogasadang gtor tshogasabya/ mje pho byung na grib yod pasakhrusadang gtsang sbra byed/ mun nag char 'thibasabyung na dam tshigasanyamasapas skong bshags bya/ nyi zla nub na tshe thung bas tshe sgrub bya/ bza' bas thob khar gzhan gyis khyer bar rmis sam gnyid sad na/ za khar 'jug pa'i bgegs la mnan pa bya/ mtshon cha chag pa dang rno med na sngagasal chad lhag byung bas gso bar bya/ rol mo la skad med pa rmis na bskyed rdzogs ma dag pas gsal la dag par gsal gdab/ ngu bred dang cho nges byed par rmis na srung ma ma mgu bsaskong bshags dang gtor tshogs bya/ gzhan gyis 'dod pa byung na/ gzhan gyi gtor tshogs kyis ma khengasapas tshogs gtor rgya ོ po gto / rang nyid kun gyi gral ga ma na 'dug pa dris na/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma 'pha pasadamigasapa rgya bskyed/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dab rdzab kyi khrod du 'dug pa rmis na —349

mesabo'i shul bzhag la / klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//shigrib yod pas khrus dang skong bshags bya/ gos ngan pa gon pa rmis na bsod nams dman pas tshogs bsag /ri nas thur du 'gro ba rmis na bar chad dang skal pa ngan pas dge spyor la 'bad cing brtson 'grus bskyed/ sa rub cing nyi zla nub pa dang / rgud pa dang / gosadamar po gon nas mchad rten dmar po la 'jegasapa dang / gcer bur bong bu la zhan pa dang / nub tu bltas nas nyams mi dga' bzhin du nyi ma nub khar 'gro ba rmis na/ 'chi rtags yin pas 'chi bslu dang tshe sgrub la 'bad par bya'o/ /'di dag ni mdo tsam ste/mdor na rmi lam gang yang sad dus shes pa mi dga' na nges par zhan la/shesapa mi bde ba med na bag chags su shes par bya'o/ /de'ang sgod la sngar 'das pa dang / bgegs kyi cho 'khrul gyi rmi lam gzhi che/ gung la bag chags dang da lta'i snang ba shas che/ tho rangasam 'ongs pa dang lhas lung ston pa'i phyir/ mngon shes kyi rnam pa dang / chas mthun pas tho rangs la brtag pa yin rgo/ /ngan pa rnams la so sa'i gnyen po rnams dang bden med kyi rtsal sbyangs pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thun mong gi mthong snang bzang ngan rnams rnal 'byar pas shesapar bya ba byer du spros pa ste/ khong du chud par bya'o/ /don gnyisapa 'od gsal mchog gi mthong snang la gnyisalas/ rang rigs pa'i mthong snang la'ang bzang po ni/ gnas lugs kyi don la sbyangs pas na/ sems can la snying rje chen po 'bad med du skye ba dang / bla ma la gdung ba mchag tu skye ba dang / 'dod yon la dgos med skye ba dang / chags sdang gi 'dzin pa je chung la 'gro ba dang / rang sems la g.yo zog gi rnam pa —350—

mthong snang rin 'a gser gyi dra ba/mi 'ag ba dang / snying nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa skye ba dang / blo sna btsan thabasasu thung la skyo shas gting nas skye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi snang ba sgyu mar mthong ba dang / snang srid slob dpon du 'cha ba dang / ci byasagazhan la phan pa dang / kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang / dad mosargyun chad med pa dang /nyon mongs pa chas nyid du 'char ba dang / chos min gyi bsam pa rgyud la mi 'byung ba dang / /bde gsal mi rtog pa rang babs su skye ba dang / gang shar rang grol du mthong ba dang / the tshom gyi 'dzin pa mi skye ba dang / bla ma'i gdamasangag la yid ches skye ba dang / chos kyi tshig don sngar mi shesapa rgyud la 'char ba dang / thamasacad blo bral du shesapa la sogs pa'o/ ngan pa ni nyamasasu blangs pa'i tshe na/ de dag las ldog pa rgyud la 'char zhing / khyad par du gnasadang yul dang / gnyen bzhasal chagasasdang skye zhing / rdzasadang yo byad la sogasagang rung la/ chagasazhen je cher gyur pa dang / dug lnga je rags la song bas mthun mjug dang / chags sdang 'bad med 'byung ba dang / gcig pur 'dug kyang sems nyon mongs pasagayengasashing bya byed 'du 'dzi la dga' ba dang / bla ma'i gdams ngag la yid mi ches pasaspros4sa kyi dge sbyor la gtso bor 'don pa dang / blo sna mang zhing rnam rtog je rags la 'gro ba dang / dgag sgrub dang 'gyur ldog mang zhing 'grogasatshad chos min la 'god pa dang / kha lta nyams len 'dzol bsasems la rdul tsam yang ma phan pa la sogs te/ mdor na chas dang mi mthun pa kun la rang gnas shing gzhan yang 'god pa rnams so/ /de dag la bla ma dam pa btsal —35/

mesabo'i shulabs las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'a ma/(kanasanyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gang 'gyur brten nas/ rang sems 'dul ba mchag tu zab bo/ /gnyis pa 'od lnga phyi'i mthong snang ni/ lusangag yid gsum gyi gnad rnams legs par gcun te bsgoms pas thig le stong pa'i sgron ma maspeb mdzub kyi rtsol ba dang bral yang / snang dus nang du gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa gnyisa'od du song bas zhabar ba'i 'ching ba las grol te/ rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i don khong du chud pa'i ltas so/ /de dus shi yang skye ba gnyis nas sangs rgya'o/ /de nas dbyingasarnam par dag pa'i sgon ma smin mtshams nas bral te 'od lnga'i snang ba dum bu la khru gang tsam pa kha dog lnga ldan gyi nang 'od zlum mu khyud ris mar por snang dus/ nang du ye shes kyi snang bas dug lnga dang sgo lnga'i 'dab 'od du song bas 'khor 'das rgyab gyes te bye ma mngal gyi grong khyer du mi 'jug pa'i rtags so/ /de dus shi yang sprul skur skye bas 'gro drug tu mi skye'o/ /de'ang mngon dga' la sogs par rdzus te skye/lo lnga brgya na sangs rgya ba'o/ /de nas 'od lnga'i snang ba gyen la 'greng ba dang /rtsibs shar dang / mdung rtse dang / mda' lta bu dang / re lde tsam du snang dusan/ nang du sprul pa'i zhing gi bag chags 'dzin pa'i rtsa bdun gyi rtsa gnyis re 'od du song bas dbyings rig 'dus te bar dor sangs rgya ba'o/ /de'ang snang ba'i 'od gsal mdun ngos tsam par gzhal yas khang par shar ba'i gnad kyis so/ /de'ang de dus shi na bar do gsum pa lhun grub la grol lo/ /dbyengs snang la rin po che'i dra ba dra byed dang / mig mangs ris dang / mig tshags lta bu dang / za 'og ber khyim dang / mchad rten dang / lcags kyu dang /—352—

mthong snang rin za gser gyi dra ba/mdung rtse dang / mda' dang / nya mig gi rnam pa lta bu shar dus nang du longs sku'i cha 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa'i rtsa lnga brgya 'od du song bas ye shes bzhi sbyor gyi snang ba la sangs rgyas te srid pa'i bar do med do/ /de'ang chos nyid las srid pa'i bar do rang log ste/ dbyings kyi rgyan rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbyings snang gis lung pa 'gags pa ni/ nang du sgrib byed gnyis snang gi rtsa bzhi brgya 'od du song ste/ rnam rtog yul gyi zhen pa dang bral bas 'di dusashi yang / /zung 'jug gi snang ba la sangs rgyas pa'i rtags so/ /dbyings rig nyin mtshan med par 'dres te snang dus/ nang du sku gsum snang tshul gyi rten 'brel byed pa'i rtsa sum stong 'od du song bas 'od gsal gyi snang ba la sangs rgya'o/ /de'ang 'khar 'das gnyis su med par grol ba'i gnad kyisaso/ de dag gi tshe thig le yang sran ma'i rdog po tsam las bse phub tsam gyi bar du 'phel lo/ /de'i tshe lus la gnyer ma med cing zas skom mi dgos pa dang / rang snang las 'bral mi phod pa dang / bar snang la 'gro ba dang /'khrul pa'i gtam mi 'byung ba'o/ /de nas thig le re re'i nang du rigs lnga'i sku rkyang pa re shar ba dang / yab yum zung 'brel du shar dus/ phung po 'od gsal du grol dus/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa med pas skye shi las 'das te/nang rtsa ma lus pa 'od du song nasardos bcas su mi snang bar chu'i zla ba lta bur snang ngo / /de dus sku gsum gyi zhen pa 'ad de/ longasasku'i shing la da lta spyod pa'o/ /de'ang longasasku'i zhing la gnyis te/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / gnas skabs rnal 'byor pa'i zhing ngo / /sangs rgyasakyi zhing ni —353—

me pa'i shul bldan la / klong 7 rab stemasakyi gsung 'bum/()sangs rgyas nasalongs skur bzhengs dus na'o/ /rnal 'thur pa la gnyis las/ tshad du phyin pa mngon sum gyis snang ba nas/ gong 'phel gyi snang ba rdzogasapa tshun chad do/ /phyin pa ni rig pa tshad phebasate/ 'di dag la longasasku'i zhing nyul ba zhes bya ste gong nas gong du 'gro zhing sangs rgyas kyi sar brtan pa thob dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas nas longs sku'i zhing brtan pa zhes bya ste/ mi 'gyur zhing mthar thug pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas 'od kyi nang na lag sor bkram pa tsam lasami mngon pas na phyi nang gi 'khrul snang zad de/sems can gyi don du 'pho ba'i skur pad+ma lta bur 'byung zhing kha cig gdod ma'i sar grol nas sprul pas don mdzad pa'o/ /de'ang phyi snang ba'i 'od gsal las/ nang rigs pa'i 'od gsal 'byangs te/ gsang ba chasanyid kyi 'od gsal du grol bar byed pas na chosatshul 'di ni kun las khyad par 'phags so/ /e ma ho/ yang gsang snying po mkha' 'gro snying tig las/ /mthong snang sna tshogs gser gyi dra ba can/ /gang gisagoms shing bsgrubs las mngan du snang / /'di yang rang rig gomasapa'i cho 'khrul tsam/ /snang srid sgod bas dag dang ma dag kun/ /grib ma gzugs la shar ba chasanyid dang / /'od gsal gdangs lasaso sor snang na yang / /rang byung ye shes ga gsagazhan 'pho 'gyur med/ /dag dang ma dag grim ma ji bzhin yang / /gdod ma'i ngang las shar der mtha' yang grol/ /'khor 'das snang rtags shin tu dag pa'i tshe/ /gdod ma'i sar phyin rmi lam sad pa 'dra/ /bzang ngan gnyisamed mnyam rdzogs blo bde 'o/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying —354—

mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba/de'i mgul/ /yo rgyan rdzong du dhi med 'od zer gyis/ /phyi rabasadon du snang bar byas pa yin/ /mthong snang rin chen gser gyi dra ba rdzogs so// //dge'o// //—355

༄/ /rdo rje g.yu sgon ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /rin ོ shog 'dra/rdo rje g.yu sgon ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ sgob dpon ོ po pad+ma ཿnga gnas la phyag 'ar+ṣa lo/ /yid bzhi re ba kun khrub cing / /'dod dgu'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /ye shes mtsho sa la ba de/ /rdo rje g.yu sgon sgrub thabs spyod/ /'di la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /phyi ltar sman ba.oṃ mo lnga la/ /nang ltar yid 'ongasalha mo lnga/ /gsang bar mkha' 'gro lnga yin pas/ /sku gsung thugasayin 'di ltar bsgrub/ /dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gangs ri྾/ /(nge (sde/skye ge (pe snyo shā) paranags spang da mas tshal/ /da na nyamasadag gnasanyad du/ /ma9 pad+ma 'dab bsnyo steng/ /sman lo skyags dang me long mda'/ /dar sna lngas brgyan gas par bya/ /mtha' skor dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / /me tog la sogs mo pa spyoms/ /de nas rang nyid skad cig gis/ /pad+ma ཿnga gnas bsgom byas la/ /mdun du gangs ri skyed mos ྾/ /dbusan rin ོ khang bzang ste/ /de nang rin ོ khri steng du/ /rdo rje g.yu sgon dkar gsal ni/ /dar dkar na bza' gser g.yus brgyan/ /phyag g.yas yid bzhi nor bu ste/ /g.yon du dngul dkar me long 'dzin/ /sa sna (pe sa 13 h+phu /phyo sa sna /sbo sa snadar thad lang nga rgyan can/ / ma ba sa da krung 'ad ra 'phra/ /356

rdo rje gaku sgron ma'i sgrub sa sazla ba 'dod la /phyogs bzhir mched bzhi gtso mo 'dra/ /kun kyang bcu drug na tshod la/ /sgeg mdzes dgyes pa'i tshul du bsgom/ /snying ga'i 'od zer rab 'phras pas /gnam sman gangs ri lha yi gnas/ /sprin dkar dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstem/ dngosadang yid kyisamachad byasal/ /sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas par bya/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hring hring swā hā/ /bdag nyid pad+ma'i 'od zer ni/ /phog pasade dag sku gsung thugs/ /dgyes pas rin chen char 'apebs shing / /'dod dgu'i bsam pa bsgrub par bsam/ /rjes la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi/ /gtor ma 'khru gsum byin brlabs la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha bha li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga 'am bdun gyisadabul/ /bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya/ /rdo rje g.yu sgon shin tu mjes pa'i sku/ /dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar 'dra/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchag stsal mdzad/ /mched lnga zhabar dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan lnga snga /ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mdzod la/ rnal 'thur bdag la dgyesapa'i zhal bzang ston/ /ba la pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /cesabarjod dgyes pas don 'grub bsam/ /thun mtshams spyod lam ci bder bya/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis/ /rmi lam sngar bas 'gyur zhing dga'/ /bud med 'du dang zas ster dang / /phyag dang bskor ba byed pa rmi/ /dngos grub zas nor sprin bzhin 'du/khyad par bud med bzang mo dang / /yul mi mang po 'du ba yin/ /'dod don —357—

mesabo'i shul bzhagalas/ klong chen rab 'byamasakya gsung 'bum/( kathun mong dngos grub thob/ /de ni phyi ltar sgrub pa'o/ lja/ rgya rgya rgya// //gnyis pa nang ltar sgrub pa ni/ /gnas dang dkyil 'khar sngon bzhin te/ khyad par za 'og khug ma sa khel dang byi ru g.yu chung gzhug /bla rdo lha mo mched lnga ni/ /dmar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams/ /dar zab rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /byed krung 'dzum bcas 'od zer 'phra/ /tshangasapa lha yi 'jig rten nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstem/ /mchod dang bstod pasamanyesabyas la/ /bdag nyid nyi ma 'od zer gyi/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyisabaskul ba yis/ /'jig rten skye bo zasanor ba sa/ /skad cig dbang gis sdud par bsam/ /ā+oṃ hrī badz+ra pra mo ha hring hring sdus sdus a kar sha ya khug dzaḥ/ sgom dang bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /stong gsum 'od dmar gcig gyur nas/ /rang la thim zhing 'dus par bsam/ /lha mo mched lnga'i 'od zer las/ /sprul pa'i lha mo dpag med 'phras/ /thams cad dbang bsdus bkug par bsam/ khyad par gang dmigs bsgrub bya ni/ /skad gaXg bkug nasadabang gyur bsam/ /rjes la ci 'byar gtang mas mchad/ /bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya/ /tshangs pa lha yi 'jig rten na/ /lha mo me tag man dhā ra/ /dpag med lha yi bstod pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum dbang mdzad pa mo/ /mchad cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ji ltar bdag gis bsams pa bzhin/ /'dod dgu'i re ba 'grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod thun mtshams ci bder gnas/ /rmi lam skye bo dpag med 'du/ /nyi zla'i steng gnas lha yul 'gro/ /bud med 'du dang gter 'don rmi/ /dngos su gang dmigasadabang du —358—

rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabasazla ba 'dod 'jo/'du/ /kun gyi yid 'phrag skye bo 'du/ /dbang gi dngos grub rgya chen thob/ /de ni nang ltar sgrub pa'o/ zhi/ rgya rgya rgya// //gsum pa gsang bar sgrub pa ni/ /dben zhing yid dang rjes mthun par/ /maṇ+ḍal 'dab bzhi dkar ser dmar/ /ljang dang lte ba mthing ga'i steng / /thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng / /me long chas 'byung sum brtsegs nang / /hrī ha ri ni sa lo ka sarba sirnyi pha la khug dzaḥ zhes pa dang ni phyi rol la/ /yul dang skye ba'i spel tshig bri/ /de nyid mkha' 'gro lngar bskyed de/ /hrīX lasadabus su ḍā ki ma/ /dmar nag spyi gtsug rin chen tog /phag zhal mche gtsigasag ra bu la/ /g.yas g.yon spri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rus pasabargyan/ khrid mo kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshan pa la/ /phyogasabazhir ha ri ni sa las/ /gtso mo 'dra ba'i zhabar bskyed do/ /kun gyi snying khar pad zla dang / /nyi steng hrīḥdamar tsheg drag can/ /ha ri ni sasabaskor ba las/ /'od zer 'phra ba bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng ni/ /mthing nag 'jigs pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'og min ye shes bkug la bstem/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchad/ /sngagasa'adi ma yengs bzlas par bya/ /ā+oṃ hrī ha ri ni sa 'o/ ka sirnyi a kar+ṣa ya khug khug sdus sdus dza dza tsit+ta hring hring / bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' 'gro la phog bskul ma thag /mkha' 'gra'i 'od zer rab 'phras pas/ /'jig rten skye ba'i zas nor dang / /gang dmigs bsgrub bya bkug par bsam/ /yang cig 'phrasapa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'dzam gling khyam khyam mer mer la/ /rgyal po la —359—

mes po'i shul bzhag la / 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum//dasogs bkug par bsam/ /yang cig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha' rgya mtsho rnga lngags la/ khor yug rnga chen gcig gyur pa/ /nyi zla'i rnga yog gis brdungs pas/ /bdag gi grags pa'i rnga sgra yis/ /'jig rten gsum po kun gragasanas/ /g.yo ldeg med zhing khyom pa yis/ /bdag gi dbang du 'dusapar bsam/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin ma yengs pas/ /zhag bdun bar du bsgrub par bya/ /rmi lam khrom du skye bos bstod/ /zas nor char 'bab mkha' la 'gro/ /gter dang rin chen rnyed pa dang / dung 'bud rnga chen brdung ba rmi/ /dngos su 'gro kun dbang du 'du/ /che btsun thams cad 'du ba dang / /zas sgor gter ni rdol ba bzhin/ /phyogs rnamasakun nas 'du ba yin/ /de ltar grub pa'i rtags byung nas/ /me long yi ge bdud rtsisabakru/ /thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po 'od du zhu/ /thod pa'i nang thim dmigs nas ni/ /bdag nyid bas bas dngos grub thob/ /gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /sgom dang bzlasapa tsam gyis ni/ /thams cad 'du zhing zas nor 'phel/ /ci bsam 'grub dang chasa'aphel lo/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig tu/ /chagasazhen mi bya sbyin par gtang / /bla ma la gusadam tshig bsrung / /rig pa ngar bskyed brtal zhugs bya/ /gas mo sbar zhing bde stong bsgom/ /desani myur du 'grub pa yin/lgargya sbyo sbyod// //yang gsang bla na med pa 'di/ /rang nyid pad+ma'i thugasaka sa /hrī dang ha ri ni sa las/ /mthing nag bde chen phag mo ni/ /phag zhal gcig ste sbyan —360—

rdo rje g.yu sgon ma'i sgrub thabasazla ba 'dod 'jo/gsum bsgrad/ /spri gug thod pa ka ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /gar byed 'od zer dpag med 'phra/ /phyogs bzhir de 'dra'i 'khar bzhi bsams/ /kun gyi thugs ka'i nyi zla las/ hrī dang ha ri ni bsabasam/ /de la pa da 'phros sna da nga bsdus/ /slar 'dus snying ga'i hrī la thim/ /steng 'og rlung ni kha sbyar te/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin las/ khyad par sna bug g.yas pa nas/ /rlang ni lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /thams cad 'od zhu tshun 'dus nas/ /sna bug g.yon nas snying gar thim/ /lus khengs bde dang stong par bsgom/ /rjes la chas kun rang gi sems/ /sems nyid ye stong spros dang bral/ /ma skyes nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /mi bsgom mi bskyed rang sar gzhag /mnyam nyid ye shes gdod ma'i ngang / /rtsa ba bral ba'i rang bshin du/ /ye shes rlab gis mthar phyin te/ /bde chen sa la mya ngan 'das/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ /mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob/ /snga ma gsum ni bskyed pa ste/ /thun mong dngos grub char bzhin 'bab/ /de ltar bsgom shes rnal 'byar la/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa kun/ /ji ltar bskyed rim bsgoms kyang 'dra/ /snying pa'i rdzogs rim kha lo bas/ /legasabasgyur thar pa'i grong du 'gro/ /gawa yang stobar 'das mnyam pa nyid/ /ji ltar bsgoms kyang blo las 'das/ /de ltar rtogs te stobar bar grol/ /de phyir rdo rje g.yu sgon gyi/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim gnyis kyi/ /thar lam 'bras bur rab sbyin pas/ /skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /shin tu yang zab mkha' 'gra'i gnad/ /bde chen dngos grub gnyis stsal ba/ /de 'dra rgyal sras pad+ma'i —36/—

mesapo'i shul ba las/ klong chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/ (kalugs/ /gang de dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gcig tu bsdus pa zab mo'i don/ /ston gsum gangasari thod dkar sa /legs sbyar dge bsa'agro ba kun/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /'di ni rtsa gnas 'bar lo las/ /yi ge bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /skal bzang don du gsal bar byas/ /gnad 'dis myur du 'grub pa yin/ /dpal rdo rje g.yu sgon ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhesabya ba/ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'thur pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// dge'o// // 362—

༄7/ /gza' bdud gsang sgrub bzhugs so/ /rin ོ shog 'dra/gza' bdud rā hu la'i gsang sgrub dug gi sbu gri zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma ཿnga gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag gakha mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku/ /che mchag ste ru ka dpal la/ /bco de zab masargyab brten du/ /reg chod dug gi spu gri n+d+ra/ /'di la rdzas dmigs sngags gnad gsum/ /rdzas ni pha wang long bu yi/ /ngos bzhir tri bzhi ra khrag bris/ /gser gangul zangs lcags gzi rnying dang / /bde gshegs ring bsrel bcas pa ni/ /'bar lo rtsibasabazhi mu khyud bcas/ /rtsibs la hūṃ bzhi mu khyud la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍamahā ro ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mos gza' rgod brtod la non par gyur cig swā hā/ zhesapris lte bar rang ming dang / khrub par gyur /bye /bye /gri 1de rtsari sa sna —7/bye sa sna sa sna /kyeg sa pa / / lta' 'khar la byas la/ /'khar la dar nag la la bcangs/ /des ni 'tshe dogs mi byed cing / /lus dang grib ma bzhi du 'brang / /de nasabrag nag 'jigs pa'i sar/ /4nga shul sa blangs 'khrub khung bca'/ /ro sol byugs par ling ga ni/ /dgra gzugs dpral bar de yi rus/ /snying gar ming bris g.yas g.yon du/ /ka ta s+t+waṃ ste bha ya mu kha haṃ yā/zhes bris pra tshil gril la gzhug /bshasabu dgu skor nang du yang / /ling ga ra khrag bris la gzhug /de nyid 'khrub khung steng du gzhag /dmar gtor khrag snasabargyan par bya/ /de la gza' yi gzugs brisagazug /de nas rang —363—

mesabo'i shul bzhag las/ 1nga chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/(kanyid skad cig gis/ /ye shes gza' mchog dud kha la/ /dbu dgu g.yas gsum dkar ljang la/ /g.yon gsum dmar ljang dbusam gsum/ /mthing nag du ba'i rnam pa la/ /spyi gtsug sgra gsan bya rog gdong / /phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon dang po na/ /chu srin zhags pa ral spri bsnams/ /'og mas mda' gzhu rgyab tu 'gengs/ /smad sbrul mig gis lus khengs bsgoms/ /thugs ka'i k+ṣa nag 'od 'phras pas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs ka nas/ /ye shes gza' mchog sbyan drangs bstem/ /mdun gyi brub khung nam mkha' la/ /gza' bdud chen po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /nam mkha' gang bar sngar bzhin bsgom/ /thun par dka' na tshon gang bsgom/ /hrī shag ru ram̐ na ga cit+ta tram̐/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha hi/ yo ge sha la dza dzaḥ/ zer/ de ltar 'bod sngags nyer gnyis kyis/ khrid phyogs ye shes spyan drangs bstim/ /dmar gtor ling ga bcas pa de/ /dgra bor bsam la sngags de la/ /bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags la dbul bar bya/ /de nas sngags rgod nyer gnyis pa/ /zhag 'dun bar du bzlasapar bya/ /de tshe ban+dhe a tsa ra/ /dngosasam rmi lam nyid du 'ong / /thag 'tsheg 'od 'byung sgo brdung sogs/ /cho 'khrul sna tshogs ci byung yang / /sems yin sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /gdod nas skye med ngang la gzhag /'jigasasgrag mi bya bsgom bzlasabya/ /de nas zhag ni bcu bzhi sa /dgra bo yod na gsod sngags bzlas/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka hrī shag ru re/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha he ke sha la che ge mo'i snying la rbad dza dza/ zhes bzlas dgra bo bsad dang gzir/ /rdul phran cha shas tsam med —364—

gza' bdud gsang sgrub/par/ /gza' mchag khros pas zos par bsam/ /de ltar zhag grangs nyer gcig tu/ /lta ba ma yengs sgom bzlas baphyon/ /thang ltod med par bsgrim lte bsgrub/ /de yis su yin pha rol sgol/ /ji ltar 'gor yang zla ba gcig /nges par 'grub par gdon mi za/ /de nas las sbyor bstan pa ni/ /dgu stong nyi ma nub mtshalas la/ /rang kha lho nub mtshams bltas la/ /skyer pa se ba gru gsum du/ /'khrub khung steng rtsig gza' bskyed la/ /me sbar ling ga sbyin bsreg bya/ /gtor ma dbul zhing gtor zor 'phangs/ /thal ba rgya gram 'og tu mnan/ /gnas de rang gi gzhi yin na/ /sgrub pa thon pa'i shul de sa /bong dug thar nu spyang tsher dang / /gu gul nag pos 'khrub khung bkru/ /rtsi sman sna tshogs bsresapa'i sa/ /rin po che yi bsres byugs la/ /'khrub khung nang du bcug la gzhag /de yis dug phyung bkra shisaso/ /g.yin gnas las kyi rjes bsdu'o/ /yang gcig brtod la gnon pa ni/ /sbrul dang ra rog sha khrag dang / /nya sha ra tshil pha wang rdo/ /rta nag ra nag khye nag gi /snying khrag dkar gsum rtsi sman bcas/ /rta nag thod pa'i nang du gzhug /rta thod maṇ+ḍal gra ru gzhag /des ni brtod la non par 'gyur/ /yang cig shi sa bstan pa ni/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā to ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ na te pa ti kha dza ke beng ru ru gyi mi sha ya ā+oṃ/myags thum ril rbad yā/ rang sgog rang gis gcod pa'i tshul/ /las rnams 'khrub par the tshom med/ /skabs su bzlasapas myur du 'khrub/ /yang cig zhung kha blang ba ni/ /zhung de rtags med dam nyams na/ /bskang bshags mchod pa dag gis mchad/ /'o ma rtsi sman gu gul dkar/ /ra mchin til —365—

mesapo'i shulabaldan la / klong r+ṣa rab 'domasakyi gsung 'bum/()nag phud kyis mchad/ /des ni myur du 'grub pa yin/ /'jig rten mchad cing bstod pas 'grub/ /de phyir bskang gso mchad gtor ni/ /dus gar+sā brgyad dang rgyun du bya/ khyad par nyi shu dgu la 'o/ /desani the tshom med par 'grub/ /rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung gnasakyis/ /phyogs bzhi'i zab gter chen po bzhi/ /yang zab gza' yi gsang sgrub sbas/ /de dag kun gyi yang zab gnad/ /chig dril dug gi sgru gri ni/ dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ /phyi rabs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /ji ltar bdag gis sgrub pa yi/ /gnad rnams bcud kyi snying po dril/ /'di bsazab pa gzhan med pas/ /gsang zhing sba bsab nga bar bya/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag 'dis/ /bdag gi zab gter bsrung bar shog /gza' bdud rā hu la'i gsang sgrub/ /dug gi sbu gri zhesabya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ /ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /—3⑪—

༄/ /drang sgong gi bstod pa'o/ /de nas drang sgong chen po la bstod pa 'di gsungs so/ /hrīḥ khyab mjug r+ṣa po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /'jigs pa'i lusal 'bar ba'i 1nga / /'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can/ /sprul pa ོ po mi bsrun pa/ /gnam lcags thog gi bdag po ste/ /skyin thang ser ba 'bebs pa'i gtso/ /drang sgong ོ po rdzuḥl can/ /ri rab steng du lha yi gtso/ /rgya ma0 steng du klu yi bdag /bar snang khams su bskyod tsa na/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams dang bsdongs/ /lus gcig mgo dgu srid gsum gtso/ /mgo gcig lha srin khros pa'i zhal/ /nyi ma zla ba grib masaganon/ /gcig ni bzhad cing dgod pa'i zhal/ /dgyes pas bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ /gcig ni khros pa srin pa'i gdong / /gdugs pa'i dgra bgegasazas su za/ /gcig ni rngam zhing za byed gdong / /gnam lcagasame yi thogasar+ṣa 'bebs/ /gcig ni 'jigasabyed ma rungs pa/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i skan sgra sgogs/ /gcig ni 'khrugs byed 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /g.yo 'gyul chen po'i ser ba 'bebs/ /gcig ni gas byed ye shes zhal/ /mngon shes nus mthu thogs med ston/ /spyog ni las rnams rdzu'aphrul gdong / /sangasargyasabastan pa srung bar byed/ /spyog /de/de spyor sa sna sa sna /ste shā〉sa sna /des sa sna ོ ba lha ya zhal/ /sgrub pa pa la dngasagrub ra/ khyad chasaskyang po ste/ /steng gi phyogs na bya rog zhal/ /dkon marga dbu 'phang bstod par —367—

me po'i shulabazhag la / klong ོ rab 'domasakyi gsung la ma/(kabyed/ /rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams pa ni/ /sdang byed dgra bo sgol ba'i rtags/ /chu srin zhags pa bsnams pa ni/ /sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul ba'i rtags/ /sku la mig gis gang ba ni/ /phyogs bcur bstan pa skyong ba'i rtags/ khyod ni bdud 'dul chen po ste/ dpal ldan mgon pa'i las mkhan mchag /re ma ti yi pho nya che/ /e ka tsa ti'i bka' sdod de/ /he ru ka yi sprul pa nyid/ /rdo rje 'asang gis dbang bskur nas/ /dkyil ga ra bcag cing dam la btags/ /sring mo gdong mo mched bzhin ba sa/ /ging kang rngam pa'i las byed ma/ /cho 'phrul 'gyed cing bstan pa bsrungs/ /bha ling gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa bzhag pa'i dgra bo la/ /thog ser dbab pa'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /ba la pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ khes gsungasaso/ /'di khrag mtsho khol ma'i rgyud nasadrang sgong ོ po la bstod pa gsungs pa rdzogs so// //gza' sgrub pa'i gnad yig /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di sgrub pa'i gnad yig ni/ /gdams ngag gnad thems shin tu gces/ /rdzasagand dmigs gnad sngags gnad do/ /rdzasani blo rdo man ngag bzhin/ /dmigs pa rang nyid rā hu la/ /'jigasapa'i thugs ka k+ṣa nag las/ /'od 'phras phyogs bas sangs rgyas kyang/ /thugs ka nyid nas ye shes kyi/ /gza' bdud spyan drangs bdag la bstem/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khrub khung dbus/ /gza' bdud tshon gang gzhung bzhin bskyed/ /'bod sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa yis/ (1 ba'i phyogs nas gza' byung nas/ /de nyid la ni —368—

drang sgong gi bstod pa/thim par bsam/ /gtor ma dbul zhing thun rdzas mchod/ /bstod nas 'bod sngags zhag bdun bzlas/ /hrī shag ru ram̐/ nā ga tsit+ta tram̐/ ma ma yong za/'gram ha hi/ yo gi sha la dza dzaḥ de ltar bzlasapasadangos su 'ongs/ /gang 'dod bcal la 'jigs mi bya/ /de nas bsad sngagasabazlas pa ni/ /dmigs pa sngar bzhin 'bod sngags bzlas/ /gtor mchad bstod rjes 'di bzlas so/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka hrī shag ru re/ ma ma yong za/ 'gram ha hi kā la dza dzaḥ de ltar zhag bdun bar du bsgrubs/ /de nasasngar bzhin gtor ma'i rjes/ /bsad sngags ming dang spel la bsgrub/ /de ltar zhag grangs nyi shu gcig /song rjes ling ga bsregs pa yi/ /thal ba mnan la gtor zor 'phangs/ /des ni the tshom med pa yin/ khren tu gsang nas bsgrub pa gces/ /1nga chen rab 'byamasabadag gis ni/ /gter kha du ma'i gnad mthong zhing / /bla ma'i man ngag bas dril nas/ /skal ldan don du bris pa yin/ /gnad 'di gzhan la ma bstan cig /zab/ 3)ཿ rgya rgya rgyaḥ—369—

༄7/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs so/ / shog 'dra'i skor/dngos grub kun gyi rin ོ gakho/ /pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 2da/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa me rma 'khyil ba bshad/ /'di la sgrub pa'i rim pa mang yang / brten na bkra shisal/ rbad na mthu che ba dril sgrub gsang ba yang gsang yin pas/ de la rten bca' ba/ bsgrub par bya ba/ las phran tshegasabastan pa gsum las/ dang po ni rang gi sgrub khang du stegs bu mda' gang 'khrub khung dang ba sapa'i zur bzhir/ 'om bu'i mda' bzhi la za 'og dang / bya rgod kyi sgo can/ dar sna dang rin po che sna tshogasapa mgul du btag pa gzugs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi nam mkhar 'dzin gtor 1da dang zas sna dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i nang du/ 'khor dang 'byar pa spel cig /bgegasadang bar chad srungasashig /'gal byed cham la phob cig /ces pa gser gyis bris te gzhug /de la gnod spyon gyi tsa kali ga gas/ /de nyid rgyun du mi gshegs par gzhag go /'phral gtang ci rigs pa mardzo gyi zur du spyom mo/ khyun du mi 'bral ba blo sto man ngag la/ dar dmar po'am shog gu la gnod sbyin gyi gzugs bris pa'i lto bar mu khyud rim pa bzhir bskor ba'i phyi ma la/ mthu ser gyi dngos grub stsol cig /bye 1depar /stes sna (sazur ches/bye sa rtegri (de/ris/ 'a nang ma la nar zas gsum ta (〈a〉 )pha la ha / 'a —370—

gnad sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'phyi pa/nang ma la 'khar lo rtsibs brgyad la/ e ste ma ru ce dgra bgegs thams cad sha spyo mā ra ya phaṭa bri/ lte ba la drag pa'i dngos grub dang / mi nor zasagasum gyi dngos grub rtsol cig bris pa'i dbus su k+ta dang / hrī kha sprad pa mtshal gyis gzab mar pri/ dri bzang dang sman sna byugasal/ rdo pha wang long bu'i ngos drug gi gsum la hrī gsum/ gsum la k+ṣa gsum brisate/ rab gnas byas nas spril te zangs khab dang ba sa pa dar dmar pos gril ba la tshon skud sna lngas re re dkris te/ bya pho mtshang lu'i snying nang du ba ga pa de phyir khug tu bcug la lus la ba nga ngo / des ni snying nye bkra shis zas nor dang zhabar 'dab 'phel/ ci bgo ba nyan/ lus dang sprib ma ltar 'ong ngo /gnyisapa sgrub pa ni/ sngon 'gro bdag nyid lhar gsal bas/ dngos gzhi gnod sbyin bskyed cing sngags bzlas pa/ rjes bstod bskul bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni rang nyid pad+ma drag sgrub gang rung du bsgoms nas thugs sngags ci 'grub bzlas so/ /dngos gzhi ni mdun gyi bar snang la gnod sbyin dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zangs kyi bya khyung dmar po ba bas pa/phyag g.yas kyi dang po ral gri/ 'og ma gri gug /g.yon dang po dgra snying dang bdud zhags/ 'og ma bhan+ta khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brjes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa/thal chen dang zhag gi tshom bu can/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhig stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pasasmad dkris pa/ me'i tshwa tshwa dang thog ser 'phra ba/gdong mo bzhi dang lha srin sde brgyad dang / sha za stong gis bskor bar —371—

mesapo'i shulabs lag klong ོ rab gomasakyigasung 'bum/()bsams la/ tshil chen gyi dud pa btang / thod rnga dang rol mo dkrol nas/mai bh+yo/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du/ /bsad khrag rba 1nga dkyil 'khar nas/ /gnod sbyin phung byed mthu rtsal can//chibs su zangs kyi bya khyung ba bas/ /'bar du sha za stong gis bskor/ /gnod sbyin chen po sku bskyod cig shan pa dmar nag dam la shog /e he rma ru tse bhu na hri tri/ mai bh+yo sha re bh+yo/ phu ru dza gh+ri ga /ha la 'gran ta ya dzaḥdza/zhesapa nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ lto phyogs kyi dur khrod nas/ rten bskyed pa de la thogs med du phyon nas thim par bsams la/ sngags de'i mthar bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags pa bdun gyis gtor ma 4la nas/sgog gi snying po bzlasapa ni/ e haṃ shaṃ tri haṃ rtsal tri ra rga sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ nā ga rā dza kro ta ni/ tri kha thun tri la thun a bhi shu nā ga rā dza dzaX dzaX/ tri kha thun bh+yo/ dgra bgegasamā ra ya rbad/ ces ci 'grub bzlasarjes bstod bskul bya ba ni/ gtor ma sngar bzhin phul la rol mo dbyangasadang ba sa pas 'di skad do/ /e he rma ru tse bh+yo/ gling bzhi srid pa'i pho brang nas/ phung byed dmar nag gshegs su gsol/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga sa /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhesapa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po gshegasasu gsol/ /phyag dang zhabasaganyisabasil mdzad la/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang ba sa pa la/ /dwangasaba'i yid kyis phyag 'phro zhin / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad bshags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ /dgyes pa'i zhal bzang 372—

gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me snang 'khyilab/dus 'dir ston/ /bcal pa'i lasarnams 'grub par mdzod/ /cesamachad bstod bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig mtshams bcad de bsgrubasapas/dngos sam rmi lam du rol mo'i sgra dang / 'od dang skye bo mang po 'du ba dang /dpon skya dang / zhang blon dang / dge bzhesadang / ban bon gyi tshogasarnamasabadag la 'dud pa dang / nor dang 'khru'i gter rnyed pa ni 'grub pa'i rtagasaso/ /sngon du sgrub pa'i las 'di kho na gal che'/ /phyis nas gang 'dod pa 'khrub pa yin pas sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa lasaphran tshegasasgrub pa la/ dgra bsad pa dang / ngag mnan pa dang / ser ba dbab pa dang /cho 'phrul gtang ba dang / sri'u gso ba/ nor sgrub pa dang drug las/ dang po bsad pa ni/ brag dmar gyi phug pa la sogasapar/ sastegasamada' gang gru gsum pa ro sal gyisabyugs par/ dgra ba'i ling ga brisate/ dzasamatha' bskor nas/ dgug gzhug bya ste/ khyi thod lcags kyi 'khar khang du bsamasapar ba ga nas/ bdag dang gnod sbyin gyi sgom bzlasasngar dang 'dra ba las/sngagasani/ e he rma ru tse/ lhu na hrī tri/ bye bh+yo/ sha re bh+yo/ phu ru dza gh+rig /ha la'agran ta ya/ gyen ta rbad sod/ su ru snying tse/ a pa lam̐ che ge mo mā ra ya sod/ra rgyug sgog la rgyug tan la rngam/ dbugasal rngubs/ khrag la 'jibs/tsig tsig sgog la ye yam̐/ zhesabazlas nas/ bstod ba'i rjesal/ gnod sbyin chen po ma ru ngasapa/ sha za khrag 'thung stong gisabaskor/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung ba sa/ /dgra ba'i steng du da rgyug cig /rbad kyang phrin las mi byed na/ /dam tshig nyamasapar mi 'gyur ram/ /da dung dgra bo mi gsod —373—

me po'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung la ma/()na/ /gnod sbyin khyod la ci byung gi /da lta nyid du sod la shog sha zo khrag 'thung snying rtsa phyung / /bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /ces rbad la/bsad sngags de lcags bye zangs bye rdo bye nyung nag dug sna'i thun dang bsdebs la/ ling ga brab pas/ rdul phran du song bar bsam mo/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubasapasarmi lam du don snying 'byin pa dang / lings byed pa dang / shing ga da pa la sogasapa rmis dus grub pas/ /ling ga mtshon gyisagatu sa la me nang du gnod sbyin bskyod pa'i zhal du phul nas thal ba lam rgya gram gyi 'og tu mnan pas/ las zla ba mi 'khyangasabar 'grub bo/ /de ltar byas kyang ma grub na/ /gnad la dbab pa ni/ gnod sbyin gyi gzugasasgog sngags dang ba sa pa bris te/ dgug gzhug byas nas/ te lo 'am/ phag thod du ba ga la/ rang gi mal 'og tu dong gru gsum brus pa'i nang ro sol byugs/ro thal bting nas thod pa de gzhag /satshon sna lngas steng g.yogs/ rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i g.yam pas kha ba da la/ dong lcags khang du bsamasapas gnod sbyin bka' nyan par bsam zhing / rang nyid lhar gsal bas drag sngags bzlas pas/ dgra rtagasabyung ba dang / thod pa phyung la sku btan te 'o masabakrus la bzod par gsol te/ lasasbyor byas pasa'agrub bo/ /desakyang ma grub na/ sngags kyi sgrom bya ba ni/ ā+oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / he bh+yo rma ru tse ghu na trī tri tsit+ta hring hring dza/ zhes bzlas pasartags byung ba dang / e he rma ru tse ghu na hrī tri/ rgyu bh+yo shaṃ re bh+yo/ phu ru dza gh+rig ltar pa 'gran ta yā/ gyin ta rbad sod/ su ru snying tse/ a pa lo mā ra ya sod/ sarba sha t+t+waṃ che ge mo mār ya rbad/—374—

gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rma la/lapa/ces sngar gyi bsad sngags kyis brab la/ sgog gnon gyi lasabyas pas mi 'grub mi srid do/ /ngag gnon ni dug shog la dgra'i ling ga lce lto bar drangs pa'i dbusasu rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i rwa bzhi la/ ā+oṃ nan/ ā nan/ hūṃ nan/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ lte bar dṛ bri/ lce'i tha mar che ge ma'i lus ngag yid gsum s+t+waṃ bha ya nan n+d+ras te/ dug khrag gis byugs la dgug bshugs byas la/ skud pa phyir bkal gyi tshon skud kyisadakris te/ khyi thod dam lkugs pa'i thod par bag la/ dug sna dang / nyung nag gi thun gyis brab cing / rtsa sngags kyi sham du/ ā+oṃ lo dṛ dza/ dgra bo che ge ma'i lusangag yid gsum s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ a lo dṛ dza hūṃ lo dṛ dza/ nā ga sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ cesabazlasate/ nyin mo thun gyis brab/ mtshan mo rang gi mal 'og tu dong gru gsum brusapar ba ga nas ro g.yam gyis kha bcad la zhag gsum bsgrub nas/ ling ga mal 'og nas phyung ste tshwa tshwa nag pa'i zhabs su bcug nas lha khang rnyings pa'i zem 'og tu mnan bas/ dgra'i nus pa nyams/ ngag lkugs kho rang gi byad kha kho rang la log nas brlag par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sngags pa nang 'gras na bya'o/ /ser ba dbab pa ni/ 'khrub khung gru gsum du/ ro sol dang / thal chen byugasal/ ra dmar rgya'am wa thod du mu zi nag po/ ltags bye/ dngul rdo/ nyung nag sngo sna/ ser srung gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i ming brisapa rnamasabacug la/ mun par mtshams bcad nas thun gyisabrab cing / e bh+yo rma ru tse/ ghu na hrī tri/ phroṃ r+ghaṃ bh+yo shaṃ ril su ru phroṃ/ gh+rig hril gh+ran ta phroṃ/ gyin ta su snga a pa la phroṃ/ re ram̐ tri thun/ phroṃ nyig hril rmar stag ling shar lding bh+yo/—375—

me bo'i shulabasalas/ klong chen rab 'amasakyi gsung 'bum//da'ur ba phroṃ phroṃ seng 'ur/ dkar thog ling / dkar bran bas /gal bun bun longs/ kwa la kā la/ baṃ hril thil/ shar shar phob ya/ zhesabazlasashing rtagasam byung gi bar du bsgrub/ de nas/ ā+oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / he bh+yo/ e rma ru tse/ 1 na hrī tri/ rak+ṣa ba sha kha rag dun tri/ tha tri du mā ra ya/ rag sha kha 'dar u thā ༄gzir gzir yā/ lo thog sngon po drongs/ pi yi shar shar/ kha drag rtsadamar po lang lang / sbur ya/ dam nyamasayul du re ram̐/ rilaril/ phrom phrom/ ging kang drag tu phob ya/ srin pho mo long / khyug khyug /'ur 'ur/ hril hril/ shar shar/ bh+yo bh+yo/ phob phob/ cesabazlasapas/ skam 'khrug glog dmar sgrub khang du 'byung zhing rmi lam du rtsasam brnga ba dang / gnam sa 'pho 'gyur byed pa dang / 'ja' 'od 'a la ba dang / nyi zla lhungasapa la sogasapa 'ong ngo / /de nas thun dong gi thod pas nam mkha' ma mthong bar byasal/dgra'i 'ong sa dang ri zur dang / yul lha'i rten yod sar thun re sbas nas/dus gnyan la ser thun 'ong bar 'phangs/ gtang ma btang nas/ sbyo gnod spyin chen po drag rtsal can/ /sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad/ /srin mo gdong mo mched bzhin ba sa/ /gi kang snga ma'i las mdzad kun/ /dam nyamasayul du keng kang phob/ /gnod sbyin chen po zor ba'i gdong / /dusal bab bo sam ya/ /dgra ba'i lo thog drungasanasaphyung / /thog ser sdang ba'i dgra la phob/ /'khru dang sngo rnamasabs bsdus la/ /rnal 'thur sgrub mtshogabadag la stsal/ ces rbad cing dul mo brdabasapasade'i mod la 'bab nges so/ /cho 'khrul gtang ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi ga gsaspra tshil la las byas—376—

gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sa pa ste rlung 'khyilapa/pa'i mgo la srin bya'i sgo gzug /snying khar dgra'i ling ga la/ khyim du ltas ngan sna tshogs dang / spyo 'bog thong zhig ces pa bris la gzhug /de wa'i thod par ba ga la/ e bh+yo ma ru tse/ ra rgyug sham rgyug /'khrul ting ling ka ni/ dha ma dzu ti su tri mun tri/ tre+e myo kya/ sha ma bu tri/ shad shad bh+yo/ ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la thong / zhesabazlas pa zhag lngar bsgrubs nas/ dgra pa'i grong mthong ba'i ri zur du sbasate/ sa dmar spar gang gtan la/ grong 'dir mi 'di'i khyim du song zhig khesalam bstan pas/ 'od dang / me stag dang / rdo char dang / spyo 'bog dang / khang pa rdib pa la sogs pa yong ngo / babasabyed na thod pa nasaling ga btan nas1sa chus bkru'o/ /sri 'u gso ba ni/ ma bu'i mal gyi steng du rten gtang la/ mda' 'ug sgo ma'i mgul du gnod sbyin gyi sku dang dar leb rgan btags pa btsugs nas phul/ bstod bskul byas nas/bu chung 'di srungasashig bya zhing / gnod sbyin gyi sku n+d+rasanas/ rtsa sngagasabrisate dril nasabu chung la btags/ rdzasabasrung la/ gla rtsi shing kun/ mu zi nag po/ za 'og /spyang brun/ bdud rtsi/ stag gi sder mo/ bya rog gi mgo /ske tshe/brag dreg /rgya tshil/ thal chen/ shi sgra/ sgog skya/ sle shes/ ba spru/ rta bon pa/byi la'i brun rnams rta chil dang bsres la/ bye ma'i thum po lusal btags/bu chung nyan na de rnarmas kyi dud pas bdug /dus bzang la gtor ma btang bas sos ngesaso/ /nor sgrub pa ni/ sgrub khang du maṇ+ḍal dmar po zla gam kyi steng du/ gtang ma sgrub thabs bzhin bshams/ dar dmar la gnod sbyin gyi sku zhal ga ga phyag gnyis byed skyil can/ g.yasalcagasakyu/ g.yon ne'u le —377—
