me bo'i shulabazhagal / 1nga chen rab 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum/()'dzin pa/ dar zab dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis sprasapa/ pad+ma dang bum pa'i steng na dmar gsal khro 'jum du bzhugs pa bris pa'i rgyab tu rtsa sngags la mi nor zas gsum gyi dngosagrub stsal cig bris pa'i nang du/ rdo pha wang long bu la gser ram pad+ma rak+tas tri drug bris pa la/ rab gnas byas pa de dar zab kyis spril la thod pa mtshan ldan 'khru dang rin po ches bkang ba/ de'i nang du bzhag pa de dkyil 'khar gyi steng du zangs gzhong du gzhug la mchod pasamatha' bskor te/ rang nyid pad+ma'i bsgom bzlasabyas rjes/ thod pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bsam pa'i nang du gnod sbyin bris pa ltar bskyed la ye shes pa bstem/ gtan ma btang / bstod pa byasanas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ lasa'od 'phras/ gnod sbyin gyi thugs ka'i hrī la phog pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi nor longs spyod thams cad bsdus par bsam la e he bh+yo rma ru tse/ rad na si ti (〈a〉sidha)dza/ ghu na hri hri/ rad na si ti (〈a〉sidha)hūṃ/ rgyu bh+yo/ shaṃ rad na si ti dza hūṃ/ su ru si ti dza hūṃ/ su ru si ti (〈a〉sirnyi)dza/ ṅghag si ti hūṃ/ gh+ra na ta rad na si ti(〈a〉sirnyi) dza/gyin ta a tri je si ti (〈a〉sirnyi) dza hūṃ/ a pa lam/ pa shaṃ ku ru si ti (〈a〉sirnyi)hūṃ dza/ zhesabazlas pas/ rin po che'i char babasapa dang /nor rnyed pa dang / khrom 'du ba dang / rnga brdung ba dang / /dung 'a da pa dang /'khru dang longs spyod sdud pa ming/ de nas/ e bh+yo rma ru tse a tri dṛ dza/ si ti (〈a〉sirnya)zab ma'i gdams pa bdud rtsi'i sman dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso ba'i mchag yin pas/ khyud la brten cing legs par —378—

gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'a lapa/goms pa yis/ /da lta nyid nas klong du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /pha la rad na kha te hūṃ dza/ 'gyul 'gyul ma ma hring hring / ma ma kha shi baṃ/ a kar sha ya dza/ a kar sha ya hring / mi 'gram khyogs/ mi snying sgul/ dṛ sgog rtsa bring bring / sum̐ rile/ ye ye/ yid kyi dbang po khug dza/ mi nor zas gsum bdag gi dbang du bsdus shig /ces pa zhag bdun bzlas pas/ 'khar dang 'thur ba phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rten gyi bla rdo de lus la gdags so/ /'du ba sang na bla rdo brdar cing / me'i nang du gnod sbyin bsams te sbyin sreg bya/ gtor ma btang nas/ bh+yo byang phyogs gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag /zhal gnyig phyag gnyis mdzesapa'i sku/ /chings su bya rgyal khyung la ba bas/ /sku mdog dmar po 'od zer can/ /rin chen sna stogs rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag g.yas lcagasakyus zas nor 'gyugs/ /phyag g.yon ne+e'i lesazas nor ster/ /sa ra du gnod sbyin stong gis bskor/ /gter bdag 'bar dang ba sa pa la/ /mchod tshogs bha ling gtor ma 'a la/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus/ /zas nor longs spyod char du phob/ /ci bas 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu/ /zhes rol mo dang ba sa pa byas pas bsam pa 'grub bo/ /de ltar gnod sbyin dmar nag sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa gsal bar bshad des bsod nams kyis/ /ma lus re ba yid bzhin rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /yon tan 'thur ba mtha' yas yongs gang shog /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi gsang sgrub me rlung 'khyil pa zhes bya ba/ rnal 'thur pa dri med 'od zer gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //bkra shis/—379—

༄7/ shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so/ /shog 'dra'i skor/shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub dug mda' nag mo zhes bya ba/ 'jigs pa'i ma mo 'a ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ shan pa skrug nag mi bsrun ma/ /sgra yi lan bus nam mkha' khyab/ /sgol ging chen mo la bco de/ /de yi gsang sgrub bshad par bya/ /brag nag srin mo khrosa'adra 'am/ /nags rong mon mo khrosa'adra bar/ /stegs bu khru gang la sogasapar/ /ro sol dug khrag chag chag gdab/ /dbus su gru gsum mu khyud dmar/ /phyi rim rtsibs bzhi mthing nag ste/ /de phyir thod phreng rdo rje'i phreng / /sgo dang rta babasaldan par pri/ /de mtha' me ri 'bar ba 'o/ /steng du khamasasa'i dgra ga gas kyi/ /snying gar ling ga bas pa'i steng / /ma ma'i dpal gtan zur gsum la/ /dgra yi ling ga gzugasapar bya/ /dpral bar rusal snying gar ming / /'doms su bla dwags brisapa yi/ /tha ma bsad pa'i sngagasakyisabaskor/ /gzhan yang bla ma chasaskyong dang / /yul lha gzhi bdag gtang ma bsham/ /de nasastong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /gnam sa mi dmigs mun pas 'khrigs/ /'jigs pa'i lcagasakhang sgo med du/ /me yi 'od stong 'bar ba'i gnas/ /dgra bgegs mi thar btson dong gsal/ rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /'jigs byed khro ba'i dkyil zhabar bsam/ /mdun gyi dkyil zhabar 'jigs pa sa /gsod byed nag mo chu gri bsnams/ /glo snying zhal gsol 380

shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i gsang byub/khrag 'dzag cing / spyan gsum ral pas gnam sa khyab/ /mche gtsigs mtshon cha'i mi 'od 'phra/ /srid pa'i rlung zhan nad rims gtang / /sma ra dmar ser 'bar bar bsgom/ /g.yas na sha za lce spyang gdong / /ro la zhan nasadagra snying za/ g.yon na nag mo wa gdong ma/ phyag gnyisazhagasapa gri gug thogs/ /mdun na nag mo 'ug gdong ste/ /rgyab na srid pa'i sha za 'a ma/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs zor 'phen bsam/ /thun ni nyung nag gri khrag gis/ /ling ga brab pasam mo yis/ /dgra bo bsang par bsam nasani/ /sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas shing brab/ /ā+oṃ khyi kha le nag mosasod/ sgog ma tri sod/ snying kha khya (〈a〉kha) 2/ ya ya sod/ tsa wa bi ri mu sod gha ya sod/ ṇi ya sod/ rasmo tsit+ta rbad/ de ltar zhag bdun song rjesal/ /rtags ni dgra la sna tshogs 'byung / /de nas sngags de'i mjug de la/ /rag mo rag mo ma gzir nan/ khams khug drongs che ge ma'i tsit+ta la rbad sod ya/ de bzlas rang la tshig pa za/ /rmugs dang rgyag snying 'dod pa dang / /rmi lam bud med mtshan ma ston/ /de tshe 'og ma gcig pu bzla/ /de nasaglo snying mgo khyer nas/ /lan gsum byung dus gtan zor 'phangs/ /'khrub khung tsher ma'i me sbar la/ /ma mo 'khar bcas kha gdangs bskyed/ /ling ga dgra dngos bsams la 'bul/ /de yis the tshom med par 'grub/ /gal te 'gyangs shing rtags med na/ /'bod rbad mtha' nas ldog byas la/ /bsad sngags drag (〈a〉btags)la bsgrub par bya/ /sod mosanag le kha khyi ā+oṃ/ sgog ma tri sod/ snying kha kha bhe/ ya yā sod/ tsa ba bi ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ ṇi ya —381—

mesapo'i shul bas las/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kasod/ rag mo tsit+ta rbad rbad tsi mo rag /sarba tsa che ge mo sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya rbad/de yis nges par 'grub pa yin/ /des kyang 'grub par ma gyure na/ /'bod rbad mgo ga ma ldog pa la/ /bsad sngags rbad sngags btags la bsgrub/ /de yis the tshom med pa yin/ /gzhan yang 'grub par dka' ba na/ u ne+e.u ne+e hūṃ phaṭa/ de ni sngagasakyi mgor btagasashing / myagasathum ral rbad/ a a/i sī/ u lha/ 'di ni sham bu btags la bzlas/ /de yisagasod cing cho 'khrul 'byung / /rtsaba'i sgrub thabasabastan pa'o/ /de yi gnad yig ni/ rdzasagand na chung nal phrug gam/ lug nag bya nag snying nang du/ dur khrod rasal 'khar lo bri/ /rtsibasabargyad mu khyud gsum pa la/ /rtsibasal rtsa sngagasabri bar bya/ /mu khyud ma mo'i spyi sngagasabri/ /lte bar ma bh+yo gzab tu pri/ /rgya tu rten 'khrul snying po bri/ /rab gnas byasal lus la bcangs/ /skabasasu klad la bskor zhing brdab/ /de yisabran bzhin lasabyed 'gyur/ /dusagand rgyu dus bstan pa ni/ /tshes gcig skya rengasadang po nas/ /nyi shar yan go gtso mo rgyu/ /'byung ba shing gi khamasayin no/ /nyi ma drosanasawo byed bar/ /g.yasakyi sgog gcod rgyu dusate/ /'byung ba me yi khamasayin no/ /sprib chung lhags nas bya gdang bar/ /g.yon gyi srog ga da rgyu dus te/ /'byung ba lcagasakyi khams yin no/ /sasgod nam byed thun chad la/ /mdunagyi sgog gcod rgyu dus te/ /'byung ba chu yi khamasayin no/ /nyi shar byed yol sa sgosanas/ /nam byed yol dus rnams su ni/ /gtso 'khor srung mar bcas pa rgyu/ /'ag ba sa yi khams yin no/ khams ga da gnad yig bstan pa ni/ /382—

shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub/sgrub dus 'khrub khung ling ga la/ /rang nyid tshes gcig gtso ma'i dus/ khreng lasagrub pa'i gtso mor bskyed/ /ling ga shing gi phur pas mnan/ dgra bo dgug gzhug ling ga sa/ tanar phyogs kha bltas rtsa sngags mthar/ /che ge ma'i sgog las mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ rag mo ṇi sha ku ru lu sum̐ rbad/ rag mo kha la tsa thun bh+yo/ rak+ta thun rbad/ tsa la tsa la thun bh+yo/ rtsa tsit+ta rbad/ snying la dun/rag mo kha la tsa thun bh+yo/ ti tha baṃ ril sa ma ya thun bh+yo/ dgra ba'i sgog la mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ zhes bzlas shing gi phur pa gdab/ g.yas kyi ma mo rgyu dus su/ /rang nyid me lasam ma'i sku/ /ling ga lcags su bskyed byasate/ khrag pa'i me 'gal thun gyis brab/ /thun sngags ram du bsgyur la bzlas/ /g.yon gyi ma mo rgyu dusasu/ /rang nyid lcags kyi ma mor bskyed/ /ling ga shing las grub par bskyed/ /mi bsad mtshon lcags drag thun gdab/ /thun sngags sum̐ du bsgyur la bzlas/ /mdun gyi ma mo rgyu dus su/ /rang nyid chu yi ma mor bsgom/ /ling ga me lasagrub par bskyed/ /drag thun dug chus brab par bya/ /thun sngagasabaṃ du bsgyur la bzlas/ /dusagazhan rnams su gzhung bzhin bya/ khyu ba'i phyogasadang badzin pa sa kha lta / na zor ma chad gces/ dgra bo'i khamasade rgyus yod na/ khyun du de yi gshed thun brab/ khyu dus lus sprid skyi zing 'jigs/ /nges pa'i dus yin bsnyun par bya/ /mo ma'i ga sngags ga ra la gtad/ /gnad kyi yang snying mthar thug yin/ /cho 'phrul gnad yig bstan pa ni/ /ma tram̐ snying khar brub khung ba 'a/ /dbus su gtan ma ling ga gzhag tana'am snying ngam rus pa la/ /phung sakhrag sbyar lce spyang —383—

ste tsho shul bsal / klong 'a rab 'amasakyi gsung la ma/()mgo /dmar mo lag na ltasangan ni/ /spre'u lug pa la sogs thogs/ /de yi snying khar k+ta yi ge /tha mar ltasangan thong zhig bri/ /ga na rje wa gdong nag mo yi/ /gzugasabya snying khar yi ge bri/ /sgog ga da sha za nag mo ni/ /'ug gdong yi ge phyag mtshan 'dra/ /ma tram̐ mgo zur gnod sbyin mo/ /g.yas zur gshin rje g.yon zur du/ /bdud ma'i gzugasagazhag gtang ma'i rtser/ /lha ma'i gzugs bris ga gas par bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la 'di btagasabazlas/ /he tsa dun po ba la/ de bzlasarang la cho 'phrul 'ongs/ /de nasam tram̐ lha dang gzugs/ /dgra yod phyogs su kha bsgyur la/ /rgyab nasathun gyisabrab bya zhing / /gang la rbad sngagasabatagasabyasanas/ /'di la 'di btagasabazlas pa bya/ che ge mo tsa he dang phaṭa ya/ zhes bzlasabaskur zhing sngags kyisagazir/ gal te ma nyan sdog la bzlas/ des ni dgra la ltasangan ni/ /ji ltar rbad pa de ltar 'ongs/ /snga ma'i las mjug mnan pa ni/ /sgrub pa thon dus sngar brtsams pa'i/ /ling ga sbyin sreg gong bzhin bya/ /thun gyis ling ga 'khrub khung gzhug /drag pa'i thun brab g.yam pasabakab/ /klu yi thebs dusaling ga dang / dri chen drod ma yal ba dang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum sbal nag khrag /payi ga'u kha sbyar ni/ /dgra ba'i khams gshed kha dog can/ /de nang rdzas dang sdig pa gzhug /ga 'u'i steng la rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram lte bar che ge nan/ /rwa bzhin ā+oṃ nan āḥnan dang / /hūṃ nan s+t+waṃ bha nan n+d+ras la/pha wang brun dang dme pho'i chus/ khyugs la dgra bo'i khams de brtags/ /shing khams yin na klu gnas sar/ /mnan zhing sa tshon sna lngasabaskor/ /me 384—

shan pa sgog sgrub nag ma'igasang sgrub/khams yin na chu mig rtsar/ /sakhamasashing gcig drung du mnan/ /chu khamasas gnyan sba bar bya/ /de ltar mnan pa'i 'brasabu ni/ /rab la mnan dusade ru 'chi/ /'bring la zla ba gcig yin te/ /tha ma zla ba gsum na nges/ /phyi dusazla ba bzhi ngesayin/ /de tshe rtagasani ma byung na/ /sader lha 'dre med pas na/ /sgrub pa mi dgos thun drug go /lan gsum bskyar la mnan par bya/ /de yang gnyan sa gsum bzhin bya/ /de yis the tshom med par 'grub/ /dang po sgrub pa gcig thems nas/ /rtag tu sgrub pa byed mi dgos/ /nyin zhag phrugs gcig thun drug ni/ /byas nas mnan pa gcig pus 'grub/ /'di ltar dang po sgrub pa de/ /lan cig grub nas nam dgos dus/ /nyin zhag gcig gisathun drug 'bad/ las mjug mnan pas 'grub pa yin/ /de yang klu gnyan gnas sa ni/ /nges par dgosapasade ru byed/ /de yisamyur du 'grub par yin/ /sgrub par byed pa'i dusasu yang / /skabs su dmar gtor btang byasal/ /'jigasapa'i skul 'dis bskul bar bya/ /bh+yo mkha' 'gro nag mo mi bsrun ma/ sha za khrag mig srin ma'i gdong / /'jigasapa'i ga gsacan mkha' 'gra'i gtso/ /sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /phyag na gsod pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /chi sasu srid pa'i rlung la ba bas/ /ral pa mtshon cha sha ra ra/ /gcer bu mi lngagasastod la dkris/ /mi yi glo snying zhal du ni/ /dmar mo khrag 'dzag rgyun du gsol/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag kyu ru snga /spyan gsum khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /sma ra mtshon cha me ltar 'bar/ shangs nas 'gos ma mtshon char 'gyed/ /ba sgru mtshon cha me ltar —385—

me tsho shul bzhagal / klong ོ rab krumasakyi gsung khrum/()'bar/ /mi mgo rlan pa'i do shal can/ /gsod byed ma mo chen mo la/ /dgra ba'i sha khrag gtor ma 'a la/ /g.yas na gsod byed sha za mo/ /dmar mo sha za ce spyang gdong / /ro la zhan nasasha la za/ /rkan brdab dgra ba'i mig 'bras 'khrul/ /lcags sder mtshon chasadagra snying 'byin/ /dmar mo khrag 'dzag zhal du gsol/ /g.yon na nag mo wa yi gdong / /pa skru mtshon cha sbu gri'i so/ /reg pa tsam gyisamago lus bregs/ /phyag na zhags pa spri gug thogs/ /lus chings sgog rtsa dmar po rja/ sha za khrag 'grung keng rus mur/ /mdun na sgog gcod sha za stong / /nag mo 'ug gdong gnam lcagasasder/ khrag gi ral pa mtshon cha'i sder/ /mtshon sder dgra yi snying la 'debs/ /gnam lcags mchu yis sgog rtsa gsad/ /skad cig stong gsum sal byed ma/ /rkan rdeb srid gsum snying khrag 'khrul/ /stong gsum za zhing srid gsum 'thung / sha za khrag 'grung la ma gyisabaskor/ sha za dpon g.yog stobar dang bcas/ /'dir byon nag mo lasamakhan ma/ /dgra ba'i sha khrag gtang ma 'a la/ /dgra bo sgol ba'i dusal babs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /dam nyamasasha zo khrag la 'thung / /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /zhesapas bstod cing bskul bar bya/ /skabs su mo rgyud gnad 'bebasabazlas/ kha the mu kha the/ ma rag sha khu/ ma ril ma ril ma mo sbyo/ 'dis ni mo rgyud las la khol/ /zhag re brgya rtsa bzlasapasa'agrub/ /kun gyi zab don gnad dril nas/ /dug mda' nag mo gtan la phabs/ /e ma snying tig gsang ba'i bka'/ /yang zab bsrung ba'i don byed —386—

shan pa n+d+ragasgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub/du/ shan pa nag ma'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /ston gsum gangasari thod dkar du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ /dge bas bstan pa 'phel bar shog shan pa sgog sgrub nag ma'i sgrub thabs dug mda' nag mo zhes bya ba/pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul a rgyan rdzong du bkod pa rdzogs so/ /bha wan+tu// //—387—

ra༅/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gi them byang dpag bsam ljon shing bzhugs pa lags so/ /them byang dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba/ dpal don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /yon kha phrin las 'dod ster rol pa can/ /rang byung ོ po pad+ma ཿnga gnas la/ /bdag gag dus rnams kun tu phyag klel lo/ /de yi yum ོ mkhar ོ mtsho rgyal ni/ /rdo rje phag mo sangasargyasakun kyi dngos/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya ma7 tshogs 4sa la/ /dus rnams kun tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab ci che ོ ོ ོ khri snyi ོོ sang rgya dkar shag sdang pa la/ /gdams da nga pa shag 'dra' yal 'dab rgyas/ /yang zab shog ser me r+sā 'bras bu can/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig dngos grub ljon shing spro/ /de la dbang gi ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /sngon 'gro yid chesakhungs btsun shes bya'i phyir/ /gter 'byung lo rgyus rin chen sgon me dang / /nyams sa sdig sgrib dam gho skong dang ni/ /dngos grub kun ཿnga mkha' 'astse brda dbang dang / /dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin mas bla ma'i dbang / /rgyud la smin grol nus pa khrug phyir te/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang snang srid chos skur 'char/ /mkha' 'askru don dbang dngos grub chu bo khrub/ /rdo rje slob dpon gas phan phrin lasamaspyo /bstan pa'i sgog shing skyag phyir gag bka' dang / /gto rgya'i byen sas spyog nas —388—

me bo'i shulabasal / klong chen rab 'amasakyi gsung 'bum/()gcig tu brgyud/ /bka' bsgosam sring dam can las la khol/ /de yi cha lag legs par bstan pa yang / /rang nyid dbang dang gdams pa dag bya'i phyir/ /bdag 'jug pad+ma 1nga yangasabazang po dang / /lag len bstan phyir tshogs mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs ldan/ /de ltar ma dgu bu ni rnam pa drug /rtsa ba'i sde tshan rnam pa bzhir bsdus pas/ /rin chen dbang gi phreng ba legasapar tshang / /de dag rnamasani zab cing rgya che bas/ /rin chen dkar shog ngosal legs par mnan/ /bka' yi rgyas btab phyi rabs don du bstan/ /smin cing grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs te/ /de yi gdams ngag ma bu'i grangasabastan pa/ /gsang sngags zab mo byin rlabs bla ma'i lam/ /de phyir gsol 'debasadri med zla rgyas dang / /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnam pa gnyisasu bstan/ /lam la 'jug pa'ang rim pasabaslab pa'i phyir/ khrid du bsdebs te nyams su blang ba ni/ /dang po'i babs tshul cig char 'jug pa'i phyir/ /nor bu'i lugs te phreng ba rtsar brgyusa'adra/ /skal ldan skyesabu khrid tshang gcig thob pas/ /mkha' spyod grol phyir nyi zla gza' skar lugs/ /de dag rim pa mi 'gyur gzer gdab phyir/ /zab mo rab 'byed don gyi drungasasu bstan/ /ji ltar khrid tshul rab tu rgyasapa ni/ /rin chen gser phreng skal ldan snying pa'i bas/ /dbang khrid sngon du tshogs chen rdzogs bya'i byer/ /rig pa khyad par can gyi tshogs bsags dang / /de ltar ma gsum bu ni rnam pa bzhig/ /rim bgrod khrid kyi yi ge tshang bar bstan/ /'di dag yang zab gnad de dkon pas na/ /rin —389—

mkha' 'gro yang tag gi zem byang dpag bsam ljon shing /chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par btab/ /dbang khrid dag gi rgyab chos bstan pa ni/ /stong pa khrigs chad chos sku lam khyer dang / /snang ba thod rgal gzugs sku lam du byed/ /de dag cha rkyen zab don sna tshogs gsum/ /so sor bye nas go rim nges pa'i don/ /dum dang ma bu'i grangs su bstan pa lags/ khregs chad rgyab yig nam mkha' skor gsum las/ /nam mkha' rab 'thumasalta ba bya rtsol med/ /nam mkha' 1nga yangs sgom pa blo las 'das/ /nam mkha' dri med spyod pa blang dor med/ /gdod ma'i ngang du gnyis med la bzla 'o/ /thod rgal rgyab yig 'od gsal gnad bzhi la/ /gser gyi sgom bus gnad rnams mdor dril zhing / /rin chen mdzod kyi dbye ba rgyas par bshad/ rgya mtsho sprin gyis shin tu rgya che ba/ /rnam grangs ma lus yongs su rdzogs par bstan/ / ga bsdusadon nyi 7 'od ra yang yod/ de yi bogs 'byin gnad bsdus gces pa'i 'gag /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan snying dang 'dra/ /de ltar ma dang bu gnyis sde tshan bdun/ /rin chen shog skyar bkod nasasnang bar byas/ /de dag kun gyi snying po'i bas phyung ba/ /zab ma'i yang zab mkha' 'gro snying gi snying / /snying la babs pas/snying gi khrag lta bu/ tadan tu yang zab bstan par phangs na yang / /mkha' 'gra'i bkas gnang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /phyi rabs 'ga' tsam 'byung ches lung bstan pas/ /de yi don phyir ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ khen tu spros pa med pa'i gang zag rnams/ /sprin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid bstan pa/ /nges don snying po rab gsang yi ge dang / /rgyal sras bla ma'i dngos grub thob byed pa/ /byin 3ma —

me bo'i shulabs las/ klong snyo rab gomasakyi gsung 'bum/()rlabasathugs sgrub shin tu zab mo dang / /tshe gcig rig 'dzin lam la gnas byed pa/ /rig 'dzin mchog sgrub rab tu gsang ba dang / /mchag dang thun mong dngos grub myur bsgrub pa/ /mkha' 'gra'i bskyed rim yid bzhin nor bu dang rdzog ྾rmadrugs za langayod/ /rlang lasa'od gsal skad cig 'grub byed pa/ /rlang sbyor ye shesadra ba dam pa dang / khams kyisa'achi med 'od gsal rab 'grub phyir/ /zab lam bde chen rgya mtsho zhes bya dang / /gsang ba zab mo'i rdzogs rim mngon byung ba/ ye shes 'od gsal 'khar la'i rim pa dang / /gdod ma'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /gzhi snang ngo sprod rab tu gsang ba dang / /mngon sum snying pa'i bas phyung dril ba ni/ /'od gsal sbubs 'jug snying gi man ngag dang / /snang rig ye shes mngan du 'byen byed pa/ /sgon ma bzhi skor mig ltar gsal ba dang / /gang yang lam gyur 'od gsal mdor gcig pa/ /'khrul snang gzhi grol rab tu gcesapa dang / /bag chags nyan mongasamyur du 'gog byed pa/ /rmi lam 'od gsal sbubasa'ajug gdams pa dang / /sems nyid gsang ba'i rang bzhin mngan phyung ba/ /gdod ma'i dbyings snang ngo sprod gsang ba dang / /gang dang mi 'dra gnad rnamasamathar thug spro / /zab don gnad kyi lde mig gsang ba dang / /mngon sum don la yid ches ma nor lam/ /'od gsal pra khrid ri chen gsal ba dang / /nyin mtshan bar do'i gces pa kun dril ba/ /gsang lam ngo sprod snying pa'i mthar thug dang / /nor dang 'byugs med gnad rnamasadril ba'i 'gag /zab don snying po man ngag gsang ba dang / /dpe don rtags kyi —39/—

ma/de 'gro ya/de gi zem bya ga ba/de ljon shi /ngo sprod gsal ba'i lam//kun ཿsa rin ོ gsang ba'i ngo sprod dang //shin tu yang zab snying /de /ded dril ba//bar do sbubs /deg man ngag snying po dang //nyams len gnad kyi gdamasapa mthar thug pa//bar do gnad kyi sgon me /debya dang gan/denasteyalo//zab ga/de babasalugasango mtshar yid /dedon/mthong snang rin ོ 'od kyi dra bas bstan//phyi rabs don du zab /de snying ga7 /de//zhal /des dri med 'od kyis legs par gdamasaspyo7/de kyine+e/de/der /de྾lo//de ltar ma /de bu ni /de bzhi yis//mkha' 'a/de gdams pa shog ser snying po /de /gnad kyi yang gnad mchog tu gsang ba'i gnad///de gsang /de du byung ba'i snying po 'di//gang dang mi 'dra kun gyis mi rtogs pa//bla ma mkha' 'a/de thugs/ded snying po 'di//bdag gi snying ste rab tu phangs pas na//rin /de shog ser ngos la bkod pa ni//bla ma'i bka' rgya mkha' 'a/de ga/de rgya dang //bka' srung dam rgya bden pa'i stson lam rgya//zab /de gnad rgya rgya lngas rgyas ba/de nas//snyeng dang 'dra ba'i bu mchog skal che ba//bla ma la gus shes rab snying brtser ldan//sgrub la brtson /de dam tshig gtsang ba dang /tshe 'di blos ba/de mkha' 'a/de ma/de rtags can//rang dang 'dra ba /deg nas gcig brgyud bya//mang por mi spel des kyang /deg la brgyud//de yang lo gsum bar du brtagasanasasbyin//bla ma mkha'a'agrosalung bstan ma byung na//rdzogs par mi sbyin snying la sa mā ya//gnad res kyang ni tshe /deg grol ba'i chos//rin /de shog ser kho bo'i snying gi snying /9

me /de /de /delas/ klo /de ba /demasakyi gsu /de//dephyo rabs skal ldan dam pas/des par zung //'di 'dra'i gdams pa yang gsang snying /de don//lo gsum nyams blangs 'od lus /deb byed pa//'dzam bu'i gling na dkon pa'i rin po che/mkha' 'a/de gsang tshig dam pa yin pas na///deg pur /des longs sgrub pa mtha' ru skyol//rang 'tshengs ga/de 'tshengs thamasacad rdzogs sangs rgya//de phyir snying bsagaces par 'di zung la//yang mdzod dmar /de nang du rgyas thob cig/rigs lnga'i gsang sgrub pad+ma stong ldan la//phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang rnam bzhis /de//de yis gtso bor rang ba/de sprul sku /deb//rigs lnga'i /de len bdud rtsi'i thigasapa la//snying po lnga dang /des pa'i gnad lnga ste//yang zab /de dril legasapar bstan pa ni//sayi /de len bdud rtsi yang /de dang //chu yi /de len bde /de rgya mtsho dang //me yi /de len bde drod rang 'bar dang //rma gi /de len dpag ba/de ljon shing dang //nam mkha'i /de len ye shesagasang /der te//ma/de dang thun mong dngos grub myur du /deb//gegs sel nad 'don bdud rtsi sprin 4nga la///der lo lnga yisaphyi nang bar /de sel///de ba brtagasabaslu nyi zla gza' bral la//dum bu gnyisakyisarnal /der don ོ /deb//ba/desagrol man ngag rin ོ snying po yis//de nyid don shes rang ga/de phan pa /deb//r+sā drug phran bu ma bzhi sde ོ lngar//rin ོ shog 'dra'i ngosal bkod pa yin//de dag rnamasakyi cha rkyen yan lag tu/khyud ga/de dag la bltos pa med pa'i phyor//ga/de don phrin lasasgrub pa'i rim pa yang //9

mkha' 'gro yang tog gi zem byang dpag bsam ljonashing /sreg sbyong cho ga 'od kyi snye ma yis/ /tshe 'das sku gdung ji ltar bzhu ba bstan/ /gzhan phan 'od kyi stobar lo bzang po yis/ /bar da'i 'gro ba rnams la phan gdags bshad/ /de yi gnad yig phyag rgya bzhi mchad kyis/ /lag len gnad yig ma tshang kha skong bstan/ /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba yis/ /tshwa tshwa'i sgo nas tshogasabasag sgrib sbyong bstan/ /rab gnasacho ga ye shes dri med kyis/ /sku gsung thugs rten rab tu gnasapa bshad/ /mazong snang gser gyi dra ba mig lta bus/ /nyams rtogs gnad dang chas kyi babasatshul la/ /ngo mtshang yid chesarmad byung bskyed pa bstan/ /de ltar ma gsum bu gsum sde tshan drug /rin chen dkar shog bzang po'i ngos la mnan/ /phyi rabs skalaldan dam pa'i rigs can rnams/ /rang gzhan don du spyod cig sa ma ya/ /de ltar zab chas snying pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /mi nub bsrung phyir drag sngags mtshon cha yang / /bka' bsrung sgrub sde so so'i rgyud gzhung las/ /yang zab gnad rnams btso te bstan pa ni/ /slob dpon gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgon mas/ /rnal 'thur bsam pa yid bzhin bsgrubasapasan/ /de yi sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchog tu zab pa'i gnad/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po 'dra ba bshad/ /'jig rten khams na rdzu'aphrul mthu rtsal can/ /kun gyi mchog gyur drang sgong chen po ste/ /snying nye bkra shis dngosasu mthu rtsal 'byung / /de phyir de 'dra kun las 'phags pas na/ /sgob dpon chen po'i bka' bsrung gtso bo yin/ /de yi gsang sgrub dug gi sbu spri bstan/ khyad par gza' bdud khyab —394—

mesapo'i shulabasalas/ 1nga chen rab 'byamasakyi gsung 'bum/(kamajug mig dmar ni/ /sngon byung slob dpon mched yin drag rtsal can/ /snang srid sil bur gtang ba'i mthu mnga' ba/ /chos 'di'i bka' bsrung gnyen po gsang ba ste/ /de yi sgrub thabs me rlung 'khyil pa bstan/ /kun dang mi 'dra gsang ba'i ma mo ni/ /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /e ka tsa ti khros pa'i rnam 'khrul mchag /sgog sgrub nag mo shan pa mi bsrun ma/ /chos 'dis phyir na lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'bral ba med pa rgyun du bsrungasabs na/ kun bzang mkha' 'gro ma mo nyid sprul nas/ /zab chasaskyong mdzad gter srung mnga' gsol ba/ /sgob pon chen pos bka' bsgos bzhag pa'i phyir/ /mchag tu gnyan zhing sgrub pa po la brtse/ /de phyir de yi sgrub thabs gsang ba ni/ /dug mda' nag po zhes bya rab tu bkod/ /'di dag rnams ni 'jigs pa'i gnam lcags 'dra/ /dam tshig ldan la sgrub thag shin tu nye/ /chos 'di'i yi ge gang yod 'di gnas pas/ /ma bsgrubs kyang ni rtag tu srung skyob byed/ /de phyir mchad gtor rgyun du bya ba gces/ khyad par dus gnyan bskang gso mchad par bya/ /tshe dang nor phyug snyan grags skye bo 'du/ /gegasarnams med cing bsam pa yid bzhin 'khrub/ /phran gsum bu ste ma bzhi sde tshan bzhi/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /de ltar yang zab chos kyi rnam grangs kun/ /yongs su dril ba'i chings kyi gal mdo la/ /rin chen dkar shog ma bu ba dgu yang / /rtsa ba'i sde tshan bcu bdun dag tu bsdus/ /rin chen shog 'dra ma bu sum cu yang / /rtsa ba'i sde tshan bcu drug dag tu bsdus/ /rin chen shog ser ma bcu bu ba gsum/ /so —395—

ma 'a 'gro yang tig gi zetshabyang dpag bamasaljon shing /sor dbye na nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ /them byang gnyis dang bsdams pas bdun cu gsum/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig gsang ba'i debs su bstan/ /phyi rabasasnying gi bu ga ga ma gartags pa/ /gzhan la mi bstan mkha' 'ba'i bka' rgya yod/ /e ma ho/ rang byung sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnasakyis/ /bod yul dbusasu zab gter sbasapa la/ /lto ru bskyed rdzogs 'dril ba sdong pa'i skor/ /nub tu gsal ba me tag kha bye 'dra/ /byang du rgyasapa yal 'dab chen po la/ /shar du legs smin 'bras bu bas du dril/ /dbus su zug pa rtsa ba'i skor lnga las/ /'di ni mthar thug 'bras bu'i gter kha ste/ /dgongs gter snying po snying tig mngon sum lam/ tshe gcig 'bras bu 'od lus 'grub par byed/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i zab gter gzhan na med/ /deng song tshe lo lnga ba kha ral dus/ /snga ma'i tshe la dngas lung brag ngosanas/ chu mo glang lor shog ser sgo bye ste/ /rjod byed tshig gi cha tsam dbang bar byas/ /deng song thod rgal longs sku'i zhing nyul dus/ kheng mo yos la mchimasaphur dgongs gter babs/ /brjod bya'i don rnams ma lus snying la shar/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros dngosasu byin brlabs pas/ /tshig don 'dresamed gsang ba'i yi ge rnams/ /rgyal sras bla ma nyid dang mtshungasapasan/ /yi ge 'di rnamasagacesapas snying la phur/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /tshe gcig 'od lus dam pa rab 'grub nas/ /phyam gcig rang bzhin gdod ma'i sar grol r+sha/ the/shā dī / dhi r+shanab dīṭ+wāṃ/deram̐ r+sha dīb dro rdo /sho//nga /rdzurjo / byetram̐ rdobye~X —396—

me bo'i shul bsal / klong chen pa 'grumasakyi gsung 'bum//dbyin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'thur pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so/ /them byang gnyis las/ 'di ni mthar thug gi bu la sbyin pa'o/ /de'ang sgod phal pa la dang po na yod pa bzhin shog ser rnams las sde tshan bdun ma gtags pa/ thams cad yongasasu rdzogs par mi sbyin te bka' rgya yod/ rab mchog snying gi bu gcig la 'di na yod pa thams cad/ them byang 'di rdzogs par sbyin/ yi ge 'di'i nang na yod pa'i chos skor rnams la 'dra min dang ba sa bslad byed pa byung na/ dam tshig gi chad pas dmyal bar lhung zhing / bka' srung gis sgog dang phrol cig/gza' rā hu la/ gnod sbyin dmar nag/rdo rje g.yul sgron/ sgog sgrub nag mo rnams la gtad pas/ thub par srung shig sam ya/ bkra shis/dge'o// //—397—

bka' drin rjes dran/skabs 'dir yang ring mo nas rnam dkar gyi bya ba la ches goms pa'i dad ldan/ sgang mkhar a gnam tshang khyim mi rnam pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas/kun mkhyen ོ d+ku gsung rab ji rnyed kun phyogs spyog tu bsgrigs te/ ngo mtshar par gyi phyi mor bskrun pa'i legs byas la rjes su yi rang drags pos /je/ce /bye :de la sna /re /go /re byebyethugs zhu ba dang 'angs ga /'a las thab pa da ba mthus na bdag 'khar gos gnas skabs nyer 'tshe zhi zhing mthar thug rnam byang bla med 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge bsngo dang smon lam/bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgol bar shog /ces dge btso spron lam snyos su d+kud pa 'di/ ston pa'i skyesarabasalas bas so/ /

dpe khrun pa/ rgyal mo 'brug pa/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mjes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ swā5 ca'i sa/la 'anaka la5/ deb brgya dang bcu gsum pa/dag /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so/ /(8(26)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/tshekrung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin kong dbyi par 'debs tshad yod kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2 09lo'i 12par par sazhi dang po bsgrigs/0 lo 2009lo'i 12par par thengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ ༷ 1/de15 spe2sku978—7—80253—210—6(2 75gsung 'bum cha tshang ( deb 1 — 26yod ) la rin sgor/ 660 00
